opts.w: 利息计算基数错误。即使延迟了三个月，附加给付下的判决后利息也只按保单限额以内的金额（$1,000,000）计算，超出限额的 $1,000,000 本金及其利息均由被保险人自理。

opts.t: All defence costs and court costs are deducted from the $1,000,000 policy limit before paying the plaintiff.
opts.w: 混淆了限额内与限额外的关系。附加给付（supplementary payments）在保单责任限额之外单独提供，不会扣减留着付赔款的 $1,000,000 限额。

main.pt: 承保场所的定义与自动承保地点
main.trap: 场所自动承保边界
main.stem: Under Section II of a Homeowners Policy, which of the following locations is automatically included within the definition of 'premises' without being specifically listed on the Coverage Summary page?
main.zh: 在房主保单第二部分（Section II）下，下列哪个地点无须在保障摘要页（Coverage Summary）上专门列明，即可自动包含在“场所（premises）”的定义之内？

opts.t: A mountainside ski chalet owned by the named insured and used only during winter holidays
opts.w: 属于“场所自动承保边界”陷阱。列名被保险人或其配偶拥有的季节性住所（seasonal residence）必须在保障摘要页（Coverage Summary）上列明才属于承保场所，未列明不会自动承保。

opts.t: A family cemetery plot or burial vault owned by an insured for household members
opts.w: 正确。被保险人拥有的个人或家庭墓地、墓穴（individual or family cemetery plot or burial vault）属于五类免列明即可自动纳入场所（premises）定义的地点之一。

opts.t: An unimproved agricultural field in Canada leased by the insured for growing hay
opts.w: 属于“场所自动承保边界”陷阱。虽然被保险人在加拿大境内拥有或租用的空地（vacant land）自动承保，但条款明确把空置的农地（farmland）除外。

opts.t: A beach house rented by the insured under a continuous lease exceeding 90 days
opts.w: 属于“场所自动承保边界”陷阱。临时居住或使用的非自有场所（premises where the insured is temporarily residing）要求连续租期不超过 90 天，租约超过连续 90 天则不在自动承保范围内。

main.pt: Coverage E 除外责任与例外情形
main.trap: 照管保管控制四因例外
main.stem: In which of the following situations would Coverage E (Legal Liability) of a Homeowners Policy respond to pay for the resulting compensatory damages?
main.zh: 在下列哪种情形中，房主保单的 Coverage E（个人法律责任）会响应并赔付所产生的补偿性赔偿？

opts.t: The insured borrows a neighbour's chainsaw to trim tree branches and drops it, cracking its casing
opts.w: 属于“照管保管控制四因例外”陷阱。借来的工具处于被保险人的照管、保管或控制（care, custody or control）之下，在 Coverage E 下被除外；四因例外仅适用于他人的场所及室内财物，不适用于借用的工具。

opts.t: The insured volunteers to install shelving on a friend's antique bookcase and drills through the side panel
opts.w: 属于 Coverage E 的施工对象除外。因被保险人或他人代其施工（as a result of any work performed on them by you or anyone on your behalf）而损坏的动产或固定装置在 Coverage E 下明确不赔。

opts.t: While renting a vacation chalet, the insured accidentally leaves a faucet running and water damage ruins the owner's floor
opts.w: 正确。虽然租住的度假屋处于被保险人使用或照管（care, custody or control）之下，但对他人拥有的场所及其内财物因火灾、爆炸、水损（water damage）或取暖烹饪设备故障烟熏造成的非故意损害属于该除外的明确例外，只要被保险人负有法律责任，Coverage E 即予赔付。

opts.t: The insured's child living in the same household trips over a garden hose on the insured's lawn and suffers an injury
opts.w: 属于“第一方与第三方混淆”陷阱。被保险人本人及与被保险人同住的任何人（any person residing in your household）的人身伤害在 Coverage E 下被除外（仅住家雇员例外）。

main.pt: Coverage F 自愿医疗给付的范围与除外
main.trap: 第一方与第三方混淆
main.stem: Under Coverage F (Voluntary Medical Payments) of Section II of a Homeowners Policy, which of the following expenses is covered?
main.zh: 在房主保单第二部分（Section II）的 Coverage F（自愿医疗给付）下，下列哪项费用属于承保范围？

opts.t: Ambulance and nursing expenses incurred within one year after a visitor falls on the front steps without the insured's fault
opts.w: 正确。自愿医疗给付（Coverage F – Voluntary Medical Payments）无须证明被保险人负有法律责任或过失，只要他人在承保场所意外受伤或被保险人非故意伤人，保险人即支付自事故之日起 1 年内发生的合理手术、牙科、住院、护理、救护车及丧葬费用。

opts.t: Emergency hospital bills for the named insured's spouse who slips in the insured's kitchen
opts.w: 属于“第一方与第三方混淆”陷阱。Coverage F 从不赔付被保险人本人及与被保险人同住的人（residents of your household，住家雇员除外）的医疗费用。

opts.t: Surgical expenses for an injured guest that have already been paid by a provincial hospitalization plan
opts.w: 属于 Coverage F 除外条款误读。任何其他医疗、牙科、手术或住院计划（medical, dental, surgical or hospitalization plan）已经承担的费用在 Coverage F 下明确不赔。

opts.t: Dental treatment incurred by a neighbour more than one year after being accidentally struck by the insured on the premises
opts.w: 属于“自愿给付年龄与对象限制”中的时间期限陷阱。Coverage F 仅支付自事故发生之日起 1 年内（within one year of the date of the accident）发生的合理医疗费用。

main.pt: Coverage G 自愿财产损害给付与年龄红线
main.trap: 自愿给付年龄与对象限制
main.stem: Which of the following property losses is covered under Coverage G (Voluntary Payment for Damage to Property) of a Homeowners Policy?
main.zh: 在房主保单的 Coverage G（自愿财产损害给付）下，下列哪项财产损失可以获得赔付？

opts.t: The insured's 15-year-old deliberately lets the air out of a neighbour's car tires and breaks the valve stems
opts.w: 陷阱：年龄。Coverage G 对故意损害的例外只到 12 岁及以下（12 years of age or under）；15 岁故意放气弄坏气门嘴不赔。

opts.t: A houseguest's laptop goes missing from the insured's car while the insured is driving the guest to the airport
opts.w: 陷阱：险种范围。Coverage G 明确不赔失踪与被盗（disappearance or theft），也不赔使用损失；丢了的笔记本电脑不在 G 之内。

opts.t: The insured accidentally drops a heavy toolbox onto a glass table owned by a tenant renting the insured's basement
opts.w: 属于“第一方与第三方混淆”陷阱。被保险人或其租客拥有或租用的财产（property owned or rented by an insured or an insured's tenant）在 Coverage G 下明确除外。

opts.t: The insured's 8-year-old, upset after losing a game, deliberately snaps a neighbour's fishing rod in half
opts.w: 正确。Coverage G（自愿财产损害给付）为 12 岁及以下（12 years of age or under）的被保险人故意造成的直接财产损害开了口子：8 岁孩子故意折断邻居的鱼竿可以赔，不要求被保险人负法律责任。

main.pt: 船艇、机动器具与拖车的特别限制
main.trap: 照管保管控制四因例外
main.stem: While on holiday, an insured borrows a friend's motorboat equipped with an inboard engine exceeding 38 kW (50 H.P.) and accidentally collides with another vessel, injuring its passenger and damaging the hull of the borrowed boat. How does Section II of the insured's Homeowners Policy respond?
main.zh: 被保险人在度假期间借用朋友一艘内机功率超过 38 千瓦（50 马力）的机动船，不小心与另一艘船相撞，导致对方船上一名乘客受伤，且借来的船体受损。被保险人房主保单的第二部分（Section II）如何响应？

opts.t: Nothing is covered because the inboard engine exceeds the 38 kW (50 H.P.) automatic limit
opts.w: 混淆了自有船艇与非自有船艇的规则。38 kW（50 H.P.）上限仅针对被保险人自己拥有的船艇；对于非自有船艇（non-owned watercraft），不论类型和马力大小，其对第三方造成的责任均受保。

opts.t: Liability for the passenger's injury and the other vessel is covered, but damage to the borrowed boat itself is excluded
opts.w: 正确。使用或操作任何非自有船艇（non-owned watercraft）对他人造成的伤害和财物损坏不论马力大小均受保；但借来的那条船本身处于被保险人的照管、保管或控制（care, custody or control）之下，其自身损坏在 Coverage E 下不赔。

opts.t: Both the damage to the borrowed boat and the injury to the passenger are fully covered under Coverage E
opts.w: 属于“照管保管控制四因例外”陷阱。借来的船艇本身属于被保险人使用或照管（care, custody or control）下的动产，不在“他人场所四因例外”之内，船体本身的损坏在 Coverage E 下不赔。

opts.t: Only the repair of the borrowed boat is covered, while the passenger's injury must be claimed under marine insurance
opts.w: 把承保范围完全颠倒了。非自有船艇对第三方的伤害由房主保单第二部分赔付，而借来的船本身的损坏因照管、保管或控制（care, custody or control）除外而不赔。

main.pt: 经营活动除外与六项自动承保例外
main.trap: 自愿给付年龄与对象限制
main.stem: According to the standard Homeowners Policy wording tested on the exam, business pursuits are excluded under Section II EXCEPT for temporary or part-time business pursuits of an insured person who is under what age?
main.zh: 根据考试所考查的标准房主保单条款措辞，第二部分将经营活动除外，但未满多少岁的被保险人所从事的临时或兼职经营活动属于自动承保的例外？

opts.t: Under the age of 21
opts.w: 正确。经营活动六项例外（business pursuits exceptions）规定，未满 21 岁（under the age of 21）的被保险人从事的临时或兼职经营活动（如当保姆、送报纸）仍在个人责任承保范围内。虽然 BC《Age of Majority Act》自 1970 年起将法定成年年龄定为 19 岁，但保单条款属于合同且考试口径一律按示范条款原文的未满 21 岁作答。

opts.t: Under the age of 12
opts.w: 属于“自愿给付年龄与对象限制”数字张冠李戴陷阱。12 岁及以下（12 years of age or under）是 Coverage G 赔付未成年人故意损坏他人财产的年龄上限，不是兼职经营活动例外的年龄。

opts.t: Under the age of 16
opts.w: 属于数字记忆混淆陷阱。16 是自有舷外机船艇自动承保的马力数（12 kW / 16 H.P.），示范条款中兼职经营活动例外的年龄红线是未满 21 岁。

opts.t: Under the age of 25
opts.w: 属于数字记忆混淆陷阱。25 是自走式割草机或园艺拖拉机自动承保的马力数（19 kW / 25 H.P.），兼职经营活动例外的年龄是未满 21 岁。

main.pt: 企业 CGL 七大风险与专业责任区分
main.trap: 商业与专业责任错位
main.stem: A plumbing contractor finishes installing a new water heater in a customer's home and leaves after the job is accepted. Later, a poorly soldered pipe joint bursts and floods the customer's basement. Under a Commercial General Liability (CGL) policy, which hazard covers this claim?
main.zh: 一名水管承包商在客户家中安装完新热水器并验收离场。事后，一处焊接不良的管接头爆裂，淹没了客户的地下室。在商业综合责任险（CGL）保单下，这一索赔属于哪种风险保障？

opts.t: Premises and operations liability
opts.w: 属于“商业与专业责任错位”陷阱。经营作业责任（premises and operations）保的是活正在干的时候（while work is in progress）发生的伤害或损害；本案在完工交付以后才出事，不属于经营作业。

opts.t: Products liability
opts.w: 属于“商业与专业责任错位”陷阱。产品责任（products liability）针对的是被保险人卖出去的物品（things sold by the insured）本身缺陷致害，而承包商做完的安装活交付后因施工缺陷出事属于完工作业。

opts.t: Completed operations liability
opts.w: 正确。完工作业责任（completed operations liability）专门承保被保险人完成的工作在交付使用后（after the work has been completed and handed over）因施工质量问题造成的第三方人身伤害或财产损害。

opts.t: Errors and omissions (E&O)
opts.w: 属于“商业与专业责任错位”陷阱。错漏责任险（E&O）承保会计师、律师、建筑师、保险经纪人等提供咨询和意见的专业人士，水管承包商完工后的物理水损归 CGL 的完工作业责任保障。

main.pt: 个人A&S四特征与不可抗辩期例外
main.trap: 欺诈与年龄误报后果对调
main.stem: An individual disability income policy has been in force for more than two years when the insurer discovers while reviewing a claim that the insured accidentally misstated their age on the original application, and also still owes an overdue renewal premium. How should the insurer handle this claim?
main.zh: 一份个人失能收入保单生效已超过两年，保险人在审核理赔时发现被保险人在原投保书上无意报错了年龄，且仍欠缴一笔逾期保费。保险人应如何处理该理赔？

opts.t: Void the policy immediately because any misstatement discovered during a claim invalidates the contract regardless of when the policy took effect
opts.w: 掉入『欺诈与年龄误报后果对调』陷阱。只有欺诈陈述（fraudulent misrepresentation）或合同生效时缺乏可保利益（insurable interest）才会导致合同无效，年龄误报（misstatement of age）不会使合同无效。

opts.t: Pay the full stated benefit without adjustment because the two-year incontestability period bars the insurer from changing benefits or collecting overdue premiums
opts.w: 错误理解不可抗辩期（incontestability）的范围。两年不可抗辩期明确将欺诈陈述和年龄误报列为例外，且保险人依法有权从赔款中扣除欠缴保费（unpaid premium）。

opts.t: Keep the policy in force, adjust the benefits or premiums to reflect the insured's true age, and deduct the unpaid premium from the claim payment
opts.w: 符合个人意外与疾病保险（Accident and Sickness Insurance, A&S）合同特征：年龄误报（misstatement of age）是两年不可抗辩期（incontestability）的法定例外，处理方式是按真实年龄调整给付或保费而非宣告合同无效；同时欠缴保费可从理赔款中直接扣除。

opts.t: Suspend the claim until the insured obtains written consent from a family member and pays an administrative penalty on the overdue premium
opts.w: 混淆了可保利益（insurable interest）中的书面同意规则。个人对自己本就有可保利益，无需亲属书面同意，合同中也无行政罚金规定。

main.pt: 个人失能险定价因素与保单类型
main.trap: 等待期与失能定义对保费方向反记
main.stem: A self-employed graphic designer wants to lower the premium on a new individual disability income policy while also understanding how insurers adjust rates on cancellable versus non-cancellable contracts. Which combination of policy choices and contract rules is accurate?
main.zh: 一位自雇平面设计师希望降低新购个人失能收入保单的保费，同时想了解保险人在可注销与不可注销合同上如何调整费率。下列哪项关于投保选择与合同规则的组合是正确的？

opts.t: Choose a shorter elimination period and an own-occupation definition; under a cancellable policy, the insurer may raise the rate of a single policyholder who files frequent claims
opts.w: 掉入『等待期与失能定义对保费方向反记』陷阱。等待期（elimination period）越短、选择本职业（own occupation）定义，保费都会越贵；且可注销保单加费只能针对整类（class）被保险人，不能单挑个人。

opts.t: Choose a longer elimination period, a shorter benefit period, and an any-occupation definition; under a non-cancellable policy, premiums are guaranteed to age 65 and cannot be changed
opts.w: 等待期（elimination period）越长、给付期（benefit period）越短、失能定义越窄如任何职业（any occupation），理赔成本越低，保费就越便宜；同时不可注销（non-cancellable）保单的续保保费保证到 65 岁，保险人不能更改。

opts.t: Choose a longer benefit period and a shorter elimination period; under a non-cancellable policy, the insurer may increase premiums across an entire occupation class at renewal
opts.w: 掉入方向反记与保单类型混淆陷阱。更长的给付期（benefit period）和更短的等待期会推高保费；按整类被保险人在续保时加费是可注销保单的做法，不可注销（non-cancellable）保单不能改保费。

opts.t: Choose an own-occupation definition and a shorter benefit period; insurers generally offer lower rates to applicants over age 60 because illness claims decrease with age
opts.w: 违背失能统计与核保规则。本职业（own occupation）定义最宽、保费最高；且年纪越大因疾病（sickness）失能的概率越高，保险人一般不给 60 岁以上的人提供 A&S 保障。

main.pt: 失能定义三档与给付终止条件
main.trap: 等待期与失能定义对保费方向反记
main.stem: A concert violinist injures a hand in a domestic accident and can no longer play the violin, but soon takes a well-paid position teaching music appreciation at a college. Under which definition of disability will the violinist continue to receive full disability income benefits, and when do benefits generally end?
main.zh: 一位交响乐团小提琴家在家中意外伤了手，再也无法拉小提琴，但很快在大学找到一份收入不错的音乐鉴赏教职。在哪种失能定义下，这位小提琴家仍能继续获得全额失能收入给付？给付通常在何时停止？

opts.t: Own occupation definition; benefits continue after the elimination period until recovery, death, or the end of the benefit period, whichever comes first
opts.w: 本职业（own occupation）定义最宽：只要无法履行本职业的重要职责，即使转去做别的工作也照样全额给付；给付在等待期（elimination period）满后开始，直至康复、身故或给付期（benefit period）结束三者中的先到者为止。

opts.t: Any occupation definition; benefits continue after the elimination period until recovery, death, or the end of the benefit period, whichever comes last
opts.w: 掉入『等待期与失能定义对保费方向反记』陷阱。任何职业（any occupation）定义最窄，只要能做任何与教育、培训、经验或收入相称的工作就不给付；且终止条件看三者中的先到者（whichever comes first），不是最后到者。

opts.t: Any occupation definition; benefits continue in full as long as the insured's new teaching salary stays below the policy's insurable earnings limit
opts.w: 混淆了任何职业（any occupation）定义与可保收入上限。在任何职业定义下，既然该小提琴家已能从事与其教育经验和收入相称的大学教学工作，给付即停止。

opts.t: Own occupation definition; benefits continue after the elimination period only until the insured starts earning income from any alternative employment
opts.w: 违背本职业（own occupation）的核心规则：在本职业定义下，即便被保险人已经在从事其他工作，保单在等待期满后依然全额给付。

main.pt: 团体失能险起付期与离职终止
main.trap: 工伤与非工伤及团体周给付起付日混淆
main.stem: An employee covered under an employer's group insurance plan misses a couple of days of work due to a common flu, and later resigns from the company. How does the group weekly indemnity and disability coverage apply to these two events?
main.zh: 一名参加雇主团体保险计划的雇员因普通流感请假两天，随后从公司辞职。团体周给付及失能保障如何适用于这两件事？

opts.t: Weekly indemnity pays from the first day of the flu, and disability coverage continues for two years after resignation under the incontestability rule
opts.w: 掉入『工伤与非工伤及团体周给付起付日混淆』陷阱。团体周给付（weekly indemnity）只对事故从第 1 天起付，对疾病要从第 4、8 或 15 天起付；且团体失能保障在离职时自动终止。

opts.t: Weekly indemnity does not pay for the brief flu absence, and long term disability coverage automatically converts to an individual policy at the employer's expense upon resignation
opts.w: 前半句正确，但后半句错误：团体计划（group insurance）的失能保障在雇佣关系结束时自动终止，不会由雇主出资自动转为个人保单。

opts.t: Weekly indemnity pays 90% of net earnings for the brief flu absence, and coverage ends immediately when employment terminates
opts.w: 混淆了工伤计划与团体周给付。团体周给付（weekly indemnity）对疾病从第 4、8 或 15 天才开始给付，专门为了排除感冒、流感这种几天就好的小病。

opts.t: Weekly indemnity does not pay for the brief flu absence because sickness benefits begin on the 4th, 8th, or 15th day, and disability coverage terminates automatically when employment ends
opts.w: 团体周给付（weekly indemnity）属于短期保障（13、26 或 52 周），事故从第 1 天起付，疾病按计划从第 4、8 或 15 天起付，不赔几天即愈的感冒流感；且团体失能保障在雇佣关系结束时自动终止。

main.pt: 工伤计划给付范围与考试口径
main.trap: 工伤与非工伤及团体周给付起付日混淆
main.stem: A bakery employee suffers severe burns while operating a commercial oven at work and is temporarily disabled. Under the rules tested on the exam for provincial workers' compensation plans, how are premiums funded, what are the employee's legal rights against the employer, and how is temporary disability income calculated?
main.zh: 一名烘焙店雇员在工作中操作商用烤箱时严重烫伤并暂时失能。按照省工伤计划的考试口径，保费由谁承担、雇员对雇主有什么法律权利、临时失能收入如何计算？

opts.t: Premiums are paid solely by employers; the employee receives no-fault benefits and gives up the right to sue the employer; temporary disability pays 90% of net earnings
opts.w: 工伤计划（workers' compensation）保费只由雇主支付，提供无过错给付（no fault benefits），受伤雇员放弃起诉雇主的权利（因此无痛苦赔偿），临时失能按雇员净收入（net earnings）的 90% 给付。按考试口径答净收入的 90%（且考试资料讲某些行业雇主强制参加），而 BC 实务现行虽同样按净收入 90% 计，但另有年度最高可保工资封顶及按雇主或家政工时门槛判定登记。

opts.t: Premiums are split equally between employer and employee; the employee may sue the employer for pain and suffering in addition to receiving 90% of gross earnings
opts.w: 三处均错：工伤计划保费只由雇主付（雇员不付）；雇员不起诉雇主、没有法院判的痛苦赔偿；临时失能按净收入（net earnings）而非毛收入的 90% 计算。

opts.t: Premiums are paid solely by employers; benefits begin after an 8-day waiting period and also cover car accidents on the employee's commute home
opts.w: 掉入『工伤与非工伤及团体周给付起付日混淆』陷阱。工伤计划从失能第 1 天起付，且下班回家路上的车祸不属于工作相关事故，工伤计划不赔。

opts.t: Premiums are paid by the employee through payroll deduction; the plan covers both occupational injuries and naturally occurring illnesses at 90% of net earnings
opts.w: 掉入『工伤与非工伤及团体周给付起付日混淆』陷阱。雇员不付工伤保费，且工伤计划在疾病方面只管职业病（industrial disease），不管自然发生的疾病。

main.pt: 旅行险定价因素与受供养子女既往症
main.trap: 旅行险定价因素混入交通方式与受供养子女误判
main.stem: A couple is purchasing a family travel insurance policy for a vacation outside their province. Which factor is NOT used by insurers to determine the travel policy premium, and which family member qualifies as a dependant child under standard travel insurance provisions?
main.zh: 一对夫妇正在为出省度假购买家庭旅行保险。保险人在厘定旅行保单保费时不使用下列哪项因素？根据常见的旅行险条款，哪位家庭成员符合受供养子女的资格？

opts.t: Travel destination is not a pricing factor; an unmarried 27-year-old unemployed child living with and fully supported by the parents qualifies as a dependant child
opts.w: 掉入『旅行险定价因素混入交通方式与受供养子女误判』陷阱。旅行地区（travel destination）是重要定价因素；而 27 岁且非身心障碍的子女已超过 26 岁上限，不算受供养子女（dependant child）。

opts.t: Mode of transportation is not a pricing factor; an unmarried child under age 26 attending an accredited university and fully supported by the parents qualifies as a dependant child
opts.w: 旅行险定价考虑个人或家庭计划、单次或年度、行程次数、行程长短、旅行地区、保单限额、年龄与健康，不看交通方式（mode of transportation）；受供养子女（dependant child）上限为未满 20 岁，或在认证教育机构就读的未满 26 岁（未婚、同住且全额供养），身心障碍者不限年龄。

opts.t: Age and health of the insured are not pricing factors; any child under age 26 qualifies as a dependant child regardless of school enrolment or marital status
opts.w: 年龄与健康（age and health）是旅行险的核心定价因素；且年满 20 岁但未满 26 岁的子女必须未婚、同住、全额供养并在认证教育机构就读才符合受供养子女定义。

opts.t: Duration of the trip is not a pricing factor; a 27-year-old child working full-time and living with the parents qualifies as a dependant child
opts.w: 行程长短（duration of trip）直接影响保费（单次最长 180 天，年度每次可选 30／60／90／180 天）；27 岁全职工作未在读的子女已超过 20／26 岁上限，不符合受供养子女条件。

main.pt: 旅行险行程取消中断与常见除外
main.trap: 行程取消与行程中断及除外边界颠倒
main.stem: Four travellers file claims under their travel insurance policies for events occurring during a trip outside the province. Based on common travel insurance exclusions and ancillary coverages, which claim is covered?
main.zh: 四名旅客因出省旅途中发生的事件向各自的旅行保险保单索赔。根据旅行险常见除外责任与附带保障，哪一项索赔会获得赔付？

opts.t: Emergency hospital and medical charges for routine childbirth occurring within eight weeks before the insured's expected delivery date during a normal pregnancy
opts.w: 踩中常见除外：预产期前 8 周内（within 8 weeks of the expected delivery date）的妊娠、流产或分娩，以及任何高风险妊娠，均属旅行险除外责任。

opts.t: Emergency medical treatment and hospital care for a broken collarbone sustained while competing for prize money in a professional snowboarding tournament
opts.w: 掉入『行程取消与行程中断及除外边界颠倒』陷阱。参加职业体育（professional sports）或危险活动（hazardous activities）属于旅行险常见除外。

opts.t: Emergency hospital care and non-refundable prepaid travel expenses up to policy limits under trip interruption after sudden severe food poisoning midway through a tour
opts.w: 旅途中突然发生的严重食物中毒符合紧急情况（emergency：保险期内突然发生、不可预见、需要立即治疗的健康问题）定义，且因为已经出发，半途住院导致的不可退预付旅费、酒店康复及返程费用属于行程中断（trip interruption）在限额内承保的范围。

opts.t: Reimbursement of non-refundable prepaid cruise tickets under trip cancellation coverage after the insured fractures a leg midway through the ocean voyage
opts.w: 掉入『行程取消与行程中断及除外边界颠倒』陷阱。行程取消险（trip cancellation）只在出发日之前（prior to departure）起作用；出发后在航程途中受伤中断行程属于行程中断（trip interruption），不是行程取消。

main.pt: 75/25合并驾驶因子与亲属雇员限制
main.trap: 合并因子 25% 误取最优或乱拉低
main.stem: Nadia is the principal driver on an Autoplan policy with a driver factor of 1.000. Which of the following listed-driver changes would result in a combined driver factor that is LOWER than Nadia's individual factor of 1.000?
main.zh: Nadia 是一份 Autoplan 保单的主驾，其个人驾驶因子为 1.000。下列哪项列名驾驶人变动会使保单的合并驾驶因子低于 Nadia 个人的 1.000？

opts.t: Listing her brother, who has a driver factor of 0.700, and her newly licensed son, who has a driver factor of 1.250
opts.w: 掉入“合并因子 25% 误取最优”陷阱：列有多名额外驾驶人时，合并驾驶因子（[combined driver factor]）的 25% 取的是风险最高（[highest-risk]）的那位列名者（儿子 1.250），而不是因子最好的哥哥（0.700），结果会高于 1.000。

opts.t: Listing only her next-door neighbour, who borrows the car on weekends and has a driver factor of 0.650
opts.w: 掉入“合并因子乱拉低”陷阱：虽然邻居的驾驶因子（[driver factor]）比主驾（[principal driver]）好，但规则明确规定只有投保人的家庭成员（[family member]）或雇员（[employee]）才能把合并因子拉低，邻居不能用来压低保费。

opts.t: Listing only her spouse, who regularly drives the family car and has an individual driver factor of 0.720
opts.w: 正确：当保单除主驾（[principal driver]）外只列配偶一人时，合并驾驶因子（[combined driver factor]）按 75% 主驾（1.000）加 25% 配偶（0.720）计算；因为配偶属于家庭成员（[family member]），其更低的个人因子可以把合并因子拉低至 1.000 以下。

opts.t: Listing only her household roommate, who is not related to her or employed by her and has a driver factor of 0.680
opts.w: 掉入“合并因子乱拉低”陷阱：无亲属或雇佣关系的室友既非家庭成员（[family member]）也非雇员（[employee]），即使其个人因子低于 1.000，系统也不会允许用他的名字把合并因子拉低。

main.pt: 事故宽免门槛与新居民记录规则
main.trap: 考试口径与实务混用或省外记录误计
main.stem: Under the rules tested on the exam, which of the following drivers qualifies for crash forgiveness so that a single chargeable claim will not increase their driver factor?
main.zh: 按照考试口径，下列哪位驾驶人符合事故宽免条件，从而使一次有责理赔不会推高其驾驶因子？

opts.t: A driver with 20 years of driving experience in British Columbia and no chargeable claims during the past 10-year scan period
opts.w: 正确：按考试口径，事故宽免（[crash forgiveness]）要求在 BC 驾驶至少 20 年，且在最近 10 年扫描期（[scan period]）内没有造成有责理赔（[chargeable claim]），即可宽免一次有责事故。（注：本题按考试口径作答；ICBC 现行规定为总驾龄满 20 年且其中至少 10 年在 BC。）

opts.t: A new resident who drove accident-free for 22 years outside the province before obtaining a British Columbia licence last year
opts.w: 掉入“省外驾龄直接抵满宽免”陷阱：按考试口径须在 BC 驾驶满 20 年（即便按现行实务也须至少 10 年在 BC），刚拿 BC 驾照一年的新居民（[new resident]）不符合事故宽免条件。

opts.t: A driver who has 15 years of driving experience in British Columbia and has remained claim-free since March 1, 2017
opts.w: 掉入“15 年与 20 年数字张冠李戴”陷阱：15 年是 ICBC 核查新居民抵达前省外驾照记录的年数，而事故宽免（[crash forgiveness]）要求 20 年驾龄。

opts.t: A driver who has 25 years of driving experience in British Columbia and had one chargeable claim 6 years ago
opts.w: 掉入“忽略 10 年无事故扫描期”陷阱：虽然 BC 驾龄超过 20 年，但 6 年前已有一次有责理赔（[chargeable claim]），不满足最近 10 年扫描期（[scan period]）内无事故的前提。

main.pt: Enhanced Care诉权与责任
main.trap: 误以为无过失等于不认定事故责任
main.stem: While driving on a highway in British Columbia after May 1, 2021, a visiting tourist from Washington State is injured in a collision caused by a careless BC motorist. Which statement accurately describes how Enhanced Care applies to this situation?
main.zh: 2021 年 5 月 1 日之后，一位来自华盛顿州的游客在 BC 公路上驾车时，被一名粗心的 BC 驾车人撞伤。下列哪项准确描述了 Enhanced Care 对该情形的适用？

opts.t: Because the injured person is a non-resident, they retain the full tort right to sue the at-fault BC driver in court for bodily injury and pain and suffering
opts.w: 掉入“非居民不受诉讼限制”陷阱：BC 自 2021-05-01 起实施的加强照护制度（[Enhanced Care]）对针对肇事司机（[at-fault driver]）的人身伤害、死亡和车损诉讼限制，对 BC 居民和非居民同样适用。

opts.t: The tourist is generally barred from suing for bodily injury, while ICBC still assigns fault for vehicle damage and the BC driver's factor
opts.w: 正确：在加强照护制度（[Enhanced Care]）这一无过失制（[no-fault]）框架下，居民与非居民原则上都不能就人身伤害起诉肇事司机（[at-fault driver]）；但“无过失”只代表不打官司，ICBC 仍要认定责任比例以决定车损赔付、驾驶因子升降及是否收 UDAP。

opts.t: Because British Columbia uses a no-fault system, ICBC no longer assigns fault percentages to either driver after a highway collision
opts.w: 掉入“无过失等于不分对错”陷阱：无过失制（[no-fault]）是指取消诉权、不问过错发放医疗康复给付，但 ICBC 依然会认定事故责任比例。

opts.t: Only innocent victims receive medical and rehabilitation benefits under Enhanced Care, while the at-fault BC driver is excluded from care benefits
opts.w: 掉入“肇事者无医疗给付”陷阱：在无过失制（[no-fault]）与加强照护制度（[Enhanced Care]）下，受害人和肇事人都能不问过错拿到广泛的照护与康复给付。

main.pt: 里程与长者等六类折扣资格
main.trap: 两档里程折扣的险种与公里数张冠李戴
main.stem: Liam renews his 12-month Autoplan policy on his passenger car and submits a mechanic's invoice from 4 days ago showing he drove exactly 7,200 km over the past year. Under the rules tested on the exam, which mileage discount does Liam qualify for?
main.zh: Liam 为其私家车续保 12 个月的 Autoplan 保单，并提交了 4 天前修车行的收据，显示过去一年实际行驶了 7,200 公里。按照考试口径，Liam 符合哪项里程折扣？

opts.t: Only the 10% Low-Kilometre discount on Autoplan Basic coverage, with no Optional coverage discount
opts.w: 掉入“两档里程折扣险种与公里数张冠李戴”陷阱：低里程折扣（[Low-Kilometre discount]）要求年保单且年行驶里程少于 5,000 km 才能减基本险 10%，7,200 km 超过了 5,000 km 门槛，反而是可选险可享按距离折扣。

opts.t: Both the 10% Basic Low-Kilometre discount and the 10–15% Optional Distance-Based discount
opts.w: 掉入“超 5,000 km 仍享双折扣”陷阱：只有年里程少于 5,000 km 的人才能同时拿满基本险低里程折扣和可选险按距离折扣；7,200 km 只够得上后一项。

opts.t: Neither mileage discount, because odometer proof must be a photo taken on the exact day of renewal
opts.w: 掉入“凭证形式与天数误判”陷阱：7 天内的修车行收据（含实际读数）属于合格的里程凭证，不必非得是续保当天拍的照片。

opts.t: Only the 10–15% Distance-Based discount on eligible Optional coverages, with no Basic discount
opts.w: 正确：按考试口径，年保单且年里程少于 10,000 km（本题为 7,200 km）并提交 7 天内实际里程凭证，可享可选险 10–15% 的按距离折扣（[Distance-Based discount]），但因超过 5,000 km 不享基本险 10% 的低里程折扣。（注：本题按考试口径 <10,000 km 作答；ICBC 自 2025-06-01 起现行规定已将续保门槛放宽至 <15,000 km。）

main.pt: UDAP触发条件与15倍封顶计算
main.trap: 未列名驾驶人出事怪错人或漏算上限
main.stem: Tariq lends his car to an unlisted friend who holds a BC driver's licence. The friend causes a collision for which ICBC pays a claim, and Tariq's policy does not have Unlisted Driver Protection (UDP). Tariq paid $1,000 for Basic and $350 for Optional coverage. Had the friend been listed, the premiums would have been $1,200 for Basic and $450 for Optional. Under the rules tested on the exam, what happens to Tariq's driver factor and how much is his Unlisted Driver Accident Premium (UDAP)?
main.zh: Tariq 把车借给一位持 BC 驾照但未列名的朋友。朋友造成了一起碰撞且 ICBC 实际赔付了款项，而 Tariq 的保单没有未列名驾驶人保障（UDP）。Tariq 实际付了基本险 $1,000、可选险 $350；要是当初把朋友列名，应付基本险 $1,200、可选险 $450。按照考试口径，Tariq 的驾驶因子会怎样变化，且他应付多少未列名驾驶人事故附加费（UDAP）？

opts.t: Tariq's driver factor is unaffected; he owes a UDAP of $3,900
opts.w: 正确：未列名驾驶人（[unlisted driver]）出有责事故，记录挂在当时开车的朋友名下，车主 Tariq 的驾驶因子（[driver factor]）不受影响。计算未列名驾驶人事故附加费（[Unlisted Driver Accident Premium (UDAP)]）：基本险差额 $200 × 15 = $3,000（未超 $5,000 上限）；可选险差额 $100 × 15 = $1,500，但按考试口径可选险部分上限为“列名时应付可选险保费的 2 倍”（2 × $450 = $900），故取 $900；合计 $3,000 + $900 = $3,900。（注：本题按考试口径“应付可选保费 2 倍”作答；现行附录措辞为已付保费的 2 倍。）

opts.t: Tariq's driver factor is unaffected; he owes a UDAP of $4,500
opts.w: 掉入“漏算可选险 2 倍封顶上限”陷阱：直接把可选险差额 $100 × 15 = $1,500 加进去了，忘了可选险部分有“列名时应付可选保费 2 倍”（2 × $450 = $900）的封顶上限。

opts.t: Tariq's driver factor increases at renewal; he owes a UDAP of $3,900
opts.w: 掉入“未列名驾驶人出事怪错车主”陷阱：未列名者造成的有责理赔记在出事时开车的司机名下，车主自己的记录、因子和续保保费不受影响。

opts.t: Tariq's driver factor is unaffected; he owes a UDAP of $3,700
opts.w: 掉入“考试口径与实务口径混用”陷阱：$3,700 是把可选险上限按“实际已付可选保费 $350 的 2 倍（$700）”计算得出的，而考试口径明确规定按“列名时应付可选保费（$450）的 2 倍（$900）”封顶。

main.pt: 三类省别制度与私营超额保障范围
main.trap: 省别制度与私营可售范围越界
main.stem: A resident of Kamloops wants $2,000,000 in third-party liability coverage and a lower collision deductible than the minimum offered by ICBC. How do British Columbia's auto insurance rules govern where the resident can buy these coverages?
main.zh: 一位住在 Kamloops 的居民想要 $2,000,000 的第三方责任险，并且想要比 ICBC 最低档还低的碰撞险免赔额。BC 的车险规则如何规定这位居民可以在哪里购买这些保障？

opts.t: Autoplan Basic, the extended third-party liability, and the lower collision deductible can all be bought as one package from a private insurer
opts.w: 掉入“私营公司能打包卖基本险”陷阱：在 BC 这一政府强制车险省，基本险（[Autoplan Basic]）由 ICBC 独家垄断销售，私营保险公司只能卖超额保障（[excess coverage]），不能连基本险一起打包出售。

opts.t: Autoplan Basic must come from ICBC, extended third-party liability from ICBC or a private insurer, and the lower deductible from a private insurer
opts.w: 正确：基本险（[Autoplan Basic]）只能向 ICBC 买；私营保险公司只能卖三样超额保障（[excess coverage]）（加高第三方责任、加强无保险/保额不足驾驶人保障、自车损失险），其中加高责任险在 ICBC 或私营公司都能买，但比 ICBC 更低的车损免赔额只有私营公司提供。

opts.t: Autoplan Basic and all collision coverage must come exclusively from ICBC, while only excess third-party liability may come from a private insurer
opts.w: 掉入“把自车损失险排除在私营可售范围外”陷阱：自车损失险（含碰撞险）属于 BC 私营公司获准销售的三样超额保障（[excess coverage]）之一，并非只能向 ICBC 购买。

opts.t: Autoplan Basic and extended liability may come from ICBC, and ICBC can also issue the lower deductible with Utilities Commission (BCUC) approval
opts.w: 掉入“BCUC 职能乱套”陷阱：BC 公用事业委员会（[BCUC]）负责监管 ICBC 的基本险费率并禁止交叉补贴（[cross-subsidization]），并不为个别投保人审批更低的可选险免赔额；更低免赔额只能去私营公司买。

main.pt: 保费调整因子与新居民30天登记
main.trap: rate class 与 rate group 混为一谈
main.stem: Which combination accurately pairs an Autoplan Basic premium adjustment factor with the way ICBC applies it?
main.zh: 下列哪项组合准确配对了 Autoplan 基本险保费的调整因子及其适用方式？

opts.t: Rate group — adjusts the Autoplan Basic premium according to whether the vehicle is driven for pleasure or commercial delivery
opts.w: 掉入“rate class 与 rate group 混为一谈”陷阱：按车辆用途（休闲或商业送货）调整基本险保费的是费率类别（[rate class]）；rate group 是按车型赔付率、维修成本等分组来调自车损失险保费的。

opts.t: Territory — assigns a passenger car based on where it is normally driven, and a taxi or bus based on where it is garaged overnight
opts.w: 掉入“地区归属规则颠倒”陷阱：在 14 个省内地区加省外 Z 区的地区（[territory]）划分中，私家车和摩托车按停放地归区，出租车和巴士才按通常行驶的地区归区。

opts.t: Rate class — adjusts Basic premium by vehicle use across over 150 classes, with commercial use costing more than pleasure use
opts.w: 正确：基本险保费在统一的基础保费（[base premium]）之上，受地区（[territory]）、费率类别（[rate class]）和驾驶人记录三个调整因子影响；其中 rate class 反映车辆用途，共 150 多种，商用一般比纯休闲用途贵。

opts.t: Demographic factor — adjusts the Autoplan Basic premium according to the principal driver's age, gender, and marital status
opts.w: 掉入“虚构人口统计定价因子”陷阱：ICBC 制度的一大好处正是费率不按年龄、性别、婚姻状况定，只按驾驶经验与事故记录定价。

main.pt: EAB收入替代计算与给付顺位
main.trap: EAB收入替代基数与顺位陷阱
main.stem: Elena, a BC resident employed full-time as a lab technologist, earns an annual gross salary of $80,000 and takes home $60,000 in net income after taxes. She is injured in a highway collision in BC and is unable to work for several months. She also has a short-term disability plan through her employer. How does the Income Replacement benefit under Enhanced Accident Benefits (EAB) respond?
main.zh: Elena 是一名全职担任实验室技术员的 BC 居民，税前毛年薪为 $80,000，税后净收入为 $60,000。她在 BC 公路的一起碰撞事故中受伤，数月无法工作。她同时享有雇主提供的短期伤残计划。加强意外给付（EAB）下的收入替代给付将如何响应？

opts.t: It is based on 90% of her $80,000 gross income, starts on the first day after the crash, and pays before her employer disability plan.
opts.w: 错误。掉入了“EAB收入替代基数与顺位陷阱”：收入替代（Income Replacement）按税后净收入（net income）而非毛收入（gross income）的 90% 计算，从事故后第 8 天而非第 1 天起付，且排在雇主伤残计划之后。

opts.t: It pays 90% of her $60,000 net income ($54,000 annualized), begins on the eighth day after the crash, and pays after her employer disability plan.
opts.w: 正确。在加强意外给付（Enhanced Accident Benefits, EAB）下，收入替代（Income Replacement）按税后净收入的 90% 计算（90% × $60,000 = $54,000/年），从事故后第 8 天起付，并排在雇主伤残计划、WorkSafeBC 和 EI 之后赔付。（注：考试口径只考“90% × 净收入”这一条算法，而 BC 现行规定为 90% 净收入与平均毛周薪 75% 两条取大。）

opts.t: It is based on 75% of her $60,000 net income, begins on the fourteenth day after the accident, and is reduced by her percentage of fault.
opts.w: 错误。比例和起付日均错误，且 EAB 对 BC 居民实行不问过错（no-fault）原则，不会因投保人在事故中的过错比例而削减收入替代金额。

opts.t: It pays a flat lump-sum settlement from the Permanent Impairment schedule on the eighth day, replacing all employer disability benefits.
opts.w: 错误。混淆了永久伤残（Permanent Impairment）与收入替代：按附表一次性给付（lump-sum payment）是永久伤残的规则，而收入替代是针对因伤无法工作期间的持续收入补偿，且排在雇主计划之后。

main.pt: 第三方责任诉讼限制例外与限额
main.trap: 反向责任与车库人员绝对化表述
main.stem: A commercial truck registered in BC with a gross vehicle weight exceeding 5,000 kg is hauling retail freight for hire (not dangerous goods). The driver loses control on a BC highway and crashes into a roadside bakery, destroying the building facade and forcing the shop to close for three weeks. Under the truck's Basic Autoplan Third-Party Liability (TPL) coverage, how are the bakery owner's claims handled?
main.zh: 一辆在 BC 登记、总重超过 5,000 kg 的商用卡车正在收费承运零售货物（非危险品）。司机在 BC 公路上失控，撞进路边一家面包店，毁了门面，店被迫停业三周。按这辆卡车的 Autoplan 基本险第三方责任（TPL），面包店店主的索赔怎么处理？

opts.t: The bakery owner can sue for the building damage and business interruption loss, and the heavy commercial truck automatically carries $1 million in Basic TPL.
opts.w: 正确。虽然 BC 禁止大部分车祸人伤和车辆损坏诉讼，但“非车辆财产损失（damage to property other than a vehicle）”和“营业中断损失（losses from business interruption）”均属于诉讼限制（lawsuits limitation）的法定例外，仍可起诉；同时总重 5,000 kg 以上的重型商用车收费运货时，基本险第三方责任（Third-Party Liability, TPL）自动为 $1 million。

opts.t: All lawsuits are banned in BC, so the bakery owner must claim under Basic Vehicle Damage (BVD) up to $200,000 for both the building and the lost income.
opts.w: 错误。误以为 BC 的诉讼禁令覆盖一切财产：非车辆财产和营业中断属于可起诉的例外；此外基本车损（BVD）只保投保车辆本身，且明确不赔营业中断。

opts.t: The bakery owner can sue for the building damage and business interruption, and the truck automatically carries $2 million in Basic TPL because all commercial trucks get that limit.
opts.w: 错误。混淆了重型商用车与危险品运输车的 TPL 限额：总重超 5,000 kg 的重型商用车自动限额是 $1 million，只有运载危险品（dangerous goods，如炸药、有毒物质）的车辆才是自动 $2 million。

opts.t: The bakery owner can sue only for the building facade up to $200,000, because business interruption is excluded from all Third-Party Liability claims.
opts.w: 错误。营业中断（business interruption）是不赔于 BVD，但明确列在第三方责任（TPL）诉讼限制的六大例外之内，且该重型商用车的基本险 TPL 限额是 $1 million 而非普通车的 $200,000。

main.pt: 基本车损BVD按比例赔付与非公路规则
main.trap: BVD全额赔付或全有全无误区
main.stem: Nora is involved in a two-car collision on a BC highway. Her car sustains $15,000 in repairable damage, and she is determined to be 40% at fault for the crash. She carries Basic Autoplan plus optional Collision coverage with a $500 deductible. How will her vehicle repair costs and deductible be settled?
main.zh: Nora 在 BC 公路上发生两车碰撞事故。她的车产生 $15,000 的可修复车损，且她被认定对此次事故负 40% 的责任。她投保了基本险以及免赔额为 $500 的可选碰撞险。她的修车费用和免赔额将如何结算？

opts.t: Basic Vehicle Damage (BVD) pays nothing because she was partially at fault; optional Collision pays $15,000 minus the full $500 deductible.
opts.w: 错误。掉入了“BVD全额赔付或全有全无误区”：基本车损（Basic Vehicle Damage, BVD）并非有责就全不赔，而是按投保人“不负责任的比例”（60%）赔付。

opts.t: BVD pays 60% ($9,000), and optional Collision covers her 40% at-fault share ($6,000) with Nora paying 40% of her Collision deductible ($200).
opts.w: 正确。基本车损（Basic Vehicle Damage, BVD）按投保人不负责的比例赔付（60% × $15,000 = $9,000）；她自己负责的 40%（$6,000）由可选的碰撞险（Collision）赔付，且她只需按自己的责任比例支付 40% 的碰撞险免赔额（40% × $500 = $200）。

opts.t: BVD pays the entire $15,000 up to the $200,000 limit regardless of fault, and Nora pays 40% of a $750 statutory deductible.
opts.w: 错误。BVD 要按投保人负责的比例扣减，不会连有责的 40% 一起赔；此外 $750 免赔额属于法定无保险/身份不明条款下逃逸司机撞坏非车辆财产的规定，与 BVD 无关。

opts.t: BVD pays 40% ($6,000) representing her fault share, while the other driver's Third-Party Liability pays the remaining 60% ($9,000).
opts.w: 错误。把 BVD 赔付比例反记成了有责比例，且在 BC 公路上的两车碰撞禁止车损诉讼，不找对方司机的第三方责任（TPL），而是由自己的 BVD 赔不负责的 60%。

main.pt: UMP保额不足驾驶人保障双条件
main.trap: UMP与法定无保险条款张冠李戴
main.stem: A BC policyholder is driving in a U.S. state that permits motor vehicle injury lawsuits. An at-fault local driver runs a red light and severely injures the BC policyholder. The court awards $600,000 in damages, but the at-fault driver's Third-Party Liability limit is only $50,000. Under the rules tested on the exam, which Basic Autoplan coverage responds to the $550,000 shortfall and up to what maximum limit?
main.zh: 一位 BC 保单持有人在美国某个允许车祸人伤诉讼的州驾车。当地一名全责司机闯红灯并严重撞伤该 BC 保单持有人。法院判赔 $600,000，但肇事司机的第三方责任险限额只有 $50,000。按照考试口径，哪一项基本险保障会弥补这 $550,000 的差额，最高限额是多少？

opts.t: Basic Vehicle Damage (BVD), up to a maximum limit of $200,000 per accident.
opts.w: 错误。基本车损（BVD）只保 BC 公路上的车辆本身损失（最高 $200,000），既不管人身伤害，也不适用于省外事故。

opts.t: Inverse Liability, paying 100% of the $550,000 bodily injury shortfall with no overall cap.
opts.w: 错误。反向责任（Inverse Liability）只赔投保车辆本身的损失，且仅在法律不允许就车损索偿的辖区（或肇事者住在该辖区）时适用，不管人伤差额。

opts.t: Underinsured Motorist Protection (UMP), covering the difference up to a maximum limit of $1 million per injured person.
opts.w: 正确。保额不足驾驶人保障（Underinsured Motorist Protection, UMP）在满足“不享有 EAB”和“肇事司机第三方责任险不足以支付判定损害”时，为投保人或同住家人补足人伤判赔差额，每人最高限额为 $1 million。（注：考试口径明确将投保人在允许诉讼的省外辖区被保额不足司机撞伤列为 UMP 赔付情形；但依现行 BC 法规，BC 居民在加美被车撞伤即享有 EAB，而享有 EAB 者通常不再适用 UMP。）

opts.t: Statutory Uninsured/Unidentified Motorist Provision, covering the difference up to $200,000 subject to a $750 deductible.
opts.w: 错误。掉入了“UMP与法定无保险条款张冠李戴”陷阱：法定无保险/身份不明驾驶人条款仅赔 BC 公路上受损的非车辆财产（最高 $200,000），不赔省外人伤判赔差额。

main.pt: 碰撞险与综合险及列明风险险的区分
main.trap: 碰撞险与综合险边界混淆
main.stem: During a violent windstorm at night, a large cedar tree falls across a BC highway. Driving around a bend moments later, Liam cannot stop in time and crashes the front of his car into the fallen tree lying on the road. If Liam carries both optional Collision and Comprehensive coverages, which coverage responds to the damage to his car?
main.zh: 在一个暴风夜，一棵大雪松倒在 BC 公路上。片刻后 Liam 驾车转过弯道，来不及刹车，车头直接撞上已经横倒在路面上的树。如果 Liam 同时购买了可选的碰撞险和综合险，哪一项保障会赔付他的车损？

opts.t: Comprehensive coverage, because the tree was blown down by a windstorm and weather perils are always Comprehensive claims.
opts.w: 错误。掉入了“碰撞险与综合险边界混淆”陷阱：如果是飞来或正在坠落的物体砸中车辆归综合险（Comprehensive），但撞上“已经掉落在路上的物体（石头、树）”属于与路面物体碰撞，归碰撞险（Collision）。

opts.t: Specified Perils coverage, because fallen trees on a roadway are classified under windstorm and earthquake perils.
opts.w: 错误。列明风险险（Specified Perils）只保火灾、盗窃、风暴冰雹等直接列明风险，不保车辆行驶中撞上路面障碍物的碰撞损失。

opts.t: Basic Vehicle Damage (BVD), because the fallen tree was not Liam's fault and BVD covers all single-vehicle road hazards.
opts.w: 错误。基本车损（BVD）只适用于涉及特定车辆的事故，单车撞上路面上的树木、坑洞或护栏不属于与另一辆车相撞，需走可选的碰撞险。

opts.t: Collision coverage, because the car struck an object already lying on the roadway rather than being hit by a falling object.
opts.w: 正确。碰撞险（Collision）承保与另一车、人或物体的碰撞或翻车，明确包含撞上路面、坑洞或裂缝、掉在路上的物体（如石头、已经倒在路上的树）以及护栏、桥墩等。

main.pt: 受保人范围、车库保单排除与承保地域
main.trap: 反向责任与车库人员绝对化表述
main.stem: Owen leaves his BC-plated sedan at a local auto repair shop for a brake inspection and gives the mechanic explicit permission to road-test the car. While road-testing Owen's car, the mechanic negligently causes a collision. Later that month, Owen plans a road trip driving from BC through Washington and California into Mexico. Which statement is correct regarding Owen's Basic Autoplan policy?
main.zh: Owen 把他在 BC 上牌的轿车留在当地一家汽车修理厂检查刹车，并明确许可修车师傅上路试车。修车师傅在试车时因疏忽引发碰撞事故。当月晚些时候，Owen 计划从 BC 自驾途经华盛顿州和加州进入墨西哥旅行。关于 Owen 的基本险保单，下列哪项陈述是正确的？

opts.t: The mechanic is excluded from Owen's Basic policy despite having permission (requiring a garage policy), and Owen's policy covers him in the U.S. but not once he enters Mexico.
opts.w: 正确。从事汽车买卖、修理、保养、存放、服务或代客停放业务的人员（auto repair / garage personnel），即使得到车主许可（even with the owner's permission），也不在车主的基本险保障内，须另买车库保单（garage policy）；同时基本险的承保地域（territorial limits）仅限加拿大、美国及往返加美港口的船只，进入墨西哥后不赔。

opts.t: The mechanic is covered under Owen's Basic policy because he held a valid licence and had the owner's permission, and coverage extends throughout North America including Mexico.
opts.w: 错误。掉入了“反向责任与车库人员绝对化表述”陷阱：汽车修理等行业人员是“持照且获车主许可即受保”这一规则的法定排除对象；且承保地域不含墨西哥。

opts.t: The mechanic is covered under Owen's Basic policy up to $200,000, but Owen's policy stops at the U.S. border unless he buys an out-of-province endorsement.
opts.w: 错误。修车师傅不受车主保单保障；而美国全境（含往返加美港口的船只）本来就在基本险自动承保地域内，无需额外批单。

opts.t: Neither the mechanic nor a ferry trip between BC and Washington State is covered under Basic Autoplan, because coverage applies only on paved roads inside BC.
opts.w: 错误。基本险的承保地域明确包含加拿大、美国以及往返加美两国港口的船只（vessels travelling between ports in Canada and the United States）。

main.pt: 反向责任与法定无保险条款的适用
main.trap: UMP与法定无保险条款张冠李戴
main.stem: Priya, a BC resident who does not own a car and does not hold a driver's licence, wakes up to find that an unidentified hit-and-run driver veered off a BC public road overnight and smashed her front wooden fence and her bicycle parked by the porch, causing $3,500 in damage. She has no other insurance covering this loss. What coverage, if any, is available to Priya?
main.zh: Priya 是一位既没有车也没有驾照的 BC 居民。她早上醒来发现，夜间有一名身份不明的肇事逃逸司机驶出 BC 公共道路，撞毁了她家门前的木围栏和停在门廊旁的自行车，造成 $3,500 损失。她没有其他保险承保这笔损失。Priya 可以获得什么保障（如有）？

opts.t: She has no coverage because she does not own a vehicle or hold an Autoplan policy.
opts.w: 错误。法定无保险/身份不明驾驶人条款（Statutory Uninsured/Unidentified Motorist Provision）来自《Insurance (Vehicle) Act》，对全体 BC 居民开放，即使没有车、没有保单、没有 BC 驾照也同样受保。

opts.t: Underinsured Motorist Protection (UMP) pays the full $3,500 with zero deductible because the unidentified hit-and-run driver carries $0 in liability coverage.
opts.w: 错误。掉入了“UMP与法定无保险条款张冠李戴”陷阱：UMP 保的是无 EAB 资格且对方保额不足时的人伤判赔差额，不管非车辆财产损失。

opts.t: The Statutory Uninsured/Unidentified Motorist Provision covers her non-vehicle property damage up to $200,000, subject to a $750 hit-and-run deductible.
opts.w: 正确。独立于基本险的法定无保险/身份不明驾驶人条款（Statutory Uninsured/Unidentified Motorist Provision）自动赔付全体 BC 居民在 BC 公路上被无保险或逃逸司机损坏的非车辆财产（建筑、围栏、自行车），最高限额 $200,000；因系逃逸司机所致，索赔人须先承担 $750 免赔额。

opts.t: Inverse Liability covers 100% of the $3,500 fence and bicycle damage because the unidentified hit-and-run driver cannot be sued in a BC court.
opts.w: 错误。反向责任（Inverse Liability）只赔投保机动车的车损，且仅适用于事故发生地或肇事者居住地为加美不允许索偿辖区的情形，不保围栏和自行车。

main.pt: UDP四种除外情形
main.trap: 同住亲友当成偶尔借车
main.stem: A car owner in Kelowna has a new basic auto policy with automatic Unlisted Driver Protection (UDP). Her adult brother, who lives in the same house, borrows her sedan for only the second time this year and causes an at-fault collision. How does UDP respond to this accident?
main.zh: 基隆拿一位车主有一份自动附带未列名驾驶人保障（UDP）的新基本车险保单。与她同住一栋房子的成年弟弟今年第二次借开她的轿车，并造成了一起有责碰撞事故。UDP 对这起事故如何响应？

opts.t: UDP applies without penalty because he drove the vehicle fewer than 12 days in the past 12 months.
opts.w: 掉入“同住亲友当成偶尔借车”陷阱：虽然一年最多 12 天是未列名驾驶人保障（Unlisted Driver Protection, UDP）的一般限额，但同住的家庭成员本来就在四种除外之内，一天也不适用。

opts.t: UDP does not apply because household family members are excluded, exposing the owner to the Unlisted Driver Accident Premium.
opts.w: 正确：主驾、登记车主或承租人的家庭成员（household/family members）或雇员属于未列名驾驶人保障（Unlisted Driver Protection, UDP）明确除外的四种人之一；他们未列名而在投保人车上造成有责事故，车主须付未列名驾驶人事故保费（UDAP）。

opts.t: UDP covers the first accident for a household member, provided the owner pays a fee at the next renewal.
opts.w: 把“符合 UDP 条件的未列名者出事后续保要付费”误套在同住家人身上：同住家人从一开始就不受 UDP 保护，第一次出事就要算 UDAP。

opts.t: UDP applies as long as the brother holds a valid driver's licence and has had no accidents since September 1, 2019.
opts.w: 以偏概全：有有效驾照且自 2019-09-01 起 5 年内未在投保人车上出过事故只是排除另外两项除外，并不能绕过“家庭成员除外”这一条。

main.pt: 自动与可选使用损失区别
main.trap: 偷零件误当整车被盗
main.stem: A commuter in Burnaby carries Comprehensive coverage on his hatchback but has not purchased Optional Loss of Use. Overnight, thieves steal all four wheels and tires from his parked car, leaving it on blocks for five days while replacements are ordered. How does Automatic Loss of Use respond to his transit expenses?
main.zh: 本拿比一位通勤族为他的掀背车买了综合险，但没有加买可选使用损失。夜间小偷把他停着的车的四个车轮和轮胎全部偷走，车被垫在砖块上停了五天等待配件。自动使用损失（Automatic Loss of Use）对他的公交费用如何响应？

opts.t: It pays no transit costs because Automatic Loss of Use covers only theft of the entire vehicle, not theft of parts.
opts.w: 正确：随综合险或列明风险险自动附带的自动使用损失（Automatic Loss of Use）只在整车被盗（theft of the entire vehicle）时触发；只被偷走轮胎、发动机等零件（theft of parts）是不赔的。

opts.t: It reimburses transit costs starting 72 hours after the theft of the wheels is reported to the police.
opts.w: 掉入“偷零件误当整车被盗”陷阱：向警方报案后 72 小时起算是整车被盗时的规则，只偷车轮根本不会触发自动使用损失。

opts.t: It reimburses transit costs immediately after the theft, subject to the Comprehensive deductible.
opts.w: 混淆了可选使用损失与自动使用损失：立即起算是可选使用损失（Optional Loss of Use）的规则，且自动使用损失既不保偷零件，也没有免赔额。

opts.t: It pays for a rental car immediately, provided the cost of the stolen wheels exceeds the policy deductible.
opts.w: 张冠李戴：“理赔额高于自车险免赔额且立即起算”是加买了可选使用损失（Optional Loss of Use）后的条件，而车主并未加买可选使用损失。

main.pt: 四件套与七件套附加包
main.trap: 混淆套餐内含与除外
main.stem: A driver in Kamloops has Comprehensive coverage and the seven-item roadside package. While driving to a conference, her car is disabled by a collision. Two hours later, she takes a taxi to her conference hotel, and the next day her battery dies on another vehicle requiring a boost and a new battery. Which statement accurately describes how the seven-item package responds?
main.zh: 坎卢普斯一位驾驶人买了综合险和七件套附加包。在开车去开会的路上，她的车因碰撞无法行驶。两小时后她打车去了会议酒店；次日她另一辆同套餐的车电瓶没电，需要搭电并换新电瓶。下列哪项准确描述了该七件套的赔付？

opts.t: Destination Assistance pays for a rental car to finish her trip, and roadside emergency coverage pays for both the boost service call and the new battery.
opts.w: 掉入“混淆套餐内含与除外”陷阱：目的地协助（Destination Assistance）明确不含租替代车，路边应急费用报销也明确不含电瓶、轮胎、汽油等零件耗材。

opts.t: Destination Assistance covers the taxi taken within 12 hours, and roadside emergency covers the boost (up to twice per term) but excludes the new battery.
opts.w: 正确：七件套的目的地协助（Destination Assistance）赔付车因碰撞、盗窃或故意破坏不能开时 12 小时内去原目的地的交通（如打车，不含租车）；路边应急每个保期最多报销 2 次搭电等服务费，但不含电瓶等零件。

opts.t: Destination Assistance applies only if the car is stolen, and roadside emergency coverage is unlimited per policy term.
opts.w: 缩窄触发原因并搞错次数限制：目的地协助在碰撞、盗窃或故意破坏不能开时都适用，而路边应急每个保期最多限 2 次。

opts.t: Both the taxi to the hotel and the emergency boost are already included in the standard four-item package.
opts.w: 混淆两个套餐的边界：目的地协助、盗窃免赔豁免和路边应急费用报销都是七件套新增的三项，不在四件套里。

main.pt: 新车三种抗折旧保障
main.trap: 新车三险的年款与第3年火盗陷阱
main.stem: An insured buys Limited-Depreciation Coverage on the exact day her passenger car enters its third model year. Four months later, the car is completely destroyed by an accidental garage fire. How will the insurer settle this total loss?
main.zh: 一位投保人在她的私家车进入第 3 个年款（model year）当天购买了限折旧险（Limited-Depreciation Coverage）。四个月后，该车因车库意外火灾全损。保险公司将如何理赔这起全损？

opts.t: It will pay the full replacement price including inflation, because fire is a standard Comprehensive peril.
opts.w: 混淆了产品赔法与除外：“全额重置价、计通胀”是新车重置升级或重置成本险的赔法，且忽略了限折旧险在第 3 个年款生效时的火灾除外。

opts.t: It will apply Limited-Depreciation Coverage as long as the repair estimate for the fire damage exceeds 50% of the vehicle's current market value.
opts.w: 掉入“新车三险的年款与第3年火盗陷阱”：50% 全损门槛属于第 1、2 个年款的新车重置升级（New Vehicle Replacement Plus），且限折旧险在第 3 个年款当天生效时不保火灾全损。

opts.t: Limited-Depreciation excludes this loss because when bought in the third model year, total losses from fire, theft, vandalism, or malicious mischief are not covered.
opts.w: 正确：限折旧险（Limited-Depreciation Coverage）虽然可保不超过 3 个年款（model years）的车，但如果保障生效当天已是第 3 个年款，由火灾、盗窃、故意破坏或恶意毁损造成的全损是不保的（仍按普通自车险实际现金价值 ACV 处理）。

opts.t: It will deny all coverage because vehicles in their third model year are only eligible for New Vehicle Replacement Plus.
opts.w: 年款记反：新车重置升级（New Vehicle Replacement Plus）只保第 1、2 个年款；第 3 个年款可以买重置成本险或限折旧险。

main.pt: 延伸与非公路TPL及收入补足
main.trap: 混淆套餐内含与除外
main.stem: An agro-tourism farm in Chilliwack uses a licensed multi-utility vehicle in its berry fields off the highway, and also operates a heavy commercial truck hauling dangerous goods on public highways. What is the maximum Extended Third Party Liability limit for the dangerous goods truck, and what deductible applies to Off-Highway Third Party Liability for the field vehicle?
main.zh: 奇利瓦克一家观光农场在非公路的浆果田里使用一辆持牌的多用途车，同时在公共公路上运营一辆运输危险品的重型商用卡车。这辆危险品卡车的延伸第三方责任最高可加到多少？田间车辆的非公路第三方责任适用多少免赔额？

opts.t: Up to $5 million for the dangerous goods truck; a $750 deductible for Off-Highway Third Party Liability.
opts.w: 把私家车/轻商的 $5M 上限和 Hit and Run 的 $750 免赔额串到了商用车和非公路第三方责任上。

opts.t: Up to $10 million for the dangerous goods truck; a $500 deductible for Off-Highway Third Party Liability.
opts.w: 前半句正确，但非公路第三方责任（Off-Highway Third Party Liability）五档限额均没有免赔额。

opts.t: Up to $2 million for the dangerous goods truck; no deductible for Off-Highway Third Party Liability.
opts.w: $2 million 是运危险品重型商用车在基本险里的起点限额，延伸第三方责任可以把它加高到 $10 million。

opts.t: Up to $10 million for the dangerous goods truck; no deductible applies to Off-Highway Third Party Liability.
opts.w: 正确：运危险品的重型商用车通过延伸第三方责任（Extended Third Party Liability）可从基本险的 $2M 最高加到 $10 million；持牌非标准车在非公路使用的非公路第三方责任（Off-Highway Third Party Liability）可选 $200,000 至 $5M 五档，且没有免赔额（no deductible）。

main.pt: 六种专项保障规则
main.trap: 混淆套餐内含与除外
main.stem: A resident of Prince George buys a new pickup truck at a dealership in Montana and wants temporary coverage to drive it back to British Columbia for registration. He obtains a temporary operation binder (APV38). Which statement about this coverage is true?
main.zh: 乔治王子城一位居民在美国蒙大拿州的车行新买了一辆皮卡，想办一份临时保障把车开回 BC 省登记。他办了车主临时保险证（APV38 binder）。关于这项保障，下列哪项说法是正确的？

opts.t: It covers 1 to 31 days for a vehicle bought in Canada or the continental US and driven to BC, though local operating permits may still be needed.
opts.w: 正确：临时保险证（binder, APV38）属于专项保障（Specialized Coverages），为 BC 居民或机构在加拿大或美国本土新购、正开回 BC 登记的车提供 1 到 31 天保障；它保车在省外行驶，但不一定代表别处允许上路，可能仍需当地行车许可。

opts.t: It automatically serves as a valid registration and operating permit in every US state and Canadian province for a period of up to 60 days.
opts.w: 天数与效力均错：期限是 1 至 31 天（不是 60 天），且它只是保险凭证，不自动代替其他辖区的上路许可。

opts.t: It has the exact same legal meaning as a standard general insurance binder used in property insurance.
opts.w: 讲义特别提醒的考点：车险里的这个 APV38 binder 与一般财产保险合同里的 binder（临时承保单）含义不同。

opts.t: It also covers unlicensed farm tractors crossing a BC highway between two fields.
opts.w: 混淆两项专项保障：不上牌的农用拖拉机横穿或上公路使用的是未上牌农用拖拉机证书（Unlicensed Farm Tractor Certificate，须随车携带），不是 APV38。

main.pt: 违反保障条件后果与酒驾
main.trap: 违约后果颠倒或酒驾等起诉
main.stem: A courier driver in Abbotsford fails to renew his driver's licence, which expired two months ago. While making a delivery, he runs a stop sign, injuring a cyclist and damaging both his own van and a parked car. Under the rules tested on the exam for a breach of coverage conditions, what is the outcome?
main.zh: 阿伯茨福德一位送货司机的驾照两个月前过期未续。在送货途中，他闯了停牌，撞伤一名骑车人并撞坏了他自己的货车和路边一辆停着的车。按考试口径关于违反保障条件的规则，结果是什么？

opts.t: The insurer refuses to pay either the injured third parties or the courier driver, leaving the victims to sue the driver personally.
opts.w: 掉入“违约后果颠倒或酒驾等起诉”陷阱：违反保障条件（breach of coverage conditions）时，保险公司仍然会赔付受害第三方，不会让无辜第三方落空。

opts.t: The insurer pays for the courier driver's van after applying a doubled deductible, and covers the third parties in full.
opts.w: 编造双倍免赔规则：违反保障条件的结果是拒赔违约者自己的车损，而不是加倍免赔额。

opts.t: The insurer covers both the third parties and the van because an expired licence is an administrative matter, not a breach of condition.
opts.w: 违背考试口径：没有有效驾照（包括驾照过期未续）在考试口径中明确属于违反保障条件（注：尽管法条字面读法与 2026 年驾照限制条款新规有细节差异，本讲考试口径一律按“没有有效驾照即违反条件”作答）。

opts.t: The insurer pays the third-party claims for the cyclist and parked car, denies the driver's van claim, and seeks recovery from the driver.
opts.w: 正确：按考试口径，没有有效驾照属于违反保障条件（breach of coverage conditions）（注：法条细节与考试口径的对照以考试口径“无有效驾照＝违反”为准）；违反条件的标准三步后果是：照赔受害第三方、不赔违约者自己的车、之后向违约者追偿付给第三方的钱。

main.pt: 谁管牌照投诉与纪律
main.trap: 监管机构张冠李戴
main.stem: A client in British Columbia wishes to file a formal complaint alleging misconduct by a licensed general insurance broker and seeks disciplinary action against the broker's licence. Which body has the delegated authority to handle licensing, complaints, and disciplinary matters for brokers in British Columbia?
main.zh: 不列颠哥伦比亚省（BC）的一位客户希望对一名持牌普通保险经纪人的不当行为提出正式投诉，并要求对该经纪人的牌照采取纪律处分。在 BC 省，哪个机构拥有受委托的权力来处理经纪人的牌照、投诉和纪律事务？

opts.t: The federal Superintendent of Financial Institutions in Ottawa
opts.w: 掉入「监管机构张冠李戴」陷阱。保险中介的监管完全属于省级管辖（provincial jurisdiction），联邦政府的监管机构管不着各省的保险经纪人。

opts.t: The Insurance Council of British Columbia under authority delegated by the province
opts.w: 正确。在 BC、AB、SK、MB 四省，具体的牌照核发（licensing）、投诉（complaints）和纪律处分（disciplinary matters）以及制定行为规章（by-laws）已委托给各自独立的保险理事会（Insurance Council）。（注：本题按考试考试口径作答，不服 Council 决定一般上诉至 Superintendent；BC 现行实务则依《Financial Institutions Act》由 BCFSA 监管并向 Financial Services Tribunal 上诉。）

opts.t: The provincial brokers' professional association that administers licensing examinations
opts.w: 掉入「监管机构张冠李戴」陷阱。省级经纪人行业协会（professional association）只负责会员专业标准与举办考试，不是法定监管者，无权核发或吊销牌照。

opts.t: The Registered Insurance Brokers of Ontario under reciprocal provincial authority
opts.w: 掉入「监管机构张冠李戴」陷阱。安省注册保险经纪人协会（RIBO）是根据安省 1981 年立法设立的安省自律组织，对 BC 省的持牌人没有任何跨省管辖权。

main.pt: BC三级牌照权限与升级
main.trap: 牌照级别与升级条件混淆
main.stem: Which of the following statements concerning the three-level step licensing system for general insurance brokers in British Columbia is INCORRECT?
main.zh: 关于不列颠哥伦比亚省（BC）普通保险经纪人的三级分级牌照制（step licensing），下列哪一项陈述是不正确的？

opts.t: A Level I licensee is generally restricted to working inside the brokerage office under the supervision of a Level II or Level III licensee at all times
opts.w: 此项陈述正确，不符合题意。按考试口径，一级牌照（Level I）持有人只限在经纪行办公室内工作，并随时受二级（Level II）或三级（Level III）持牌人监督。

opts.t: A Level II licensee may solicit and transact general insurance both inside and outside the brokerage office while supervised by a Level III licensee
opts.w: 此项陈述正确，不符合题意。二级牌照（Level II）持有人可以在经纪行办公室内外开展所有一般保险业务，但仍须受三级（Level III）持牌人监督。

opts.t: A Level II licensee automatically qualifies for a Level III licence to manage a brokerage after completing a set number of years of work experience
opts.w: 正确（此项为错误陈述）。掉入「牌照级别与升级条件混淆」陷阱：分级牌照制（step licensing）每升一级都要求掌握更多知识并通过相应考试，绝不是凭工作年资自动升级；且只有 Level III 才能拥有或管理经纪行。（注：本题按考试口径作答；BC 现行 Council Rules Rule 6(1) 对 Level 1 另有修完规则课可出外执业及固定薪金比例等规定。）

opts.t: Only a Level III licensee who has satisfied the highest knowledge requirements is permitted to own or manage a general insurance brokerage office
opts.w: 此项陈述正确，不符合题意。在 BC 的三级牌照体系中，每升一级要求更多专业知识，且只有三级牌照（Level III）持有人才被允许拥有或管理经纪行。

main.pt: 牌照期限保荐与跨省执业
main.trap: 把现行实务当成考试口径
main.stem: A broker licensed and operating in British Columbia is asked by a local client to insure a commercial warehouse the client just purchased in a neighbouring province. Which statement accurately describes the licensing and policy requirements for this transaction?
main.zh: 一位在 BC 省持牌执业的经纪人，受本地客户委托为其刚在邻省购置的一座商业仓库投保。下列哪项陈述准确描述了该笔交易的牌照与保单要求？

opts.t: The broker must be licensed in every province where business is done, and the policy must be countersigned by a licensed broker in that province who shares the commission
opts.w: 正确。按考试口径，跨省执业的经纪人必须在每一个做业务的省份都持牌；此外，保险人在某省承保财产时，保单须由该省持牌经纪人副署（countersign）并分给其部分佣金，否则违法。（注：本题按考试考试口径作答；BC 现行成文法中并无副署分佣条文。）

opts.t: Because the broker's British Columbia licence is continuous with an annual filing requirement, it automatically grants reciprocal authority across all western provinces
opts.w: 掉入「牌照级别与升级条件混淆」陷阱。虽然 BC 牌照确实是连续有效并有年度申报要求（continuous with an annual filing requirement），但牌照属于省级管辖，不会自动获得跨省执业权。

opts.t: The broker may place the coverage without holding an out-of-province licence as long as the client's head office resides in British Columbia and pays the premium there
opts.w: 错误。经纪人必须在每一个开展业务的省份持牌，且承保外省财产须遵守当地持牌经纪人副署（countersign）的规定，不能因客户总部在 BC 就豁免。

opts.t: The broker only needs a sponsor from the provincial brokers' association to issue a temporary three-year interprovincial binder covering the out-of-province warehouse
opts.w: 错误。保荐人（sponsor）只能是雇用申请人的经纪行或保险人（自雇者由所代表的保险人保荐），行业协会不作保荐，且 3 年是新斯科舍省的牌照期限而非跨省暂保单。

main.pt: 吊照事由与回扣的判定
main.trap: 回扣与合法折扣或小赠品不分
main.stem: Under the licensing provisions of the Insurance Act tested on the exam, which of the following actions by a broker would NOT be grounds for licence revocation as illegal rebating?
main.zh: 根据考试所测《保险法》的牌照规定，经纪人的下列哪项行为不会因构成违法回扣（rebating）而成为吊销牌照的事由？

opts.t: Refunding a portion of the stated policy premium in cash to a bakery owner so that a renewal quote matches a lower competing quote
opts.w: 掉入「把现行实务当成考试口径」陷阱。把保单所列保费（stated policy premium）的一部分以现金返还给投保人作为购买诱因（inducement），是最典型的回扣，按考试口径属于违法并可吊销牌照。

opts.t: Offering a prospective client a complimentary one-year fitness club membership if the client transfers all commercial policies to the brokerage
opts.w: 掉入「回扣与合法折扣或小赠品不分」陷阱。回扣不限于现金，提供钱以外的有价物（something of value other than money，如一年健身会籍）作为转保诱因，同样属于违法回扣。

opts.t: Crediting a portion of the broker's commission directly back to the insured outside the policy to close a competitive fleet account
opts.w: 错误。经纪人私下将部分佣金返还给被保险人以促成交易，实质就是返还保单所列保费的一部分作为诱因，构成违法回扣（rebating）。

opts.t: Giving clients promotional pens and coffee mugs of minimal value, or applying a premium discount authorized by the insurer in the policy
opts.w: 正确。价值小到不足以构成购买诱因的小赠品（giveaways of minimal value，如笔、咖啡杯、帽子）不算回扣；保险人自己批准并直接体现在保单保费中的折扣也不是经纪人私下返还的回扣，因此均不会导致吊照。（注：本题按考试口径作答，回扣一律违法可吊照；BC 现行法 FIA s.79 则允许低于保费 25% 的回扣。）

main.pt: 挪用信托资金与欠缴保费
main.trap: 牌照级别与升级条件混淆
main.stem: Brokers hold client premiums in trust until those funds are remitted to the insurer. Under the grounds for licence revocation, misappropriation of trust funds includes three specific behaviours. Which of the following correctly lists all three?
main.zh: 经纪人将客户保费以信托方式持有，直至交给保险人。在吊销牌照的事由中，挪用信托资金（misappropriation of trust funds）包括三种具体行为。下列哪一项正确列出了这三种行为？

opts.t: Tied selling, charging unconscionable service fees, and failing to disclose insurer sales incentives
opts.w: 错误。搭售（tied selling）、收取不合情理的费用（unconscionable fees）以及未披露损害客户利益的激励，属于违反行为准则中「建议客户」与「收费披露」的情形，而非挪用信托资金的三种形式。

opts.t: Poor financial control, willful misstatement of the trust position, and embezzlement of client trust funds
opts.w: 正确。经纪人以信托方式（in trust）持有保费，动用信托资金是严重违规，挪用信托资金（misappropriation of trust funds）明确包括三种情况：财务控制不力（poor financial control）、故意虚报信托头寸（willful misstatement of trust position）以及侵占资金（embezzlement of funds）。

opts.t: Placing risks with unlicensed insurers, rebating premiums, and failing to countersign out-of-province policies
opts.w: 错误。违规使用无牌保险人和回扣属于其他独立的吊照或违法事由，不属于挪用信托资金的三种形式。

opts.t: Negotiating credit terms with an insurer, investing commission income, and refunding cancelled policy premiums
opts.w: 错误。与保险人正常协商代理协议或处理自身佣金收入并非挪用客户信托保费。

main.pt: 行为准则：诚信能力与保密
main.trap: 牌照级别与升级条件混淆
main.stem: A longtime client asks a general insurance broker to arrange specialized aviation hull coverage for a newly acquired charter aircraft. The broker has never handled aviation risks and lacks a solid understanding of the coverage and procedures involved. Under the Code of Conduct principle of competence, what should the broker do?
main.zh: 一位老客户请普通保险经纪人为其新购入的包机安排专门的航空机身险。该经纪人从未处理过航空风险，对该保障和相关实务程序缺乏扎实了解。根据行为准则（Code of Conduct）中的「能力」（competence）原则，该经纪人应当怎么做？

opts.t: Accept the account and learn the aviation procedures while placing the policy so the client does not move to a competitor
opts.w: 错误。行为准则明确规定，经纪人要对自己能力的弱点保持敏感，超出个人能力时绝不能「边做边学」（learn as they go）。

opts.t: Bind temporary coverage immediately and rely on the insurer's underwriter to explain any gaps after the policy is issued
opts.w: 错误。对保险原理没有清楚理解、对实务程序没有扎实知识就不算称职（competent），贸然出单会导致不合理的保障缺口。

opts.t: Decline to act for the client on this risk and recommend that the client consult another broker who possesses the required competence
opts.w: 正确。根据行为准则第二条「能力」（competence），当业务超出个人能力边界时，经纪人应当拒绝代理（decline to act）并建议客户去找具备该方面能力的经纪人，而不是边做边学。

opts.t: Share the client's confidential financial files with neighbouring brokerages without asking the client in order to gather informal quotes
opts.w: 错误。违反行为准则第五条「保密」（confidentiality）：客户信息只能为当初提供它的目的并在授权范围内分享，不得擅自向其他经纪人泄露客户机密。

main.pt: 建议客户收费与协会角色
main.trap: 把现行实务当成考试口径
main.stem: Under the Code of Conduct rules tested on the exam regarding advising clients, fee disclosure, and professional associations, which statement is CORRECT?
main.zh: 根据考试所测行为准则中关于建议客户、收费披露以及行业协会的规定，下列哪一项陈述是正确的？

opts.t: Any fee charged above the insurer's premium on an individual policy must be explained clearly in writing in advance, stating both the amount and the reason for the fee
opts.w: 正确。根据行为准则第六条「收费披露」（fee disclosure），在单张保单上收取超出保险人保费的任何费用，必须事先书面（in writing in advance）向被保险人清楚解释金额和收费理由；说不出理由的费用被视为「不合情理」（unconscionable）。

opts.t: A broker may require a client to purchase a homeowner policy as a condition of issuing an automobile policy whenever the two policies are bundled
opts.w: 错误。以购买家财险为条件才出车险保单属于典型的「搭售」（tied selling），行为准则第四条「建议客户」明确规定经纪人不得参与或协助搭售。

opts.t: A broker who complies with government legislation but fails to meet the higher ethical standards of a provincial brokers' association will have their licence revoked by the association
opts.w: 掉入「把协会纪律当成行政吊照」陷阱。行业协会（professional association）的标准高于法律要求，达不到协会标准的后果是可能被终止会籍（termination of membership），而不是由协会吊销牌照。

opts.t: There is no need to inform a client about a policy warranty that is a condition of coverage unless a claim is later denied for breaching that warranty
opts.w: 错误。根据行为准则第四条「建议客户」，没有告诉客户保单上有保证条款（warranty）且那是承保条件，属于服务与建议不达标的典型例子。

variants.pt: 保险的主要社会功能
variants.trap: 真话非主
variants.stem: An instructor asks a licensing class to identify the primary function of insurance from four accurate statements about the industry. Which statement should the students choose?
variants.zh: 一位讲师要求考牌班学员从四句关于保险业的正确表述中挑出保险的主要功能。学员应当选择哪一项？

opts.t: Eliminating worry so entrepreneurs feel confident starting new commercial ventures
opts.w: 消除忧虑、鼓励创业（eliminates worry）是五项社会功能之一，但不是唯一的主要功能，掉入了「真话非主」陷阱。

opts.t: Protecting mortgaged assets so financial institutions can safely issue loans
opts.w: 这是信贷体系的基础（basis of credit）功能，虽然表述本身正确，但并非主要功能。

opts.t: Generating jobs for adjusters, contractors, and healthcare professionals
opts.w: 这是就业与投资资本（employment and capital）功能，并非题干所问的主要功能。

opts.t: Collecting premiums into a common fund to share the losses of a few among many
opts.w: 把保费汇成资金池、让多数人分担少数人的损失即分散风险（spread of risk），是保险唯一的主要功能。

variants.pt: 法定定义五要点与赔付方式选择权
variants.trap: 买价误当补偿额与赔付方式绝对化
variants.stem: Which of the following statements is NOT part of the five key points in the legal definition of insurance?
variants.zh: 下列哪项表述不属于保险法定定义五个要点的内容？

opts.t: Insurance provides a means of shifting financial responsibility for losses to an insurer in exchange for a premium
opts.w: 把财务责任转移给保险人并支付保费（premium）是法定定义的第一个要点，表述正确。

opts.t: Payment is made only for future accidental losses and never for deliberate or already-occurred property losses
opts.w: 只保将来可能遇到的意外损失、不保故意或已发生财产损失是法定定义的第四个要点，表述正确。

opts.t: Indemnity must always be paid in money and cannot take the form of repairing or replacing the damaged property
opts.w: 法定定义第五点明确规定赔付可以是钱也可以是等值的东西（如修理或更换受损财产），说「必须只赔钱」是错误的绝对化陷阱，因此是本题要选的 NOT 项。

opts.t: The amount of payment is restricted to indemnity so the insured neither profits nor falls short after a loss
opts.w: 赔付以补偿（indemnity）为限、出险后不多不少是法定定义的第三个要点，表述正确。

variants.pt: risk与peril的法定含义区分
variants.trap: 口语偷换法定含义
variants.stem: During an office discussion, an underwriter refers to an insured bakery building as 'a well-maintained risk.' How does this everyday phrasing compare with the strict legal definition of insurance?
variants.zh: 在一次办公室讨论中，承保人把一栋受保的面包房建筑称为「一个维护良好的 risk」。这种日常说法与严格的保险法定定义相比有何不同？

opts.t: In the legal definition, 'risk' means the chance of financial loss, while the bakery building is the object of insurance
opts.w: 法定定义中风险（risk）指亏钱的可能性，而被保的那栋面包房建筑是保险标的（object of insurance），口语里常把标的叫成 risk，考场必须按法定含义区分。

opts.t: In the legal definition, 'risk' means the cause of loss such as fire, while the bakery building itself is the peril
opts.w: 火灾等损失起因是危险（peril），不是 risk，面包房建筑本身也不是 peril。

opts.t: There is no difference because the Insurance Act defines 'risk' solely as the physical bakery property being insured
opts.w: 《Insurance Act》法定定义里的 risk 是亏钱的可能性，把受保的面包房实物财产当成法定定义的 risk 属于口语偷换陷阱。

opts.t: In the legal definition, 'risk' refers to the policy premium charged, while the bakery building is the indemnity
opts.w: 收取的保单保费（premium）和补偿（indemnity）与风险及面包房保险标的的定义完全不同。

variants.pt: 补偿原则与损失发生前一刻价值
variants.trap: 买价误当补偿额与赔付方式绝对化
variants.stem: Why does the legal definition of insurance restrict claim payments to indemnity based on the value immediately before the loss, while excluding deliberate losses?
variants.zh: 为什么保险的法定定义将理赔金额限制在按损失发生前一刻价值计算的补偿范围内，同时排除故意制造的损失？

opts.t: To ensure the insured recovers the actual loss without profiting or wasting resources on deliberate damage
opts.w: 补偿（indemnity）按出事前一刻价值算，是为了让人拿回实际损失、既不靠出事赚钱也不少赔；不保故意损失是因为那会浪费社会资源。

opts.t: To allow policyholders to insure losses that have already occurred whenever they agree to a higher premium
opts.w: 已经发生的损失绝对不保（即便同意付更高保费），否则人人都等出事再买，保险公司无法生存。

opts.t: To guarantee that the insured always receives the original historical purchase price of the damaged home
opts.w: 补偿按受损房屋在损失发生前一刻的价值计算，不是按历史购买价计算。

opts.t: To ensure that private stock insurance companies can retain all premiums without paying claims in cash
opts.w: 限制在补偿范围内是为了防止从损失中获利或补偿不足，与私营股份公司留存保费或拒付现金理赔无关。

variants.pt: 股份公司、相互公司与政府保险人
variants.trap: 口语偷换法定含义
variants.stem: Which statement correctly describes the role of government insurers in the Canadian property and casualty insurance market?
variants.zh: 下列哪项正确描述了政府保险人在加拿大财产与意外险市场中的角色？

opts.t: Government insurers distribute compulsory automobile insurance exclusively through independent brokerages in all four provinces including Quebec
opts.w: 虽然 BC、SK、MB、QC 四省政府都办强制车险，但只有 BC、SK、MB 三省通过独立经纪行（independent brokerage）分销，QC 不在其内。

opts.t: Governments in BC, SK, MB, and QC provide compulsory auto insurance to residents, and SK's insurer also competes in private property lines
opts.w: BC、SK、MB、QC 四省政府向居民提供强制汽车险，且 SK 的政府保险人（government insurer）还在汽车险以外的财产险等领域与私营公司竞争。

opts.t: Government insurers are owned by private corporate shareholders and return annual profit dividends to external stock market investors
opts.w: 由私人企业股东所有并向外部股市投资者派发年度利润分红的是私营股份公司（stock company），不是政府保险人。

opts.t: Liability insurance is the largest line of property and casualty insurance in Canada, exceeding automobile and property premiums combined
opts.w: 在财产与意外险（property and casualty, P&C）三大险种中，汽车险排第一且超过全部 P&C 保费的一半，财产险排第二，责任险排第三。

variants.pt: 直营、独立经纪与代理的特征对比
variants.trap: 代表一家等于雇员
variants.stem: Which of the following statements does NOT apply to the independent brokerage distribution system?
variants.zh: 下列哪项表述不适用于独立经纪分销体系？

opts.t: Brokers are salaried employees representing a single insurance company, and that insurer owns the client book of business
opts.w: 「是代表单一保险公司的受薪雇员且客户业务簿归保险公司」是直营（direct writing）的特征；独立经纪（independent brokerage）不是保险公司雇员，通常代表多家公司，业务归经纪行所有，因此该项是不适用的错项。

opts.t: Brokerages normally represent more than one private insurer as well as the Facility Association for automobile coverage
opts.w: 独立经纪行通常同时代表多家私营保险公司，也可就汽车险代表剩余市场协会（Facility Association），表述正确。

opts.t: Insurers pay the brokerage a commission based on business volume, which the brokerage uses to pay rent and staff salaries
opts.w: 保险公司按业务量向独立经纪行付佣金（commission），经纪行用佣金支付工资、房租等运营开支，表述正确。

opts.t: It is the most widespread channel, handling over 80% of P&C business and government auto insurance in BC, SK, and MB
opts.w: 独立经纪是最主流的分销渠道（占八成以上 P&C 业务），且在 BC、SK、MB 三省经办政府强制车险，表述正确。

variants.pt: 伦敦劳合社的性质与承保条流程
variants.trap: 把劳合社当保险公司
variants.stem: Which statement accurately describes the structure of Lloyd's of London?
variants.zh: 下列哪项表述准确描述了伦敦劳合社的结构？

opts.t: It is a Canadian mutual insurance company owned by commercial policyholders who insure communication satellites and offshore oil rigs
opts.w: 伦敦劳合社（Lloyd's of London）既不是由投保通信卫星和海上钻井平台的商业保单持有人拥有的加拿大相互保险公司，也不是保险公司，而是一个承保人市场。

opts.t: It is a provincial government insurer that competes with private companies for standard residential property and automobile business
opts.w: 劳合社不是省政府保险人，不与私营公司争抢常规住宅财产和汽车险业务，而是主要承保常规保险公司接不了的特殊或复杂风险。

opts.t: It is a marketplace of underwriters who assume risks in their own names and form syndicates managed by underwriting agents for complex risks
opts.w: 劳合社本身不是保险公司，而是由承保人（underwriter）组成的市场，每个承保人以自己名义和资产认风险，复杂风险由多个承保会员组成辛迪加（syndicate）并由承保代理人（underwriting agent）管理。

opts.t: It is a direct writing company whose salaried employees issue policies for unusual commercial risks without using brokers or slips
opts.w: 劳合社不是由受薪雇员直接为特殊商业风险出单的直营保险公司，业务需由经纪人将风险资料写在承保条（slip）上交由承保人认领比例。

variants.pt: 合意要素：要约与无条件承诺
variants.trap: 附条件接受当合意
variants.stem: An insurer sends a property insurance quote with a $500 deductible to a warehouse owner. The owner replies, 'I accept your quote, provided you lower the deductible to $100.' That night, before the insurer responds, wind damages the roof. What is the status of the coverage?
variants.zh: 保险公司向仓库业主发出一份免赔额为 500 加元的财产险报价。业主回复：「我接受报价，前提是你们把免赔额降到 100 加元。」当晚在保险公司回复前，大风吹坏了屋顶。保障处于什么状态？

opts.t: Coverage is in force with a $500 deductible because the owner stated that the quote was accepted.
opts.w: 错误（附条件接受当合意陷阱）。虽然业主口头说了接受，但附带了把免赔额从 500 加元降到 100 加元的条件，不属于无条件承诺（Unconditional Acceptance），合同并未成立。

opts.t: Coverage is voidable at the option of the owner because the loss occurred during negotiations.
opts.w: 错误（无效与未成立混淆陷阱）。可撤销（Voidable）发生在合同形式上已存在但某要素有瑕疵时；这里双方仍在讨价还价，根本没有达成合意（Agreement）。

opts.t: No contract exists because a conditional response is still negotiation rather than an agreement.
opts.w: 正确。合意（Agreement）要求一方提出要约、另一方作出无条件承诺；附条件的回应（要求把 500 加元免赔额改成 100 加元）说明双方仍在谈判，没有合意，因此合同尚未成立。

opts.t: Coverage is automatically bound at the $100 deductible under the rule of utmost good faith.
opts.w: 错误（原则滥用陷阱）。最大诚信（Utmost Good Faith）要求双方诚实，但不能代替合意（Agreement）自动替未回复的保险公司答应新条款。

variants.pt: 缔约能力：商号与未成年人规则
variants.trap: 商号直接当签约主体
variants.stem: Under the rules tested on the exam on legal capacity, which statement accurately describes a contract entered into by a minor for an item that is not a necessity of life?
variants.zh: 按照考试考试资料关于缔约能力的规则，下列哪项准确描述了未成年人就非生活必需品所订立的合同？

opts.t: The minor retains the right to repudiate and void the contract within a reasonable period of time.
opts.w: 正确。按考试考试口径，成年年龄在普通法下是 21 岁（多数省已降到 19 岁或更低），未成年人可以为生活必需品（食物、衣服、住所）订立有效合同，其他合同则保留在合理期限内撤销（Voidable）的权利。（注：考试按考试口径作答；BC 现行《Infants Act》规定未成年人合同对未成年人不可执行，除非成年即 19 岁后一年内追认或未否认，例外清单中无生活必需品一项。）

opts.t: The contract is automatically void from the beginning for both the minor and the adult seller.
opts.w: 错误（无效与可撤销混淆陷阱）。未成年人就非生活必需品订立的合同在考试口径下是可撤销（Voidable），由受保护的未成年人在合理期限内选择是否撤销，而非自始绝对无效（Void）。

opts.t: The broker has the legal authority to evaluate the minor's maturity and declare the contract binding.
opts.w: 错误（越权判断陷阱）。正如经纪人无权评估客户的精神状态一样，经纪人也无权单方面裁定未成年人的非必需品合同不可撤销，有争议应交由法院。

opts.t: The contract is fully enforceable against the minor as long as it uses a trade name with d/b/a.
opts.w: 错误（概念拼接陷阱）。加上 d/b/a 只是解决商号（Trade Name）挂靠业主法定姓名的问题，并不能赋予未成年人订立非生活必需品合同的完全缔约能力（Legal Capacity）。

variants.pt: 风险的四类处理方式与纯风险
variants.trap: 免赔额当风险转移
variants.stem: Which statement correctly pairs a risk handling method or risk category with how it is treated in insurance?
variants.zh: 下列哪项正确配对了风险处理方式或风险类别及其在保险中的定性？

opts.t: Avoidance of risk is the most practical and commonly used method for everyday household perils.
opts.w: 错误（头尾记反陷阱）。回避（Avoidance）因为要把正常生活和经营一并放弃，是最不实用（least practical）的方法；风险转移（Transfer，即买保险）才是最常用、最实用的方法。

opts.t: Pure risk carries a chance of loss with no chance of gain, so it is the only insurable category.
opts.w: 正确。纯风险（Pure risk）只有亏的可能、没有赚的可能，因此是唯一可保的风险类别；投机风险（Speculative risk）既可能亏也可能赚，不可保。

opts.t: Speculative risk becomes insurable whenever the applicant agrees to carry a higher deductible.
opts.w: 错误（投机风险可保陷阱）。投机风险（Speculative risk，如创业、买股票、打牌下注）有获利可能，社会不允许人靠失败获利，无论免赔额多高都不可保。

opts.t: Controlling risk is a complete solution because it eliminates weather perils like hail and lightning.
opts.w: 错误（夸大控制作用陷阱）。风险控制（Controlling）只能降低损失频率和严重度，并不是完整方案，因为风、冰雹、雷击这类自然危险是控制不了的。

variants.pt: 标的合法与可保利益的区分
variants.trap: 赃物与别人财产混为一谈
variants.stem: Which of the following parties has a valid insurable interest that supports an enforceable insurance contract?
variants.zh: 下列哪一方拥有有效的可保利益，能够支撑一份可强制执行的保险合同？

opts.t: A watch repair shop that takes temporary custody of customers' watches for servicing.
opts.w: 正确。受托保管人（Bailee，如干洗店、修车行、修表店）对客人交来保管或维修的财物依法负有责任，一旦受损会在财务上受损，因此具有可保利益（Insurable Interest）。

opts.t: A grandchild who has been promised a family piano when the grandparent passes away.
opts.w: 错误（期待继承陷阱）。对期待继承的财物没有可保利益（Insurable Interest），因为即便钢琴现在毁损，孙辈当前的财务状况和之前并无差别。

opts.t: A homeowner who insures a next-door neighbour's detached garage out of goodwill.
opts.w: 错误（他人财产陷阱）。邻居的车库烧毁不会让该房主在法律和财务上受损，给邻居的财产投保缺乏可保利益（Insurable Interest）。

opts.t: A collector who insures stolen paintings purchased from an illicit seller.
opts.w: 错误（赃物与别人财产混为一谈陷阱）。给偷来的赃物投保违背公共利益，违反的是标的合法（Legality of Object），合同不可强制执行。

variants.pt: 保险专有三要素与无效可撤销
variants.trap: 一般五要素与保险专有三要素混淆
variants.stem: When an applicant deliberately conceals prior policy cancellations on an insurance application, the contract becomes voidable. What does 'voidable' mean in contract law?
variants.zh: 当投保人在投保单上故意隐瞒既往被解约记录时，合同变为可撤销（voidable）。在合同法中，「可撤销」是什么意思？

opts.t: The contract is treated in law as though it never existed for either party.
opts.w: 错误（无效与可撤销混淆陷阱）。「法律上视为从未存在」是无效（Void）的含义，而不是可撤销（Voidable）。

opts.t: The contract remains binding only if the wrongdoer chooses to ratify it after a loss.
opts.w: 错误（权利归属颠倒陷阱）。选择权在受害方（无过错方）手里，过错方无权强行要求合同继续有效。

opts.t: The contract automatically converts into a temporary binder until a court reviews it.
opts.w: 错误（无中生有陷阱）。可撤销合同不会自动变成临时保单（Binder）。

opts.t: The wrongdoer cannot enforce it, while the injured party may keep it in force or cancel it.
opts.w: 正确。可撤销（Voidable）意味着过错方无权要求强制执行合同，而受损害的无过错方则保有选择权，既可以让合同继续有效，也可以选择将其撤销当作无效处理。

variants.pt: 临时保单、承保权限出处与超权限责任
variants.trap: 超权限出险误以为保险公司兜底
variants.stem: Where does a general insurance broker's binding authority come from, and why do insurers often place binding limits in the second document?
variants.zh: 一般保险经纪人的承保权限来自哪里？为什么保险公司常把承保限额写在第二份文件里？

opts.t: From the provincial statute and the cover note, so the regulator can revise underwriting limits without amending the act.
opts.w: 错误（出处张冠李戴陷阱）。零售经纪人的承保权限（Binding Authority）来自保险公司的代理协议与费率手册，而非省成文法或临时保单（Cover note）本身。

opts.t: From the agency agreement and the rate manual, so the insurer can adjust limits as markets change without renegotiating agreements.
opts.w: 正确。经纪人的承保权限有两个出处：①代理协议（Agency Agreement）和②费率手册（Rate Manual）；写在费率手册里是为了市场变化或出了大赔案后，保险公司想调整权限时不必逐家重谈代理协议。

opts.t: From the errors and omissions policy and the endorsement form, so the brokerage can self-authorize prohibited commercial risks.
opts.w: 错误（因果颠倒陷阱）。错误与遗漏（E&O）保险是在经纪人越权承保出险后用来赔付责任的，而不是授予承保权限的文件。

opts.t: From the signed application and the floater form, so the broker can bind oral coverage without sending written confirmation.
opts.w: 错误（概念拼凑陷阱）。投保单（Application）是客户的要约，浮动保单（Floater）是保流动财产的改单文件，均不是承保权限的来源；且口头承保必须立刻书面确认。

variants.pt: 保单变更的三种书面文件
variants.trap: 改条款乱选 Rider 或 Binder
variants.stem: A commercial photographer needs coverage for expensive cameras that are taken to different outdoor shoots every day, while an engineering consultant needs professional liability coverage that is not provided under the consultant's office building policy. Which two documents should be used, in order?
variants.zh: 一位商业摄影师需要为每天带去不同外景地拍摄的昂贵相机投保，而一位工程顾问需要投保其办公楼保单不保的职业责任险。依次应当使用哪两种文件？

opts.t: An endorsement followed by a binder.
opts.w: 错误（文件用途混淆陷阱）。常离开原地点的摄影器材用浮动保单（Floater），办公楼保单不保的职业过失需要另立保单（Separate Policy），而不是临时保单（Binder）。

opts.t: A separate policy followed by an endorsement.
opts.w: 错误（顺序与用途混淆陷阱）。流动摄影器材用浮动保单（Floater），而新增完全独立的职业责任险才用另立保单（Separate Policy）。

opts.t: A binder followed by a floater.
opts.w: 错误（文件用途混淆陷阱）。临时保单（Binder）只用于正式出单前的临时保障，不能解决长期流动器材保障或新增独立险种的问题。

opts.t: A floater followed by a separate policy.
opts.w: 正确。承保流动性大、常离开原地点的财产（如承包商工具、摄影师器材、珠宝）用浮动保单（Floater）；原合同一字不动、另买一份独立险种（如在办公楼保单外另买职业责任险，且不必是同一家保险公司）用另立保单（Separate Policy）。

variants.pt: 省级监管职能与偿付能力
variants.trap: 省政府职能混入「定价」
variants.stem: A newly incorporated property insurer has obtained its federal licence after meeting the strict financial standards of OSFI. Before this insurer can legally sell property policies to residents in a specific province, what else is required and how is its solvency regulated?
variants.zh: 一家新成立的财产保险公司达到了联邦金融机构监理署（OSFI）的严格财务标准并取得了联邦牌照。在该保险公司合法向某省居民销售财产保单之前，还需要满足什么要求？其偿付能力如何受监管？

opts.t: It needs no further licence because a federal licence automatically grants authority to sell in every province
opts.w: 错在「无需省牌照」。讲义明确指出，在哪个省做业务就要在哪个省领牌，即使已经有联邦牌照（Federal Licence）也必须取得该省牌照。

opts.t: It must have its property premium rates set by the provincial Superintendent before issuing any policies
opts.w: 掉入「省政府定价」陷阱。省保险监理官负责监督合同条款和发牌，不为私营财产险设定保费水平。

opts.t: It must still obtain a provincial licence where it operates, while OSFI continues to monitor its solvency
opts.w: 正确。联邦注册的保险公司由联邦金融机构监理署（OSFI）持续监控其财务稳健与偿付能力（Solvency），但进入任何一个省营业时，仍必须向该省保险监理官申领省级牌照。

opts.t: It must deposit its entire premium revenue with PACICC in advance to guarantee future claim payments
opts.w: 混淆了偿付能力监管与破产兜底机制。财产与意外险赔偿公司（PACICC）是在同业破产时先垫付有效索赔、再按直接承保保费向同业摊派（Assessment），不需要事前把全部保费存入 PACICC。

variants.pt: 经纪人与保险人的受托责任
variants.trap: 把「未赚」偷换成「全部」
variants.stem: A client pays a 12-month policy premium to a brokerage at the start of the policy term. Three months into the term, how is the insurer's fiduciary obligation regarding that premium defined?
variants.zh: 客户在保期开始时向经纪行支付了一份 12 个月保单的保费。保期过去三个月时，保险人对这笔保费的受托责任（Fiduciary Obligation）是如何界定的？

opts.t: The insurer may treat the entire 12-month premium as earned revenue once the policy has been in force for 60 days
opts.w: 错在「满 60 天即全部视为已赚」。保费必须到 12 个月保期届满才算完全赚到；60 天只是代理协议常见的经纪行汇款期限上限（30 到 60 天），与保费是否赚到无关。

opts.t: One-quarter of the premium is earned for expenses and claims, while the remaining unearned portion is held in trust
opts.w: 正确。12 个月的保单过了 3 个月，保险人只赚到了 3/12（即四分之一），可用于支付工资、运营和赔款；剩余未赚保费（Unearned Premium）视为信托持有（Held in Trust），若保单提前取消须退还给被保险人。

opts.t: The insurer must hold 100% of the premium in trust until the policy expires without deducting any operating costs
opts.w: 掉入「把未赚偷换成全部」陷阱。已过保期对应的已赚保费（Earned Premium）可以用来支付工资、运营开销和赔款，只有未赚部分才视为信托持有。

opts.t: The insurer has no fiduciary responsibility for unearned premiums because only brokers act as fiduciaries
opts.w: 错在「只有经纪人是受托人」。讲义明确指出，保险人和经纪人都是受托人（Fiduciaries），都对未赚取的那部分资金负有受托保管义务。

variants.pt: 起保时刻与搬移条款条件
variants.trap: 起保时间与地址张冠李戴
variants.stem: Hannah carries $120,000 of property coverage on her home contents, and her policy expires in 4 days. When a nearby wildfire threatens her street, she moves half her furniture to a rented storage unit in another town. The wildfire causes $95,000 of damage to the contents left at her home. How does the removal clause apply to the furniture in the storage unit?
variants.zh: Hannah 的家居财物保额为 120,000 加元，保单还有 4 天到期。当附近的山火威胁到她所在街道时，她把一半家具搬到了另一镇租用的储物仓。山火对留在她家里的财物造成了 95,000 加元的损失。搬移条款（Removal Clause）如何适用于储物仓里的家具？

opts.t: It is covered at the storage unit for the remaining 4 days of the policy term, for up to the $25,000 limit left
opts.w: 正确。搬移条款（Removal Clause）三个条件全部命中：① 为防止承保危险（山火）造成损失而必须搬离；② 保障期为 7 天或保单剩余期取短者（剩余 4 天比 7 天短，所以保 4 天）；③ 可用保额须扣减原地点已发生的损失（120,000 减去 95,000，剩 25,000 加元）。

opts.t: It is covered at the storage unit for the full 7-day removal period, for up to the original $120,000 policy limit
opts.w: 漏掉了「取短者」与「扣减原地点损失」两条规则。保单只剩 4 天到期，不能保满 7 天；原地点已损失 95,000 加元，未列明地点最多只剩 25,000 加元保额可用。

opts.t: It is not covered at all because the rented storage unit is an unnamed location not listed on the declarations page
opts.w: 忽略了法定搬移条款例外。虽然保单通常只保列明地点，但为躲避承保危险、防止损失或进一步损失而搬往未列明地点时，法律强制延伸保障。

opts.t: It is covered for 7 days, just as if she had moved the furniture there temporarily to make room for home renovations
opts.w: 混淆了搬离原因。只有受到承保危险威胁而被迫搬离才触发搬移条款；为了装修腾地方、家里放不下寄存别处，都不属于搬移条款的承保范围。

variants.pt: 限额条款警示、代位、弃权与交付
variants.trap: 起保时间与地址张冠李戴
variants.stem: Marcus received his fire insurance policy in the mail three weeks ago, but he has not yet paid the premium invoice. Yesterday, a negligent repair contractor accidentally started a fire that damaged Marcus's workshop. How do the Insurance Act rules on policy delivery and subrogation apply?
variants.zh: Marcus 三周前收到了寄来的火险保单，但还没支付保费账单。昨天，一名疏忽的维修承包商意外引发火灾，烧毁了 Marcus 的工坊。《Insurance Act》关于保单交付和代位求偿（Subrogation）的规则如何适用？

opts.t: The delivered policy binds the insurer despite the unpaid premium, and after paying the claim, it may sue in Marcus's name
opts.w: 正确。保单一旦交付（Delivery of Policy）即约束保险人，即使保费未付也必须理赔；保险人赔付之后取得代位求偿权（Subrogation），可以「站进被保险人的鞋里」，以 Marcus（被保险人）的名义向疏忽的承包商追偿。

opts.t: The insurer may deny the fire claim because a delivered policy is not binding until the initial premium is paid in full
opts.w: 违反保单交付规则。保单已经交付给被保险人，即使还没付保费，合同对保险人依然有约束力。

opts.t: Marcus must first sue the negligent contractor himself, and the insurer only pays if the contractor proves to be insolvent
opts.w: 颠倒了理赔与代位求偿的顺序。代位求偿是保险人先向被保险人赔付承保损失，然后才代位行使对责任方的追偿权。

opts.t: The insurer must pay the fire claim first, and then sue the contractor in the insurer's own name for double the loss amount
opts.w: 错在「以保险人自己的名义」及「双倍索赔」。代位求偿诉讼必须以被保险人的名义提起，且只追偿已赔付的损失。
