variants.pt: 火险三必保、四除外与敌意之火
variants.trap: 火险法定除外「连坐」后续火灾
variants.stem: By law, every policy insuring against the peril of fire must provide coverage for three mandatory perils, subject to four statutory exclusions. Which statement accurately reflects these rules?
variants.zh: 根据法律规定，每一份承保火灾危险的保单都必须承保三项法定必保危险，并适用四项法定除外。下列哪项陈述准确反映了这些规则？

opts.t: It must cover fire, windstorm, and every type of mechanical or chemical explosion that occurs on the insured property during the policy term
opts.w: 混入了「风暴」并扩大了「爆炸」范围。三项法定必保是火、雷电、以及天然气／煤气／人造气的爆炸（Explosion of natural, coal, or manufactured gas），不含风暴，也不是一切爆炸。

opts.t: It covers fire, lightning, and natural, coal, or manufactured gas explosion, excluding lightning damage to electrical devices unless fire ensues
opts.w: 正确。火险保单的三项法定必保是火（Fire）、雷电（Lightning）和燃气爆炸（天然气、煤气或人造气）；同时雷击电器设备本身属于四项法定除外之一，但如果雷击电器后引发了火灾，后续火灾损失照赔。

opts.t: It covers damage caused by both friendly fires contained in a hearth and hostile fires, provided that actual ignition and flame take place
opts.w: 错在「承保友好之火」。友好之火（Friendly Fire）是指待在容器里的火（如壁炉里的柴火），保单只承保跑出容器外的敌意之火（Hostile Fire）。

opts.t: If an electric iron overheats and sets fire to an ironing board and the kitchen wall, the entire loss including the kitchen wall is excluded
opts.w: 掉入「法定除外连坐后续火灾」陷阱。直接加热（Application of heat）除外只排除被熨烫的那件衣物本身；引燃烫衣板和厨房墙壁的火灾属于敌意之火，照常理赔。

variants.pt: 法定条件1至5：重大变更与合同终止
variants.trap: 法定条件「临时活动算重大变更」与「欺诈只扣虚报项」
variants.stem: Victor converts his detached residential garage into a full-time commercial woodworking shop and promptly notifies his property insurer in writing. Under Statutory Condition 4 (Material Change), what options does the insurer have?
variants.zh: Victor 把自家独立车库改造成全职商业木工坊，并及时书面通知了他的财产保险公司。根据法定条件 4（重大变更 Material Change），保险人有哪些选择？

opts.t: The insurer may only cancel the policy by giving 30 days' personal written notice and retaining a short-rate cancellation penalty
opts.w: 通知天数与退费方式全错。保险人终止没有 30 天当面通知的规定（法定条件是挂号信 15 天或当面 5 天），且保险人取消只能按比例（Pro Rata）退费，不能收短期费率（Short Rate）罚金。

opts.t: The insurer may cancel and return the unearned premium, or give written notice of the extra premium that Victor must pay within 15 days
opts.w: 正确。将私人车库改为全职商业木工坊属于实质且持续的重大变更（Material Change）。被保险人及时告知后，保险人可以退还未赚保费并取消保单，或选择继续承保并书面通知须在收到通知后 15 天内补交额外保费（若 15 天内不付则可取消并退未赚部分）。

opts.t: The insurer must keep the policy in force at the original residential rate until the current annual policy period expires at renewal
opts.w: 错在「必须按原费率维持到续保」。重大变更大幅增加了损失可能性，保险人有权取消或要求在 15 天内补交加费。

opts.t: The insurer may alter the wording of Statutory Condition 4 with Victor's signed written consent in order to exclude woodworking fires
opts.w: 违反法定条件不可修改原则。法定条件（Statutory Conditions）对合同双方均有约束力，任何改动、删减或增加对被保险人都无效，即使得到被保险人同意也不能改。

variants.pt: 法定条件6至15：理赔、欺诈与时效
variants.trap: 法定条件「临时活动算重大变更」与「欺诈只扣虚报项」
variants.stem: After a warehouse fire, the insured submits a verified proof of loss on May 1. Under the exam rules for the Statutory Conditions, what are the statutory deadlines for payment, election to repair, and starting legal action?
variants.zh: 仓库失火后，被保险人于 5 月 1 日提交了经核实的损失证明（Proof of Loss）。按法定条件（Statutory Conditions）的考试口径，付款、选择修复重置以及提起诉讼的法定期限分别是什么？

opts.t: Payment within 30 days of the loss; written notice to repair within 15 days and work begun within 30 days of the loss; lawsuit within 2 years of proof of loss
opts.w: 把所有天数和起算点都搞混了。付款是损失证明完成后 60 天内，通知修复是收到损失证明后 30 天内（45 天内开工），诉讼是自损失发生后 1 年内（考试口径）。

opts.t: Payment within 45 days of proof of loss; written notice to repair within 60 days and work begun within 90 days of proof of loss; lawsuit within 6 months of the loss
opts.w: 把 45 天（开工期限）和 60 天（付款期限）调换了位置，且修复通知、开工期限与 6 个月诉讼时效均错。

opts.t: Payment within 60 days of proof of loss; written notice to repair within 15 days and work begun within 45 days of proof of loss; lawsuit within 1 year of proof of loss
opts.w: 错在「15 天通知修复」和「自损失证明起算 1 年」。通知修复是收到损失证明后 30 天内，而 1 年诉讼时效是从「损失发生之日（after the loss occurs）」起算，不是从交损失证明起算。

opts.t: Payment within 60 days of proof of loss; written notice to repair within 30 days and work begun within 45 days of proof of loss; lawsuit within 1 year after the loss occurs
opts.w: 正确。把条件 12、13、14 的四个核心数字和两个起算点全部对齐：① 付款：损失证明（Proof of Loss）完成后 60 天内；② 修复重置（Replacement）：收到损失证明后 30 天内书面通知意图、45 天内开工；③ 诉讼（Action）：考试口径下须在损失发生后 1 年内提起（MB、SK 为 2 年）。注：BC 现行《Insurance Act》将财产险诉讼时效改为自知道或应当知道损失发生起 2 年，且法定条件现行只剩 14 条，但考场答题一律按 15 条及 1 年时效作答。

variants.pt: E&O头号原因与成因
variants.trap: E&O主因与次因混淆
variants.stem: Which of the following is the single largest source of errors and omissions (E&O) claims against insurance brokers, accounting for almost half of all such claims?
variants.zh: 在针对保险经纪人的错误与遗漏（E&O）索赔中，下列哪一项是占近一半比例的最大来源？

opts.t: Delays in processing policy endorsement requests submitted by policyholders during the policy term.
opts.w: 错误。在保单期内处理批单请求拖延以及保单变更出错都属于「其他 E&O 来源」，不是占近 50% 的最大来源，属于「E&O主因与次因混淆」陷阱。

opts.t: Violating the conditions set out in the brokerage agreement signed with the insurer.
opts.w: 错误。违反与保险公司签订的经纪协议（brokerage agreement）是其他五种 E&O 来源之一，不是头号原因，属于「E&O主因与次因混淆」陷阱。

opts.t: Inadequate coverage, such as failing to arrange coverage in time or giving wrong advice on its availability.
opts.w: 正确。保障不足（inadequate coverage）占错误与遗漏（E&O）索赔的近 50%，是头号原因，包括未告知除外、未安排或安排太晚、给错保障、对能否买到某保障给了错误说法。

opts.t: Making administrative errors during policy cancellation or renewal notice procedures for existing clients.
opts.w: 错误。为现有客户办保单取消或续保通知时出错只是其他 E&O 来源之一，并非占近一半的主因，属于「E&O主因与次因混淆」陷阱。

variants.pt: 对客户的法律标准与E&O保险
variants.trap: 考试口径与BC现行法混淆
variants.stem: Under the rules tested on the exam, why do individual employees working inside an insurance brokerage not need to purchase their own separate errors and omissions (E&O) insurance policy?
variants.zh: 根据考试考试口径，为什么在保险经纪行内部工作的个人员工不需要自己单独购买一份错误与遗漏（E&O）保险？

opts.t: Because individual brokers cannot be named in an E&O claim if a client suffers a financial loss.
opts.w: 错误。当经纪人未达到合理的技能、谨慎与勤勉（reasonable skill, care and diligence）标准致客户亏损时，客户可以同时向经纪人个人和经纪行提出错误与遗漏（E&O）索赔。

opts.t: Because the insurer whose policy was sold is legally required to pay for all broker negligence.
opts.w: 错误。Broker 首要对客户负责，其职业过失由经纪行的 E&O 保单保障，并非由承保财产险的保险公司买单。

opts.t: Because the standard of reasonable skill, care and diligence applies only to brokerage owners, not staff.
opts.w: 错误。合理的技能、谨慎与勤勉标准适用于向客户提供建议和安排保障的经纪人，并非只适用于老板。

opts.t: Because the E&O policy purchased by the brokerage covers all staff members working for that brokerage.
opts.w: 正确。按考试口径，经纪行购买的 E&O 保单覆盖行内全体工作人员，因此个人不必另买。注：BC 现行 Council Rules 要求每位持牌人都必须持有或被覆盖于 E&O 保险，离职或换行时必须确认自己被雇主保单覆盖，但考卷答题一律按考试资料考试口径。

variants.pt: 物质危险与道德危险区分
variants.trap: 物质与道德危险混淆
variants.stem: A shop owner leaves flammable waste piled near equipment and refuses to fix safety issues, remarking, "Why bother spending money on prevention when the insurance policy will pay for everything anyway?" Under the rules tested on the exam, how is this attitude classified?
variants.zh: 一位店主把易燃废料堆在设备旁且拒绝整改安全隐患，还说：「反正保单什么都会赔，干嘛还要花钱防损？」考试把这种态度归为哪一类？

opts.t: Moral hazard, because an attitude of indifference to loss stems from the applicant's personal character.
opts.w: 正确。按 FOI 考试口径，因为有保险就粗心大意、抱着「反正都保了」而对损失漠不关心（indifference to loss）的心态出自申请人性格，归在道德危险（moral hazard）之下。

opts.t: A peril, because the owner's carelessness is the direct event that destroys the property.
opts.w: 错误。风险事故（peril）是造成损失的事件（如火灾、盗窃），而危险（hazard）是可能引发风险事故的条件，不能把条件当成事件。

opts.t: Structural physical hazard, because the attitude directly alters the construction type of the building.
opts.w: 错误。建筑结构类型属于物质危险（physical hazard），而题干问的是店主「反正都保了」的漠不关心态度，属于「物质与道德危险混淆」陷阱。

opts.t: An easily visible condition that requires no investigation into the applicant's character.
opts.w: 错误。物质危险才看得见且容易发现，而道德危险（含财务、品行、对损失漠不关心的主观特征）往往很难不经调查就发现，属于「物质与道德危险混淆」陷阱。

variants.pt: 核保人身份首要职能与信息源
variants.trap: 核保首要职能与次要工作混淆
variants.stem: When an underwriter reviews loss experience data as one of the four main sources of underwriting information for a class of business, over what time period is that loss history typically examined?
variants.zh: 当核保人将「损失经验数据」作为四类主要核保信息源之一来评估某类业务时，通常查看过去多长时间的赔付历史？

opts.t: The past 3 to 5 years of claims paid compared with premiums collected for that class of risk.
opts.w: 正确。核保人的四个信息源是投保单、经纪人、损失经验数据（loss experience data）和检查报告（inspection report）；其中损失经验数据看的是过去 3 到 5 年该类风险的赔款与保费对比。

opts.t: Only the single most recent policy term of the individual applicant.
opts.w: 错误。损失经验数据看的是公司在这类风险上过去 3 到 5 年的赔付历史，而不是只看单个申请人最近一期。

opts.t: Every single policy year since the insurer was first established, maintained by independent adjusters.
opts.w: 错误。讲义明确损失经验数据看过去 3 到 5 年，而不是从保险公司成立起的所有年份，且不由独立理赔人维护。

opts.t: The first 30 calendar days after a brokerage submits a new application.
opts.w: 错误。30 个日历日是 BC 现行规则下无 E&O 保险自动停牌的期限，与核保查看过去 3 到 5 年损失经验数据无关，属于「考试口径与BC现行法混淆」陷阱。

variants.pt: 五种核保决定与定价分工
variants.trap: 核保首要职能与次要工作混淆
variants.stem: After reviewing an application for a workshop with minor housekeeping issues, an underwriter decides not to reject the risk outright. Along with refusing the risk or accepting it as submitted, which of the following completes the five possible underwriting decisions?
variants.zh: 在审核一家存在轻微内务管理问题的车间投保单后，核保人决定不直接拒保。除了拒保和按递交条件原样接受外，下列哪一项完整列出了其余三种核保决定？

opts.t: Accepting with a lower premium, waiving the deductible, or transferring the risk to an independent adjuster.
opts.w: 错误。风险偏高时核保人会加费率或提高免赔额，而不是降费或免除免赔额，更不会把承保风险转给独立理赔人。

opts.t: Accepting at an increased rate, accepting with an increased deductible, or accepting subject to certain conditions.
opts.w: 正确。核保的五种决定是：拒保、按递交条件接受、加费率后接受、提高免赔额后接受、附带某些条件接受。

opts.t: Issuing a renewal certificate, sending a cancellation notice, or delegating rating to the client.
opts.w: 错误。准备续保证明和取消通知属于保单持有人服务（policyholder's service），不是对投保申请的核保决定，属于「核保首要职能与次要工作混淆」陷阱。

opts.t: Requiring the broker to co-insure the loss, freezing the rate, or filing an E&O claim.
opts.w: 错误。经纪人不是保险合同当事人，不承担共同保险赔付，这三项都不属于五种核保决定。

variants.pt: 理赔两步流程与两类理赔人
variants.trap: 考试口径与BC现行法混淆
variants.stem: In the standard claims process, when would an insurer typically assign an independent adjuster rather than a company adjuster to handle a loss?
variants.zh: 在标准理赔流程中，保险公司通常在什么情况下会指派独立理赔人而不是公司理赔人来处理损失？

opts.t: For every routine claim, because company adjusters are not permitted to deal directly with policyholders.
opts.w: 错误。公司理赔人（company adjuster）是保险公司内部理赔人员，处理大部分日常案件。

opts.t: Only when a client files an E&O claim against the brokerage for inadequate coverage.
opts.w: 错误。独立理赔人（independent adjuster）用于处理保单出险后的理算，并非只在发生 E&O 索赔时才使用。

opts.t: When the insurer lacks sufficient internal staff in that area or when the claim requires specialized expertise.
opts.w: 正确。公司理赔人处理大部分案子；当保险公司内部人手不够，或该次理算需要特别专长时，会聘用独立理赔公司的人（独立理赔人），有时保险公司也会允许经纪行代为指定。

opts.t: Whenever the broker exercises authority as a first line underwriter to reject the claim.
opts.w: 错误。「首线核保人（first line underwriter）」是指经纪人在投保阶段最早评估风险并如实向保险公司披露，经纪人并不负责拒赔或理算。

variants.pt: 对保险公司义务与首线核保人
variants.trap: 单边义务陷阱
variants.stem: Although the industry often refers to all insurance salespeople as brokers, what are the two legal distinctions between an agent and a broker under the rules tested on the exam?
variants.zh: 尽管行业里习惯把所有保险销售人员都统称为 broker，但按考试口径，代理人（agent）与经纪人（broker）在法律上的两点区别是什么？

opts.t: An agent is a direct party to the insurance contract, whereas a broker is an unlicensed employee hired by the policyholder.
opts.w: 错误。无论是 Agent 还是 Broker，都只是中介（intermediary），既不是保险合同的直接当事人（parties to the contract 只有被保险人和保险公司），也不是保单持有人雇用的无牌雇员。

opts.t: An agent's main duty is to the insurer and usually for one company; a broker's main duty is to the client across multiple insurers.
opts.w: 正确。两点区别：① 首要义务对谁：Agent 对保险公司，Broker 对客户；② 代表几家公司：Agent 通常一家，Broker 虽可代表一家但多数情况下替客户在多家保险公司之间比较。注：BC 现行《Financial Institutions Act》只定义 insurance agent、insurance salesperson 和 insurance adjuster，broker 是行业用语而非牌照类别，但答题按两点区别。

opts.t: An agent owes a duty of honesty only to the insurer, whereas a broker owes a duty of honesty only to the policyholder client.
opts.w: 错误。经纪人两头都有义务：对客户尽合理技能、谨慎与勤勉，对保险公司作为首线核保人必须说真话、不隐瞒重要信息，并非只对保单持有人客户诚实，属于「单边义务陷阱」。

opts.t: An agent handles only complex commercial policy rating, whereas a broker handles only loss adjusting after a claim occurs.
opts.w: 错误。复杂商业险保单定价是核保人（underwriter）的工作，出险后的损失理算是理赔人（claims adjuster）的工作，都不是区分 Agent 与 Broker 的标准。

variants.pt: 三者取最小与ACV计算
variants.trap: 三者取最小漏算或错选受款人
variants.stem: Marcus owns a custom glassblowing furnace that is destroyed when the studio roof collapses under snow load. When the adjuster determines the actual cash value (ACV) of the furnace under the policy's indemnity agreement, which rule applies to the valuation?
variants.zh: 马库斯拥有一座定制玻璃吹制窑炉，在工作室屋顶被积雪压塌时全毁。当理赔人根据保单赔偿协议核定该窑炉的实际现金价值（ACV）时，适用下列哪项定损规则？

opts.t: The adjuster must include the furnace's future investment value and sentimental value when calculating replacement cost before subtracting depreciation.
opts.w: 错在把未来投资价值和感情价值算入重置成本与赔款；保险遵循完全补偿（complete indemnity）原则，不赔错过的未来收益或感情价值。

opts.t: The insurer bears the legal burden of proving replacement cost through supplier quotes, and depreciation is deducted from the original purchase price.
opts.w: 错在颠倒了举证责任；通过供应商报价证明重置成本（replacement cost）的举证责任在被保险人，且折旧是从重置成本而非原买价中扣除。

opts.t: The settlement is always fixed at the full policy limit shown on the declarations page, regardless of the insured's actual financial interest in the property.
opts.w: 错在无视“三者取最小”原则（ACV、被保险人权益、保额三者取最小），并非不论被保险人实际财务利益一律按声明页保额赔付。

opts.t: The insured must prove replacement cost, and the adjuster deducts depreciation based on condition, obsolescence, resale value, and normal life expectancy.
opts.w: 正确。计算实际现金价值（ACV ＝ 重置成本 − 折旧）时，重置成本的举证责任在被保险人（需提供供应商或承包商报价），理赔人再综合状况（condition）、过时（obsolescence）、转售价值（resale value）和正常寿命（normal life expectancy）四个因素核定折旧。

variants.pt: 建筑重置成本三条件
variants.trap: 重置成本三条件缺一仍按新价算
variants.stem: David's music academy carries commercial property insurance with an IBC 4005 replacement cost endorsement. After a covered water loss, David submits claims for several damaged items. Which item is INELIGIBLE for replacement cost settlement and must be handled on another valuation basis?
variants.zh: 大卫的音乐学院投保了附有 IBC 4005 重置成本批单的商业财产险。在一场承保的水损事故后，大卫就多项受损财物提交索赔。其中哪一项不符合重置成本赔付条件，必须按其他估值基础处理？

opts.t: Retail stock of music books held for sale, and an old amplifier already replaced before the loss and left unused in storage.
opts.w: 正确。IBC 4005 批单明文不适用于商业存货（stock）；同时，财物与设备按重置成本（replacement cost）赔付要求出险时仍能按原用途使用，已经换了新机而留着没扔的旧设备不按重置成本赔。

opts.t: Damaged acoustic studio walls that are promptly repaired on the same site using new building materials of like kind and quality.
opts.w: 错在墙体在原址尽职迅速用同类同质（like kind and quality）新料修复，完全符合建筑重置成本三条件。

opts.t: An active digital mixer whose exact model is discontinued, replaced promptly with the closest new model performing the same function.
opts.w: 错在根据 IBC 4005 规则，买不到完全相同的新财产时，尽量相似且能发挥同样功能的新财产即视为同类同质。

opts.t: A damaged recital hall roof whose reconstruction on the same site is completed after a brief delay caused by municipal permit review.
opts.w: 错在市政审批延误不影响重置成本保障，且同址实际完工满足重置成本三条件。

variants.pt: 标准按揭条款与受偿顺序
variants.trap: 三者取最小漏算或错选受款人
variants.stem: Sophia borrows $60,000 from a private lender to buy a floral shop building, and her property policy includes an IBC 3000 Standard Mortgage Clause. Unbeknownst to the lender, Sophia misrepresents a material fact on her insurance application, and a covered fire later destroys the shop. How does the Standard Mortgage Clause govern this situation?
variants.zh: 索菲亚向一位私人放贷人借款 $60,000 购买花店建筑，其财产险保单包含 IBC 3000 标准按揭条款。在放贷人不知情的情况下，索菲亚在投保申请时对重要事实作了不实陈述，随后一场承保火灾烧毁了花店。标准按揭条款如何处理这一情况？

opts.t: Neither Sophia nor the private lender can collect under the policy, because only chartered banks and trust companies qualify as mortgagees under the clause.
opts.w: 错在误以为只有银行和信托公司能做按揭权人；任何对承保财产有可保利益的人（银行、信托公司、信用社、个人）都可以是按揭权人（mortgagee）。

opts.t: The insurer may deny Sophia's claim, but must still pay the lender up to its $60,000 insurable interest and then acquires subrogation rights against Sophia.
opts.w: 正确。标准按揭条款（Standard Mortgage Clause）保证按揭权人的利益不因被保险人的不实陈述或违反条件而失效，故保险公司拒赔索菲亚后仍须向私人放贷人赔付其 $60,000 可保利益，并在赔付额范围内代位取得向索菲亚追偿的权利（排在按揭权人收回全部按揭权益之后）。

opts.t: The insurer may immediately cancel the policy without giving statutory notice to the private lender once Sophia's misrepresentation on the application is discovered.
opts.w: 错在违反了标准按揭条款的第二项保证：不给按揭权人同样的法定通知，保险公司不得终止保单或作不利于按揭权人的改动。

opts.t: The insurer is legally responsible for delivering the certified copy of the policy to the private lender, failing which Sophia's misrepresentation is excused.
opts.w: 错在混淆了送达核证副本（certified copy）的责任人；确保按揭权人收到保单核证副本是被保险人自己的责任。

variants.pt: 条件与保证的拒赔规则
variants.trap: 把保证当条件看因果关系
variants.stem: Hannah is reviewing the conditions and warranties section of a property policy for her licensing exam. Under standard exam rules, which statement accurately describes statutory conditions, policy conditions, and warranties?
variants.zh: 汉娜正在为牌照考试复习财产险保单中的条件与保证章节。按照考试口径，下列哪项准确描述了法定条件、保单条件与保证？

opts.t: Statutory conditions are drafted individually by property insurers to manage risk, whereas policy conditions are enacted directly by provincial statute.
opts.w: 错在把法定条件（statutory conditions，由成文法规定）与保单条件（policy conditions，由保险公司自定）的来源说反了。

opts.t: A breach of warranty removes coverage only when it directly triggers the loss, whereas breaching any policy condition removes coverage regardless of cause.
opts.w: 错在把条件（condition）和保证（warranty）对因果关系的要求完全颠倒，掉进了“把保证当条件看因果关系”陷阱。

opts.t: Statutory conditions apply to fire property, accident and sickness, and auto policies, and conditions set duties the insured must follow or refrain from.
opts.w: 正确。按考试口径，法定条件（statutory conditions）出现在承保火的财产保单、意外与疾病险及汽车险中，且条件（condition）规定被保险人必须履行或不得从事的义务。（注：考试按此考试口径作答，而 BC 现行《Insurance Act》s.8 与 s.29 将 Part 2 法定条件适用于寿险、意外疾病险等之外的一切合同。）

opts.t: Warranties do not require strict compliance by the policyholder as long as the insured agrees to pay a higher deductible when a loss claim is submitted.
opts.w: 错在保证（warranty）要求严格遵守（strict compliance），不能靠多付免赔额免除违约后果。

variants.pt: 除外财产与除外风险辨析
variants.trap: 空置天数缩水与雷电误列除外
variants.stem: Even an "all risks" property policy excludes nine common perils unless special coverage is purchased. Which of the following losses is caused by a peril that is generally COVERED rather than excluded under a standard property policy?
variants.zh: 即使是“一切险”财产保单，除非另行加购保障，否则也会除外九项共同风险。下列哪项损失是由标准财产险保单通常承保（而非除外）的风险引起的？

opts.t: Basement damage caused by municipal sewer back-up and overland floodwaters.
opts.w: 错在下水道倒灌（sewer back-up）与洪水（flood）均属于九项共同除外风险（perils excluded），尽管洪水和地震很容易加买。

opts.t: A wooden gable shattered and set ablaze by a direct lightning strike during a summer storm.
opts.w: 正确。雷电（lightning）是火险保单的法定必保风险，不属于共同除外风险（仅雷击电器设备本身有法定除外），因此雷击直接损毁屋顶山墙属于承保范围。

opts.t: Extra reconstruction expenses required to comply with a municipal building by-law.
opts.w: 错在因执行建筑法规（by-law）而增加的修理或建造费用属于九项共同除外风险之一。

opts.t: Greenhouse glass fouled by smoke from agricultural smudging and steel frames weakened by gradual rust.
opts.w: 错在农业熏烟（smudging）或工业烟以及锈蚀（rust）、腐蚀、磨损均属于共同除外风险。

variants.pt: 直接损失与间接损失区分
variants.trap: 灭火破坏当间接、断电坏货当直接
variants.stem: A brief electrical fire on an outdoor mast burns the power cable feeding Grace's commercial cheese warehouse, cutting off electricity while the warehouse is closed for three days. When Grace reopens, the power cable is charred and all refrigerated cheese stock has spoiled. Under her unendorsed commercial property policy, what is covered?
variants.zh: 户外电杆上的一场短暂电气火灾烧毁了通往格蕾丝商业奶酪仓库的电缆，导致仓库在歇业三天期间断电。格蕾丝重新开门时，电缆已烧焦，冷藏库内的全部奶酪存货均已变质。在她未加批单的商业财产险保单下，哪些损失受保？

opts.t: Only the direct fire damage to the power cable feeding the warehouse, not the spoiled cheese stock.
opts.w: 正确。火的直接损失（direct loss）仅限于通往仓库的那段电线；断电三天导致的商业存货变质是直接损失的后果，属于间接损失（indirect loss），未加批单的标准商业财产险不保。

opts.t: Both the charred power cable and the spoiled cheese stock, because the fire started the chain of events.
opts.w: 错在掉进“断电坏货当直接”陷阱，把断电引起的冷库商业存货变质当成了火灾直接损失。

opts.t: Only the spoiled cheese stock, because commercial property policies automatically cover freezer spoilage.
opts.w: 错在混淆了个人险与商业险：通常对冰柜食物另有保障的是居住类保单，而非标准商业财产险。

opts.t: The spoiled cheese stock plus the lost wholesale revenue from the three-day closure.
opts.w: 错在把断电坏货和营业收入损失这两项间接损失（indirect loss）都算进了未加批单的商业财产险。

variants.pt: 成对成套与部件赔付规则
variants.trap: 三者取最小漏算或错选受款人
variants.stem: In Elena's commercial print shop, a falling beam cracks a single replaceable roller assembly inside a multi-part binding machine, and vandals ruin one corner panel of a sectional lobby floor covering that originally cost $3,000 for the whole room. Under the parts rule, what is the insurer obligated to pay?
variants.zh: 在埃琳娜的商业印刷店里，一根掉落的横梁砸裂了一台多部件装订机内部的一个可更换滚轴组件，同时蓄意破坏者毁坏了整屋原价 $3,000 的大堂拼接地垫的一角。根据部件规则，保险公司有义务赔付什么？

opts.t: The full replacement cost of the entire multi-part binding machine and the entire $3,000 floor covering.
opts.w: 错在要求整件更换，违反了部件（parts）规则只赔受损部分的原则。

opts.t: The retail price of the damaged component alone, excluding any labour cost required for its installation.
opts.w: 错在漏掉了安装费用；部件（parts）规则明确包含受损部件的价值加上安装费（plus the cost of installation）。

opts.t: A flat 2.5% allowance of the total commercial policy limit to cover minor component and flooring damage.
opts.w: 错在把屋顶折旧算例里的 2.5% 混入部件规则，部件规则不按保额固定百分比赔付。

opts.t: The value of the damaged component plus installation costs, without replacing the whole machine or floor.
opts.w: 正确。根据部件（parts）规则，由多个部件组成的财产只坏了一部分时，只赔坏掉部件的价值加安装费（value of the damaged part plus the cost of installation），不赔整台机器或整屋 $3,000 的地垫。

variants.pt: 被保险人定义与同住条件
variants.trap: 忽略非具名被保险人出险时必须同住的硬条件
variants.stem: Elena is the sole named insured on a Homeowners policy. Following a burglary at her home, whose stolen belongings would qualify for coverage under the definition of the Insured?
variants.zh: Elena 是家主保单上唯一的具名被保险人。在她家发生入室盗窃后，根据被保险人（the Insured）的定义，谁被盗的物品符合承保资格？

opts.t: Her partner, who has lived with her continuously for 18 months and is the adoptive co-parent of their child
opts.w: 同居伴侣（common-law partner）若与具名人同为某个子女的亲生或收养父母（natural or adoptive parents of the same child），只需连续同居满 1 年即符合配偶定义；同居 18 个月已达标。

opts.t: Her 22-year-old foster son, who lives in her home and works full-time at a local warehouse while saving for school
opts.w: 非亲属的受照管人员（如寄养子女）必须在 21 岁以下（under 21 years of age）且受具名人照管才算被保险人；已满 22 岁且非全日制受供养学生不在被保险人范围内。

opts.t: Her brother, who lives across town in a rented apartment and stored his winter clothing in Elena's basement
opts.w: 双方亲属（relatives）必须在出险时与具名人住在同一家庭（living in the same household）才属于被保险人；住在城另一头的兄弟不算被保险人。

opts.t: A full-time university student who pays Elena monthly rent to board in a spare bedroom during the school year
opts.w: 寄宿者与房客（boarders and roomers）明确排除在被保险人定义之外，无论年龄或是否在读。

variants.pt: 十一项扩展的条件与免赔额
variants.trap: 扩展保障的条件刺与免赔额混淆
variants.stem: A burglar steals a handbag containing the insured's house keys. The police are notified, and the locks are rekeyed at a cost of $420. If the Homeowners policy has a $500 deductible, how is this claim settled?
variants.zh: 窃贼偷走了装有被保险人家门钥匙的手提包。被保险人已报警，并花费 $420 重新配锁。如果家主保单的免赔额为 $500，这项索赔如何结算？

opts.t: Nothing is paid because the $420 rekeying expense falls below the $500 policy deductible
opts.w: 换锁扩展（lock replacement）属于五项不扣免赔额（no deductible）的扩展保障之一（其余四项为消防费、冰柜食品、纵火奖励、信用卡伪钞），不受 $500 免赔额限制。

opts.t: $420 is paid in full because no deductible applies to the Lock Replacement extension, up to $500
opts.w: 钥匙被盗并已报案（stolen and reported to police）符合换锁扩展（lock replacement）条件，最高赔付 $500 且不扣免赔额（no deductible），换锁或改钥匙由保险公司决定，故全额赔付 $420。

opts.t: Nothing is paid because the extension only covers full lock replacement, not rekeying existing locks
opts.w: 换锁扩展明确规定可以换锁或改钥匙（locks replaced or rekeyed），且选择换锁还是改钥匙由保险公司决定（at the insurer's option）。

opts.t: $420 is paid only if the burglar actually used the stolen keys to enter the insured dwelling
opts.w: 换锁扩展的触发条件是钥匙被盗并报案，目的是预防窃贼用钥匙进屋，并不要求窃贼已经使用该钥匙入室。

variants.pt: 赔付基础与法规升级除外
variants.trap: 误以为重置成本或保证重置成本会赔新建筑规范升级费用
variants.stem: Following a theft loss, an insured chooses to take an immediate Actual Cash Value (ACV) settlement for 100 stolen music CDs rather than replacing them right away. Under the IBC Homeowners Basis of Claim Payment, what right does the insured retain?
variants.zh: 发生盗窃损失后，被保险人选择对被盗的 100 张音乐 CD 先拿实际现金价值（ACV）结算，而不是立即买回。在 IBC 家主表的赔付基础下，被保险人保留什么权利？

opts.t: No further right, because electing an immediate ACV settlement permanently waives replacement cost coverage on the stolen items
opts.w: 先选实际现金价值（ACV）结算并不会永久放弃重置成本权利，保单允许在规定期限内修复或替换后补领差额。

opts.t: The right to replace the CDs within 30 days of the loss and claim the difference between ACV and replacement cost
opts.w: 30 天是财产转移、搬家和空置停保的期限，而先拿 ACV 后补领重置成本差额的期限是 180 天。

opts.t: The right to repair or replace the CDs within 180 days of the loss and claim the difference between ACV and replacement cost
opts.w: 赔付基础条款规定，被保险人可先选择实际现金价值（ACV）结算，若从损失日起 180 天内（within 180 days of the date of loss）决定修复或替换，可再索赔 ACV 与重置成本（replacement cost）之间的差额。

opts.t: The right to claim replacement cost even without buying new CDs, provided proof of loss is filed within 90 days of the theft
opts.w: 个人财产必须实际完成修复或替换（repaired or replaced）才能获得重置成本赔付，不修不换只能按 ACV 结算。

variants.pt: Coverage C 两类特别限额与计算
variants.trap: 特别限额错把「仅被盗」当「不论原因」
variants.stem: An insured consultant's $3,000 business laptop is stolen from her hotel room while attending a conference in Calgary. In a separate burglary at her home in Vancouver, thieves steal a home desktop computer worth $4,000 and commercial software worth $3,200. Ignoring the deductible, how does Coverage C respond to these losses?
variants.zh: 一位投保顾问价值 $3,000 的营业用手提电脑在卡尔加里开会住酒店时被盗。在温哥华家中的另一起入室盗窃中，窃贼偷走了价值 $4,000 的家用台式电脑和价值 $3,200 的商用软件。不考虑免赔额，Coverage C 如何赔付这些损失？

opts.t: Pays $2,000 for the business laptop in Calgary, $4,000 for the home desktop, and $2,500 for the software
opts.w: 营业用书籍、工具和仪器（books, tools and instruments pertaining to a business）虽然有 $2,000 特别限额，但仅在处所上（only while on the premises）才保；带去外地酒店被盗全额拒赔。

opts.t: Pays $0 for the business laptop away from the premises, $4,000 for the home computer hardware, and $2,500 for the software
opts.w: 营业财产（business property）只在处所上（on the premises）受保，带去酒店被盗赔 $0；家用电脑硬件（computer hardware）不受特别限额限制全赔 $4,000，而电脑软件（computer software）适用 $2,500 的不论原因特别限额。

opts.t: Pays $0 for the business laptop, $2,500 for the home computer hardware, and $2,500 for the commercial software
opts.w: $2,500 的特别限额只限制电脑软件（computer software），电脑硬件（hardware）没有特别限额，因此 $4,000 的家用台式机全额赔付。

opts.t: Pays $3,000 for the business laptop under temporary removal, $4,000 for the hardware, and $3,200 for the software
opts.w: 营业财产不适用个人财产的全球临时离开（temporarily away from the premises）保障，离开处所即无保障；同时软件受 $2,500 特别限额封顶。

variants.pt: 1151水损4天与空置两只时钟
variants.trap: 空置（vacant）两只时钟与冬季离家 4 天混用
variants.stem: A family is permanently transferred to another province and moves out of their home on May 1, leaving several rooms of furniture behind while trying to sell the house. No new occupant moves in. On May 10, vandals break several windows and smash a bathroom sink, causing water damage. Under an IBC 1151 policy, how is this claim handled?
variants.zh: 一家人被永久调往外省，于 5 月 1 日搬出住宅，在卖房期间留下了几个房间的家具，且没有新住户搬入。5 月 10 日，破坏分子砸碎了几扇窗户并砸烂浴室洗手盆导致水损。在 IBC 1151 保单下，这项索赔如何处理？

opts.t: Covered in full, because leaving several rooms of furniture inside means the dwelling is considered unoccupied rather than vacant
opts.w: 空置（vacant）的定义明确指出「不论是否留有家具（regardless of the presence of furnishings）」，只要所有住户已迁出且无意返回、也无新住户，即构成空置。

opts.t: Covered in full, because the vandalism and water damage occurred on Day 10, well within the 30-consecutive-day vacancy grace period
opts.w: 混淆了空置的两只时钟：明知空置超过 30 个连续日是所有险种全部停保；但破坏或恶意行为、水损、玻璃破碎三项危险在空置当刻（immediately upon becoming vacant）就已经停保。

opts.t: Only the broken windows are covered, because glass breakage remains insured for the first 30 consecutive days after the home becomes vacant
opts.w: 玻璃破碎（glass breakage）与破坏（vandalism or malicious acts）、水损（water damage）一样，在住宅处于在建或空置期间（while under construction or vacant）当刻即除外不保。

opts.t: Denied in full, because coverage for vandalism, water damage, and glass breakage ceases immediately when the dwelling becomes vacant
opts.w: 所有住户迁出且无意返回即为空置（vacant，不论有无家具）；破坏或恶意行为、水损、玻璃破碎三项承保危险在空置当刻立即停止（无需等到 30 天），故 5 月 10 日的损失全额拒赔。

variants.trap: 1153 阔表承保范围与共管摊派条件张冠李戴
variants.stem: Smoke puffs back from a wood-burning living room fireplace, staining the living room sofa and curtains. Under which IBC Homeowners form(s) would the damage to the sofa and curtains be covered?
variants.zh: 客厅烧木柴的壁炉倒灌冒烟，熏黑了客厅沙发和窗帘。在哪一张（或哪几张）IBC 家主表下，沙发和窗帘的损坏会得到赔付？

opts.t: IBC 1155 Comprehensive Form only, because personal property is insured on an All Risks basis which does not exclude fireplace smoke
opts.w: 沙发和窗帘属于个人财产（Coverage C）。在列名险中，烟害（smoke）明确除外壁炉冒烟（smoke from a fireplace）；1151 与 1153 的个人财产均按十三项列名险承保，只有 1155 Comprehensive Form 将个人财产升级为一切险（All Risks），从而承保壁炉烟害。

opts.t: Both IBC 1153 Broad Form and IBC 1155 Comprehensive Form, because both forms upgrade personal property coverage to an All Risks basis
opts.w: 1153 Broad Form 仅把建筑（A、B）升级为一切险，室内沙发和窗帘属于个人财产（C），在 1153 下仍适用十三项列名险，壁炉烟不赔。

opts.t: All three forms (1151, 1153, and 1155), because sudden and abnormal smoke from any domestic heating device is one of the 13 Named Perils
opts.w: 虽然烟（smoke）是十三项列名险之一，但条文限定为供暖或炊事设备突发、异常、故障运行冒烟，并明确除外壁炉（fireplace）冒烟。

opts.t: None of the three forms, because smoke puffing back from a wood-burning fireplace is a standard exclusion under every Homeowners policy
opts.w: 1155 综合表（Comprehensive Form）下的一切险并未将壁炉冒烟列为除外责任，这正是讲义指出的 1155 典型「多赔」好处之一。

variants.pt: 共管单元业主表的损失分摊与改良
variants.trap: 1153 阔表承保范围与共管摊派条件张冠李戴
variants.stem: A condominium unit owner spent $15,000 upgrading the original builder-grade carpet in his unit to hardwood flooring. A burst water pipe destroys the flooring. How is coverage arranged between the Condominium Corporation's policy and the unit owner's Condominium Unit Owners Form?
variants.zh: 一位共管单元业主花费 $15,000 将单元内开发商原装的地毯升级为硬木地板。一根爆裂的水管毁坏了地板。共管法团保单与业主的共管单元业主表之间如何划分保障？

opts.t: The Condominium Corporation's policy covers the full $15,000 hardwood upgrade on a replacement cost basis because flooring is permanently attached to the building
opts.w: 共管法团（Condominium Corporation）的保单只保开发商原装标准配置（original installations），不赔业主后来自己做的改良所增加的价值。

opts.t: The unit owner's policy covers the increased value under Unit Improvements and Betterments at replacement cost, while the corporation's policy covers original installations
opts.w: 原装地毯在共管法团保单里，而业主后来改装硬木地板增加的价值由业主自己的共管单元业主表中的「单元改良（Unit Improvements and Betterments）」按重置成本（replacement cost）承保（基本限额 $1,000，常见为 C 的 25%）。（注：本题按考试口径作答；BC 现行《Strata Property Act》s.149/s.161 规定分契法团必须保原装固定装置，业主自保后期改良。）

opts.t: The unit owner's policy covers both the unit's original purchase price and the $15,000 hardwood flooring upgrade under Coverage A on a replacement cost basis
opts.w: 共管单元业主表（Condominium Unit Owners Form）不设住宅建筑 Coverage A，也不承保单元的购买价（does not cover the purchase price of the unit），楼体结构由法团保单承保。

opts.t: The unit owner's Loss Assessment coverage pays for the $15,000 hardwood flooring inside his own unit on an Actual Cash Value basis, up to the $5,000 standard limit
opts.w: 损失分摊（loss assessment）保的是共有财产损失向全体业主的摊派，而非业主自己单元内的装修改良；且单元改良是按重置成本（replacement cost）而非 ACV 赔付。

variants.pt: 建筑、存货与设备的归类边界
variants.trap: 租户改良与植物错格
variants.stem: A company owns its office building and keeps several items on the premises: live palm trees in the indoor lobby, silk floral arrangements in the reception area, and lumber stored for a major structural addition. Which of these is insured under the building category?
variants.zh: 一家公司拥有自己的办公楼，并在处所内放有几样物品：室内大堂里的活棕榈树、前台区域的丝绸插花，以及为大型结构加建而存放的木材。其中哪一项由建筑（building）这一格承保？

opts.t: Both the live palm trees in the lobby and the silk floral arrangements in the reception area
opts.w: 错在把丝绸花也算作建筑（building）。只有业主自有建筑内用于装饰的活植物（live decorative plants）才属于建筑，办公室里的丝绸花属于设备，落入了「租户改良与植物错格」陷阱。

opts.t: The lumber stored on the premises for the upcoming major structural addition
opts.w: 错在混淆了日常维护材料与大修翻新材料。只有为维护、日常修理和小改动放在处所上的材料才归建筑（building），大修或新建用的材料不在此列，需要另买建工险。

opts.t: The silk floral arrangements and the lumber, while live plants are always excluded
opts.w: 错在颠倒了建筑（building）的承保边界。丝绸花和大修木材都不算建筑，反而是业主自有建筑内用于装饰的活棕榈树明确归入建筑。

opts.t: Only the live palm trees kept for decorative purposes inside the owner-occupied building
opts.w: 正确。在业主自有建筑（owner-occupied building）内用于装饰的活植物属于建筑（building）范畴；丝绸花、门前户外种的树、大修翻新材料都不属于建筑。

variants.pt: 共保公式计算与被保险人自担额
variants.trap: 偷换所问（赔款 vs 自担额）
variants.stem: A warehouse has an actual cash value of $600,000 and is insured for $360,000 subject to an 80% co-insurance clause. Following a windstorm that causes a $90,000 partial loss, how much must the insured absorb out of pocket?
variants.zh: 一间仓库的实际现金价值（ACV）为 $600,000，在适用 80% 共保条款的保单下投保了 $360,000。一场风暴造成 $90,000 的部分损失后，被保险人必须自己掏腰包承担多少？

opts.t: $22,500, because the insurer pays $67,500 and the insured bears the remaining balance
$67,500, which is the amount calculated by applying the co-insurance ratio to the $90,000 loss
opts.w: 错在落入「偷换所问（赔款 vs 自担额）」陷阱。$67,500 是保险人赔付的金额，不是被保险人自掏腰包的金额。

opts.t: $90,000, because the insured failed to carry the required $480,000 of insurance coverage
opts.w: 错在认为未保足 $480,000 就一分不赔。共保条款只按 Did ÷ Should 的比例折算部分损失赔款，不会全额拒赔。

opts.t: $5,000, because the co-insurance penalty is capped at the $5,000 waiver threshold
opts.w: 错在混淆了共保豁免（waiver of co-insurance）门槛与共保自担额。$5,000 是小额损失是否触发共保的豁免上限，不是共保罚则的封顶线。

variants.pt: 共保豁免门槛与红色警示规则
variants.trap: 小额损失误套共保罚则
variants.stem: Under the rules tested on the exam, what printing requirement applies to a commercial property policy containing a co-insurance clause, and what is the maximum loss eligible for the co-insurance waiver on a $400,000 policy limit?
variants.zh: 按照考试所考的标准考试资料规则，含有共保条款的商业财产保单须满足什么印制要求？在保额为 $400,000 的保单下，可享受共保豁免的最高损失额是多少？

opts.t: A warning stamped in red ink on the first page, and a maximum waiver threshold of $8,000
opts.w: 错在共保豁免（waiver of co-insurance）取的是「保额的 2%（$8,000）」与「$5,000」中的较小者而非较大者，落入了「小额损失误套共保罚则」的数字混淆陷阱。

opts.t: A warning printed on the back page, and a maximum waiver threshold of $4,000
opts.w: 错在警示位置与豁免金额均不符。警示必须印在保单首页（first page），且 $400,000 保额的 2% 为 $8,000，与 $5,000 取较小者应为 $5,000。

opts.t: A warning stamped in red ink on the first page, and a maximum waiver threshold of $5,000
opts.w: 正确。按考试口径，含共保等限额条款的保单须在首页用红色墨水（red ink）印警示，否则不约束被保险人（注：BC现行《保险法》s.31已改为首页印醒目粗体警示语，但考卷按考试资料答红色墨水）；保额 $400,000 的 2% 是 $8,000，与 $5,000 取较小者为 $5,000。

opts.t: No special warning is required for commercial policies, and a maximum waiver threshold of $5,000
opts.w: 错在认为商业保单不需要印制限额警示。凡含免赔、共保等限额条款的合同，漏印首页警示则该条款对被保险人不具约束力。

variants.pt: 列名险表与广式表的承保对比
variants.trap: 广式表当成「包赔一切」
variants.stem: An underwriter is calculating the basic fire rate for a commercial property policy and adding a loading for Broad Form coverage. Which of the following factors is NOT one of the five underwriting factors used to determine the basic fire rate?
variants.zh: 核保人正在计算一份商业财产保单的基本火险费率，并为广式表保障加上附加费（loading）。下列哪一项不属于决定基本火险费率的五个核保因素？

opts.t: The occupancy of other tenants sharing the same commercial building
opts.w: 错在误以为邻居用途不影响费率。占用（occupancy）是五大费率因素之一，同一栋楼里有餐馆、修车行等高火险邻居，也会把本商户的火险费率拉高。

opts.t: The total number of employees working on the premises and the firm's annual revenue
opts.w: 正确。基本火险费率（basic fire rate）只看结构、保护、占用、地点、过去五年的理赔记录五个因素；员工人数和营业额都不在五因素里，是典型的干扰项。

opts.t: The distance to the nearest fire hall, fire hydrants, and automatic sprinkler systems
opts.w: 错在把公共保护与私人保护（public and private protection）排除在外。消防站远近、消防栓水源与店内自动喷淋直接决定火险费率高低。

opts.t: The frequency and severity of fire losses experienced over the past five years
opts.w: 错在忽略了理赔记录（loss experience）。核保人确定基本火险费率时，会重点审查过去五年的火损次数和严重度。

variants.pt: 残骸清理、代位求偿与防护系统
variants.trap: 广式表当成「包赔一切」
variants.stem: A restaurant is required by its commercial property policy to maintain an automatic kitchen fire suppression system. Unknown to the insured, debris inside a pipe blocks the system before a grease fire breaks out. How does the protective safeguards provision apply?
variants.zh: 一家餐馆按其商业财产保单要求须维护厨房自动灭火系统。在被保险人毫不知情的情况下，管道内的杂物在油脂起火前堵住了系统。防护系统条款对此如何适用？

opts.t: Coverage remains in force because an unknown defect does not constitute a breach of the notification obligation
opts.w: 正确。防护系统（protective safeguards）条款规定，被保险人只对「知道的」中断或缺陷、维护合同取消、或因误报被警方暂停出警负有立即通知义务；被保险人浑然不知的管道堵塞不算违反，保险人不得因此拒赔。

opts.t: Coverage is automatically suspended from the moment the pipe becomes blocked regardless of knowledge
opts.w: 错在把防护系统条款当成了无过错绝对失效保证。只有被保险人知道缺陷却未立即通知时，保险人才可减保、加费或注销。

opts.t: The insurer will pay the claim but exercise subrogation against the restaurant's business partner who cooked that day
opts.w: 错在违反了代位求偿（subrogation）放弃规则。保险人对保单涉及其利益的人（如收款人、合伙人、子公司）放弃代位求偿权。

opts.t: The policy limit is permanently reduced by the amount of the fire claim unless an additional premium is paid
opts.w: 错在违背了恢复条款（reinstatement）。商业财产保单发生赔付后，保额自动恢复，既不减少保额也不另收保费。

variants.pt: 犯罪险证据门槛与处所外财产
variants.trap: 犯罪险与上锁车辆缺证据
variants.stem: A merchant adds transit coverage for stock and leaves boxes of merchandise inside an unattended delivery van with a fully enclosed body. All doors are locked, but the driver leaves a side window slightly open for ventilation, and a thief reaches in to steal the boxes without leaving any marks. Is this loss covered?
variants.zh: 一名商人为存货加保了运输途中保障，并将几箱货物留在无人看管的全封闭厢式货车内。所有车门均已锁好，但司机为了通风将侧窗留了一条缝，小偷伸手拿走了货箱且未留下任何痕迹。这笔损失赔吗？

opts.t: Yes, because the delivery van has a fully enclosed body and all doors were locked
opts.w: 错在掉进「犯罪险与上锁车辆缺证据」陷阱。上锁车辆保证（Locked Vehicle Warranty）要求四件齐全，缺了「车窗关严」和「可见强行进入痕迹」任何一条都不赔。

opts.t: Yes, because the parked van qualifies as a temporary location outside the insured's control
opts.w: 错在误用临时地点（temporary location）概念。临时地点指不归被保险人所有、租用或控制的地点（如送修的木工店），自家配送车受上锁车辆保证约束。

opts.t: No, unless the merchant also purchased Boiler and Machinery insurance for the delivery vehicle
opts.w: 错在混淆险种。锅炉与机器险（Boiler and Machinery）保的是超过 15 psi 的压力容器爆炸及机械电气故障，与运输途中存货被盗毫无关系。

opts.t: No, because the Locked Vehicle Warranty requires closed windows, locked doors, and visible marks of entry
opts.w: 正确。上锁车辆保证（Locked Vehicle Warranty）规定，无人看管车辆里的财产被偷，必须同时满足四项：全封闭车身或车厢、门锁着、窗关着、且有可见的强行进入痕迹（visible marks of forcible entry）。

variants.pt: 营业中断与额外费用险的触发与期限
variants.trap: 广式表当成「包赔一切」
variants.stem: An insurance brokerage wants to ensure that if a fire destroys its office, it can immediately rent temporary quarters and lease computers at higher-than-normal cost so that operations never stop. Which coverage is specifically designed for this need?
variants.zh: 一家保险经纪行希望确保万一办公室被大火烧毁，能够立即以高于平时的成本租用临时场所和电脑，使业务不中断。哪一种保障是专门为此需求设计的？

opts.t: Business Interruption (Earnings Form), which pays lost net profit while the business shuts down
opts.w: 错在险种定位不符。盈利式（Earnings Form）保的是停业期间失去的利润和持续费用，赔到财产修好为止，而经纪行需要的是不停业继续运转的多花费用。

opts.t: Extra Expense Insurance (IBC 4027), which pays the extra costs above normal to continue operating
opts.w: 正确。额外费用险（Extra Expense Insurance, IBC 4027）专保损失后继续正常营业所需的一切比平时多出来的额外费用，不要求证明这些费用减少了索赔，最适合保险经纪、旅行社、医生、报社、银行这类停几天都受不了的业务。

opts.t: Builder's Risk – Broad Form (IBC 4042), which covers temporary offices for up to 30 consecutive days
opts.w: 错在混淆险种。建工险（Builder's Risk）保的是在建工程的材料（按完工价值买，停工超 30 天终止），不保办公室灾后临时租房和租电脑的额外营业费用。

opts.t: Installation Floater, which covers office computers while being leased after a catastrophe
opts.w: 错在混淆了安装流动险（Installation Floater）。安装流动险保的是专做机器设备安装的承包商从运输、等待安装到安装验收期间的物损，不保灾后维持营业的额外费用。

variants.pt: 普通法与成文法的特征及优先关系
variants.trap: 法源特征张冠李戴
variants.stem: During a licensing study session, four candidates compare how common law and statute law operate in British Columbia. Which candidate's statement is ACCURATE?
variants.zh: 在一次考牌学习讨论中，四名考生比较了普通法与成文法在不列颠哥伦比亚省的运作方式。哪位考生的陈述是准确的？

opts.t: Once a common law precedent is established by a court, a provincial legislature cannot override it by passing a statute.
opts.w: 颠倒了优先顺序。省议会通过成文法（statute law）后，优先于同一事项上的任何普通法先例（common law precedent），属于【法源特征张冠李戴】。

opts.t: Statute law can only be enacted by a legislature after courts have already established a line of precedent on the same issue.
opts.w: 混淆了成文法的立法条件。议会可以在完全没有先例的领域直接通过成文法制定规则，不需要先有法院判例，属于【法源特征张冠李戴】。

opts.t: Common law precedents set in previous cases can never be overturned by the courts even when social conditions have changed.
opts.w: 违背普通法演进规则。当社会时代条件变化时，旧的普通法先例可能被法院推翻，属于【限定词偷换陷阱】中的绝对化表述。

opts.t: Written law enacted by parliament or a provincial legislature takes priority over any conflicting common law precedent.
opts.w: 正确。议会或省议会通过的书面成文法（statute law）优先于针对同一事项的任何冲突普通法先例。

variants.pt: 侵权三要素与过失的可预见性
variants.trap: 限定词偷换陷阱
variants.stem: After slipping on icy steps outside a bakery, a courier breaks an ankle. On the way to the hospital, the ambulance is struck by a driver who runs a red light, giving the courier a concussion. Under the elements of a tort and negligence, what is the bakery occupier's legal position?
variants.zh: 一名快递员在面包店外的结冰台阶上滑倒摔断脚踝。送医途中，救护车被一名闯红灯的司机撞上，导致快递员脑震荡。根据侵权三要素与过失规则，面包店占用人的法律责任是什么？

opts.t: The occupier is liable for both the broken ankle and the concussion because the initial slip on the icy steps started the chain of events.
opts.w: 忽略了近因（proximate cause）中断规则。虽然最初在结冰台阶滑倒开启了事件链，但闯红灯司机是插进来的另一个主因，脑震荡并非台阶结冰的直接后果，属于【限定词偷换陷阱】。

opts.t: The occupier is presumed negligent for both injuries unless the occupier can prove that the bakery steps were properly cleared and salted.
opts.w: 颠倒了普通法过失的举证责任。过失必须由原告证明（negligence must be proved），被告在被证明前视为无辜，并非预设对两项伤害都有过失、须自证已清理撒盐才能免责，只有严格责任才倒置举证，属于【严格责任与拒赔划等号】。

opts.t: The occupier may be liable for the broken ankle as a foreseeable direct result, but not for the concussion caused by the other driver.
opts.w: 正确。根据侵权三要素与近因（proximate cause）规则，被告只对违反法律义务所直接导致且可合理预见（foreseeable）的脚踝骨折负责，另一名闯红灯司机撞击救护车导致脑震荡属于介入的独立主因，归该司机负责。

opts.t: The occupier owed only a moral duty to clear natural ice from the steps and therefore has no legal liability for either of the injuries.
opts.w: 混淆了法律义务与道德义务。占用人对进入场所的使用者负有保持台阶合理安全的法律义务（legal duty），不是道德义务，属于【限定词偷换陷阱】。

variants.pt: 严格责任的适用范围与可保性
variants.trap: 严格责任与拒赔划等号
variants.stem: A rural farm operator brings tanks of toxic ammonia gas onto the property for agricultural processing. A valve fails despite regular maintenance, and escaping gas sickens neighbouring residents. How is the operator's liability determined?
variants.zh: 一名农场经营者为了农业加工将有毒氨气罐带入场所。尽管定期维护，一个阀门仍然失灵，逃逸的气体使邻近居民生病。经营者的责任如何认定？

opts.t: The operator is strictly liable because a dangerous substance brought onto the premises escaped, and liability insurance generally covers this unless excluded.
opts.w: 正确。占用人为自身利益把本来不在那里的危险物（如泳池水、气体、毒物）带入场所，一旦逃逸伤人即负严格责任（strict liability）；除非保单另有除外，责任保险一般承保此类赔偿。

opts.t: The operator has no tort liability because the regular maintenance records prove the operator exercised the care of a reasonable and prudent person.
opts.w: 错误。危险物从场所逃逸适用不问过错的严格责任，不能仅凭定期维护记录证明已尽到合理谨慎人注意就免除侵权责任，属于【严格责任与拒赔划等号】。

opts.t: The operator is subject only to criminal penalties for the gas leak, meaning neither civil damages nor general liability insurance coverage applies.
opts.w: 错误。气体意外泄漏致邻居受损属于民事侵权索赔损害赔偿金（damages），并非仅受刑法处罚的犯罪，责任保险一般也予以承保，属于【严格责任与拒赔划等号】。

opts.t: The neighbouring residents bear the burden of proving the operator negligently or intentionally released the gas before any civil recovery is allowed.
opts.w: 错误。严格责任下举证责任倒置，邻近居民无需承担证明经营者因过失或故意排放气体的举证责任即可索赔，属于【严格责任与拒赔划等号】。

variants.pt: 占用人对不同进入者的注意义务
variants.trap: 进入者义务档次错位
variants.stem: A builder leaves an unfenced excavation pit with bright yellow machinery on a residential lot. A seven-year-old child wanders onto the lot to play on the machinery and is injured. Under the rules tested on the exam, how is this situation classified?
variants.zh: 一名建筑商在住宅地块上留下一个未围栏的挖掘坑和鲜黄色的机械。一名七岁儿童走进地块爬上机械玩耍时受伤。根据考试所考的规则，这种情况如何归类？

opts.t: Because the child entered without permission, the child is treated as an adult trespasser and the builder only owes a duty not to set deliberate traps.
opts.w: 错误。儿童缺乏避险的成熟判断，即便未经许可进入，也不按普通成年侵入者（trespasser）仅不设陷阱的最低义务对待，属于【进入者义务档次错位】。

opts.t: The unfenced pit and machinery are an attractive nuisance (allurement), so the occupier must keep the premises free from any danger to children.
opts.w: 正确。未围栏的基坑与机械等天然吸引儿童的东西称为诱惑性危险物（attractive nuisance 或 allurement），按考试口径，占用人对儿童负有最重一档义务：必须使场所免于任何危险。（注：本题按考试口径作答；BC 现行《Occupiers Liability Act》s.3(1) 规定标准始终是在一切情形下合理，并无绝对免于任何危险这一档。）

opts.t: The child is classified as a licensee on the lot, meaning the builder is liable only for concealed dangers of which the builder had actual knowledge.
opts.w: 错误。把受诱惑物吸引的儿童混同于被许可人（licensee）仅防实际已知隐蔽危险的标准，属于【进入者义务档次错位】。

opts.t: The builder has no legal liability for the accident because parents are always legally responsible for injuries suffered by their minor children.
opts.w: 错误。占用人对受诱惑物吸引的儿童负有独立保护义务，且父母并非「总是（always）」对未成年子女相关事故负责，属于【限定词偷换陷阱】。

variants.pt: 房东与有偿保管人的注意义务
variants.trap: 限定词偷换陷阱
variants.stem: Under a residential lease for an unfurnished house, the landlord agrees to be responsible for structural repairs. A porch railing becomes rotten, and the tenant notifies the landlord twice over three weeks, but the landlord does nothing. A guest leans on the railing, falls, and is injured. Why is the landlord liable under the rules tested on the exam?
variants.zh: 在一份不带家具住宅的租约中，房东同意负责结构维修。门廊栏杆腐烂，租客在三周内通知了房东两次，但房东未采取任何行动。一名客人靠在栏杆上摔倒受伤。根据考试所考的规则，房东为什么要负责？

opts.t: Because landlords are strictly liable for any injury occurring on leased premises regardless of notice.
opts.w: 错误。房东默认不负责，也不适用不问通知的严格责任，属于【严格责任与拒赔划等号】。

opts.t: Because the landlord contracted to make repairs and failed to do so after receiving reasonable notice of the defect.
opts.w: 正确。按考试口径，房东约定负责维修，且在收到关于缺陷的合理通知（reasonable notice）后仍不修，由此造成的伤害或财产损失由房东负责。（注：本题按考试口径作答；BC 现行《Occupiers Liability Act》s.6 规定只要租约把维修责任放在房东身上且违约对占用人可诉即负责，条文并未把事先通知列为绝对前提。）

opts.t: Because a residential landlord acts as a bailee for hire with respect to the personal safety of the tenant's visitors.
opts.w: 错误。有偿保管人（bailee for hire）是指为出售以外目的收费暂时保管他人动产的人（如修车行、干洗店），与住宅房东对租客访客的人身安全无关，属于【进入者义务档次错位】。

opts.t: Because every lease of an unfurnished dwelling carries an implied warranty of fitness throughout the lease term.
opts.w: 错误。只有带家具出租的房屋（furnished premises）才推定在租期开始时适合出租用途，不带家具住宅默认并无贯穿租期的适租默示保证，属于【限定词偷换陷阱】。

variants.pt: 雇主替代责任、工伤保险与独立承包商
variants.trap: 职务过程与承包控制混淆
variants.stem: A commercial building owner hires a reputable independent roofing contractor to repair a flat roof. However, the building owner insists on supplying an old scaffolding rig that has a cracked plank and directs the crew on how to position it. The plank snaps and injures a passerby. Who is legally liable under the rules tested on the exam?
variants.zh: 一名商业楼宇业主聘请了一家信誉良好的独立屋顶承包商修理平屋顶。然而，业主坚持提供一套带裂纹木板的旧脚手架，并亲自指挥工人如何摆放。木板断裂砸伤了一名路人。根据考试所考的规则，谁在法律上负责？

opts.t: Only the independent roofing contractor is liable because a building occupier is never legally responsible for work performed by an outside contractor.
opts.w: 错误。楼宇占用人虽然一般不对独立承包商（independent contractor）的过失负责，但存在三项共担例外，说「绝不负责（never legally responsible）」属于【限定词偷换陷阱】。

opts.t: Neither party can be sued in tort by the injured passerby as long as the roofing contractor maintains active provincial Workers' Compensation coverage.
opts.w: 错误。工伤保险（Workers' Compensation）取代的是受伤雇员起诉雇主的权利，不剥夺受伤路人（第三方）向侵权人提起侵权诉讼的权利，属于【职务过程与承包控制混淆】。

opts.t: Only the building owner is liable because hiring an independent contractor automatically creates employer-employee vicarious liability for all site accidents.
opts.w: 错误。独立承包商不是雇员，聘请承包商不会自动产生雇主对雇员的替代责任；触发异常情形时是占用人与承包商共同承担责任（jointly liable），而非仅业主一人负责，属于【职务过程与承包控制混淆】。

opts.t: Both the building owner and the contractor share liability because the owner supplied defective equipment and controlled how the work was done.
opts.w: 正确。按考试口径，占用人选任独立承包商尽了合理注意且工作本应进行时一般不负责，但在三种情形下须与承包商共担责任：工作本身危险、伤害由占用人提供的有缺陷设备造成、或占用人控制了施工方式。（注：本题按考试口径作答；BC 现行《Occupiers Liability Act》s.5(1)(a) 还要求占用人在选任之外对监督 supervision 也尽到合理注意才能免责。）

variants.pt: 连带责任、家养动物与父母对子女的责任
variants.trap: 限定词偷换陷阱
variants.stem: A 14-year-old is given a high-powered snowmobile by their parents and rides it unsupervised across a neighbour's landscaped yard, destroying rare shrubs. Under what rule can the neighbour hold the parents legally liable?
variants.zh: 一名 14 岁少年收到父母给的大功率雪地摩托，在无人看管的情况下骑车穿过邻居家的园艺院子，毁坏了名贵灌木。邻居可以根据什么规则要求其父母承担法律责任？

opts.t: Although parents are generally not liable for a child's torts, they are liable here for failing to supervise a dangerous thing entrusted to the child.
opts.w: 正确。父母默认不代赔子女的侵权，但有四项例外：明显未尽监管控制、损害由父母交给孩子控制的危险物或动物（如枪、刀、全地形车、雪地摩托、鞭炮、猛兽）造成、按父母指示授权行事、或受雇于父母的生意。本题触发了「交给危险物并疏于监管」例外。

opts.t: Parents are automatically and unconditionally liable in tort for all property damage committed by an unmarried minor child living in their household.
opts.w: 错误。父母一般不替同住的未成年子女赔钱，并非自动且无条件对一切财产损害负责，属于【限定词偷换陷阱】。

opts.t: Only the 14-year-old can be held liable because parents are responsible for a child's torts only when the child is employed in a parent's business.
opts.w: 错误。受雇于父母生意只是四项例外之一，把危险物（如雪地摩托）交给孩子控制且未尽监管同样令父母负责，属于【限定词偷换陷阱】。

opts.t: Neither the child nor the parents can be held liable unless the snowmobile had previously caused similar property damage on a neighbour's premises.
opts.w: 错误。无论是14岁能理解后果的少年本人，还是把危险物交给孩子的父母，都不存在「此前未造成类似邻里财产损害就免责」的说法，属于【严格责任与拒赔划等号】。

variants.pt: 承保协议与赔偿性质
variants.trap: 惩罚性赔偿与超限额本金混入保单
variants.stem: A client asks her broker what types of damages and losses are covered by the insuring agreement of a liability policy. Which explanation is correct?
variants.zh: 一位客户向经纪人询问责任保单的承保协议保哪些类型的赔偿和损失。下列哪项解释是正确的？

opts.t: Property damage is restricted strictly to the direct cost of repairing or replacing damaged tangible items.
opts.w: 掉入「把使用损失排除在财产损害外」陷阱。财产损害（property damage）明确包含使用损失（loss of use），并非只保修复或更换费用。

opts.t: Bodily injury covers immediate physical trauma only and excludes subsequent sickness or death resulting from the injury.
opts.w: 概念缩水错误。人身伤害（bodily injury）不仅包括身体受到的实际伤害，还包括疾病以及由该伤害或疾病日后导致的死亡。

opts.t: Exemplary damages ordered by a judge to deter future misconduct are paid up to the per occurrence limit.
opts.w: 掉入「惩罚性赔偿与超限额本金混入保单」陷阱。惩戒性或惩罚性赔偿（exemplary or punitive damages）不在责任保单保障范围内，由被保险人自付。

opts.t: Compensatory damages owed to a third party for bodily injury or property damage caused by an occurrence are covered.
opts.w: 正确。承保协议（insuring agreement）的核心就是支付被保险人因一次事故（occurrence）造成第三方人身伤害或财产损害而在法律上应付的补偿性赔偿（compensatory damages）。

variants.pt: 法律责任的认定主体
variants.trap: 道义责任与私自认责陷阱
variants.stem: After a visitor slips on wet tiles in a bakery, the bakery owner feels guilty and asks her broker to make sure the liability insurer pays the visitor right away. What should the broker explain about how liability coverage works?
variants.zh: 一名访客在面包店湿滑的地砖上滑倒后，店主感到内疚，要求经纪人确保责任保险公司立即赔钱给访客。关于责任险如何运作，经纪人应当怎样解释？

opts.t: The policy pays only if the insured is legally liable, which is decided by a court rather than by moral obligation.
opts.w: 正确。被保险人觉得有道义责任不触发保单，责任险只在被保险人法律上有责任（legally liable）时才响应，而法律责任由法院认定。

opts.t: Every liability claim must proceed through a full court trial before the insurer can pay any compensation.
opts.w: 把「由法院认定」误解为「每案必开庭」。虽然法律责任由法院认定，但多数情况下证据明显支持原告时，保险人会同意庭外和解（out-of-court settlement）。

opts.t: The broker and the insurer's underwriter jointly decide whether negligence has been established on the premises.
opts.w: 掉入「道义责任与私自认责陷阱」。经纪人和核保人都无权对被保险人在法律上是否有责任下结论。

opts.t: Moral responsibility is sufficient to trigger payment as long as the injury occurred during the policy period.
opts.w: 掉入「道义责任与私自认责陷阱」。仅有道义责任绝不触发责任保单，过失和法律责任必须成立。

variants.pt: 事故发生制与occurrence定义
variants.trap: 每次事故限额当成全年总额
variants.stem: Which statement correctly distinguishes an occurrence-basis liability policy from other concepts in liability insurance?
variants.zh: 下列哪项陈述正确区分了事故发生制责任保单与责任险中的其他概念？

opts.t: An accident is broader than an occurrence because an accident covers gradual exposure over several months.
opts.w: 包含关系颠倒。occurrence 比 accident 更宽：accident 是突发、时间确定的事件，而 occurrence 还包括长期持续或反复暴露于大体相同的有害条件。

opts.t: Under an occurrence-basis policy, coverage is triggered only when the claim is first reported before the policy expires.
opts.w: 把索赔提出制（claims-made basis）当成了事故发生制（occurrence basis）。发生制只看损害是否发生在保单期内，哪怕保单到期多年后才被起诉，当年保单依然响应。（考试只按考试口径考发生制，实务中另有 BC《Limitation Act》2 年基本时效与 15 年终极时效的规定。）

opts.t: An occurrence-basis policy covers injury or damage occurring during the policy period, regardless of when a claim is made.
opts.w: 正确。事故发生制（occurrence basis）的核心规则是只看伤害或损害是否发生在保单期内，不看索赔何时提出；考试凡问触发方式均按发生制考试口径作答，尽管实务中职业责任险常见索赔提出制且受诉讼时效法约束。

opts.t: The limit per occurrence represents the maximum total amount the insurer will pay for all claims combined during the policy term.
opts.w: 掉入「每次事故限额当成全年总额」陷阱。保单期内所有有效索赔的最高总赔付额叫累计限额（aggregate limit），而不是每次事故限额（limit per occurrence）。

variants.pt: 每次事故与累计限额计算
variants.trap: 每次事故限额当成全年总额
variants.stem: A contractor's liability policy has a per occurrence limit of $1,000,000 and an aggregate limit of $2,000,000. During the policy period, three covered occurrences result in legal liability of $600,000, $900,000, and $800,000 respectively. What amount will the insurer pay for the third claim?
variants.zh: 一家承包商的责任保单每次事故限额为 $1,000,000，累计限额为 $2,000,000。在保单期内，三次受保事故分别产生 $600,000、$900,000 和 $800,000 的法律赔偿责任。保险人对第三次索赔将赔付多少？

opts.t: $800,000, because each claim is individually under the $1,000,000 per occurrence limit.
opts.w: 忘记检查累计限额（aggregate limit）。前两次已赔付 $600,000 + $900,000 = $1,500,000，距离 $2,000,000 累计上限仅剩 $500,000。

opts.t: $500,000, because the first two claims used $1,500,000 of the $2,000,000 aggregate limit.
opts.w: 正确。前两次事故均未超过 $1,000,000 每次事故限额（per occurrence limit），分别获赔 $600,000 和 $900,000，合计用去 $1,500,000；第三次索赔 $800,000 受剩余累计限额（aggregate limit）约束，只能赔 $500,000。

opts.t: $0, because the first two claims already exceeded the $1,000,000 limit stated on the policy.
opts.w: 掉入「每次事故限额当成全年总额」陷阱。把 $1,000,000 每次事故限额误当成了全年累计限额。

opts.t: $1,000,000, because the per occurrence limit resets in full after each covered occurrence.
opts.w: 忽略了累计限额（aggregate limit）的全年封顶作用，且赔付额也不可能超过实际损失 $800,000。

variants.pt: 分项限额两步计算
variants.trap: 每次事故限额当成全年总额
variants.stem: A policy carries split limits of $100,000 / $250,000 / $50,000. One occurrence causes bodily injury to three passengers in the amounts of $120,000, $150,000, and $100,000. How much will the insurer pay for the third passenger after paying the first two?
variants.zh: 一张保单的分项限额为 $100,000／$250,000／$50,000。一次事故造成三名乘客受人身伤害，金额分别为 $120,000、$150,000 和 $100,000。在赔付前两名乘客后，保险人将赔付第三名乘客多少？

opts.t: $50,000, as the first two receive $100,000 each under the per person limit, leaving $50,000 of the $250,000 occurrence limit.
opts.w: 正确。分两步计算分项限额（split limits）：先把每人压到每人人身伤害限额 $100,000 以内，前两位各赔 $100,000 共用去 $200,000；再看每次事故人身伤害合计限额 $250,000，只剩 $50,000 可赔给第三位乘客。

opts.t: $100,000, because the third passenger's bodily injury claim does not exceed the $100,000 per person limit.
opts.w: 只看了第一个数（每人限额 $100,000），忽略了第二个数（单次事故人身伤害合计限额 $250,000）的封顶限制。

opts.t: $0, because the first two claims totaling $270,000 already exhausted the $250,000 per occurrence bodily injury limit.
opts.w: 颠倒了两步计算的顺序。必须先用每人限额 $100,000 把前两人分别压到 $100,000（合计 $200,000），而不是直接把原始索赔额 $120,000 和 $150,000 相加。

opts.t: $100,000, because the $50,000 property damage limit supplements the exhausted per occurrence bodily injury limit.
opts.w: 混淆了分项限额与综合限额（inclusive limit）。分项限额的第三个数 $50,000 专用于财产损害，不能与人身伤害限额混用。

variants.pt: 出险后五项义务与急救例外
variants.trap: 等对方索赔才报案或强行阻拦索赔
variants.stem: A customer trips over a display rack in a hardware store. Although she says she feels fine, the store owner drives her home and gives her a cheque to cover her torn coat so she will not complain. He does not notify his insurer until a writ arrives two weeks later. Which statement about the owner's actions is correct?
variants.zh: 一名顾客在五金店被展示架绊倒。虽然她说感觉没事，店主还是开车送她回家，并开了张支票赔她扯破的外套以免她投诉。直到两周后收到传票，他才通知保险公司。关于店主的行为，下列哪项陈述是正确的？

opts.t: He complied with the reporting duty because no notice is required until a formal notice of a claim is received.
opts.w: 掉入「等对方索赔才报案或强行阻拦索赔」陷阱。被保险人必须及时报告可能引起索赔的任何事故（occurrence），不能等到收到法律文件才首次报告事故。

opts.t: The insurer must reimburse the cheque for the coat because it qualifies as emergency first aid at the scene.
opts.w: 曲解了急救（first aid）的范围。急救针对的是有人受伤时的即时医疗救助，赔偿财物或塞钱私了不属于急救，保险人不会偿还。

opts.t: His payment for the coat fulfilled his duty to prevent the customer from filing a formal liability claim.
opts.w: 掉入「等对方索赔才报案或强行阻拦索赔」陷阱。阻止第三方索赔不是被保险人的义务，私自付钱反而侵犯了保险人专属的调查与和解权。

opts.t: He breached his policy duties by failing to report the occurrence promptly and by paying without insurer consent.
opts.w: 正确。店主一没有在事发后及时报告可能引发索赔的 occurrence，二未经保险人同意自愿向对方付款（非急救费用），同时违反了出险后五项义务中的第 1 项和第 5 项。

variants.pt: 附加给付范围与超限额利息
variants.trap: 惩罚性赔偿与超限额本金混入保单
variants.stem: Which item is NOT covered under the supplementary payments agreement of a liability insurance policy?
variants.zh: 下列哪一项不在责任保险单的附加给付协议保障范围内？

opts.t: Reasonable expenses incurred by the insured at the insurer's request to assist with the defence.
opts.w: 该项属于附加给付第 2 项。被保险人应保险人要求、为协助抗辩而发生的合理费用由附加给付在限额之外承担。

opts.t: The portion of a compensatory damages judgment that exceeds the policy's limit of liability.
opts.w: 正确（本题选不适用项）。超出保单限额的判决本金不属于附加给付（supplementary payments），必须由被保险人自己承担。

opts.t: Court costs taxed against the insured by the judge at the conclusion of the liability lawsuit.
opts.w: 该项属于附加给付第 3 项。判由被保险人承担的诉讼费（court costs）由附加给付在保单限额之外支付。

opts.t: Costs of defence, including legal fees and the cost of hiring an independent claims adjuster.
opts.w: 该项属于附加给付第 1 项。抗辩费用（costs of defence）及聘请独立理算师（independent adjuster）调查谈判的费用均在限额之外另付。

variants.pt: 承保场所的定义与自动承保地点
variants.trap: 场所自动承保边界
variants.stem: A named insured wants to know which property is automatically covered as 'premises' under Section II of her Homeowners Policy without being listed on the Coverage Summary. Which location qualifies?
variants.zh: 一名列名被保险人想知道，在不在保障摘要页上列明的情况下，哪处物业能自动作为房主保单第二部分下的“场所”获得保障。下列哪个地点符合条件？

opts.t: A vacant non-farm building lot purchased by the insured outside Canada for future residential construction
opts.w: 属于“场所自动承保边界”陷阱。自动纳入场所定义的非农空地（vacant land）仅限加拿大境内，在加拿大境外购买的住宅空地必须另行安排保险。

opts.t: A site in Canada where a commercial retail plaza is being constructed by an independent contractor for the insured
opts.w: 属于“场所自动承保边界”陷阱。在建用地自动算作场所的条件是在加拿大境内且为被保险人自住而建的一户、两户或三户住宅（one, two or three-family dwelling），由承包商在建的商业零售广场或超过三户的住宅不算。

opts.t: A seasonal summer cabin in Canada owned by the insured's spouse that was omitted from the Coverage Summary page
opts.w: 属于“场所自动承保边界”陷阱。列名被保险人或其配偶拥有的季节性住所（seasonal residence）必须在保障摘要页列明才受保，遗漏未列明则不保。

opts.t: A newly acquired house in Canada intended as the insured's principal residence within 30 days of taking possession
opts.w: 正确。在加拿大境内将成为被保险人主要住所（principal residence）的新场所，自取得所有权或接管之日起自动承保，最长至连续 30 天、保单到期终止之日或另行安排责任保险之日三者中最早的时间点。

variants.pt: Coverage E 除外责任与例外情形
variants.trap: 照管保管控制四因例外
variants.stem: Which of the following claims is covered under Coverage E (Legal Liability) of a standard Homeowners Policy?
variants.zh: 下列哪项索赔属于标准房主保单 Coverage E（个人法律责任）的承保范围？

opts.t: A residence employee cleaning the insured's windows is injured when a negligently maintained porch railing gives way
opts.w: 正确。虽然被保险人本人及同住者的人身伤害在 Coverage E 下被除外，但住家雇员（residence employee）是该除外的明确例外；当住家雇员因被保险人的过失在工作中受伤并提出索赔时，Coverage E 予以响应。

opts.t: Smoke from an open wood-burning fireplace in a rented ski lodge stains the owner's walls and curtains
opts.w: 属于“照管保管控制四因例外”陷阱。对租用场所的烟熏例外仅限于取暖或烹饪设备突然、异常的故障运行所产生的烟（smoke from a sudden, unusual and faulty operation of a heating or cooking unit），壁炉（fireplace）的烟明确不算。

opts.t: A paying boarder living in the insured's home slips on a wet hallway floor and sues the insured
opts.w: 属于“第一方与第三方混淆”陷阱。与被保险人同住的人及寄宿者（roomer or boarder）提出的人身伤害索赔在 Coverage E 下被明确除外。

opts.t: The insured verbally agrees to assume all liability for any damage when borrowing a colleague's electric bicycle
opts.w: 属于合同承担责任（liability assumed by contract）除外。口头承诺揽下的他人责任不在两项例外（无合同本身也有法律责任，或与场所有关的书面合同）之内，Coverage E 不赔。

variants.pt: Coverage F 自愿医疗给付的范围与除外
variants.trap: 第一方与第三方混淆
variants.stem: Which statement accurately describes how Coverage F (Voluntary Medical Payments) operates under a Homeowners Policy?
variants.zh: 下列哪项陈述准确描述了房主保单下 Coverage F（自愿医疗给付）的运作规则？

opts.t: It pays medical expenses for the named insured when accidentally injured while travelling outside Canada
opts.w: 属于“第一方与第三方混淆”陷阱。Coverage F 从不赔付被保险人本人（the insured）的医疗费用，无论事故发生在国内还是境外。

opts.t: It covers workplace medical expenses for an injured worker who is entitled to provincial workers' compensation benefits
opts.w: 属于工伤赔偿除外。受工伤赔偿法（workers' compensation legislation）保障的人员所发生的费用在 Coverage F 下明确不赔。

opts.t: It pays reasonable medical, dental, ambulance, and funeral bills within one year of an accident regardless of fault
opts.w: 正确。自愿医疗给付（Coverage F）不要求证明被保险人存在过失或法律责任，承保事故之日起 1 年内发生的合理手术、牙科、住院、护理、救护车及丧葬费用。

opts.t: It responds only after a court determines that the insured is legally liable for the visitor's bodily injury
opts.w: 属于把 Coverage E 与 Coverage F 混淆的陷阱。需要证明法律责任（legal liability）的是 Coverage E；Coverage F 是不问对错的自愿给付。

variants.pt: Coverage G 自愿财产损害给付与年龄红线
variants.trap: 自愿给付年龄与对象限制
variants.stem: A homeowner asks whether Coverage G (Voluntary Payment for Damage to Property) will respond to several recent incidents. Which incident is eligible under Coverage G?
variants.zh: 一名房主询问 Coverage G（自愿财产损害给付）能否响应近期发生的几起事件。下列哪起事件符合 Coverage G 的给付条件？

opts.t: A neighbour's bicycle borrowed by the insured is stolen while parked outside a store
opts.w: 属于 Coverage G 除外责任。因财产的使用损失、失踪或被盗（loss of use, disappearance or theft）而产生的索赔在 Coverage G 下明确除外。

opts.t: While helping a neighbour move a patio heater, the insured accidentally drops and cracks it without being legally liable
opts.w: 正确。自愿财产损害给付（Coverage G）承保被保险人非故意造成、且在法律上未必需要负责（even though not legally liable）的直接财产损害。

opts.t: The insured accidentally scratches a dining room table that the insured owns and insures under Section I of the policy
opts.w: 属于“第一方与第三方混淆”陷阱。被保险人自己拥有的财产以及已在第一部分（Section I）下承保的财产在 Coverage G 下明确不赔。

opts.t: A neighbour claims loss of rental income after the insured accidentally damages the neighbour's lawn equipment
opts.w: 属于 Coverage G 仅保直接损害的限制。因财产的使用损失（loss of use）而产生的索赔在 Coverage G 下被明确除外。

variants.pt: 船艇、机动器具与拖车的特别限制
variants.trap: 照管保管控制四因例外
variants.stem: Which of the following watercraft, motorized vehicles, or trailers owned by the insured is automatically covered for liability under Section II of a Homeowners Policy without requiring an endorsement?
variants.zh: 被保险人拥有的下列哪项船艇、机动器具或拖车，无须批改即可在房主保单第二部分下自动获得责任保障？

opts.t: An owned boat with an outboard motor rated at 38 kW (50 H.P.) that was purchased several years ago
opts.w: 超过舷外机功率上限。自有船艇装舷外机（outboard motor）自动承保的合计功率上限为 12 kW（16 H.P.），38 kW（50 H.P.）是其他类型发动机的上限，且非新购 30 天内，因此须加保。

opts.t: A camping trailer that breaks loose and hits a cyclist while being towed down a road by a registered automobile
opts.w: 违反拖车挂接限制。拖车（trailer）只有在当时没有挂在、载于或被拖于需要机动车登记的机动车上（not attached to, carried on or being towed by a motor vehicle）时才受保，牵引途中脱钩归汽车保险处理。

opts.t: An owned self-propelled snow blower with an engine not exceeding 19 kW (25 H.P.) used on the insured's driveway
opts.w: 正确。被保险人自己拥有的自走式割草机、扫雪机或园艺拖拉机（self-propelled lawn mower, snow blower or garden-type tractor），只要功率不超过 19 kW（25 H.P.），即自动承保。

opts.t: A motorized golf cart driven by the insured along public residential streets to a grocery store
opts.w: 违反使用地点限制。电动高尔夫球车（motorized golf cart）仅在球场上使用时（while in use on a golf course）才自动承保，开上公共街道不保。

variants.pt: 经营活动除外与六项自动承保例外
variants.trap: 自愿给付年龄与对象限制
variants.stem: Under Section II of a Homeowners Policy, which of the following business-related activities is automatically covered as an exception to the business pursuits exclusion without requiring an endorsement?
variants.zh: 在房主保单第二部分下，下列哪项与经营沾边的活动作为经营活动除外的例外，无须批改即可自动获得保障？

opts.t: Renting out more than 3 car spaces or stalls in the insured's garage and stable to neighbours
opts.w: 超出车位数量限制。经营活动例外规定出租或待租的车位或马厩位不得超过 3 个（not more than 3 car spaces or stalls），超过 3 个不保。

opts.t: Accommodating more than 2 roomers or boarders in a single family unit of an insured two-family dwelling
opts.w: 超出寄宿者人数限制。出租自住的两户或三户住宅的一部分时，每个家庭单位的寄宿者不得超过 2 名（not more than 2 roomers or boarders per family unit），超过 2 名不保。

opts.t: Providing professional architectural design services to paying clients from a home studio
opts.w: 属于“商业与专业责任错位”陷阱。提供或未能提供任何专业服务（rendering or failure to render any professional service）属于第二部分的一般除外，必须购买错漏责任险（E&O）。

opts.t: Occasionally renting out the portion of the dwelling usually occupied by the insured while away on a winter holiday
opts.w: 正确。偶尔把自己平时自住的那部分住宅出租（occasional rental of the portion of the dwelling usually occupied by you）属于经营活动除外的六项自动承保例外之一。

variants.pt: 企业 CGL 七大风险与专业责任区分
variants.trap: 商业与专业责任错位
variants.stem: Under a Commercial General Liability (CGL) policy, which of the following claims falls under the definition of 'personal injury' rather than 'bodily injury' or professional liability?
variants.zh: 在商业综合责任险（CGL）保单下，下列哪项索赔属于“人身权益侵害（personal injury）”而非“身体伤害（bodily injury）”或职业责任？

opts.t: A grocery shopper trips over an unattended stock cart in a store aisle and breaks an ankle
opts.w: 属于“商业与专业责任错位”陷阱。超市通道内撞上理货车摔断脚踝属于场所状况与作业引起的身体伤害（bodily injury），不属于人身伤害以外的权益侵害（personal injury）。

opts.t: A retail store manager publishes a false written statement that libels a competing local merchant
opts.w: 正确。CGL 中的人身权益侵害（personal injury）是指经营活动造成的、身体伤害以外的侵害（injury other than bodily injury），包括书面诽谤（libel）、口头诽谤（slander）、恶意控告、非法进入或驱逐以及歧视。

opts.t: A consumer is scalded when a defective glass coffee carafe sold by a kitchenware shop shatters during use
opts.w: 属于“商业与专业责任错位”陷阱。售出商品缺陷破裂致人烫伤属于产品责任（products liability）导致的身体伤害（bodily injury），而非 personal injury。

opts.t: A dentist negligently damages a patient's nerve while performing a routine tooth extraction
opts.w: 属于“商业与专业责任错位”陷阱。医生、牙医、药剂师等医疗保健人员的专业失误不在 CGL 承保范围内，须由医疗过失责任险（Malpractice Insurance）承保。

variants.pt: 个人A&S四特征与不可抗辩期例外
variants.trap: 欺诈与年龄误报后果对调
variants.stem: More than two years after issuing an individual accident and sickness policy, an insurer proves that the applicant intentionally concealed a serious heart condition on the application. Which statement correctly describes the insurer's legal position?
variants.zh: 一份个人意外与疾病保单出单超过两年后，保险人证实投保人在投保书上故意隐瞒了严重的心脏病史。下列哪项准确描述了保险人的法律地位？

opts.t: The insurer may challenge the contract at any time and typically declare it void because fraudulent misrepresentation is an exception to incontestability
opts.w: 两年不可抗辩期（incontestability）有两个例外：欺诈陈述（fraudulent misrepresentation）与年龄误报（misstatement of age）。故意隐瞒重大既往病史属于欺诈陈述，保险人任何时候都可以挑战并通常宣告合同无效。

opts.t: The insurer cannot contest the statement or deny the claim because more than two years have passed since the policy became effective
opts.w: 忽略了不可抗辩期（incontestability）的欺诈例外。两年后不可抗辩只保护非欺诈性的陈述，欺诈陈述随时可被挑战并拒赔。

opts.t: The insurer must keep the policy active and simply adjust the monthly benefit or premium to reflect the true risk as for a misstatement of age
opts.w: 掉入『欺诈与年龄误报后果对调』陷阱。按真实情况调整给付或保费是年龄误报（misstatement of age）的后果，而不是欺诈陈述的后果。

opts.t: The insurer may only deduct past-due premiums from the claim payment because the original application does not form part of the insurance contract
opts.w: 违背个人 A&S 合同的第一项特征：投保书（application）本身就是保险合同的组成部分，而非仅允许扣除欠缴保费。

variants.pt: 个人失能险定价因素与保单类型
variants.trap: 等待期与失能定义对保费方向反记
variants.stem: When setting premiums for individual accident and sickness policies, an insurer evaluates three main pricing factors, one of which is the cost of claims. Which of the following correctly identifies the other two pricing factors and the rule for rate increases on a standard renewable policy?
variants.zh: 在厘定个人意外与疾病保单的保费时，保险人评估三个主要定价因素，其中之一是理赔成本。下列哪项正确指出了另外两个定价因素，以及普通可续保保单在加费时的规则？

opts.t: Mode of transportation and provincial tax rates; the insurer may single out an individual insured for a rate increase at renewal after a large claim
opts.w: 混淆概念。交通方式既不是旅行险也不是失能险的定价因素；且保险人在可续保保单下绝不能在续保时单挑（single out）某个被保险人加费。

opts.t: Insurable earnings limit and statutory conditions; the insurer may never adjust renewal rates even if the claims experience of an entire class deteriorates
opts.w: 错误识别定价三要素。可保收入上限与法定条件不是与理赔成本并列的三大定价因素，且非不可注销保单在整类（class）理赔经验恶化时可以对整类续保加费。

opts.t: Operating expenses and employer assessments; the insurer must cancel the entire occupation class if any single member develops a serious chronic illness
opts.w: 雇主分摊评估属于工伤计划（workers' compensation）范畴，个人 A&S 的三大定价因素是理赔成本、营运费用与投资收益。

opts.t: Operating expenses and investment income; the insurer may raise renewal premiums for an entire class with poor claims experience, without singling out one insured
opts.w: 个人 A&S 保费由理赔成本（cost of claims）、营运费用（operating expenses）和投资收益（investment income）三大因素决定；对于可注销或可调整保单，当某一类被保险人理赔经验变差时，保险人可对该整类续保加费，但不得单挑个人。

variants.pt: 失能定义三档与给付终止条件
variants.trap: 等待期与失能定义对保费方向反记
variants.stem: An insured accountant holds a disability income policy with the narrowest definition of disability. After an injury, the insured can no longer work at their former firm but is fully capable of working as a financial analyst with comparable pay based on their education and training. How will the policy respond?
variants.zh: 一位投保的会计师持有一份采用最窄失能定义的失能收入保单。受伤后，该被保险人无法在原事务所工作，但凭其教育与培训完全有能力担任薪酬相称的财务分析师。保单将如何回应？

opts.t: Pay full monthly benefits because the narrowest definition is own occupation, which only tests whether the insured can perform duties at their original firm
opts.w: 掉入『等待期与失能定义对保费方向反记』陷阱。本职业（own occupation）是最宽定义，而不是最窄定义。

opts.t: Pay 90% of net earnings for up to 52 weeks from the first day of injury because the insured changed employers and occupations after the accident
opts.w: 把工伤计划（workers' compensation）的净收入 90% 比例和团体周给付（weekly indemnity）的事故首日起付及 52 周混入个人失能定义题中。

opts.t: Pay no benefits because the narrowest definition is any occupation, and the insured can perform a job suited to their education, training, experience, or earnings
opts.w: 最窄的失能定义是任何职业（any occupation）：只要被保险人能够从事任何一种与其教育、培训、经验或收入相称的工作，保单就不给付。

opts.t: Pay full monthly benefits until age 65 regardless of recovery because the insured cannot return to their exact prior position at the accounting firm
opts.w: 违背任何职业（any occupation）定义及给付终止条件。不仅能从事相称工作时不赔，即便获赔也会在康复、身故或给付期满的先到者停止。

variants.pt: 团体失能险起付期与离职终止
variants.trap: 工伤与非工伤及团体周给付起付日混淆
variants.stem: An employee covered by a group insurance plan with a 26-week weekly indemnity benefit and long term disability (LTD) coverage breaks an ankle in a weekend recreational accident and remains disabled for well over a year while still employed. When do the weekly indemnity and LTD benefits begin?
variants.zh: 一名参加团体保险计划（含 26 周的周给付及长期失能 LTD 保障）的在职雇员，在周末休闲意外中摔断脚踝，失能持续远超一年。周给付和 LTD 给付分别从何时开始？

opts.t: Weekly indemnity begins on the 4th, 8th, or 15th day of disability, and LTD eligibility begins only after a two-year incontestability period
opts.w: 掉入『工伤与非工伤及团体周给付起付日混淆』陷阱。第 4、8 或 15 天起付适用于疾病（sickness），而意外事故（accident）从第 1 天起付；LTD 在周给付期结束时立即接续，与两年不可抗辩期无关。

opts.t: Weekly indemnity begins on the first day of disability caused by the accident, and LTD eligibility begins when the 26-week weekly indemnity period ends
opts.w: 团体周给付（weekly indemnity）对意外事故从失能第 1 天起付，给付期为 13、26 或 52 周；长期失能（Long Term Disability, LTD）的资格从周给付期结束时开始，只要仍符合定义常可付至 65 岁。

opts.t: Neither group benefit pays because non-occupational weekend accidents are covered exclusively by the provincial workers' compensation plan
opts.w: 完全颠倒了工伤计划与 A&S 的分工。工伤计划（workers' compensation）只保工作相关事故，九成以上与工作无关的事故正是靠 A&S（含团体计划）保障。

opts.t: LTD begins on the first day of the recreational accident, while weekly indemnity only reimburses prescription drugs and routine dental care
opts.w: 混淆了周给付、长期失能（LTD）与可选附加险。事故第 1 天起付的是周给付；处方药与牙科属于大额医疗（Major Medical / Extended Health Care）和牙科附加计划。

variants.pt: 工伤计划给付范围与考试口径
variants.trap: 工伤与非工伤及团体周给付起付日混淆
variants.stem: A cabinetmaker develops a chronic lung condition from inhaling wood treatment chemicals on the job, and shortly after returning to work breaks a wrist in a collision while driving home after a shift. How does a provincial workers' compensation plan respond to these two disabilities?
variants.zh: 一名木柜工因在工作中吸入木材处理化学品而患上慢性肺病；复工后不久，他在下班开车回家途中发生碰撞摔断手腕。省工伤计划对这两次失能如何回应？

opts.t: Neither condition is covered because illness is the leading cause of disability and all motor vehicle collisions are excluded
opts.w: 忽略了职业病（industrial disease）保障。虽然自然发生的疾病不属工伤，但在工作中接触化学品染上的职业病由工伤计划承保。

opts.t: Both conditions are covered from the first day of disability at 90% of net earnings because the worker is an employee in a compulsory industry
opts.w: 掉入『工伤与非工伤及团体周给付起付日混淆』陷阱。下班回家路上的交通事故与工作无关，工伤计划不赔。

opts.t: The lung condition is covered as an industrial disease, but the wrist injury on the drive home is not work-related and is not covered by workers' compensation
opts.w: 工伤计划（workers' compensation）只承保工作相关事故和在工作中染上的职业病（industrial disease），因此吸入工作化学品导致的肺病获赔；下班回家途中的车祸不属于工作相关事故，必须靠个人或团体 A&S 保障。考试口径直接按是否工作相关及『某些行业强制、净收入 90%』作答，而 BC 实务现行另有最高可保工资封顶。

opts.t: The wrist injury is covered because commuting is part of employment, while the lung condition must be claimed under individual accident and sickness insurance
opts.w: 把职业病与非工作通勤事故的赔付边界完全颠倒。职业病由工伤计划赔，下班路上的车祸工伤计划不赔。

variants.pt: 旅行险定价因素与受供养子女既往症
variants.trap: 旅行险定价因素混入交通方式与受供养子女误判
variants.stem: Before leaving on a trip outside the province, a traveller asks how travel insurance handles a pre-existing medical condition diagnosed prior to departure and whether standard statutory conditions apply to travel policies. Under the rules tested on the exam, which statement is correct?
variants.zh: 在出省旅行出发前，一名旅客询问旅行保险如何处理出发前已确诊的既往症，以及法定条件是否适用于旅行保单。考试规则是什么？

opts.t: Pre-existing conditions are automatically covered on any single trip under 180 days, and travel insurance policies are exempt from provincial statutory conditions
opts.w: 两处均错：出发前已存在的既往症（pre-existing condition）在单次最长 180 天的保单中并不自动承保；且和所有 A&S 保单一样，旅行险同样受所在省法定条件（statutory conditions）约束。

opts.t: Pre-existing conditions are covered only if the traveller travels by commercial airline, and all insurers use a standard policy wording identical to homeowner forms
opts.w: 掉入『旅行险定价因素混入交通方式与受供养子女误判』陷阱。交通方式与旅行险无关，且旅行险没有标准保单（no standard policy forms），每家措辞不同。

opts.t: Pre-existing conditions are permanently excluded under all policies unless the traveller is under age 20, and statutory conditions apply only to group travel plans
opts.w: 混淆了受供养子女 20 岁年龄界限与既往症稳定期规则，且个人旅行险同样受法定条件（statutory conditions）约束。

opts.t: Pre-existing conditions are not automatically covered, though some policies cover them after a 3- or 6-month stability period, and statutory conditions apply
opts.w: 既往症（pre-existing condition）不自动承保，有的保单在病情受控稳定一段时间即稳定期（stability period，三或六个月，视病情而定）后会赔，且旅行险受省法定条件（statutory conditions）约束。考试口径答稳定期三或六个月且受法定条件约束，而实务现行没有全国统一稳定期天数且 BC 省《Insurance Act》对未点名排除的既往症及团体险法定条件另有具体条文规定。

variants.pt: 旅行险行程取消中断与常见除外
variants.trap: 行程取消与行程中断及除外边界颠倒
variants.stem: Prior to departing on a prepaid international tour, an insured's immediate family member covered by the policy terms passes away unexpectedly, making it impossible for the insured to travel. Which travel insurance coverage responds to this loss, and how does it differ from coverage that applies after departure?
variants.zh: 在预付国际旅行团出发前，保单条款所列的一名指定亲属突发去世，导致被保险人无法成行。哪项旅行险保障对此损失作出回应？它与出发后适用的保障有何区别？

opts.t: Trip cancellation coverage responds because the covered event occurred before departure, whereas trip interruption coverage applies only after departure
opts.w: 行程取消险（trip cancellation）在出发日之前起作用：当出发前发生承保的医疗紧急情况或指定亲属去世导致被保险人不可能成行时予以补偿；而出发后发生变故则由行程中断（trip interruption）承保。

opts.t: Trip interruption coverage responds because non-refundable prepaid travel deposits are only insured under interruption clauses prior to the departure date
opts.w: 掉入『行程取消与行程中断及除外边界颠倒』陷阱。行程中断（trip interruption）只管出发之后的损失，出发前无法成行导致预付旅费损失归行程取消（trip cancellation）管。

opts.t: Optional non-medical baggage and passport coverage responds because a relative's death is not a personal medical emergency of the insured traveller
opts.w: 混淆了可选非医疗保障（行李、机票、护照遗失与法律咨询）与行程取消险（trip cancellation）。指定亲属去世正是行程取消险的标准承保触发事件之一。

opts.t: Neither coverage responds unless the insured traveller is already more than 500 kilometres away from home when the immediate family member passes away
opts.w: 把承保地域（coverage territory：离家 500 公里以上或出省生效）的旅途医疗生效条件错误套用到出发前的行程取消险（trip cancellation）上。

variants.pt: 75/25合并驾驶因子与亲属雇员限制
variants.trap: 合并因子 25% 误取最优或乱拉低
variants.stem: Marcus is listed as the principal driver of his personal car with a driver factor of 0.900. He also lists his sister (driver factor 0.650) and his nephew (driver factor 1.150) on the policy. How will ICBC calculate the combined driver factor for this policy?
variants.zh: Marcus 是其私家车保单上的主驾，驾驶因子为 0.900。他在保单上还列了妹妹（驾驶因子 0.650）和外甥（驾驶因子 1.150）。ICBC 将如何计算该保单的合并驾驶因子？

opts.t: 75% based on Marcus's 0.900 factor and 25% based on his nephew's highest-risk 1.150 factor
opts.w: 正确：当列有两人以上时，合并驾驶因子（[combined driver factor]）由 75% 主驾（[principal driver]）因子加上 25% 风险最高（[highest-risk]）的那位额外列名驾驶人（外甥 1.150）决定。

opts.t: 75% based on Marcus's 0.900 factor and 25% based on his sister's lowest-risk 0.650 factor
opts.w: 掉入“合并因子 25% 误取最优”陷阱：25% 权重取的是风险最高（经验最短、有责事故最多）的列名者，而不是风险最低、驾驶记录最好的妹妹。

opts.t: 50% on Marcus's 0.900 factor, 25% on his sister's 0.650 factor, and 25% on his nephew's 1.150 factor
opts.w: 掉入“自造分摊比例”陷阱：无论额外列了多少名驾驶人，只有主驾（75%）和风险最高的一位额外列名驾驶人（25%）计入合并因子，不会拆成 50/25/25。

opts.t: 100% based on his nephew's 1.150 factor because the highest-risk listed driver overrides all others
opts.w: 掉入“最高风险全额替代”陷阱：100% 单一因子只在仅列主驾一人时适用；有多名驾驶人时主驾仍占 75%，最高风险额外列名者只占 25%。

variants.pt: 事故宽免门槛与新居民记录规则
variants.trap: 考试口径与实务混用或省外记录误计
variants.stem: Elena moved to British Columbia from another jurisdiction two months ago after 18 years of licensed driving. Two years before moving, she caused a rear-end collision in her former home jurisdiction. How will ICBC treat her history when setting her driver factor?
variants.zh: Elena 拥有 18 年持照驾龄，两个月前从外地搬到 BC。在搬家前两年，她在原居住地造成过一起追尾事故。ICBC 在设定她的驾驶因子时将如何处理她的历史记录？

opts.t: ICBC counts the prior rear-end collision because it occurred after March 1, 2017, and falls within the 10-year scan period
opts.w: 掉入“省外事故计入因子”陷阱：对新居民（[new resident]）而言，来到 BC 之前在外地造成的事故不计入（只计来到 BC 后在 BC 发生的有责事故）。

opts.t: ICBC reviews all 18 years of her prior driving record, ignores the pre-BC crash, and grants immediate crash forgiveness
opts.w: 掉入“超额认年数与误给宽免”陷阱：虽然来到 BC 前的事故确实不计入，但 ICBC 最多只看新居民抵达前最近 15 年的驾照记录（而非全部 18 年），且刚到 BC 的新居民头 3 年因子加高，不享有事故宽免（[crash forgiveness]）。

opts.t: ICBC assigns a reduced learner-style driver factor for her first 3 years and disregards her out-of-province licence record
opts.w: 掉入“新居民与学员待遇混淆”陷阱：起步给降低因子的是学员（[learner]）；新居民在头 3 年会拿到加高的驾驶因子（[driver factor]），且 ICBC 会核查其抵达前最近 15 年的驾照记录。

opts.t: ICBC applies a higher factor for up to 3 years, checks up to 15 years of prior licensing, and ignores the pre-BC crash
opts.w: 正确：新居民（[new resident]）头 3 年适用加高的驾驶因子（[driver factor]）（无事故则逐年回落），ICBC 会核查其抵达前最近 15 年的驾照记录，且到 BC 之前发生的事故不计入。

variants.pt: Enhanced Care诉权与责任
variants.trap: 误以为无过失等于不认定事故责任
variants.stem: A client asks their broker why ICBC still investigates who caused a collision if British Columbia moved to Enhanced Care on May 1, 2021. Which of the following is NOT affected by ICBC's fault determination?
variants.zh: 一位客户问经纪人：既然 BC 在 2021 年 5 月 1 日已转为 Enhanced Care，为什么 ICBC 还要调查是谁造成了碰撞？下列哪一项不受 ICBC 责任认定的影响？

opts.t: Whether an injured BC resident qualifies for medical and rehabilitation benefits
opts.w: 正确：在加强照护制度（[Enhanced Care]）下，所有 BC 居民不问过错（[no-fault]）都能拿到广泛的医疗照护与康复给付，因此这项基本给付资格不受责任比例影响。

opts.t: How a policyholder's own vehicle damage claim is settled under their Autoplan policy
opts.w: 掉入“车损赔付不看责任”陷阱：ICBC 认定责任比例的第一项用途就是决定自车损失理赔在 Autoplan 保单下怎么赔付（例如基本险按不负责比例赔自车损坏）。

opts.t: Whether an involved motorist's individual driver factor will increase at policy renewal
