opts.t: Bert lacks legal capacity to contract after a loss
opts.w: 缔约能力是第 2 章的合同要素，与已发生损失无关。

opts.t: The broker has no authority to quote insurance
opts.w: 经纪人有没有权限不是这里的原因；即使有，已经发生的损失也不保。

bank.note: 定义第 (iv) 点：保险只赔意外的、将来的损失。如果已发生的损失也能买保险，人人都等出事才买，保险公司无法经营。

bank.stem: When settling a property claim, who has the right to choose between repairing or replacing the damaged item and paying cash?

opts.t: The insured, in all cases
opts.w: 反了。FOI 说的是 the insurance company always has the right。

opts.t: The broker who arranged the policy
opts.w: 经纪人不是合同当事人，不决定赔付方式。

opts.t: The insurer
A court, whenever both options are possible
opts.w: 不需要法院；这是合同本身给保险人的权利。

bank.note: 定义第 (v) 点：赔付可以是钱或其他等值物，保险公司始终有权选择修理／更换或付现。要工要料的损失（如屋顶）通常选修；CD、乐器、家居个人物品通常付现。

bank.stem: Property and casualty (general) insurance includes all types of insurance other than:

opts.t: Automobile and liability insurance
opts.w: 汽车险与责任险恰恰是 P&C 的两大险种。

opts.t: Life and health insurance
Habitational and business property insurance
opts.w: 住宅与商业财产险是 P&C 的第二大保费来源。

opts.t: Insurance sold by government insurers
opts.w: 政府保险人卖的强制车险也是 P&C；P&C 的边界看险种，不看卖方。

bank.note: 考试口径：P&C（general insurance）涵盖寿险与健康险以外的所有险种。这也是 general insurance 牌照名字的由来。

bank.stem: Under the FOI exam view, which class of insurance represents the largest share of property and casualty premiums in Canada?

opts.t: Automobile insurance
Habitational property insurance
opts.w: 财产险（住宅与商业）是第二大，不是第一。

opts.t: Liability insurance
opts.w: 责任险是第三大保费来源，排在汽车与财产之后。

opts.t: Commercial property insurance
opts.w: 商业财产与住宅合在财产险里，排第二。

bank.note: 汽车险保费超过全部 P&C 保费的 50%，比其他所有险种加起来还多；财产第二、责任第三。

bank.stem: In a stock insurance company, ownership rests with:

opts.t: The policyholders
opts.w: 保单持有人所有的是相互公司。

opts.t: The brokers who sell its policies
opts.w: 经纪人是中介，不是公司的所有人。

opts.t: The provincial government
opts.w: 政府保险人是另一类组织。

opts.t: The shareholders

bank.note: 股份公司由股东所有，股东的主要目的是从投资中获利。加拿大大部分保险由股份公司承保。

bank.stem: When a mutual insurance company makes money, it is returned to:

opts.t: Its shareholders, as a return on the capital they invested
opts.w: 相互公司没有外部股东；把盈余给股东是股份公司。

opts.t: The policyholders, through dividends or later rate adjustments
The brokers who sold its policies, as contingent commissions
opts.w: FOI 在相互公司一节没有提经纪佣金；这是把分销问题搬进来。

opts.t: The provincial government, as an additional premium tax
opts.w: 与相互公司的组织形式无关。

bank.note: 相互公司由保单持有人所有，目标是以尽可能低的成本提供保险；赚了钱以红利直接返还，或通过后续费率调整返还。（这是 FOI 对组织形式的概括，不等于某家公司某年必有返还，KU-0054。）

bank.pt: 政府保险人兼营财产险
bank.stem: In which province does the government also sell property and other lines of insurance in competition with private insurers?

opts.t: British Columbia
opts.w: BC 政府（ICBC）办强制车险并竞争附加车险，FOI 没说它做财产险。

opts.t: Manitoba
opts.w: MB 政府办强制车险，FOI 没说它做财产险。

opts.t: Saskatchewan
Quebec
opts.w: QC 政府办强制车险，FOI 没说它做财产险。

bank.note: 四省（BC／SK／MB／QC）政府都办强制车险，只有 SK 政府还在财产险等其他险种上与私营公司竞争。

bank.stem: Governments in all of the following provinces provide compulsory automobile insurance to residents EXCEPT:

opts.t: Ontario
British Columbia
opts.w: BC 在名单里（ICBC）。

opts.t: Manitoba
opts.w: Manitoba 政府办强制车险，在 FOI 名单里。

opts.t: Quebec
opts.w: Quebec 政府办强制车险，在 FOI 名单里。

bank.note: FOI 名单：British Columbia、Saskatchewan、Manitoba、Quebec 四省政府向居民提供强制车险。安省不在其中。

bank.stem: Under the direct writing system of distribution, the business written is owned by:

opts.t: The insurer
The individual producer
opts.w: 直营人员是公司雇员，不拥有业务；拥有业务簿的是代理制下的代理人。

opts.t: The brokerage office
opts.w: 业务归经纪行的是独立经纪制。

opts.t: The Facility Association
opts.w: Facility Association 与业务归属无关。

bank.note: 直营制：销售人员是保险公司雇员，只卖本公司产品，保险公司拥有全部业务并承担全部行政职能。

bank.stem: Which distribution method is used to sell over 80 percent of all property and casualty insurance in Canada?

opts.t: The direct writing system of the insurers
opts.w: 直营只是三种之一，FOI 没给它这个份额。

opts.t: The agency system of small business owners
opts.w: 代理制是三种之一，不是主流。

opts.t: The syndicates operating at Lloyd's of London
opts.w: 劳合社是一个专门市场，不是分销制度，更不是主流。

opts.t: The independent brokerage system

bank.note: 独立经纪制：全国 6,500 多家经纪行、逾 33,000 人，逾 80% 的 P&C 保险经此售出（2017 年版数字，考试按此答）。

bank.stem: How is an independent brokerage normally paid for the business it places?

opts.t: A salary paid by each of the insurers that it represents
opts.w: 领工资的是直营制下的公司雇员。

opts.t: A commission paid by the insurer on the business written
A fixed service fee that is set out in the Insurance Act
opts.w: FOI 没有这条；佣金是保险公司付的。

opts.t: Only a share of each insurer's annual underwriting profits
opts.w: FOI 只说按业务付佣金，没说只分利润。

bank.note: 经纪行业主不是雇员；保险公司按经纪行写下的全部业务付佣金，经纪行用它付工资、房租、邮资等开支。

bank.stem: How does an agent under the agency system differ from a producer under the direct writing system?

opts.t: The agent may represent several insurers at the same time
opts.w: 代理人与直营人员一样只代表一家（另加 Facility Association）；代表多家是经纪人。

opts.t: The agent is paid only a salary and never any commission
opts.w: 代理人按业务拿佣金和奖金；拿工资的是直营雇员。

opts.t: The agent is a small business owner who owns a book of business
The agent is not permitted to represent the Facility Association
opts.w: 反了：FOI 说代理人代表一家保险人 and the Facility Association。

bank.note: 代理人像直营一样只代表一家，但他是小业主：拿佣金和奖金，拥有自己的业务簿。只代表一家≠是雇员。

bank.stem: An agent under the agency system represents:

opts.t: One insurer and the Facility Association
Any number of insurers chosen by the agent
opts.w: 代表多家的是独立经纪。

opts.t: Only government insurers
opts.w: 代理制讲的是私营保险人的分销。

opts.t: Lloyd's syndicates exclusively
opts.w: 替劳合社辛迪加做中介的是非承保会员经纪人，与代理制无关。

bank.note: 考试口径：这类代理人只代表一家保险公司加上 Facility Association，但他们本身是自己经营的小企业主。

bank.stem: Independent brokerage offices are used to distribute compulsory government automobile insurance in all of the following provinces EXCEPT:

opts.t: British Columbia
opts.w: BC 的 Autoplan 经经纪行卖出，在名单里。

opts.t: Saskatchewan
opts.w: Saskatchewan 的政府车险也经经纪行分销，在名单里。

opts.t: Quebec
Manitoba
opts.w: Manitoba 的政府车险也经经纪行分销，在名单里。

bank.note: 这是两张名单的错位：办强制车险的政府有四个（BC、SK、MB、QC），但 FOI 说经纪行分销政府强制车险的只有三个（BC、SK、MB）。

bank.stem: Which of the following statements about Lloyd's of London is NOT correct?

opts.t: It began in the late 17th century writing marine insurance
opts.w: 正确陈述：Lloyd's 起源于 17 世纪末，最初做的是海上保险。

opts.t: It is an insurance company that issues policies in its own name
Its underwriting members assume risks for themselves
opts.w: FOI 原文：underwriters who assume risks for themselves。

opts.t: Membership is open to anyone meeting its financial requirements
opts.w: 正确陈述：只要满足 Lloyd's 委员会（Committee of Lloyd's）定的财务条件，任何人都可以成为会员。

bank.note: 考试口径：Lloyd's 本身不是保险公司，自己也不经营任何保险业务。它是承保人组成的市场。

bank.stem: When a risk is placed at Lloyd's using a slip, when is the slip forwarded to the Policy Signing Office?

opts.t: As soon as the first underwriter signs it
opts.w: 第一个承保人只认了一部分；要认满才送签。

opts.t: When the broker has collected the premium
opts.w: FOI 的送签条件是认满 100%，不是收到保费。

opts.t: When the Committee of Lloyd's approves the risk
opts.w: 委员会管的是会员资格的财务要求，不审每一张 slip。

opts.t: When 100 percent of the risk has been subscribed

bank.note: 承保人在 slip 上各认总限额的一定百分比，认满 100% 后送到 Policy Signing Office；所有劳合社保单必须带该处的钢印。

bank.stem: Each Lloyd's syndicate is managed by:

opts.t: An underwriting agent
The Policy Signing Office
opts.w: 签章处只给认满的 slip 盖钢印，不管理辛迪加。

opts.t: The producer who submits the risk
opts.w: producer 只是把承保资料交给经纪人。

opts.t: A provincial insurance regulator
opts.w: FOI 没有说省监管机构管理辛迪加。

bank.note: 辛迪加由承保会员（names）组成，每个辛迪加由一名 underwriting agent 管理，他为每一类业务指定一名专家承保人。

bank.stem: A customer slips on a wet floor in the Butlers' furniture store and is injured. The Butlers may be held financially responsible. This is an example of which category of risk?

opts.t: Personal risk
opts.w: 人身风险是自己失去健康或生命带来的损失。这里受伤的是顾客。

opts.t: Property risk
opts.w: 财产风险是自有财产灭失或损坏；这里没有财产受损。

opts.t: Liability risk
Speculative risk
opts.w: 投机风险是另一种分类（可赚可亏），而且不可保。

bank.note: 三类风险：personal、property、liability。自己的行为伤到别人、法律让你在财务上负责＝liability risk。

bank.stem: Betty is terrified of causing a fatal car accident, so she decides never to drive at all. Which method of dealing with risk is she using?

opts.t: Retention
opts.w: 自留是自己承担损失；Betty 是把风险彻底消掉。

opts.t: Transfer
opts.w: 转移是买保险把后果转给别人；她没有买任何东西。

opts.t: Controlling
opts.w: 控制是降低频率与严重度（比如开车更小心），不是不开车。

opts.t: Avoidance

bank.note: Avoidance＝所有亏钱的可能都被消除。FOI 的两个例子：卖掉家具店、Betty 干脆不开车。FOI 同时判它 generally not a practical method。

bank.stem: Installing burglar and fire alarms in a store is an example of:

opts.t: Controlling risk to reduce the frequency and severity of losses
Transferring the risk of loss to an alarm monitoring company
opts.w: 装警报不是把财务后果转给别人。

opts.t: Avoiding the risk by eliminating every possible chance of loss
opts.w: 警报不会消除全部损失可能；FOI 说预防措施 do not always work。

opts.t: Retaining the risk through self-insurance and deductibles
opts.w: 自留是自己出钱承担损失，不是采取预防措施。

bank.note: Risk control＝采取措施降低损失的频率与严重度，装防盗防火警报是 FOI 原例。

bank.stem: Which of the following perils cannot be effectively controlled by loss control measures?

opts.t: Burglary of the store
opts.w: 防盗警报正是控制盗窃的手段之一。

opts.t: Hail
Fire in the stockroom
opts.w: 防火警报是 FOI 举的控制手段。

opts.t: Theft of cash by customers
opts.w: 可以通过管理与设备控制；FOI 点名控制不了的是风、冰雹、闪电。

bank.note: 控制不是完整方案的两个理由：① 预防措施不总管用；② 风、冰雹、闪电这类危险根本无法有效控制。

bank.stem: A deductible on an insurance policy is one way an insured can:

opts.t: Transfer all of the risk to the insurer
opts.w: 有免赔额就不是全部转移；免赔额那部分自己扛。

opts.t: Avoid the risk entirely
opts.w: 免赔额不消灭风险，损失照样可能发生。

opts.t: Retain part of the risk
Control the frequency of losses
opts.w: 免赔额是财务安排，不直接降低损失频率。

bank.note: 考试口径：免赔额（deductible）是被保险人自留一部分风险的方式之一。 免赔额越高，被保险人自留越多，保费也越低。

bank.stem: Which method of dealing with risk is described as the most popular and practical?

opts.t: Avoidance of risk by giving up the activity
opts.w: 回避恰恰是 FOI 说 not a practical method 的那个。

opts.t: Retention of risk through self-insurance
opts.w: 自留适合大公司或小额损失，一般人和企业很少能完全自己承担。

opts.t: Controlling of risk with loss prevention
opts.w: 控制不是完整方案：措施会失灵，风雹雷也控制不了。

opts.t: Transfer of risk through insurance

bank.note: 考试口径：通过保险转移风险，是应对风险最普遍、最实际的办法。 官方练习卷第 4 题同一考点。

bank.stem: Which of the following often find self-insurance less expensive than other options?

opts.t: Students renting their first apartment
opts.w: FOI 说一般人和企业很少能完全自担损失。

opts.t: Large railways and various levels of government
Small retail stores with one location
opts.w: 同上，小企业很少能完全自担。

opts.t: Professional musicians who travel
opts.w: 这是第 2 章 floater 一节的例子，与自保无关。

bank.note: FOI 点名 Canadian Pacific、Canadian National Railways 以及各级政府：对它们而言自保通常比其他办法便宜。

bank.stem: Which of the following situations involves a risk that insurers will cover?

opts.t: Bert may lose money playing poker
opts.w: 赌博是投机风险：可能赢也可能输，不可保。

opts.t: The furniture store may go bankrupt
opts.w: 经营失败是投机风险，FOI 明说 bankruptcy 不可保。

opts.t: Fire may damage the store's stock
A new product line may fail to sell
opts.w: 生意的成败是投机风险，可赚可亏。

bank.note: 只有纯风险可保：只有亏钱的可能、没有获利的可能。火灾只会让人亏；扑克、破产、新产品都可赚可亏，是投机风险。

bank.stem: A contract is defined as:

opts.t: Any written document that has been signed by two people
opts.w: 合同不必书面；口头协议同样有约束力。

opts.t: A promise by one party to give a gift to another party
opts.w: 单方面赠与没有对价，不构成合同。

opts.t: An insurance policy that has been issued by a licensed insurer
opts.w: 保险单是合同的一种，不是合同的定义。

opts.t: An agreement between two or more parties enforceable at law

bank.note: 考试口径：合同是两方或多方之间、在法律上可强制执行的协议（enforceable at law）。

bank.stem: All contracts require five elements to be enforceable at law. Which of the following is NOT one of those five elements?

opts.t: Consideration
opts.w: 一切合同都需要对价。

opts.t: Legality of object
opts.w: 一切合同都需要标的合法。

opts.t: Genuine intention
opts.w: 一切合同都需要真实意思。

opts.t: Insurable interest

bank.note: 五要素：Agreement、Consideration、Legality of Object、Legal Capacity、Genuine Intention。Insurable interest 是保险合同额外的三要素之一（另两个是 utmost good faith、indemnity）。

bank.stem: The Butlers apply for a policy with a $100 deductible. The insurer issues a policy with a $500 deductible instead. What is the status of the contract?

opts.t: No agreement exists; the policy did not match the offer
There is agreement, because the insurer issued a policy
opts.w: 签发保单只有在按要约内容签发时才算承诺。

opts.t: The contract is valid but voidable by the insurer
opts.w: 这里的问题是合意不成立，不是哪一方可以撤销。

opts.t: There is agreement once the Butlers pay any premium
opts.w: 付钱是对价；合意的问题在于签发的东西与要约不一致。

bank.note: 填好的投保单是要约，保险公司按要约签发保单才是承诺。要 $100 给 $500 → 不是无条件接受 → 无合意。

bank.stem: Regarding the agreement element of a contract, which statement is correct?

opts.t: Only a written agreement is binding on the parties
opts.w: FOI 原意相反：不必书面。

opts.t: An oral agreement is just as binding as a written one
An oral agreement binds the insured but not the insurer
opts.w: 口头协议对双方同样有约束力。

opts.t: Agreement exists while the parties are still negotiating
opts.w: 双方还在谈判时，合意尚未形成。

bank.note: 考试口径：合意不必书面，口头协议对合同双方的约束力与书面协议完全相同。 这一条在 binder 一节再出现一次。

bank.stem: Under an insurance contract, what does the insured give as consideration?

opts.t: The completed application form
opts.w: 填好的投保单是要约，不是对价。

opts.t: The insured's agreement to act in good faith
opts.w: 诚信是另一要素（utmost good faith），不是对价。

opts.t: Payment of the premium or a promise to pay it later
The insurer's promise to pay claims fairly
opts.w: 那是保险人一方的承诺，题问的是被保险人给的。

bank.note: Consideration＝双方交换有价值之物。保险里被保险人给的对价是保费，或日后支付保费的承诺。

bank.stem: A person insures a car that he knows was stolen. When the car is damaged, the contract is unenforceable. Which element of a contract is missing?

opts.t: Insurable interest
opts.w: 常见错选。章末配对题 (g) 的答案是 legality of object：偷来的东西→标的不合法。

opts.t: Consideration
opts.w: 保费已付，对价不缺。

opts.t: Legality of object
Legal capacity
opts.w: 投保人是成年人，缔约能力不缺。

bank.note: FOI：给非法取得的财产投保，出险时合同不可执行——缺的是 legality of object。区分：偷来的东西→标的不合法；别人的东西→无可保利益。

bank.pt: 未成年人与生活必需品
bank.stem: Eleven-year-old Benji buys a $350 painting at an art gallery. His parents insist he return it. Under the FOI exam view, what is the result?

opts.t: The gallery may keep the money because Benji paid in cash
opts.w: 付现不改变未成年人的缔约能力问题。

opts.t: The gallery must refund the money; a painting is not a necessity of life
The contract is binding because Benji understood the price
opts.w: 理解价格不等于有缔约能力。

opts.t: The contract is binding because his friends lent him the money
opts.w: 钱从哪来与合同效力无关。

bank.note: FOI：未成年人只能为生活必需品（食物、衣服、住所）订立有效合同。画不是必需品，画廊必须退钱。（BC 现行《Infants Act》的写法不同，见讲解页第④节；考试按 FOI 答。）

bank.stem: A person under the influence of alcohol will generally be declared incompetent to contract only if it can be shown that the person:

opts.t: Had consumed any amount of alcohol before signing
opts.w: 门槛远高于喝过酒；FOI 说法律让这类人极难撤销合同。

opts.t: Later regretted having signed the contract
opts.w: 事后后悔与缔约能力无关。

opts.t: Was totally unable to understand he was making a contract
Was a regular, long-standing client of the same broker
opts.w: 是不是经纪人的老客户，与缔约能力无关。

bank.note: 两种情形之一才算无能力：① 完全不能理解自己在订合同（或不懂后果）；② 被人故意灌醉或下药。门槛高是为了防止拿「我喝多了」赖掉正当合同。

bank.stem: The Butlers operate their store under the trade name "Butlers' Best Buy Furniture" without incorporating. A policy issued only in that trade name would be:

opts.t: Unenforceable, because a trade name has no legal status
Enforceable, because the name appears on all invoices
opts.w: 用在发票和招牌上不赋予法律地位。

opts.t: Enforceable, as long as the premium is paid
opts.w: 付保费解决的是对价，不解决缔约能力。

opts.t: Voidable only by the insurer
opts.w: FOI 判的是 unenforceable，不是可撤销。

bank.note: 只用商号经营在法律上没有地位，不能缔约。正确写法要带业主法定名字：Bert and Betty Butler t/a（trading as）／d/b/a（doing business as）／o/a（operating as）Butlers' Best Buy Furniture。官方练习卷第 8 题同一考点。

bank.stem: To prove genuine intention, it must be shown that the agreement was not affected by each of the following EXCEPT:

opts.t: Fraud
opts.w: Fraud 是破坏真实意思的四种情形之一。

opts.t: Indemnity
Duress
opts.w: Duress 是破坏真实意思的四种情形之一。

opts.t: Concealment
opts.w: Concealment 是破坏真实意思的四种情形之一。

bank.note: 破坏真实意思的四种情形：Fraud、Duress、Concealment、Mistake。Indemnity 是保险合同的三要素之一，是正面要素，不是破坏因素。

bank.stem: Which of the following does NOT have an insurable interest in the property described?

opts.t: A bank that holds a mortgage on a house
opts.w: 抵押权人是 FOI 点名有可保利益的一方。

opts.t: A dry cleaner holding customers' clothing
opts.w: 受托保管人（bailee）是 FOI 点名有可保利益的一方。

opts.t: A granddaughter expecting to inherit silverware
A business partner in the building owner's firm
opts.w: 财产所有人及其合伙人有可保利益。

bank.note: 对期待继承的财产没有可保利益：损失发生后，潜在继承人的财务状况与损失前并无不同。有可保利益的：所有人及合伙人、抵押权人、受托保管人、可能对第三方负法律责任的人。

bank.stem: An applicant deliberately fails to tell the insurer about previous claims and a prior cancellation of insurance. Which element of an insurance contract has been breached?

opts.t: Utmost good faith
Consideration
opts.w: 对价是保费，与告知无关。

opts.t: Indemnity
opts.w: 补偿讲赔多少，与投保时告知无关。

opts.t: Legality of object
opts.w: 标的合法讲的是保的东西或目的是否违法。

bank.note: 最大诚信要求双方完全诚实；保险公司必须能信赖投保人关于风险、既往理赔、解约、拒保的陈述。章末配对题 (h) 同一考点。

bank.stem: Unnecessary delays by an insurer in settling claims may demonstrate:

opts.t: A lack of insurable interest on the part of the insured
opts.w: 可保利益是被保险人一侧的要素。

opts.t: A breach of the legal capacity requirement
opts.w: 缔约能力讲的是订约时的人，与理赔拖延无关。

opts.t: An absence of good faith by the insurer
That the contract was never agreed between the parties
opts.w: 合意早已成立；理赔阶段的问题不让合同回到「没合意」。

bank.note: 最大诚信是双向的：保险人要用清楚无歧义的语言写合同，理赔要及时、公正；不必要的拖延可能说明保险人缺乏诚信。

bank.stem: A voidable contract is one that is:

opts.t: Considered in law never to have existed, for either party
opts.w: 这是 void 的定义。

opts.t: Void as to the wrongdoer but not the wronged party, unless it so elects
Enforceable by either party only if it was made in writing
opts.w: 书面与否不是 voidable 的定义。

opts.t: Automatically void as to both parties once 30 days pass
opts.w: FOI 没有 30 天这条，是编的。

bank.note: Void＝视为从未存在。Voidable＝对过错方无效，对受害方不无效，除非受害方选择把它当作无效。

bank.stem: Why is a broker's binding authority often stated in the insurer's rate manual rather than in the Agency Agreement?

opts.t: Rate manuals are filed with and approved by the regulator
opts.w: FOI 没有这么说；理由是方便调整。

opts.t: Agency Agreements are not legally allowed to contain any limits
opts.w: 代理协议可以写权限；FOI 说的是写在费率手册里更容易改。

opts.t: Brokers are not permitted to read the insurer's Agency Agreement
opts.w: 编出来的；FOI 只说权限写在费率手册里便于调整。

opts.t: Authority can then change without renegotiating each agreement

bank.note: 承保权限有两个出处：Agency Agreement 与 rate manual。市场变化或出大额赔案后保险公司想调整权限，写在费率手册里就不必逐一重谈每份代理协议。

bank.stem: A broker binds a commercial building for an amount above the binding authority granted by the insurer, and a loss occurs before the insurer reviews it. Who may be responsible for the loss?

opts.t: The insurer, because the broker acted as its agent
opts.w: 超出承保权限绑定的情形，责任在经纪行而不在保险人。

opts.t: The brokerage, through an errors and omissions claim
No one, because the binder is void
opts.w: binder 本身的效力不是这里的问题；损失由谁承担才是。

opts.t: The insured, because the binder was oral
opts.w: 题干没说是口头的；而且口头 binder 同样有约束力。

bank.note: 经纪人超出承保权限又出险，经纪行可能面对错误与遗漏（E&O）索赔，由经纪行而不是保险公司承担损失。所以每个经纪人都必须清楚自己的权限。

bank.stem: A contractor wants coverage for equipment that is frequently moved from job site to job site. Which type of document is designed for property with a high degree of mobility?

opts.t: An endorsement deleting an exclusion
opts.w: 批单改条款；题问的是专为流动财产设计的保障。

opts.t: A binder issued by the broker
opts.w: binder 是正式保单前的临时合同，与财产是否流动无关。

opts.t: A floater
A separate policy from another insurer
opts.w: 另立保单用于原合同改不了的保障（如职业责任），不是流动财产的标准做法。

bank.note: 早期财产保单只保在指定地点的财产；floater 承保流动性高的财产，如承包商设备、杂项工具、专业乐手与摄影师器材，也用于珠宝、皮草等有特别限额的物品。

bank.stem: Each province's Superintendent of Insurance has all of the following responsibilities EXCEPT:

opts.t: Supervising the terms and conditions of contracts sold by private insurers
opts.w: FOI 列的省级职能第一项：私营保险公司卖的合同都要经省批准。

opts.t: Setting the financial standards an insurer must meet for a federal licence
Licensing every insurer that transacts business in the province
opts.w: FOI 列的第二项：在哪个省营业就要在哪个省领牌。

opts.t: Monitoring the financial stability of provincially chartered insurers
opts.w: FOI 列的第三项：省一般只盯按省章程成立的公司。

bank.note: 省 Superintendent 管三件事：合同条款、给保险公司发牌、省注册公司的财务稳定。联邦牌照的财务标准由 OSFI 定，不是省。

bank.stem: Fortress Insurance Company holds a federal licence and plans to start selling property insurance in British Columbia and Alberta. What licensing is required?

opts.t: A licence in each province in which it transacts business
None, because the federal licence covers every province
opts.w: FOI 明说：即使已有联邦牌照，也要在营业的每个省领牌。

opts.t: A licence only in the province where its head office is
opts.w: 省牌照跟着营业地走，不是跟着总部走。

opts.t: Membership in PACICC instead of any provincial licence
opts.w: PACICC 是破产兜底机构，不是发牌机构。

bank.note: 保险公司要在营业所在的每一个省分别领牌；即使已经拿到联邦牌照，这条也照样适用。

bank.stem: The Superintendent's ongoing audits show that an insurer is failing to maintain the assets required to pay potential future losses. What may happen first?

opts.t: Its policyholders are charged an extra premium to cover the shortfall
opts.w: FOI 没有向保单持有人加收的机制；补足靠公司自己。

opts.t: Its brokers' agency agreements are cancelled by the government
opts.w: 代理协议是保险公司与经纪行之间的合同，政府不会代为解除。

opts.t: PACICC immediately pays every claim that is open at the insurer
opts.w: PACICC 在公司破产、赔不出钱时才赔；资产不足先是暂停营业。

opts.t: Its operations may be suspended until the deficiency is remedied

bank.note: 资产不足 → 暂停营业直到补足；情节极严重 → Superintendent 接管资产。PACICC 是破产后的兜底，不是第一步。

bank.stem: An insurer becomes bankrupt. Its insured has unpaid claims of $300,000 arising from a single occurrence and an unearned premium of $1,200 on the policy. Using the PACICC amounts in the FOI study material, what can the insured recover?

opts.t: $300,000 for the claims and $840 of unearned premium
opts.w: 单一事故全部索赔上限 $250,000；退费 70%×1,200=840 还要受每单 $700 封顶。

opts.t: $250,000 for the claims and $840 of unearned premium
opts.w: 索赔上限对了，但未赚保费退费每单最多 $700。

opts.t: $250,000 for the claims and $700 of unearned premium
$300,000 for the claims and $700 of unearned premium
opts.w: 退费封顶对了，但单一事故全部索赔最多 $250,000。

bank.note: FOI 口径：单一事故全部索赔最多 $250,000；未赚保费退 70%、每单最多 $700。现行数字已换（KU-0040），考场按 FOI 口径。

bank.stem: The Butlers paid Fortress Insurance Company the full premium for a 12-month policy. One month later, how much of the premium has the insurer earned, and what is the status of the rest?

opts.t: All of it is earned once the policy is issued and delivered
opts.w: 保费要到保单期满才完全赚到，不是出单即赚。

opts.t: 1/12 is earned; the rest is unearned and held in trust for a refund
Half is earned; the other half is held by the broker as security
opts.w: 按时间比例赚，一个月只赚 1/12；未赚部分由保险人信托持有。

opts.t: 11/12 is earned because the policy has been in force for a month
opts.w: 比例说反了：过了 1 个月只赚 1/12。

bank.note: 保费要到保单期满才算全部赚得（fully earned）。 一个月后只赚 1/12，未赚部分视为信托持有，以备保单提前取消时退还。

bank.stem: As described in the FOI course, all of the following statements about brokers' handling of premiums are correct EXCEPT:

opts.t: Most provinces require the brokerage to set up a separate premium trust fund
The agreement with the insurer usually allows 30-60 days to remit premiums
opts.w: FOI 原话：通常给经纪行 30–60 天把保费汇给保险公司。

opts.t: It is standard practice for brokers to deduct their commission before paying
opts.w: FOI 原话：经纪人惯例先扣下全部佣金、余款付给保险公司。

opts.t: Ontario requires premiums to be deposited within three banking days
opts.w: 安大略 RIBO 规定：不晚于收款后 3 个银行工作日存入独立信托账户。

bank.note: 多数省不要求单设信托基金，安大略是例外。「哪个省不一样」是这一节最爱考的角度。

bank.stem: In the description of the parties to an insurance contract, the insurer is which party?

opts.t: The first party to the contract
opts.w: 第一方是被保险人，保险人是第二方。

opts.t: A third party to the contract
opts.w: 第三方不是合同当事人；保险人当然是当事人。

opts.t: An intermediary, not a party
opts.w: 中介是经纪人；保险人是合同当事人。

opts.t: The second party to the contract

bank.note: 被保险人是合同的第一方，保险人是第二方；第三方（third party）不是合同当事人。

bank.stem: A broker who has binding authority binds a new client's homeowners coverage by telephone at 3:15 p.m. on June 1. When does coverage begin?

opts.t: At 12:01 a.m. standard time on June 1
opts.w: 12:01 a.m. 是一般保单的生效时刻；有承保权限时自绑定那一刻起保。

opts.t: At 12:01 a.m. standard time on June 2
opts.w: 不必等到次日；FOI 的注说绑定即起保。

opts.t: At 3:15 p.m. on June 1, when it is bound
When the insurer later issues the policy
opts.w: binder 本身就是合同（第 2 章），不必等正式保单。

bank.note: 考试口径：经纪人有承保授权（binding authority）时，保障从绑定那一刻起生效。 一般情况才是 12:01 a.m. 标准时间、Named Insured 地址。

bank.stem: A forest fire threatens the insured's home, so she moves her furniture to a friend's barn, a location not named on her fire policy. The furniture stays there and is destroyed when the barn burns on the tenth day. How does the Removal Clause apply?

opts.t: Covered, because the property was necessarily removed to prevent loss
opts.w: 搬离的理由成立，但保障只有 7 天或保单剩余期，第 10 天已过期。

opts.t: Not covered, because coverage at the unnamed location lasts only seven days
Covered, if the insurer is told about the new location within 30 days
opts.w: 搬移条款没有「30 天内报告」的条件；限制是 7 天。

opts.t: Not covered, because unnamed locations are never covered under fire policies
opts.w: 说得太绝对：因承保危险必须搬离的，7 天内照保。

bank.note: 搬移条款三条件：因承保危险必须搬离；保额扣掉原地点已发生的损失；7 天或保单剩余期，取短。第 10 天出险不在保障期内。

bank.pt: 搬移条款 · 可用保额
bank.stem: A building and contents are insured for $200,000 at the named location. A fire there causes an $140,000 loss, and saved contents are moved to an unnamed location, where a second fire two days later destroys them (value $80,000). What is the most the insurer must pay for the loss at the unnamed location?

opts.w: 要先扣掉原地点已赔的 $140,000：剩下的保额只有 $60,000。
保额不会因为换地点而重置；搬出去的财产只用剩余保额。
$140,000 是原地点的损失，不是剩余保额。

bank.stem: A policy contains a $1,000 deductible clause, but the required warning that the policy contains a clause which may limit the amount payable was never printed or stamped on its face page. What is the effect?

opts.t: The whole policy is void because a required item is missing
opts.w: 后果只落在限额条款本身，保单其余部分照常有效。

opts.t: The deductible still applies because the insured accepted the policy
opts.w: FOI 明说：不印警示，该条款对被保险人无约束力。

opts.t: The broker must pay the deductible out of earned commission
opts.w: FOI 没有让经纪人代付的规则；后果是条款失效。

opts.t: The deductible clause is not binding on the insured

bank.note: 法律要求在首页用红墨水印警示语，"Unless these words are printed or stamped on the face page, any such clause shall not be binding upon the insured." 免赔额与共保是两个例子。BC 现行改为醒目粗体（KU-0016），后果相同。

bank.stem: After paying the insured's claim, the insurer sues the contractor who caused the loss. In whose name is the action taken?

opts.t: In the insurer's own name, as a new claim
opts.w: 代位＝站进被保险人的鞋里，行使的是被保险人原有的权利。

opts.t: In the broker's name, as agent of the insured
opts.w: 经纪人不是追偿权人。

opts.t: In the insured's name, standing in its shoes
In the name of the provincial Superintendent
opts.w: 监管机关与个案追偿无关。

bank.note: Subrogation＝"to put oneself into another's shoes"。保险人赔付后取得被保险人对责任方的追偿权，对责任方提起的诉讼以被保险人的名义进行。

bank.stem: A broker tells a client over the phone that the insurer will not enforce a policy condition requiring the sprinkler system to be inspected. A loss later occurs. Under the Insurance Act rule on waiver, is the condition waived?

opts.t: Yes, because the broker represents the insurer and may speak for it to the client
opts.w: FOI 口径：只有保险人授权的人书面签字的弃权才有效；经纪人口头说不算。

opts.t: No, because a waiver must be in writing and signed by a person the insurer authorizes
Yes, provided the broker later confirms the waiver to the client by email
opts.w: 经纪人自己的确认仍然不是保险人授权的人签字。

opts.t: No, because no term or condition of a fire policy can ever be waived by anyone
opts.w: 太绝对：保险人授权的人可以书面弃权。

bank.note: 保险法规定：保险人放弃合同中的任何条款或条件，必须书面作出、并由保险人授权的人签字，否则不算放弃。 这个人通常是保险公司高管。

bank.stem: Your clients received their policy one month ago but have not paid the premium. Yesterday they had a fire loss. What is the insurer's obligation?

opts.t: It must pay the claim as if the premium had been paid
There is no coverage until the premium has been paid
opts.w: FOI 口径：交付即约束保险人，如同保费已付。

opts.t: It pays half the claim because only half the premium is due
opts.w: 没有按比例打折的规则。

opts.t: It pays only if the premium is paid within the next 60 days
opts.w: 60 天是法定条件 12 的付款期，与交付效力无关。

bank.note: 保单一旦交付，即使保费还没付，对保险人的约束力与已付保费相同。 章末自测第 6 题。

bank.stem: Provincial Insurance Acts require every policy insuring loss by fire to provide which three coverages?

opts.t: Fire, windstorm and hail damage to buildings and contents
opts.w: 风与冰雹不在法定必保之列。

opts.t: Fire, lightning and explosion from any cause whatsoever
opts.w: 爆炸只限天然气、煤气或人造气，不是一切爆炸。

opts.t: Fire, smoke and water damage caused by firefighters
opts.w: 烟与消防用水是火的直接损失，但不是法定三项的写法。

opts.t: Fire, lightning and explosion of natural, coal or manufactured gas

bank.note: 法定必保三项（考试口径）：Fire · Lightning · Explosion of Natural, Coal or Manufactured Gas。这是最低要求，保险公司可以给得更宽。BC 现行 s.34(1)(b) 只写天然气或人造气爆炸、且不论是否随后起火（实务口径，KU-0017）。

bank.stem: Which of the following losses results from a hostile fire?

opts.t: Logs burning in the living-room fireplace
opts.w: 火在它该在的容器里，是友好之火。

opts.t: Steaks burnt while cooking on the barbecue
opts.w: 故意放进友好之火的财产，不保。

opts.t: A carpet scorched by a spark from the fireplace
Paper deliberately thrown into the wood stove
opts.w: 火仍在容器里，是友好之火。

bank.note: 友好之火待在它该在的容器里；逃出容器或本来就不在容器里的是敌意之火。保单只保敌意之火。壁炉溅出的火星烧坏地毯是FOI 例子。

bank.stem: While ironing, the insured leaves a hot iron on a shirt. The shirt catches fire, and the fire spreads to the curtains and the walls of the house. How do the standard legislated exclusions apply?

opts.t: Nothing is covered, because the fire began with the application of heat
opts.w: 除外只针对被直接加热的那件东西，引起的火灾损失照赔。

opts.t: The shirt is excluded; the fire damage to the curtains and house is covered
Everything is covered, including the shirt, because a hostile fire occurred
opts.w: 被直接加热的衬衫正是法定除外的对象。

opts.t: Only the house is covered; the curtains are excluded as household contents
opts.w: 窗帘与房子同样是被引燃的「其他财产」，照赔。

bank.note: Application of heat 除外只针对正在被直接加热的那件财产；由此引发的火灾烧到保单承保的其他财产，照常赔付。

bank.stem: Lightning strikes a house. Under the legislated fire coverages and exclusions, each of the following losses is covered EXCEPT:

opts.t: The television set, damaged directly by the lightning
The sofa, burned by a fire that the lightning started
opts.w: 雷击引发的火灾损失不在除外之列。

opts.t: The roof, split open by the lightning strike itself
opts.w: 雷电是法定必保；除外只针对电器设备。

opts.t: The kitchen, damaged when the strike caused a natural gas explosion
opts.w: 天然气爆炸也是法定必保。

bank.note: 雷电必保，但雷击直接打坏电器设备（电视、炉灶、冰箱、冰柜）除外；这条除外只管雷击本身造成的电器损坏；雷击引发火灾造成的其他损失仍然赔。

bank.stem: All of the following statements about the Statutory Conditions in a fire policy are true EXCEPT:

opts.t: They must be printed on every policy under the heading Statutory Conditions
opts.w: FOI 原话：这些规则须以 Statutory Conditions 为标题印在每张保单上。

opts.t: They are imposed by provincial legislation and bind all parties
opts.w: FOI 口径：由省立法规定，对合同各方都有约束力。

opts.t: They clearly outline the rights and responsibilities of both parties
opts.w: FOI 说这是法定条件重要的原因：确保双方被公平对待。

opts.t: The insurer may change them if the insured agrees to the change in writing

bank.note: 法定条件不许保险人改动，即使被保险人同意也不行。 改、删、加都对被保险人无效。

bank.pt: 法定条件 1 · 不实陈述
bank.stem: When applying for insurance, an applicant deliberately did not disclose two previous cancellations in order to obtain a lower rate. After a fire, the insurer alleges misrepresentation. Which statement is correct?

opts.t: The insured must prove that full disclosure was made on the application
opts.w: FOI 口径：举证责任在保险人，不在被保险人。

opts.t: The contract is automatically void for all property, whatever the link
opts.w: 条文是「就相关财产」无效；FOI 还要求与损失直接相关。

opts.t: The insurer must prove it, and may void the contract only if it is linked to the loss
Misrepresentation matters only if it is discovered before any claim is made
opts.w: FOI 口径：指控通常就是在索赔时才提出。

bank.note: 以往解约、拒保属重要事实；故意不披露以求低费率是欺诈性遗漏。FOI 口径："The onus to prove misrepresentation rests with the insurer"，且只有能证明"directly linked to the loss"才可使合同无效。

bank.stem: For the purposes of Statutory Condition 1, a fact is material if knowing it would lead the insurer to:

opts.t: Ask the broker to place the risk with a different insurer
opts.w: FOI 定义只有两个后果：拒保或加费。

opts.t: Decline the risk or charge a higher premium for accepting it
Order an inspection report from an independent firm
opts.w: 检查报告是核保信息来源（第 4 章），不是重要事实的定义。

opts.t: Pay the broker a reduced rate of commission on the policy
opts.w: 佣金与重要事实的定义无关。

bank.note: Material fact＝保险人知道了就会 decline the risk altogether 或 charge a higher premium。例子：以往理赔、以往解约或拒保、现有防护系统。

bank.pt: 法定条件 2 · 他人财产
bank.stem: The Butlers' upholstery shop often holds about $50,000 of customers' furniture. Their policy says nothing about property of others. A fire destroys the shop and the customers' furniture. Under Statutory Condition 2, is the customers' furniture covered?

opts.t: No, unless the Butlers' interest in that property is stated in the contract
Yes, because as bailees the Butlers automatically have coverage for it
opts.w: 有可保利益不等于有保障：权益要写进合同。

opts.t: Yes, but only up to half its value as a standard allowance
opts.w: FOI 没有按一半价值赔付的规则。

opts.t: No, because bailees can never insure property they do not own
opts.w: 受托保管人对客户财产有可保利益，写进合同即可保。

bank.note: "…the insurer is not liable for loss or damage to property owned by any person other than the insured, unless the interest of the insured therein is stated in the contract." 受托保管人有可保利益，但要写进合同。

bank.pt: 法定条件 3 · 权益变更
bank.stem: The insured homeowner dies, and the house passes under her will to her daughter. Two months later, before anyone contacts the insurer, the house is damaged by fire. Under Statutory Condition 3, what is the daughter's position?

opts.t: The policy ended on the death, so there is no coverage
opts.w: 条件 3 正是死亡导致所有权变更后，保险人仍负责。

opts.t: She is covered only if she notified the insurer within 15 days
opts.w: 15 天是重大变更补保费的期限，与本条无关。

opts.t: She is covered only for contents, not for the building itself
opts.w: 条件 3 不区分建筑与室内财产，权利整体承继。

opts.t: She has the same rights under the existing contract as the deceased

bank.note: Change of Interest：保险人对破产授权转让、继承、法律运作、死亡导致的所有权变更后发生的损失仍负责。继承人取得与原被保险人同样的权利。

bank.pt: 法定条件 4 · 重大变更
bank.stem: Without telling the insurer, a homeowner converts his private garage into an autobody shop for paying customers. Six months later a fire starts in the shop. What may the insurer do under Statutory Condition 4?

opts.t: Pay in full, because the garage was described in the policy
opts.w: 未告知的重大变更使合同就受影响部分失效。

opts.t: Pay in full unless it can prove the homeowner acted fraudulently
opts.w: 重大变更不以欺诈为要件；只要实质、持续、未告知。

opts.t: Treat the contract as void as to the part affected by the change
Cancel the whole policy back to its original start date
opts.w: 后果是「就受影响部分」失效，不是全单追溯撤销。

bank.note: 私人车库改汽车修理厂是FOI 例子。未及时书面告知的重大变更"avoids the contract as to the part affected thereby"——直接归因于该变更的损失不赔。

bank.pt: 重大变更 · 实质且持续
bank.stem: A furniture store holds a one-day free barbecue during a clearance sale. A barbecue stand collapses and the resulting fire damages the store. The insurer wants to deny the claim as an unreported material change. What is the best response?

opts.t: The denial stands, because the barbecue clearly increased the chance of loss
opts.w: 增加风险还不够：还必须既实质又持续。

opts.t: It is not a material change, because a change must be substantial and continuing
The denial stands, because the change was not notified in writing
opts.w: 先要认定是重大变更，才轮到有没有告知。

opts.t: It is not a material change, because the cause was an equipment failure
opts.w: FOI 的理由不是损因，而是一天的活动谈不上实质且持续。

bank.note: Butler 家烧烤会是FOI 原例："the insurer must prove that the change … was both (1) substantial; and (2) continuing." 一天的活动两样都不沾（KU-0015）。

bank.stem: Under Statutory Condition 5 of the standard fire policy, all of the following are correct EXCEPT:

opts.t: If the insured terminates, the refund is calculated on a pro rata basis
The insurer may terminate with 15 days' notice sent by registered mail
opts.w: 条件 5(1)(a)：挂号信 15 天。

opts.t: The insurer may terminate with five days' written notice personally delivered
opts.w: 条件 5(1)(a)：当面送达书面通知 5 天。

opts.t: The insured may terminate the contract at any time on request
opts.w: 条件 5(1)(b)：被保险人随时请求即可。

bank.note: 保险人终止 → 按比例（pro rata）退；被保险人终止 → 按短期费率（short rate）退。两边都受最低保留保费限制。

bank.stem: An insurer sends a notice of termination by registered mail. The letter arrives at the post office to which it is addressed on March 10. Using the wording of Statutory Condition 5 in the FOI course (not later provincial amendments), when does the 15-day period begin to run?

opts.t: On the day the insurer mailed the letter
opts.w: 条件 5(5)：从信件到达收件邮局的次日起算，不是寄出日。

opts.t: On March 10, the day the letter reached the post office
opts.w: 要从到达那天的次日开始算。

opts.t: On the day the insured signs for and opens the letter
opts.w: 起算点看邮局收到，不看被保险人什么时候签收。

opts.t: On March 11, the day after it reached the post office

bank.note: FOI 条件 5(5)："commences to run on the day following the receipt of the registered letter at the post office to which it is addressed." BC 现行改为送达被保险人邮址当天（第④节）。

bank.stem: An insured files a $20,000 proof of loss that deliberately includes $3,000 of items she never owned. The insurer proves this. Under Statutory Condition 7, what happens?

opts.t: The insurer pays $17,000 for the items she did own
opts.w: 欺诈的后果是整个索赔无效，不只扣掉虚报的部分。

opts.t: The insurer pays $20,000 and then sues to recover $3,000
opts.w: 证明了欺诈就可整单拒赔，不必先赔后追。

opts.t: The insurer may deny the entire claim
The insurer pays the claim less a fraud penalty
opts.w: 法定条件里没有罚款扣减的机制。

bank.note: 保险人能证明欺诈的，可以拒赔整个索赔，而不只是拒赔欺诈的那一部分。 诚实的错误不算欺诈；举证在保险人。

bank.pt: 法定条件 6 · 损失证明
bank.stem: Under Statutory Condition 6, the proof of loss verified by statutory declaration must include each of the following EXCEPT:

opts.t: A complete inventory of the destroyed and damaged property
A written valuation of the property prepared by a licensed appraiser
A statement that the loss did not occur through any wilful act of the insured
opts.w: 条件 6(1)(b)(iii)。

opts.t: The amount of other insurance and the names of the other insurers

bank.note: 损失证明七项：损毁清单、何时如何发生、非故意声明、其他保险、各方权益与负担、签发后的变化、出险时财产位置。持牌评估师估值不是法定要求。

bank.pt: 法定条件 8 · 谁可以报
bank.stem: The insured has been in hospital for several months after a fire at his home. His brother, acting as his agent, wants to give notice of loss and file the proof of loss. Under Statutory Condition 8, is this allowed?

opts.t: Yes, if the insured's absence or inability is satisfactorily accounted for
No, only the named insured can sign a statutory declaration of loss
opts.w: 条件 8 正是允许代理人代办的规定。

opts.t: No, only a practising lawyer may act on the insured's behalf in a claim
opts.w: FOI 口径：律师、朋友、亲属都可以作代理人。

opts.t: Yes, but only a mortgagee named in the policy may file the proof of loss
opts.w: 受款人代办是被保险人拒绝时的另一条路；这里代理人就可以。

bank.note: 被保险人不在或不能，且理由令保险人满意（如长期住院、长期出国），被保险人的代理人可以代为通知和交损失证明；被保险人拒绝时，受款人（如按揭权人）也可以。

bank.pt: 法定条件 9 · 施救费用
bank.stem: After a windstorm tears open part of the roof, the insured spends $600 on tarps to keep rain out. Under Statutory Condition 9, how are these expenses treated?

opts.t: They are the insured's own cost, because salvage is the insured's duty
opts.w: 义务在被保险人，但费用保险人要分担。

opts.t: They are paid by the insurer only if the claim exceeds the deductible
opts.w: 条件 9 没有这个前提。

opts.t: They are paid by the broker, who arranged the coverage for the client
opts.w: 经纪人与施救费用无关。

opts.t: The insurer contributes pro rata towards reasonable and proper expenses

bank.note: 条件 9(1) 被保险人必须采取一切合理措施防止进一步损失；9(2) 保险人按比例（pro rata）分担为此支出的合理费用。不要求冒生命危险。

bank.stem: Each of the following is consistent with Statutory Condition 10 (Entry, Control, Abandonment) EXCEPT:

opts.t: The insurer has an immediate right of access to survey the damaged property
opts.w: 条件 10：出险后保险人有立即进入查勘的权利。

opts.t: The insurer has a further right of entry after the insured secures the property
opts.w: 条件 10：安顿好之后还有再次进入评估的权利。

opts.t: The insured may abandon damaged property to the insurer and claim its full value
The insurer is not entitled to control or possession of the insured property
opts.w: 这是条件 10 的原文：保险人无权控制或占有财产。

bank.note: "without the consent of the insurer there can be no abandonment to it of insured property." 是「需同意」，不是「被禁止」（KU-0014）。

bank.stem: An insured and her insurer disagree about whether the policy covers a loss at all. She asks you whether the appraisal process can settle the dispute. What is the correct answer?

opts.t: Yes, either party may demand appraisal for any claim dispute
opts.w: 评估只解决价值分歧，不解决保不保。

opts.t: No, appraisal only determines value or the amount of loss, not coverage
Yes, but only if the dispute is raised within 60 days of the loss
opts.w: 60 天是付款期，与评估无关。

opts.t: No, appraisal is available only to the insurer, not to the insured
opts.w: FOI 口径：任何一方都可以提出。

bank.note: 评估程序（appraisal）只定损失金额，与保单是否承保这个问题毫无关系。 评估要书面提出、且在损失证明交付之后。

bank.pt: 法定条件 · 时限辨析
bank.stem: Using the 15 Statutory Conditions of the standard fire policy, all of the following time limits are correct EXCEPT:

opts.t: An action must be started within two years after the loss in every province
The loss is payable within 60 days after completion of the proof of loss
opts.w: 条件 12：损失证明完成后 60 天内付款。

opts.t: Notice of intent to repair is due within 30 days after receipt of proof of loss
opts.w: 条件 13(1)：收到损失证明后 30 天内书面通知。

opts.t: Repair work must begin within 45 days after receipt of the proof of loss
opts.w: 条件 13(2)：收到损失证明后 45 天内开工。

bank.note: FOI 条件 14：一年（Manitoba 与 Saskatchewan 两年），自损失发生起算。BC 现行是 2 年、自知道或应当知道起（KU-0012），但考场按 FOI 口径。

bank.stem: Under Statutory Condition 15 of the standard fire policy, where may written notice to the insurer be delivered or sent by registered mail?

opts.t: To the broker's office that placed the policy
opts.w: 条件 15 指定的是保险人在本省的总代理处或总部。

opts.t: To the office of the provincial Superintendent
opts.w: 监管机关不是通知送达处。

opts.t: To any adjuster assigned to the insured's claim
opts.w: 理赔人不是法定的通知送达处。

opts.t: To the chief agency or head office of the insurer in the province

bank.note: 给保险人的书面通知，可以送达或挂号寄到保险人在本省的总代理处（chief agency）或总部。 给被保险人的通知当面送达或挂号信寄最后告知的地址。

bank.stem: Insurance is said to be fiduciary in nature. In simple terms, a fiduciary is:

opts.t: A person who guarantees the debts of another
opts.w: 那是担保人，不是受托人。

opts.t: A person who sets insurance rates for the province
opts.w: FOI 说省不定价；也与受托无关。

opts.t: One who handles other people's money
A company licensed by the federal government
opts.w: 联邦牌照与受托性质无关。

bank.note: 简单说，受托人（fiduciary）就是经手别人钱财的人。 保险人与经纪人都是受托人，必须确保别人对他们的信任不被滥用。

bank.stem: Insurance differs from commodities like groceries, gas or automobiles. Which of the following is one of the differences?

opts.t: Insurance can only be bought through a licensed broker
opts.w: FOI 给的两点是「要申请」和「价格因人而异」，没有说只能通过经纪人买。

opts.t: An application is required, and not everyone may buy it
Its price is set by the province for every consumer
opts.w: FOI 第二点正相反：价格人人不同，取决于被保风险。

opts.t: It cannot be returned once the premium has been paid
opts.w: 被保险人随时可以终止并拿短期费率退费（第 3 章）。

bank.note: 两点不同：An application is required（不是谁都能买，风险不合标准通常拒保）；Cost not the same for all persons（保费取决于随风险变化的多种因素）。

bank.stem: Who are the only parties to an insurance contract arranged by a broker?

opts.t: The insured and the insurance company
The insured, the insurer and the broker
opts.w: 经纪人是中介，不是合同当事人。

opts.t: The broker and the insurance company
opts.w: 被保险人才是当事人；经纪人不是。

opts.t: The insured and the brokerage that placed it
opts.w: 经纪行同样只是中介。

bank.note: 经纪人、代理人不是保险合同的当事人；合同当事人只有被保险人和保险公司两方。 经纪人、代理人的角色是中介。

bank.stem: Each of the following correctly reflects the traditional distinction between agents and brokers EXCEPT:

opts.t: Agents legally owe their primary duty to the insurer
opts.w: FOI 原话：Agents represent insurer's interests。

opts.t: Brokers legally owe their primary duty to the client
opts.w: FOI 原话：Brokers represent client's interests。

opts.t: Agents represent one insurance company
opts.w: FOI 第二点区别：代理人代表一家公司。

opts.t: Brokers may not choose to represent only one insurer

bank.note: 第二点区别：经纪人也可以只代表一家保险公司，但多数情况下会让消费者在几家保险公司之间选。 经纪人可以只代表一家，只是多数情况下给多家选择。

bank.stem: The law requires insurance brokers to meet which standard in their affairs?

opts.t: The lowest available premium in the market
opts.w: FOI 从未把最低价当法律标准；义务是对的建议与保障。

opts.t: Absolute guarantee of the client's coverage
opts.w: 法律要求的是合理标准，不是绝对担保。

opts.t: Reasonable skill, care and diligence
Best efforts as decided by the insurer
opts.w: 标准由法律定，不由保险人定。

bank.note: 法律要求经纪人执业时尽到合理的技能、谨慎与勤勉（reasonable skill, care and diligence）。 客户因经纪人没达到这个标准而受损，可对经纪人和经纪行提 E&O 索赔。

bank.stem: A broker sells a homeowners policy without telling the client that sewer back-up is excluded. The basement floods from a sewer back-up and the claim is denied. The client says the broker should have told him. How is this exposure best classified?

opts.t: Misrepresentation of the risk; the claim can be filed against the insurer only
opts.w: 这里不是风险描述错误；E&O 是对经纪人与经纪行，不是对保险人。

opts.t: Inadequate coverage; an E&O claim may be made against the broker as well as the brokerage
A processing delay; only the individual broker can be held responsible
opts.w: 不是处理延误；FOI 说 E&O 可对经纪人和经纪行提出。

opts.t: No E&O issue arises, because the exclusion was printed in the policy wording
opts.w: FOI 把「没告诉客户有哪些除外」列为保障不足的第一种成因。

bank.note: 保障不足（inadequate coverage）的第一种成因就是 Failure to advise clients of exclusions；E&O 索赔"may be filed against the broker and the brokerage"。

bank.stem: Which of the following accounts for the largest share of errors and omissions claims against brokers?

opts.t: Inadequate coverage
Brokerage Agreement violations
opts.w: 违反经纪协议是「其他来源」之一，不是头号原因。

opts.t: Processing delays
opts.w: 处理延误也是其他来源之一。

opts.t: Cancellation and renewal errors
opts.w: 取消与续保出错同样属于其他来源。

bank.note: 保障不足（inadequate coverage）是 E&O 索赔的头号原因，接近全部索赔的一半。

bank.stem: Several causes of inadequate coverage claims are commonly identified. All of the following are among those causes EXCEPT:

opts.t: Failure to advise clients of exclusions
opts.w: 保障不足四成因之一。

opts.t: Failure to place coverage or placing it too late
opts.w: 保障不足四成因之一。

opts.t: Providing the incorrect coverage
opts.w: 保障不足四成因之一。

opts.t: Policy change errors

bank.note: 保障不足四成因：没讲除外、没安排或太晚、给错保障、错说能否买到。Policy change errors 属于「其他 E&O 来源」（另有风险描述错误、取消续保错误、处理延误、违反经纪协议）。

bank.stem: A broker forgets to process a commercial client's renewal, the policy expires, and a fire occurs the following week. Among the recognized sources of E&O claims, this is best described as:

opts.t: A brokerage agreement violation
opts.w: 经纪协议是经纪行与保险公司之间的事；本案是续保环节漏办。

opts.t: A misrepresentation of the risk
opts.w: 漏办续保与风险描述是否准确无关。

opts.t: A cancellation and renewal error
Incorrect advice on available coverage
opts.w: 不是对能否买到保障给错建议，而是漏办续保。

bank.note: 其他 E&O 来源五种：风险描述错误、取消与续保出错、保单变更出错、处理延误、违反经纪协议。

bank.stem: A new customer service representative joins a brokerage that carries errors and omissions insurance. She asks whether she must buy her own E&O policy. What is the answer?

opts.t: Yes, every individual must buy a personal policy
opts.w: FOI 口径：经纪行的 E&O 保单覆盖全体员工，个人不必另买。

opts.t: No, the brokerage policy covers all persons working there
Only if she is given authority to bind coverage
opts.w: FOI 没有把承保权限作为另买的条件。

opts.t: Only after the first claim is made against her
opts.w: E&O 是事前安排的保障，不是出事后才买。

bank.note: 考试口径：经纪行的 E&O 保单覆盖行内所有工作人员，所以个人不必另买自己的保单。 BC 现行另要求每个持牌人都被至少 $1M／$2M 的 E&O 覆盖（Council Rules 7(11)，KU-0061）。

bank.stem: To keep a large account from moving to a competitor, a broker leaves the client's two previous fire losses off the submission to the insurer. How should this conduct be viewed?

opts.t: A breach of the broker's duty to the insurer that can never be justified
Acceptable, because the broker's primary duty is to the client
opts.w: 经纪人对保险人同样有义务：说真话、不隐瞒。

opts.t: Acceptable, as long as the client asked the broker to do it
opts.w: 客户要求也不能让隐瞒变得正当。

opts.t: A problem only if one of those losses happens again
opts.w: 义务在提交时就已违反，与之后是否出险无关。

bank.note: 对保险人的义务：说真话、不隐瞒重要信息。为了不丢客户而隐瞒，保险人被故意误导，这种对保险人的不诚实，在任何情况下都说不过去。

bank.stem: Why are brokers often referred to as "first line underwriters"?

opts.t: They make the final decision to accept or reject every risk
opts.w: 最终决定由保险公司核保人作出。

opts.t: They are employed by the insurer's underwriting department
opts.w: 经纪人不是保险公司雇员；核保人才是。

opts.t: They set the premium rates for all commercial risks
opts.w: 复杂商业风险全部由核保人定价。

opts.t: They are first to assess the risk and check the insurer's eligibility rules

bank.note: 经纪人是最先评估客户风险、判断它是否符合保险人承保条件（eligibility requirements）的人。

bank.stem: What is the reason underwriters are exempt from licensing?

opts.t: They work under the supervision of a licensed broker
opts.w: 核保人是保险公司雇员，不受经纪人监督。

opts.t: They only handle commercial risks, which are exempt
opts.w: 核保人也处理个人险；豁免理由不是险种。

opts.t: They are not involved in selling directly to consumers
They hold a federal licence through their employer
opts.w: FOI 没有说核保人借雇主取得联邦牌照。

bank.note: 核保员（underwriter）是保险公司的雇员；他们不直接向消费者卖保险，所以不需要持牌。

bank.stem: What is the primary role of the underwriter?

opts.t: To bind coverage on all risks submitted by brokers to the insurer
opts.w: 绑定是经纪人在承保权限内做的事，不是核保人的首要职能。

opts.t: To choose the risks most likely to be profitable for the insurer
To process cancellations and issue premium refund cheques
opts.w: 取消通知属于保单服务，是次要职能。

opts.t: To settle claims arising under the policies the insurer issues
opts.w: 理算索赔是理赔人的事。

bank.note: 核保员的首要职能是挑选对保险人最可能盈利的风险。 定价、保单服务都是后续职能。

bank.stem: Underwriters obtain the information needed for risk selection from all of the following sources EXCEPT:

opts.t: Premium tax returns filed with the province
The application completed by the applicant
opts.w: FOI 列的四个核保信息源之一。

opts.t: The broker who submits the business
opts.w: 四个信息源之一：经纪人常能提供申请人的声誉信息。

opts.t: Inspection reports on the property
opts.w: 四个信息源之一：外勤代表或独立检查公司。

bank.note: 四个信息源：投保单、经纪人、损失经验数据、检查报告。保费税申报与风险选择无关。

bank.stem: An underwriter finds that, over the past three to five years, total claims on welding shops have significantly exceeded the premiums collected for that class. A broker now submits a welding shop. What may the underwriter do?

opts.t: Accept the risk on the basis presented, because past losses do not predict future losses
opts.w: FOI 正是用损失经验数据来判断这类风险。

opts.t: Refer the decision to the provincial Superintendent of Insurance for approval
opts.w: 核保决定由保险公司核保人作出，不报监管机关。

opts.t: Accept it but cancel all other welding shops currently insured
opts.w: FOI 没有因一宗投保去取消同类在保业务的做法。

opts.t: Reject it, or suggest ways the broker might make the risk more attractive

bank.note: 考试口径的例子：赔款明显超过该类保费时，核保员可以拒绝这份投保，或者建议经纪人怎样改得让保险人更愿意接。

bank.stem: In general insurance, a hazard is best defined as:

opts.t: The event, such as fire or theft, that causes a loss
opts.w: 那是风险事故（peril），不是危险。

opts.t: The financial value of the property that may be lost
opts.w: 价值是保额问题，与危险的定义无关。

opts.t: A condition which may cause a peril to occur
The probability that the insurer will become insolvent
opts.w: 偿付能力是第 3 章的事。

bank.note: 危险（hazard）是可能引发风险事故的条件。 危险是条件，peril 是事故本身。

bank.pt: 物质危险 · 内务管理
bank.stem: An inspection report on a furniture store notes uplifted carpeting and an accumulation of waste materials in the building. Which kind of hazard does this represent?

opts.t: A moral hazard, showing indifference to loss
opts.w: 地毯翘起、堆积废料是FOI 列的内务管理例子，属物质危险。

opts.t: A physical hazard related to housekeeping
A moral hazard related to the owner's character
opts.w: 这是场所状况，不是申请人的主观特征。

opts.t: A physical hazard related to construction
opts.w: 建筑结构讲的是抵御风险事故的能力，不是整洁程度。

bank.note: 物质危险三类条件：建筑结构、占用性质、内务管理。会增加损失机会的内务问题，例如地毯翘起、楼内堆积废物。

bank.pt: 道德危险 · 漠不关心
bank.stem: When the broker suggests adding deadbolt locks, an applicant says, "Why bother? Everything's insured." This attitude indicates:

opts.t: A moral hazard: indifference to loss because insurance exists
A physical hazard, because the premises lack proper locks
opts.w: 缺锁是场所条件，但题目问的是申请人的态度。

opts.t: Utmost good faith, because the applicant is being candid
opts.w: 最大诚信讲的是如实告知，不是对防损的态度。

opts.t: No hazard, because the applicant has disclosed his attitude
opts.w: 如实说出态度不会消除这种危险。

bank.note: 道德危险迹象之三：对损失漠不关心。投保人觉得「反正都保了」就不肯多花力气防损减损，说明道德危险（moral hazard）很高。

bank.stem: Underwriters consider all of the following conditions in evaluating physical hazard EXCEPT:

opts.t: Type of building construction
opts.w: FOI 列的物质危险三类条件之一。

opts.t: Occupancy of the property
opts.w: FOI 列的物质危险三类条件之一。

opts.t: Housekeeping on the premises
opts.w: FOI 列的物质危险三类条件之一。

opts.t: The applicant's financial condition

bank.note: 物质危险＝场所（建筑结构、占用、内务管理）。财务状况是道德危险的迹象（财务困难的人更可能骗保）。

bank.stem: Which statement about moral hazard is correct?

opts.t: It is always observable during a physical inspection
opts.w: FOI 口径：道德危险可能看得见也可能看不见，不调查往往难以判断。

opts.t: It can usually be removed by regular cleaning of the building
opts.w: 清洁降低的是物质危险（内务管理）。

opts.t: It is extremely difficult to detect
It refers to the type of building construction
opts.w: 建筑结构是物质危险。

bank.note: "Moral hazard is extremely difficult to detect." 道德危险是申请人的主观特征：财务状况、品行、对损失漠不关心。物质危险看得见、常可降低。

bank.stem: An underwriter may make any of the following decisions about a risk EXCEPT:

opts.t: Accept the risk with an increase in the deductible
opts.w: FOI 列的五种核保决定之一。

opts.t: Accept the risk if the broker guarantees any losses
Accept the risk subject to certain conditions
opts.w: FOI 列的五种核保决定之一。

opts.t: Reject the risk as it has been presented
opts.w: FOI 列的五种核保决定之一。

bank.note: 五种决定：拒保、原样接受、加费率接受、提高免赔额接受、附条件接受。FOI Study Checklist 印成「Four」，正文列 5 种。经纪人个人担保损失不是核保选项。

bank.stem: The Butlers ask two brokerages to quote on their furniture store, a complex commercial risk. Who determines the rate or premium for each recommended coverage?

opts.t: The insurance company underwriters
Each broker, using the insurer's personal-lines rate manual
opts.w: 费率手册用于个人财产险；复杂商业险由核保人定价。

opts.t: The provincial Superintendent of Insurance
opts.w: 省不定价（第 3 章）。

opts.t: The Insurers' Advisory Organization
opts.w: IAO 出检查报告，不定价。

bank.note: 较复杂的商业风险，定价全部由核保员做。 个人险经纪人用费率手册，小企业专用保单用费率表。

bank.stem: In many insurers, the underwriter who prepared the original policy is responsible for all policyholder's service on it. This includes all of the following EXCEPT:

opts.t: Making changes to the policy
opts.w: 保单服务三件事之一。

opts.t: Preparing a cancellation notice, if required
opts.w: 保单服务三件事之一。

opts.t: Preparing the renewal certificate
opts.w: 保单服务三件事之一。

opts.t: Adjusting claims made under the policy

bank.note: 保单持有人服务三件事：改保单、需要时准备取消通知、准备续保证明。理算索赔是理赔人的事。

bank.stem: A client calls the brokerage to report that a neighbour's child broke a window worth about $300. How should brokerage personnel respond?

opts.t: Tell the client the loss is too small to be worth reporting
opts.w: FOI 口径：再小的报案，客户都认为很重要。

opts.t: Report it directly to an independent adjuster, bypassing the insurer
opts.w: 流程是经纪行报保险公司，由保险公司安排理赔人。

opts.t: Treat it as important, since reporting it shows the client considers it so
Tell the client to call the insurance company himself
opts.w: 第一步就是被保险人向经纪行报案，经纪行要接住。

bank.note: 索赔看起来再小，客户既然报了，就说明他很在乎。 看起来可能在保障内时，经纪行通知保险公司。

bank.stem: Which two steps are normally taken when a loss occurs?

opts.t: The insured reports to the adjuster; the adjuster reports to the insurer
opts.w: 第一步是向经纪行报，不是向理赔人。

opts.t: The insured reports to the brokerage; the brokerage reports to the insurer
The insured reports to the insurer; the insurer reports to the broker
opts.w: 顺序反了：经纪行把案子报给保险公司。

opts.t: The insured reports to the Superintendent; the Superintendent assigns an adjuster
opts.w: 监管机关不参与个案理赔。

bank.note: (i) Insured Reports Claim To Brokerage；(ii) Brokerage Reports Claim To Insurer。保险公司认为可能存在索赔时安排理赔人理算。

bank.pt: 公司理赔人与独立理赔人
bank.stem: After a major windstorm, an insurer's staff adjusters cannot handle all of the claims. Which statement is correct?

opts.t: The insurer may contract an independent firm, and may let the brokerage appoint one
Only the insurer's own staff adjusters may settle claims under its policies
opts.w: FOI 口径：没空或需专长时可以外聘独立理赔公司。

opts.t: Independent adjusters represent the insured against the insurer
opts.w: 独立理赔人受保险公司委托理算，不是被保险人的代表。

opts.t: The broker must adjust the claims personally until staff become available
opts.w: 理算由理赔人做；经纪行有时只是代为指定独立理赔人。

bank.note: 公司理赔人处理大部分理赔；公司理赔人忙不过来、或者这宗损失需要专门技能时，保险公司可以外包给独立理赔公司；有时保险人还会允许经纪行代它指派独立理赔人。

bank.stem: Using the figure given in the FOI course, approximately what share of all premiums paid by Canadian consumers is for personal and commercial property insurance?

opts.t: Almost 15 percent
opts.w: FOI 原话是 almost 35 percent。

opts.t: Almost 35 percent
Almost 55 percent
opts.w: 比FOI 口径高了 20 个百分点。

opts.t: Almost 75 percent
opts.w: FOI 原话是 almost 35 percent，远没有这么高。

bank.note: 加拿大消费者所付保费里，将近 35% 花在个人与商业财产险上（2017 年口径的快照）。

bank.stem: A property policy is written on an "all risks" basis, covering direct physical loss or damage subject to its conditions and exclusions. Under such a policy, which causes of loss are insured?

opts.t: All causes of loss unless specifically excluded by the policy
Only the perils listed by name on the Declarations Page
opts.w: 那是列明风险保单的写法。

opts.t: Every cause of loss without exception, since it is all risks
opts.w: 一切险也有除外：FOI 说没有一张保单保所有损失。

opts.t: Only fire, lightning and explosion of natural or manufactured gas
opts.w: 那是第 3 章火险的法定必保底线。

bank.note: 一切险：除非保单明文除外，任何原因造成的损失都保。 列明风险保单：没列的风险造成的损失不保。

bank.stem: Many property policies sold in Canada were developed by the Insurance Bureau of Canada (IBC). Which statement about these forms is correct?

opts.t: Insurers must use them without change
opts.w: FOI 原话正相反：保险公司可以作任何修改。

opts.t: They are approved by each province as the standard policy
opts.w: FOI 说「没有标准保单」。

opts.t: They are issued to consumers by the IBC itself
opts.w: IBC 是行业协会，开发表单，不对消费者出单。

opts.t: Insurers are permitted to change or modify them

bank.note: IBC 是代表 125 家以上保险公司的行业协会；保险公司可以随意修改这些示范表单。 所以说 No Standard Policy。

bank.stem: The Butlers' commercial property policy shows amounts of insurance for building and stock, but no amount for equipment. A fire destroys the store's equipment. How does the policy respond to the equipment loss?

opts.t: It is covered, because all business property at the location is automatically insured
opts.w: 商业险不像房主表那样自动承保；只保列了保额的项目。

opts.t: It is covered under the building item, since equipment is attached to the building
opts.w: FOI 把建筑、存货、设备分为三项，没列保额的设备不保。

opts.t: It is not covered, because coverage applies only to items with an amount of insurance shown
It is covered at actual cash value, up to the stock limit shown on the policy
opts.w: 没有借用其他项目保额的规则。

bank.note: 只有在保单上写了保额的项目才有保障。 保险公司不要求把营业用的所有财产都保上。

bank.stem: A fire starts in the furnace room of an apartment building owned by your client. Each of the following is a direct loss recoverable within the peril of fire EXCEPT:

opts.t: Water damage where firefighters hosed down other parts of the building
opts.w: FOI 例子：消防水龙造成的水渍是火的直接损失。

opts.t: Loss of rental income while the units cannot be occupied
Damage to the roof caused by firefighters' axes
opts.w: FOI 例子：消防斧劈坏屋顶是火的直接损失。

opts.t: Smoke and heat damage to an adjacent storage shed
opts.w: FOI 例子：相邻仓库的烟熏与高温损失是火的直接损失。

bank.note: 消防水、消防斧、烟与高温：只要被认定是那场火的直接结果，就算在火灾这一风险里赔。租金收入损失是间接损失，要另加保。

bank.stem: A small fire damages the utility pole supplying power to a grocery store over a long weekend. The power to the refrigeration equipment is cut, and the perishable stock spoils. The only physical fire damage is to the wiring leading to the store. How does a commercial property policy treat the spoiled stock?

opts.t: Not covered, unless it was added for an additional premium
Covered as a direct loss, because fire was the first cause
opts.w: 存货本身没被火烧；它的损失是直接损失的后果。

opts.t: Covered, but only if the store reports it within 72 hours
opts.w: FOI 没有 72 小时报告规则。

opts.t: Not covered, because perishable stock can never be insured
opts.w: FOI 说这种保障通常可以加费加保。

bank.note: Dew Drop By 杂货店例：火的直接损失只有通往店里的电线；存货损失是间接损失，商业财产险不保，不过通常可以加保费把它加进来。

bank.stem: In general insurance, a warranty is best defined as:

opts.t: A requirement imposed by statute that binds all parties to the contract
opts.w: 那是法定条件，由法律规定。

opts.t: A clause that removes certain property from coverage
opts.w: 那是除外条款，不是保证。

opts.t: A guarantee by the insurer that claims will be paid within 60 days
opts.w: 60 天付款是法定条件 12，且是保险人一方的义务。

opts.t: An insured's promise that certain facts are as stated and will stay that way

bank.note: 保证（warranty）是被保险人的承诺：某些事实确实如其所述，而且会一直保持。 违反即合同失效，要求严格遵守。

bank.stem: A welding shop's policy contains a "No Spray Painting Warranty." The owner occasionally spray paints at the back of the shop anyway. A fire then starts while he is welding pipe for a customer. How may the insurer respond?

opts.t: Pay the claim, because the fire was caused by welding, not spray painting
opts.w: 保证被违反，不论与损失有无因果都可拒赔。

opts.t: Pay the claim less a penalty for the breach of warranty
opts.w: 没有扣罚款的规则；后果是没有保障。

opts.t: Deny coverage, because the warranty was breached whatever the cause of the loss
Pay only if the spray painting had stopped before the fire
opts.w: 违反已发生；FOI 没有这种补救。

bank.note: B. Iron 例：即使这次损失跟喷漆作业毫无关系，也不赔。 保证要严格遵守，违反就可拒赔，"quite irrespective of their materiality"。（BC 现行 s.32 允许法院审查不合理条款，见章节课第④节，考场按 FOI 口径。）

bank.stem: A store's policy requires the insured to notify the insurer immediately when any known defects exist in its sprinkler system or burglar alarm. This requirement is an example of:

opts.t: A statutory condition
opts.w: 法定条件由法律规定；这是保险公司自定的。

opts.t: A policy condition
A property exclusion
opts.w: 除外是把财产或风险排除在保障外；这里是要求被保险人做某事。

opts.t: A deductible clause
opts.w: 免赔额是每次损失自付的金额，与通知无关。

bank.note: 条件＝要求被保险人做或不做某事。保单条件由保险公司为重要保障领域自行制定——Butler 店喷淋与报警器的缺陷通知是FOI 例子。

bank.stem: Personal and commercial property policies usually exclude each of the following types of property EXCEPT:

opts.t: A building vacant for 20 consecutive days
Money and securities kept on the premises
opts.w: 这是FOI 列明的除外财产之一。

opts.t: Automobiles, water craft and aircraft
opts.w: 这是FOI 列明的除外财产之一。

opts.t: Books of account of the insured
opts.w: 这是FOI 列明的除外财产之一。

bank.note: 除外的是连续空置超过 30 天的财产；20 天不在除外之列。其余除外财产：债权或产权凭证、证券、汽车、船、飞机、现金、其他机动车、账簿。

bank.stem: Exclusions common to both personal and commercial property policies include each of the following EXCEPT:

opts.t: Earthquake and flood damage to the building
opts.w: FOI 列的共同除外风险。

opts.t: Wear and tear, rust and corrosion
opts.w: FOI 列的共同除外风险。

opts.t: Increased cost of repair due to enforcement of a by-law
opts.w: FOI 列的共同除外风险。

opts.t: A hostile fire spreading from next door

bank.note: 共同除外风险：地震、洪水、农业或工业烟、磨损渐变、锈蚀、战争、核事故、执行法规增加的费用、下水道倒灌。敌意之火正是财产险承保的核心风险。

bank.stem: Why is war excluded from property insurance policies?

opts.t: War losses are insured instead by the federal government
opts.w: FOI 没有说战争损失由联邦政府承保。

opts.t: War damage is always gradual and therefore uninsurable
opts.w: 战争是巨灾，不是渐变。

opts.t: Losses from war could jeopardize the solvency of insurers
Coverage for war is readily available by endorsement
opts.w: 「很容易买到」说的是地震和洪水。

bank.note: 巨灾损失的可能让所有保险人担心；战争损失可能危及保险人的偿付能力，所以不保。 地震和洪水保障则 readily available。

bank.stem: Which statement about deductibles is correct?

opts.t: A deductible transfers the first part of each loss to the broker
opts.w: 免赔额是被保险人自留，不是转给经纪人。

opts.t: The higher the deductible, the lower the premium paid
The deductible applies only once per policy year
opts.w: FOI 口径：每次损失（each loss）都先扣免赔额。

opts.t: Deductibles are used mainly to increase insurer profits
opts.w: FOI 说的理由是让保险负担得起。

bank.note: 免赔额是每次损失先自付的金额；"helps to keep insurance affordable … The higher the deductible, the lower the premium paid." 视为部分自留。

bank.stem: The Butlers ask whether they can choose a $250 deductible on stock, $500 on equipment and $1,000 on the building under their commercial property policy. Which answer is correct?

opts.t: Yes, the form may allow it, but a common deductible is the recommended practice
No, a commercial policy must apply one deductible to all property
opts.w: FOI 说表单可能允许分项设免赔额。

opts.t: Yes, and lower deductibles on each item will reduce the premium
opts.w: 免赔额越低，保费越高，不是越低。

opts.t: No, commercial deductibles below $1,000 are not permitted
opts.w: FOI 说标准最低是 $500，不是 $1,000。

bank.note: 商业财产险表单可以让 Bert 和 Betty 给每类财产分别选免赔额，但建议的做法、也是通行做法，是全保单统一一个免赔额。 最低 $500 是标准。

bank.stem: A pair of earrings is appraised at $2,000. Thieves take one earring; the remaining earring alone is worth $700. Under the Pair and Set rule, what is the basis of the claim payment, before any deductible?

opts.t: $2,000, because the pair is no longer complete
opts.w: 规则说一件损失不等于整对损失。

opts.t: $1,000, half of the appraised value of the pair
opts.w: 不是简单对半；要扣剩下那只的实际价值。

opts.t: Nothing, because the remaining earring keeps its value
opts.w: 被偷那只的损失仍要赔。

opts.t: $1,300, the pair value less the earring that remains

bank.note: 成对或成套的物品坏了一件，不等于整对整套都损失了；没坏的那件仍有价值，这部分要从赔款里扣除。 2,000 − 700 = $1,300。

bank.stem: One part of an insured machine is damaged by an insured peril. The rest of the machine is undamaged. Under the Parts clause, what is the basis of settlement?

opts.t: The replacement cost of the entire machine
opts.w: 部件条款只赔损坏的部件。

opts.t: The cost of the replacement part only, without installation
opts.w: FOI 明说包括安装费。

opts.t: The cost of the replacement part plus its installation
The actual cash value of the whole machine less depreciation
opts.w: 部件条款不按整机的 ACV 计算。

bank.note: 部件条款（Parts Clause）把赔款限定在替换部件的价钱加安装费。

bank.stem: The Indemnity Agreement limits payment to the least of three amounts. Which set lists them?

opts.t: Purchase price, market value and amount of insurance
opts.w: 买价与市价都不是赔偿协议里的要素。

opts.t: ACV at the time of loss, the insured's interest and the amount of insurance
Replacement cost, the insured's interest and the deductible
opts.w: 第一项应为 ACV，不是重置成本；免赔额是之后才扣的。

opts.t: ACV, sentimental value and the mortgage balance
opts.w: 感情价值不算；按揭余额是谁拿钱的问题。

bank.note: 赔偿协议：不超过 (i) 出险时的 ACV、(ii) 被保险人在财产上的权益、(iii) 声明页上的保额，三者中最小的。

bank.stem: In determining depreciation, adjusters consider each of the following factors EXCEPT:

opts.t: Sentimental value of the item
Condition of the item
opts.w: FOI 列的折旧四因素之一。

opts.t: Obsolescence of the item
opts.w: FOI 列的折旧四因素之一。

opts.t: Normal life expectancy of the item
opts.w: FOI 列的折旧四因素之一。

bank.note: 折旧四因素：状况、过时、转售价值、正常寿命。感情价值从来不是赔款因素。

bank.stem: An insured item has a replacement cost of $15,000 and depreciation of $5,000. The insured owns it outright, the amount of insurance is $12,000, and the deductible is $500. Using the Indemnity Agreement on an ACV basis, how much will the insured receive?

opts.w: 这是保额 12,000 减免赔额；但 ACV 10,000 更小。
这是重置成本减免赔额；ACV 基础要先扣折旧。
ACV 取对了，但忘了再扣免赔额 500。

bank.stem: A fire totally destroys a building with an actual cash value of $500,000. It is insured for $420,000, and the owner still owes $250,000 to the mortgagee named in the Standard Mortgage Clause. Ignoring any deductible, how much is the owner himself entitled to receive?

opts.w: 这是赔款总额；按揭权人要先拿 $250,000。
这是付给按揭权人的那部分。
ACV 比保额大，三者取最小只能是 $420,000。

bank.note: 先三者取最小：ACV 500,000、保额 420,000 → $420,000；按揭权人按其可保利益先受偿 $250,000；业主本人得 $170,000。练习卷第 33 题（I.M. Broke）同一结构。

bank.stem: When an adjuster determines the replacement cost of lost or damaged items, who has the onus to provide price quotes or estimates from suppliers and contractors?

opts.t: The adjuster
opts.w: 理赔人负责算，但举证责任FOI 明说在被保险人。

opts.t: The insured
The broker
opts.w: 经纪人不负责提供估价。

opts.t: The insurer's underwriter
opts.w: 核保人负责选风险，不参与定损举证。

bank.note: 举证责任在被保险人：要由他向理赔人提供供应商和承包商的报价或估价。

bank.stem: When replacement cost coverage is claimed for a building loss, all of the following provisions apply EXCEPT:

opts.t: Replacement must be completed within 30 days of the loss
Replacement must be effected with due diligence and dispatch
opts.w: 建筑重置成本三条件之一。

opts.t: Replacement must be on the same site or an adjacent site
opts.w: 建筑重置成本三条件之一。

opts.t: Replacement cost is paid only when replacement has been effected
opts.w: 建筑重置成本三条件之一。

bank.note: 三条件：尽职迅速、同址或邻址、实际重置后才按重置成本付。FOI 没有「30 天内完工」这种期限；缺一条就按 ACV 赔。

bank.stem: After their store is destroyed by fire, the Butlers decide to rebuild in Whitehorse, Yukon, instead of at the original site. Their policy has replacement cost coverage. How will the building loss be settled?

opts.t: On a replacement cost basis, because the store will be rebuilt
opts.w: 重建地点不在同址或邻址，不满足条件。

opts.t: At replacement cost, but only once the new store opens for business
opts.w: 地点条件不满足时，开业也拿不到重置成本。

opts.t: Nothing is paid, because relocating the business voids the policy
opts.w: 不是不赔，是退回 ACV 基础。

opts.t: On an actual cash value basis, since the same-site provision is not met

bank.note: 同址或邻址条件有个很实际的作用：让被保险人没有「故意制造损失、借机搬迁生意」的动机——降低道德危险。不满足就按 ACV。

bank.pt: 审批延误不影响重置成本
bank.stem: An insured's house burns down. She applies for a building permit right away, but construction cannot start for several months because the city is slow to approve the building plans. Is her replacement cost coverage affected?

opts.t: Yes, it is lost because replacement was not effected with dispatch
opts.w: FOI 明说：市政审批延误不危及重置成本保障。

opts.t: Yes, the delay converts the settlement to a valued policy basis
opts.w: 定值保单是另一种赔付基础，与延误无关。

opts.t: No, a delay caused by the city's approval process does not jeopardize it
No, but she must rebuild on a different site to qualify
opts.w: 条件正相反：要同址或邻址。

bank.note: 因市政府审批图纸拖延而无法开工的，不影响重置成本保障。 被保险人要尽力尽快重置。

bank.stem: Hail damages the 20-year-old asphalt shingles on a store. Replacement cost is $8,000, and depreciation is charged at 2.5% per year. Before the deductible, what is the settlement on an actual cash value basis?

opts.w: 这是重置成本基础的赔付，ACV 基础要扣折旧。
折旧算成了 75%；20 年只折 50%。

bank.stem: Under a valued policy covering an original painting, what is the basis of settlement after a total loss?

opts.t: The value agreed to by the insured and the insurer
The actual cash value at the time of loss
opts.w: 定值保单不按 ACV。

opts.t: The replacement cost of a similar new painting
opts.w: 原创艺术品无法重置，所以才用定值。

opts.t: The price the insured originally paid for it
opts.w: 当初的买价不是定值保单的赔付基础。

bank.note: 无法重置的财产（原创艺术、家传首饰、皮草、古董、纪念品）可按定值承保，理赔按被保险人与保险人事先约定的价值结算；通常要合格评估师估值。

bank.stem: Under the IBC 4005 Replacement Cost Endorsement, replacement cost settlement is NOT available for which of the following, even if replacement cost is specified?

opts.t: A building for which replacement cost is specified
opts.w: 建筑正是重置成本批单最常用的对象。

opts.t: Machinery and equipment for which replacement cost is specified
opts.w: 设备可以按重置成本，批单没有除外。

opts.t: Office furniture for which replacement cost is specified
opts.w: 办公家具不在 3(a)–(e) 的除外清单里。

opts.t: Stock

bank.note: IBC 4005 第 3 条：不适用于 (a) 存货（stock）；(b) 模型、冲模、模具；(c) 艺术品、古董、珍品；(d) 业务记录；(e) 法规限制增加的重置成本。

bank.stem: In general insurance, a mortgagee is best defined as:

opts.t: Only a chartered bank that has lent money on the property
opts.w: FOI 口径：信托公司、信用社、个人或一群人都可以。

opts.t: The owner who has borrowed money against the property
opts.w: 借钱的业主是抵押人（mortgagor）。

opts.t: Anyone having an insurable interest in the property insured
The broker who arranged the property insurance
opts.w: 经纪人不是按揭权人。

bank.note: 抵押权人（mortgagee）是对被保财产有可保利益的任何一方，可以是银行、信托公司、信用社，也可以是个人或一群人。

bank.stem: A bookstore owner borrows $60,000 from a bank to buy her store. She adds a donut fryer without telling the insurer, and three days later a fryer fire destroys the building. Her claim is denied for an unreported material change. What happens to the bank's interest?

opts.t: The bank receives nothing, because the claim was denied
opts.w: 标准按揭条款正是让按揭权人不受被保险人违约影响。

opts.t: The bank is paid to the extent of its insurable interest
The bank is paid only if it knew about the donut fryer
opts.w: 按揭条款不要求按揭权人知情才赔。

opts.t: The bank must sue the owner, since the insurer has no duty
opts.w: 保险人对按揭权人负赔付义务。

bank.note: Page Binder 例：她因没报告业务上的重大变更被拒赔，但 Hank's Bank 仍在其可保利益范围内拿到了赔款。

bank.stem: As a condition of their loan, the Butlers must give Hank's Bank a certified copy of their policy. Who is responsible for ensuring the bank receives it?

opts.t: The Butlers, although many brokerages forward copies for clients
The insurer, which must mail it to every mortgagee by law
opts.w: 保险公司准备核证副本，但确保银行收到是 Butler 家的责任。

opts.t: Hank's Bank, which must request it from the insurer
opts.w: FOI 没把责任放在银行身上。

opts.t: The provincial Superintendent, who keeps a registry of mortgages
opts.w: 省监管机关与核证副本的交付无关。

bank.note: 确保银行收到这份保险确认，是 Bert 和 Betty 自己的责任；为了帮客户尽这项义务，很多经纪行会把核证副本直接寄给抵押权人。

bank.stem: The Standard Mortgage Clause gives the mortgagee all of the following guarantees EXCEPT:

opts.t: Payment even if the insured neglected to save property from loss
opts.w: FOI 列的第一项保证：疏忽不影响按揭权人。

opts.t: Payment even if the insured misrepresented a material fact
opts.w: FOI 列的第一项保证：不实陈述不影响按揭权人。

opts.t: The same notice of termination the insured is entitled to
opts.w: FOI 列的第二项保证。

opts.t: Full repayment of the mortgage if the insured becomes ill

bank.note: 两项保证：(1) 被保险人违反任何保单条件（疏忽、遗漏或不实陈述），按揭权人照样受偿；(2) 不作不利于按揭权人的减保，不经同样通知不终止。按揭条款不是信用保险。

bank.stem: Under the IBC 3000 Standard Mortgage Clause, the mortgagee learns that the insured building has been vacant for 40 consecutive days. What is the mortgagee required to do?

opts.t: Nothing, because the clause protects the mortgagee regardless
opts.w: 保护不是无条件的：按揭权人知悉空置超过 30 天要通知。

opts.t: Cancel the policy and buy a separate one
opts.w: 条款没有要求按揭权人取消保单。

opts.t: Notify the insurer forthwith of the vacancy
Pay the insured's deductible in advance
opts.w: 条款要求按揭权人为未允许的危险增加补保费，不是付免赔额。

bank.note: IBC 3000 第 1 条：抵押权人知悉房屋连续空置或无人居住超过 30 天的，必须立即通知保险人；知悉的权益转让或危险增加也一样。

bank.stem: IBC Homeowners Forms are designed to insure which type of dwelling?

opts.t: Multi-unit residential buildings owned by a condominium corporation
opts.w: 共管大楼的楼体由法团投保，单元业主另用 Condominium Unit Owners 表。

opts.t: Single family dwellings occupied year-round by their owners
Single family dwellings rented to tenants on a year-round basis
opts.w: 出租屋（rented dwellings）属于限制更多的另一类保单，家主表只保自住。

opts.t: Seasonal cottages occupied by their owners during the summer
opts.w: 季节性住宅可作为附加地点加进保单，但家主表本身是为全年自住设计的。

bank.note: 家主表（Homeowners Forms）＝业主全年自住的独户住宅；也可以保「建成后业主自己要住」的在建住宅。出租屋、季节屋、共管单元、租客各有各的表。

bank.pt: 被保险人 · 找不算的
bank.stem: Under a Homeowners Form, each of the following persons is an insured EXCEPT:

opts.t: An unrelated roomer who rents a bedroom in the named insured's house
The named insured's mother, who lives permanently in the same household
opts.w: 双方的亲属（relatives of either）同住即为被保险人。

opts.t: A 17-year-old exchange student living with and cared for by the insureds
opts.w: 21 岁以下、由具名被保险人照管的人（含交换生、寄养子女）算被保险人。

opts.t: The insureds' 23-year-old son, a dependent full-time student living in a dorm
opts.w: 在读学生可以超过 21 岁，只要全日制且经济依赖，暂住校外也算。

bank.note: 考试口径：寄宿者与租房客不算在被保险人照管之下，也不是「insureds」。他们应自己买租客险。注意：只有具名者可以起诉保险人（IBC 1151 定义段）。

bank.pt: 同居伴侣 · 三年规则
bank.stem: Raj owns his home and is the only person named on his Homeowners policy. His partner Lena has lived with him in a conjugal relationship for two years; they have no children together and are unmarried. Lena's $4,000 bicycle collection is destroyed in a fire at the home. Under FOI's definition of spouse, how is Lena's property treated?

opts.t: It is covered, because she lives in the same household as the named insured
opts.w: 同住是必要条件但不充分：她得先落进「配偶／同居伴侣」这一类，而她只同居了两年。

opts.t: It is covered, because common-law partners qualify after one year of cohabiting
opts.w: 一年那一档只适用于双方是同一子女的亲生或收养父母；他们没有孩子。

opts.t: It is uninsured under Raj's policy, because only married spouses ever qualify
opts.w: 反了：同居伴侣满足条件（连续同居 3 年，或有共同子女同住 1 年）同样算配偶。

opts.t: It is uninsured under Raj's policy, because the three-year test is unmet

bank.note: 同居伴侣要算被保险人：连续同居 3 年，或是同一子女的亲生／收养父母且同居 1 年。两年无子女两条都不满足。经纪人的正确动作是把 Lena 加为具名被保险人或给她单独出单（FOI：COMMON-LAW RELATIONSHIPS - HOW TO AVOID COVERAGE GAPS）。

bank.pt: 被保险人 · 必须同住
bank.stem: Gomer is the only named insured on his Homeowners policy. Four months ago he and his wife Griselda agreed to a trial separation, and she moved to her parents' home, leaving some of her belongings in the house. Last week the house burned down. What is the insurer's position on Griselda's property?

opts.t: It must pay, because a legally married spouse is always an insured person
opts.w: 婚姻只让她落进「配偶」一类；非具名被保险人还必须在出险时同住。

opts.t: It must pay, but only up to the $2,000 special limit for a spouse's property
opts.w: 家主表没有「配偶财产」这类特别限额，这是编出来的。

opts.t: It has no obligation to pay, since she was living elsewhere at the time of loss
It must pay once Griselda signs a statutory declaration about the separation
opts.w: 声明改变不了事实：分居搬走就是不在同一住户。

bank.note: FOI 原例（Gomer 与 Griselda）：非具名被保险人必须在出险时住在同一住户（学生例外）。分居搬走＝不在同一住户＝不赔。

bank.stem: A student older than 21 remains an insured under the parents' Homeowners policy if the student is:

opts.t: Enrolled part-time and living in the parents' home
opts.w: 学生这一类要求全日制在读；住家里只说明同住，不是学生这一档的条件。

opts.t: In full-time education and dependent on the insureds
Under 25 years of age and studying anywhere in Canada
opts.w: FOI 没有 25 岁上限，也没有限定在加拿大读书，这是编的。

opts.t: Living in a dorm and paying their own tuition and rent
opts.w: 经济上自立恰恰不符合 dependent（受供养）的要求。

bank.note: 考试口径：学生可以超过 21 岁，但必须是全日制在读、并依靠被保险人供养，暂住校外也在保。学生临时离家的个人财产另有 $2,500 特别限额。

bank.pt: 扩展保障 · 找不是扩展的
bank.stem: Each of the following is listed among the Extensions of Coverage common to all Homeowners Forms EXCEPT:

opts.t: Guaranteed replacement cost on the dwelling
Arson conviction reward of up to $1,000
opts.w: 这是第 (ix) 项扩展，且不扣免赔额。

opts.t: Tear out of walls to repair water damage
opts.w: 这是第 (viii) 项扩展：为修水管漏水必须拆开的墙与天花板。

opts.t: Automatic inflation protection after a loss
opts.w: 这是第 (xi) 项扩展：出险时按通胀自动调高 Section I 保额。

bank.note: 十一项扩展：残骸清理、财产转移、搬家、消防费、温差、冰柜食品、换锁、拆装（tear out）、纵火举报奖励、信用卡伪造伪钞、通胀保护。Guaranteed Replacement Cost 是赔付基础的一种选项，写在 Basis of Claim Payment 里，不是扩展。

bank.stem: Mia loses her house keys at a hockey arena and asks her insurer to pay a locksmith $300 to re-key her locks. How does the lock replacement extension respond?

opts.t: It pays the $300 in full, because this extension carries no deductible
opts.w: 免赔额确实不适用，但前提是钥匙被盗并已报案；丢失不触发。

opts.t: It pays the $300 less the policy deductible shown on the summary page
opts.w: 换锁扩展本来就不扣免赔额；而且丢钥匙根本不在保障里。

opts.t: It pays up to $500, and Mia may choose whether to re-key or replace
opts.w: 上限是 $500，但换锁还是改钥匙由保险人决定（at our option），且要被盗。

opts.t: It pays nothing, because it applies only to keys stolen and reported

bank.note: 换锁扩展：$500 以内、钥匙被盗且向警方报案、换锁还是改钥匙由保险人选、不扣免赔额。官方练习卷第 38 题的错误陈述正是「lost or stolen」——丢失不赔。

bank.stem: While vacuuming, Leo accidentally pulls the plug of the freezer in his basement. The food spoils before anyone notices. How does the freezer food extension respond?

opts.t: It pays up to $2,000 for the food, with no deductible applied
opts.w: 限额与免赔规则说的是对的，但这次的起因被明确除外。

opts.t: It pays up to $2,000 for the food, less the policy deductible
opts.w: 起因除外，谈不上扣不扣免赔额。

opts.t: It pays nothing, as disconnection of power in the building is excluded
It pays up to $1,000, the limit for accidental power interruptions
opts.w: 没有 $1,000 这一档；冰柜食品扩展是 $2,000。

bank.note: 冰柜食品扩展：$2,000、不扣免赔额，起因限于意外停电（房内或房外）与机械故障。明确除外：跳闸／保险丝，以及冰柜所在建筑内电源被意外或故意断开（宠物、吸尘时拔掉插头）。

bank.pt: 温差扩展 · 两个条件
bank.stem: In which situation would the change of temperature extension pay for frozen houseplants?

opts.t: The furnace malfunctions overnight and the plants in the living room freeze
opts.w: 炉子故障不是承保危险造成的实体损坏；FOI 明说这种冻坏植物不保。

opts.t: Vandals smash a window in January and the plants in the house freeze
The utility company's planned outage stops the furnace and the plants freeze
opts.w: 计划停电不是承保危险造成的建筑或设备实体损坏。

opts.t: Hail breaks a window and the potted plants left out on the deck freeze
opts.w: 第二个条件不满足：财产当时必须在住宅里，阳台上的不算。

bank.note: 温差扩展两个条件同时满足：① 承保危险对建筑或其设备造成实体损坏；② 受损财产当时在住宅内。FOI 原例正是破坏者打碎玻璃后室内植物冻死。
