bank.stem: Under the Homeowners debris removal extension, when does the additional 5% become available?

opts.t: When the loss plus debris removal exceeds the amount of insurance
Whenever debris removal is needed after any loss, insured or uninsured
opts.w: 残骸清理只在损失由承保危险造成时才有。

opts.t: Only when the dwelling is a total loss and has to be demolished
opts.w: FOI 没有「全损」这个触发条件；判据是赔款加清理费超过保额。

opts.t: Only after the insured has paid a separate debris removal deductible
opts.w: 没有单独的残骸清理免赔额，这是编出来的。

bank.note: FOI：损失由承保危险造成；若赔款（含清理费）超过保额，另给该金额的 5% 用于残骸清理。没超过保额时，清理费就在原保额内赔。

bank.stem: The Chans are moving their household goods from Burnaby to their new principal residence in Seattle. During the move their furniture is damaged by an insured peril. How does the moving to another home extension apply?

opts.t: It covers the furniture for 30 consecutive days anywhere in North America
opts.w: 30 天是对的，但地域只限加拿大，不是北美。

opts.t: It covers the furniture until the policy expires, wherever the new home is
opts.w: 期限是 30 个连续日或保单到期／终止，以先到者为准；地域限加拿大。

opts.t: It covers the furniture only while the goods are in a public warehouse
opts.w: 搬家扩展保的是运输途中与在新居所两处，不是只保仓库。

opts.t: It provides no coverage for this move, because it is restricted to Canada

bank.note: 搬家扩展：财产运往并存放在将作为主要居所的新地点；仅限加拿大；连续 30 天或保单到期／终止，以先到者为准。注意与「个人财产临时离开处所——全世界」区分。

bank.stem: A fire destroys the Lius' insured home. Instead of rebuilding, they decide to sell the lot and move to another city. On what basis will the insurer settle the dwelling loss?

opts.t: Replacement cost, because the policy was written on that basis
opts.w: 重置成本以在同地、同用途、同类材料、合理期限内修复或重建为前提。

opts.t: Market value of the lot and the house as at the date of the fire
opts.w: 保险赔的是建筑损失，不是地块与房屋的市场价。

opts.t: Actual cash value, because the home is neither repaired nor replaced
Replacement cost, provided they buy another home within 180 days
opts.w: 180 天是个人财产「先 ACV 后补差」的期限，不适用于异地另买房。

bank.note: 建筑按修复或重建费用（取低）、不扣折旧赔，条件：同一地点、同一用途、类似质量材料、合理期限内完成。不修不建的，按 ACV 赔。

bank.pt: 个人财产 · 找按重置赔的
bank.stem: Under the Homeowners Forms, each of the following personal property losses is settled on an actual cash value basis EXCEPT:

opts.t: A 19th-century oil painting destroyed in a fire
opts.w: 因固有性质无法以新品替换的（古董、艺术品、绘画、雕像）按 ACV。

opts.t: A two-year-old laptop stolen and promptly replaced
Old stereo equipment replaced years ago but never discarded
opts.w: 已不作原用途的财产按 ACV——这条专门针对堆积不用的东西。

opts.t: Hockey memorabilia whose value comes from its history
opts.w: 年代或历史构成其价值的（纪念品、收藏品）按 ACV。

bank.note: 个人财产默认按重置成本赔（前提是尽快修复或替换），四类只按 ACV：① 无法以新品替换的（古董、艺术品）；② 年代或历史构成价值的（纪念品、收藏品）；③ 未保持良好可用状态的；④ 已不作原用途的（过时衣物、换下没扔的电器）。

bank.pt: 先 ACV 后补差 · 180 天
bank.stem: After a burglary, Tom accepts an actual cash value settlement for his stolen TV because he is unsure whether to replace it. Five months after the loss he buys a new TV. What can Tom do?

opts.t: Claim the difference between ACV and replacement cost
Nothing, because choosing ACV at the time of the claim is final
opts.w: FOI 明写可以事后改主意，只要在期限内。

opts.t: Claim the difference, but only with the adjuster's written consent
opts.w: 条款没有要求理赔人书面同意，被保险人有权在期限内补差。

opts.t: Claim the full cost of the new TV as a separate second loss
opts.w: 补的是 ACV 与重置成本之间的差额，不是把新电视当第二次损失。

bank.note: 被保险人可先按 ACV 结算；损失日起 180 天内决定修复或替换的，可再索赔 ACV 与重置成本的差额。五个月约 150 天，在期限内。

bank.stem: Under the Homeowners Form wording described in FOI, the Parks' home is insured on a guaranteed replacement cost basis. After a fire, the city requires the rebuilt home to meet current building codes, adding $18,000 to the rebuilding cost. How is the $18,000 treated?

opts.t: It is paid, because guaranteed replacement cost pays the full rebuilding cost
opts.w: 保证重置只突破保额，不突破「法规升级费用不赔」这条除外。

opts.t: It is paid, but only up to 10% of the amount of insurance on the dwelling
opts.w: 10% 是建筑固着物临时移出那一项，与法规升级无关。

opts.t: It is uninsured, because guaranteed replacement cost applies only to ACV
opts.w: 保证重置是重置成本的加强版，与 ACV 无关；不赔的原因是法规除外。

opts.t: It is uninsured, because increased costs from building bylaws are excluded

bank.note: FOI：无论按重置成本还是保证重置成本结算，都不赔因分区、拆除、修缮或建筑法规而增加的修复或重建费用。被保险人有权得到出险前同类型的建筑，按新规范多出来的钱自付（市场上另有 by-law 批单可买）。

bank.stem: The amount of insurance for Coverage A - Dwelling Building includes each of the following EXCEPT:

opts.t: A sun deck attached to the side of the dwelling
opts.w: 住宅及附着结构都在 Coverage A 内。

opts.t: Swings and a slide embedded in concrete in the yard
opts.w: 处所上永久安装的户外设备在 Coverage A 内。

opts.t: A garage separated from the house by a clear space
An in-ground swimming pool and its attached equipment
opts.w: 户外泳池及附着设备在 Coverage A 内。

bank.note: Coverage A 包括：住宅与附着结构、永久安装的户外设备、户外泳池及附着设备、在处所上或紧邻处所的建材用料；另可选用最多 10% 保建筑固着物临时移出、最多 5% 保户外树木。与住宅隔开一段空地的车库属于 Coverage B（Detached Private Structures）。

bank.pt: 在建住宅 · 建材被盗
bank.stem: The Nguyens insure their new house under a Homeowners Form while it is being built. Before the house is completed, $6,000 of lumber stacked on the lot is stolen. How does the policy respond?

opts.t: It pays, because materials on the premises are part of the dwelling building
opts.w: 建材确实在 Coverage A 里，但盗窃这一危险在完工可入住前不保。

opts.t: It pays nothing, as theft is insured only once the dwelling is ready for occupancy
It pays up to $2,000, the special limit for building materials
opts.w: 没有建材的 $2,000 特别限额；$2,000 是营业财产、证券等。

opts.t: It pays, provided the lumber was stored adjacent to rather than on the lot
opts.w: 放在处所上还是紧邻处所都在保障地域内；不赔的原因是在建期间盗窃除外。

bank.note: Coverage A 原句：建材用料 We insure against the peril of theft only when your dwelling is completed and ready to be occupied. 在建期间的建材被盗不赔（Theft 危险的除外 c 再写一次）。

bank.stem: A windstorm uproots a $1,200 maple tree in the Smiths' front yard. Their Coverage A limit is $500,000. How much does the Homeowners policy pay for the tree?

opts.t: Nothing, as wind is an uninsured peril for trees
$500, the maximum payable for any one tree
opts.w: 单株 $500 上限是对的，但树木的保障根本不包括风暴冰雹。

opts.t: $1,200, which is well within 5% of Coverage A
opts.w: 5% 是总额度，承保危险只限六种，不含风暴。

opts.t: $700, which is the loss less a $500 deductible
opts.w: 问题不在免赔额：风暴不是树木的承保危险。

bank.note: 户外树木、灌木、植物：可用 Coverage A 的最多 5%，单株 $500（含清理），承保危险只限火、闪电、爆炸、飞机或车辆撞击、暴动、破坏或恶意行为——风暴冰雹不保。草坪与待售苗木一律不保。

bank.stem: Coverage C - Personal Property excludes each of the following items EXCEPT:

opts.t: An all-terrain vehicle used on the insured's acreage
opts.w: 机动车辆（含 ATV、雪地车、高尔夫车、摩托车）不在 Coverage C 内。

opts.t: A truck cap stored in the insured's backyard
opts.w: 露营单元、卡车顶盖、拖车及其设备不在 Coverage C 内。

opts.t: A radar detector powered by the car's electrical system
opts.w: 靠车辆电力系统才能用的设备算车辆设备，除外。

opts.t: A snow blower used to clear the insured's driveway

bank.note: 机动车辆除外有一组例外：为维护处所而用的机动器具（骑乘割草机、园艺设备、吹雪机）、残障人士用的三轮以上电动轮椅或代步车、船只（另有 $1,000 特别限额）——这些 Coverage C 照保。备用汽车零件（风扇皮带、轮毂盖）也不算「设备」，在 $1,000 限额内保。

bank.pt: 营业财产 · 离开处所
bank.stem: Betty's $3,000 laptop, used only for her home-based business, is stolen from her hotel room while she attends a trade convention in Toronto. How much does her Homeowners policy pay?

opts.t: $2,000, the special limit for business property
opts.w: $2,000 只适用于在处所上的营业财产；离开处所就一分不赔。

opts.t: $3,000, since personal property is insured worldwide
opts.w: 「全世界」只适用于个人财产；营业用书籍、工具、仪器只在处所上保。

opts.t: Nothing, as business property is insured only on the premises
$2,500, the limit for property temporarily away from home
opts.w: $2,500 是学生临时离家的个人财产限额，与营业财产无关。

bank.note: 营业财产（books, tools and instruments pertaining to a business）：$2,000 合计、且只在处所上。FOI 原例 Betty 在多伦多酒店被盗的手提电脑，保险公司有权全额拒赔。家庭生意多的客户要加批单或另买商业财产险。

bank.stem: A kitchen fire destroys Anna's $9,000 fur coat. Her Homeowners policy has the standard Special Limits of Insurance. Before the deductible, how much of the coat's value is payable?

opts.t: $2,000, the limit for furs and fur garments
opts.w: $2,000 的皮草限额只在被盗时适用；火灾不受此限。

opts.t: $9,000, as the fur limit applies only to theft
$5,000, the limit for a single personal article
opts.w: 家主表没有「单件 $5,000」的通用限额；$5,000 是园艺拖拉机。

opts.t: Nothing, as furs must be listed on a floater
opts.w: 不加保也有保障；只是被盗时封顶 $2,000。

bank.note: 特别限额分两类：一类不论原因（营业财产、证券、学生财产、现金、园艺拖拉机、船只、软件、汽车备件）；一类只在被盗时（珠宝手表宝石皮草 $2,000、钱币 $200、手稿邮票 $1,000、收藏卡 $1,000、每辆自行车 $500）。FOI 特别提醒：说「皮草大衣理赔一律封顶 $2,000」是经纪人常犯的错。

bank.stem: Thieves take the Wongs' computer and printer worth $6,000 and software worth $3,800. Applying the Homeowners Special Limits of Insurance, how much is payable before the deductible?

opts.w: 软件有 $2,500 合计限额，不能全额。
限额只管软件；电脑硬件不受特别限额，全额赔。
软件不是不保，是封顶 $2,500。

bank.pt: 免赔额与特别限额的先后
bank.stem: A fire destroys the Lees' garden tractor, valued at $6,200. Their deductible is $1,000, and garden type tractors carry a $5,000 Special Limit of Insurance. How much does the insurer pay?

opts.w: 把免赔额扣在限额上了；FOI 的顺序是先扣免赔再看限额。
扣完免赔后 $5,200 仍高于 $5,000 限额，要封顶。
既没扣免赔额，也没套特别限额。

bank.stem: Which Homeowners Special Limit of Insurance applies only when the property is stolen?

opts.t: Securities, up to $2,000 in all
opts.w: 证券的 $2,000 不论原因都适用。

opts.t: Money and bullion, up to $200 in all
opts.w: 现金与金银块的 $200 不论原因都适用。

opts.t: Collectible cards, up to $1,000 in all
Watercraft, up to $1,000 in all
opts.w: 船只的 $1,000 不论原因都适用。

bank.note: 只在被盗时适用的五项：珠宝手表宝石皮草 $2,000、钱币收藏 $200、手稿邮票集邮 $1,000、收藏卡 $1,000、每辆自行车 $500。证券、现金、船只属于「不论原因」那一类。

bank.pt: 额外生活费 · 怎么算
bank.stem: After a fire, the Butlers live in a motel for one month. They spend $2,200 on the room, $1,800 on restaurant meals (they normally spend $600 a month on food), $240 on a kennel and $400 on taxis. How much does Coverage D pay?

opts.w: 餐费只赔超出平时的部分，要扣掉平时的 $600。
多扣了：狗舍和出租车是出险前没有的开支，全额赔。
额外生活费不只赔住宿；餐费差额、狗舍、出租车都是额外开支。

bank.note: Coverage D 只赔比平常多出来的（over and above）。餐费 $1,800 − $600 ＝ $1,200；住宿通常全额 $2,200；狗舍 $240、出租车 $400 出险前不存在，全额。合计 $4,040。

bank.pt: 额外生活费 · 生活水准
bank.stem: The Kims lived in an 800 sq. ft. bungalow before a fire made it unfit to live in. While repairs are made, they rent a 1,600 sq. ft. house. How does Coverage D treat their extra rent?

opts.t: It pays only what is needed to keep their normal standard of living
It pays the full rent, because the home is unfit for occupancy
opts.w: 触发条件满足了，但赔付以维持原有生活水准为限。

opts.t: It pays the full rent, but only for a maximum of two weeks
opts.w: 两周上限是民政当局禁止进入那一项，不是一般额外生活费。

opts.t: It pays nothing, because renting a house is a change of residence
opts.w: 临时租房正是额外生活费要赔的情形，只是不能借机提高生活水准。

bank.note: FOI：只赔维持正常生活水准所必需的额外开支，不能借损失改善生活——800 平方英尺的人租 1,600 平方英尺，保险人没有义务全赔。赔付期为修复或重建所需的合理时间；如决定永久搬迁，则为在别处安顿所需的合理时间。

bank.stem: A riot causes fire damage to a neighbouring building, and police bar access to the Tran family's undamaged home for three weeks. Riot is an insured peril on their policy. For how long does Coverage D pay their additional living expense?

opts.t: For the full three weeks the order remains in place
opts.w: 民政当局禁止进入有明确上限：不超过两周。

opts.t: For up to 30 consecutive days
opts.w: 30 天是财产转移、搬家扩展与空置的数，不是禁止进入。

opts.t: For nothing, because their own home was undamaged
opts.w: 这一项恰恰不要求自家受损，只要求起因是自己保单承保的危险。

opts.t: For a period not exceeding two weeks

bank.note: Access Prohibited by Order of Civil Authority：起因必须是被保险人自己保单承保的危险；额外生活费与公平租金价值最多两周。地震引起的疏散，除非保了地震，否则不赔（KU-0070 讲巨灾时还会用到这一条）。

bank.stem: Under the Homeowners Basic Form (IBC 1151), Benji leaves a pot of cooking oil on the stove for 20 minutes. It never ignites, but black smoke damages the kitchen. How does the smoke peril respond?

opts.t: It pays, since all smoke damage from a cooking unit is insured
opts.w: 烟熏危险限于设备「突发、异常、故障」运行；人走开不算设备故障。

opts.t: It pays, but only after the fire department confirms the cause
opts.w: FOI 没有这种前置条件，这是编的。

opts.t: It pays nothing, as the smoke did not come from a faulty operation
It pays nothing, because smoke is insured only on IBC 1155
opts.w: 基本表 1151 也保烟熏，只是限于设备突发异常故障，且不含壁炉烟。

bank.note: IBC 1151 烟熏：smoke due to a sudden, unusual and faulty operation of any heating or cooking unit，不含壁炉烟。FOI 原例：Benji 的油锅不是设备故障，Fortress 拒赔；而炉子故障冒烟（$6,000 清洗）照赔。

bank.pt: 坠落物 · 先击中外墙
bank.stem: Under IBC 1151, a dead branch from a tree on the Butlers' lot falls directly onto their new patio furniture and destroys it. The branch touches no building. What is the result?

opts.t: Covered under the falling object peril, less the deductible
opts.w: 坠落物危险要求先击中建筑外部，这根树枝没有。

opts.t: Denied, because the object never struck the building exterior
Covered under the windstorm peril, since branches fall in wind
opts.w: 题目没有风暴；而且危险的认定看实际起因。

opts.t: Denied, because patio furniture is excluded from Coverage C
opts.w: 露台家具是普通个人财产，不在除外清单里。

bank.note: IBC 1151 坠落物：必须是先击中建筑外部的坠落物（falling object）。考试口径的例子：枯枝直接砸在露台家具上，保险人以「没有先击中建筑外部」拒赔。

bank.stem: Ella, the named insured, accidentally backs her own car into the door of her detached garage. Under which Homeowners Forms is the damage to the garage covered?

opts.t: Under IBC 1153 and IBC 1155, which insure buildings on an all risks basis
Under all three forms, as impact by land vehicle is a named peril
opts.w: 1151 的车辆撞击明确不含被保险人自己拥有或驾驶的车。

opts.t: Under IBC 1155 only, since only it insures buildings on an all risks basis
opts.w: 1153 Broad 也把建筑（含附属独立建筑）升级为 all risks。

opts.t: Under none of the forms, since damage by an insured's own car is excluded
opts.w: 这条除外只写在 1151 的列名危险里；all risks 表没有这条除外。

bank.note: 1151 列名危险 5：does not include any impact by a vehicle owned or operated by you or your employees。1153 把住宅与附属独立建筑升级为 all risks，1155 连个人财产也是 all risks——自家车撞自家车库在这两张表里都没有对应除外（官方练习卷第 46 题 1155 也判赔）。

bank.stem: Under IBC 1151, water damage from each of the following sources is excluded EXCEPT:

opts.t: Sewer water backing up through a basement floor drain
opts.w: 下水道、集水井、化粪池倒灌明确除外（可加批单）。

opts.t: Rainwater pooling in the yard and seeping through the foundation
opts.w: 地表水除外——地面积水从墙地渗入不保。

opts.t: A slow drip from a valve that went unnoticed for months
opts.w: 持续或反复的渗漏除外，这是维护问题。

opts.t: A supply line that suddenly bursts behind the dishwasher

bank.note: IBC 1151 水损承保四种：① 供水总管突发意外漏水；② 住宅内水管、供暖、喷淋、空调系统或家用盛水器具突发意外漏水；③ 住宅外家用盛水器具（非冻结）；④ 其他承保危险突然造成的开口进水。除外九种：冬季冻结（有条件）、持续渗漏、下水道倒灌、地下水、地表水、岸冰、供水总管本身、漏水的系统本身、在建或空置期间。

bank.pt: 冻结 · 离家超过 4 天
bank.stem: In January, the Fosters leave for a seven-day trip. They do not arrange for anyone to check the heat, and they leave the water on. On day five the furnace fails and the pipes freeze and burst. What is the coverage under IBC 1151?

opts.t: Covered, as sudden escape of water from a plumbing system
opts.w: 冻结有专门的除外条件，这里正好落在除外里。

opts.t: Covered, provided they told the insurer before leaving
opts.w: FOI 明写无须通知保险人；要的是两项措施之一，与通知无关。

opts.t: Excluded, since they were away more than four days without either precaution
Excluded, because freezing damage is never covered in winter
opts.w: 冻结不是一律不保：离开不超过 4 个连续日、或采取了两项措施之一，照保。

bank.note: 冬季供暖季在有供暖部分发生冻结：被保险人离开超过 4 个连续日，除非 ① 安排称职的人每天进屋查看供暖，或 ② 关水并排空所有水管与盛水器具，否则不赔。不需要事先通知保险人。官方练习卷第 42 题：第四天正在返程途中，仍在期限内，赔。

bank.pt: 风暴冰雹 · 三项损失
bank.stem: A windstorm tears a hole in the Butlers' roof and rips off shingles. Rain pours through the hole and stains the ceiling and furniture. Their satellite dish is also wrecked. Under IBC 1151, which losses are covered?

opts.t: The roof and shingles, but neither the interior nor the furniture
opts.w: 风暴先在建筑上造成开口，随后进雨造成的内部与家具损失也赔。

opts.t: The roof, interior and furniture, but the satellite dish is excluded
All three losses, including the wrecked satellite dish on the roof
opts.w: 户外天线（含卫星接收器）在风暴冰雹危险里明确除外。

opts.t: The satellite dish only, because rain damage inside a home is never insured
opts.w: 雨水损失在「风暴先造成开口」时是赔的。

bank.note: IBC 1151 风暴冰雹：屋内财产与建筑内部的风、冰雹、随附雨水损失，除非风暴先在建筑上造成开口，否则不赔；户外收音机电视天线与卫星接收器除外；冰雪重压、波浪、洪水除外。FOI 原题答案：Yes／Yes／No。

bank.pt: 玻璃破碎 · 找不保的
bank.stem: The glass breakage peril of IBC 1151 covers each of the following accidental losses EXCEPT:

opts.t: A crystal vase knocked off a shelf by a visitor
A glass shower door in the dwelling cracked by a child
opts.w: 构成住宅一部分的玻璃意外破碎是承保的。

opts.t: A storm window shattered while stored in the garage
opts.w: 防风窗与门的玻璃即使拆下存放也在保。

opts.t: A picture window cracked when the ground settled
opts.w: FOI 原例：地面沉降导致前窗开裂，照赔。

bank.note: 玻璃破碎只保构成住宅或附属建筑一部分的玻璃（含防风门窗，拆下存放也在保），起因包括地面移动与意外。玻璃做的个人财产（灯、摆设、碗碟、玻璃桌面）一律不在这一危险里。另：在建或空置期间不保。

bank.pt: 运输危险 · 找承保的
bank.stem: The Butlers' truck, towing their own vacation trailer and boat, upsets on the highway. Which loss is covered by the transportation peril of IBC 1151?

opts.t: Dishes and utensils kept in the vacation trailer
opts.w: 被保险人自有度假或家用拖车里的财产除外，无论是否临时移出。

opts.t: The boat and its trailer being towed behind
opts.w: 船只及其设备、马达在运输危险里明确除外。

opts.t: The TV mounted on a bracket in the trailer
opts.w: 同样在自有拖车里，除外。

opts.t: Suitcases of clothing in the truck's cab

bank.note: 运输危险：所乘汽车或所挂拖车（或公共承运人）发生碰撞、翻覆、出轨、搁浅、沉没，造成临时移出处所的个人财产损失。除外：自有度假或家用拖车里的财产、船只；建筑固着物为修理或换季存放而临时移出的另行承保。FOI 原题四项全 No，因为都在拖车里或是船。

bank.stem: Under IBC 1151, each of the following theft losses is excluded EXCEPT:

opts.t: A TV stolen by the tenant renting the insured's basement
opts.w: 出租部分被租客、租客雇员或其家庭成员偷盗的，除外。

opts.t: A purebred puppy stolen from the insured's backyard
opts.w: 动物、鸟、鱼的盗窃除外——走失也能报成被盗。

opts.t: Jewellery stolen from a hotel room while on vacation
A car sold to a buyer whose cheque later bounces
opts.w: 同意的所有权变更，即使是被骗，也不算盗窃。

bank.note: 盗窃除外五条：① 在被保险人拥有、租用或占用的其他住所发生的（暂住期间除外）；② 出租部分被租客等偷；③ 在建住宅及建材（完工可入住前）；④ 动物、鸟、鱼；⑤ 同意的所有权变更（哪怕被骗）。度假酒店被盗属于「个人财产临时离开处所——全世界」，承保，但珠宝受 $2,000 盗窃限额约束。

bank.stem: Rick's family was suddenly transferred to Montreal 20 days ago. All their furniture is still in the house, nobody lives there, and they do not plan to return. Vandals now break in and smash the windows. Under IBC 1151, what is the result?

opts.t: Covered, because the 30-day vacancy limit has not yet been reached
opts.w: 30 天是全部保障停止的时钟；破坏、水损、玻璃破碎在空置当刻就停。

opts.t: Uninsured, because vandalism coverage ends once the home is vacant
Covered, because furniture in the house means it is still occupied
opts.w: FOI 的空置定义明写「不论是否留有家具」。

opts.t: Uninsured, because any dwelling left empty for 14 days is excluded
opts.w: 没有 14 天这个数；整体停保的门槛是明知空置超过 30 个连续日。

bank.note: 空置（vacant）＝不论是否留有家具，所有住户已迁出且无意返回、也没有新住户。两只时钟：① 破坏或恶意行为、水损、玻璃破碎在空置当刻就不保；② 明知空置超过 30 个连续日，全部保障停止。FOI 原例：O'Shea 家家具都在，仍判为空置。

bank.stem: Under the Homeowners Comprehensive Form (IBC 1155), each of the following losses is excluded EXCEPT:

opts.t: A roof that collapses under a sudden heavy snow load
Mice chewing through electrical wiring in the attic
opts.w: 鸟、害虫、浣熊、啮齿动物、昆虫造成的损失除外（建筑玻璃除外）。

opts.t: Cracks in the foundation caused by settling of the ground
opts.w: 沉降、膨胀、收缩、开裂除外——这是维护类损失。

opts.t: The motor of the dishwasher breaking down
opts.w: 磨损、老化、缺陷、机械故障除外——那是保修的事。

bank.note: 1155＝建筑与个人财产都是 all risks：没被明文除外的都保。FOI 点名的两个好处：壁炉冒烟、雪压塌顶。除外清单：使用中的运动器材、加工中的财产、磨损老化缺陷机械故障、沉降开裂、鸟兽虫害、地震滑坡等地动（引发的火或爆炸只赔后续损失）、以及与 1151 相同的水损除外。

bank.stem: The Ortegas insure under IBC 1155. Which loss to their downhill skis is covered?

opts.t: A ski snaps when Ana hits a mogul on the slope
opts.w: 运动器材因使用而损坏是 1155 的明文除外。

opts.t: A ski cracks as Luis lands a jump in the terrain park
opts.w: 同样是使用中损坏，除外。

opts.t: The skis' edges wear out after three seasons of use
opts.w: 磨损老化是 1155 另一条独立的除外，与使用中损坏无关。

opts.t: The skis are smashed when their car is rear-ended

bank.note: 1155 除外 sporting equipment where the loss or damage is due to its use；但运动器材在事故、火灾或其他承保原因下受损照赔。FOI 第 10 题：滑雪板在车祸中撞坏——Yes。

bank.pt: IBC 1155 · 珠宝限额何时解除
bank.stem: Under the IBC 1155 wording, the $2,000 Special Limit for jewellery, watches and furs is lifted when the loss is caused by:

opts.t: Theft from the locked home
opts.w: 被盗正是这类限额要咬住的情形。

opts.t: Mysterious disappearance
opts.w: 神秘失踪不是列明危险，限额照样适用。

opts.t: A Specified Peril such as fire
Theft while travelling abroad
opts.w: 无论在家还是在外被盗，都受 $2,000 限额。

bank.note: IBC 1155 原文：前五项（珠宝皮草 $2,000、钱币 $200、手稿邮票 $1,000、收藏卡 $1,000、每辆自行车 $500）do not apply to any claim caused by a Specified Peril。Specified Perils 共 11 项（火、闪电、爆炸、烟、坠落物、飞机车辆撞击、暴动、破坏、水损、风暴冰雹、运输）。效果与 FOI「只在被盗时适用」基本一致，但 1155 的措辞更宽：神秘失踪等非列明原因也会被封顶。

bank.pt: 承保定额 · 单一限额
bank.stem: A broker values the Garcias' dwelling at $300,000 replacement cost. The insurer requires personal property at 80% of Coverage A and follows FOI's usual percentages for Coverages B and D. If the policy is written on a Single Limit basis, what is the single limit?

opts.w: 漏了 Coverage B 的 10%（$30,000）——B 不能删，也是另加的。
这是按 C＝90% 算的；本题保险人要求 80%。
把 D 算成 10% 了；FOI 的常用比例是 20%。

bank.stem: A client has no detached structures on his lot and asks his broker to delete Coverage B from his Homeowners policy to save premium. What should the broker tell him?

opts.t: The coverages are sold as a package and none may be deleted
Coverage B can be deleted if he signs a statement that no structures exist
opts.w: 家主表是套装，保险人不允许删除任何保障。

opts.t: Coverage B can be reduced to 5% of Coverage A but never fully deleted
opts.w: 5% 是户外树木的数；套装的保障与限额不能下调。

opts.t: Coverage B is optional and is included only when it is requested
opts.w: Coverage B 是自动包含的标准保障，不是可选项。

bank.note: 考试口径：Homeowners 表单的各项保障打包出售，保险人不允许删掉任何一项。 没有附属建筑也不能删 Coverage B；自动给的限额不够时可以加，不能减（官方练习卷第 48 题）。

bank.stem: A condominium unit owner's Loss Assessment coverage would respond to a special assessment levied by the corporation for each of the following reasons EXCEPT one where:

opts.t: The corporation's policy carried a very large deductible
opts.w: 法团大额免赔造成的缺口正是 Loss Assessment 要接的。

opts.t: A co-insurance penalty reduced the corporation's recovery
opts.w: 共保罚则造成的缺口在五种原因之列。

opts.t: The corporation's building was simply underinsured
opts.w: 法团保额不足是五种原因的第一种。

opts.t: The loss came from a peril the owner's own policy excludes

bank.note: 法团向业主摊派的五种原因：保额不足、大额免赔、共保罚则、起因非承保或被除外、违反保单条件。但考试口径强调：Loss Assessment 只在摊派所对应的损失是业主自己保单承保的损失时才赔，所以要劝业主买最宽的保障。标准限额 $5,000，常见提高到 C 的一定倍数。

bank.pt: 共管 · 业主自装改良
bank.stem: A condominium unit owner replaces the original carpet with hardwood floors. Which coverage protects the value of this upgrade?

opts.t: The corporation's building policy
opts.w: 法团保单只含原装的地毯、墙板、固定装置；业主改良增加的价值它不赔。

opts.t: The Loss Assessment coverage
opts.w: Loss Assessment 接的是法团向全体业主的摊派，不是自家改良。

opts.t: Unit Improvements and Betterments
The Unit Additional Protection
opts.w: 这一项是法团对单元没保险或保险不足时补单元本身的，不是专保改良。

bank.note: 共管业主三项必备：Unit Improvements and Betterments（业主自装改良，基本 $1,000，常见为 C 的 25%，按重置成本赔）、Loss Assessment（$5,000 起）、Unit Additional Protection（法团保单不足或无效时保单元）。

bank.stem: Under IBC's Mobile Home Forms, the emergency removal expense coverage provides:

opts.t: Up to 10% of the dwelling amount for any damage caused while moving the home
opts.w: 活动房表明确不保搬运本身造成的损失；比例也是 5%。

opts.t: Up to 5% of the dwelling amount to move the home away from a threatened loss
Up to 20% of the dwelling amount for living expenses while the home is moved
opts.w: 20% 是 Coverage D 的常用比例，与紧急迁移无关。

opts.t: Up to $1,000 for disconnecting utilities, with towing costs excluded
opts.w: 断开水电和拖运费都在 5% 的范围内，没有 $1,000 这个数。

bank.note: 活动房表在家主表基础上两处改动：① 住宅描述扩到永久家电家具、雨篷、裙板、门廊、系固设备；② 承保危险威胁时，最多住宅保额 5% 用于迁离（断水电、拖运）。搬运造成的损失不保。

bank.stem: Policies insuring dwellings owned by the insured but rented to others normally exclude which perils?

opts.t: Vandalism and theft
Fire and lightning
opts.w: 火与闪电是任何财产保单的核心承保危险，不会被除外。

opts.t: Windstorm and hail
opts.w: FOI 点名的出租屋常见除外是破坏与盗窃，不是风暴。

opts.t: Water and explosion
opts.w: FOI 没有把这两项列为出租屋的常见除外。

bank.note: 保险人把最好的保单留给自住。出租屋（rented dwellings）通常：除外破坏或恶意行为与盗窃；建筑与个人财产常只按 ACV 赔；多数保险人只在同时承保业主主要住所时才接。

bank.stem: Some insurers use the term 'contents' on a commercial property policy. What does it include?

opts.t: Building and stock
opts.w: contents 不含建筑；建筑＋存货＋设备合称 all property。

opts.t: Stock and equipment
Building and equipment
opts.w: contents 不含建筑。

opts.t: Equipment and money
opts.w: 现金是商业财产表的除外财产，不在 contents 里。

bank.note: 商业财产＝与营业有关的财产，通常分 building（建筑）、stock（存货）、equipment（设备） 三类。有的保险人用 all property＝三者全部；contents＝存货＋设备。

bank.pt: 列名险表 · 找不在内的
bank.stem: The Commercial Property Named Perils Form (IBC 4036) insures each of the following perils EXCEPT:

opts.t: Theft of stock by outsiders
Leakage from fire protective equipment
opts.w: 这是 4036 的八项列名险之一（喷淋等消防设备泄漏）。

opts.t: Smoke from a faulty stationary furnace
opts.w: 这是 4036 的列名险之一，限固定炉具突发异常故障。

opts.t: Impact by a land vehicle or spacecraft
opts.w: 飞机、航天器、陆上车辆撞击是列名险之一（不含自家或雇员的车）。

bank.note: 4036 八项列名险：火、闪电（含电器）、爆炸（有限）、飞机／航天器／陆上车辆撞击、暴动破坏恶意行为、固定炉具冒烟、消防设备泄漏、风暴冰雹。盗窃不在里面——它是 Broad Form 的好处之一。

bank.stem: The Commercial Property Broad Form (IBC 4037) covers each of the following losses that the Named Perils Form does not cover EXCEPT:

opts.t: Collapse of the roof under a heavy accumulation of snow
opts.w: 塌陷是 FOI 列的 Broad Form 好处之一，大雪地区尤其重要。

opts.t: Theft of stock and equipment by an outside burglar
opts.w: 盗窃存货与设备是 Broad Form 的好处之一。

opts.t: A delivery truck driven by an employee hitting the store
opts.w: Broad Form 保车辆撞击，即使是被保险人或其雇员开的车。

opts.t: Damage caused by an earthquake that cracks the walls

bank.note: Broad Form＝all risks of direct physical loss or damage，没被明文除外就保。FOI 列的五个好处：车辆撞击（含自家与雇员的车）、各种来源的烟（农业熏烟与工业作业除外）、水管冻裂或破裂、盗窃、塌陷。明确除外：地震、修补有缺陷或不当的材料、工艺、设计的费用。

bank.pt: 水管冻裂 · 哪张表保
bank.stem: One winter night the overhead water line in the Butlers' store freezes and bursts, causing $180,000 of water damage to their furniture stock. Which commercial property form responds?

opts.t: Both forms, because water damage is common to both
opts.w: 4036 的列名险里没有一般水损，只有消防设备泄漏。

opts.t: Neither form, because freezing is always excluded
opts.w: Broad Form 恰恰把水管冻裂列为相对 4036 的好处。

opts.t: The Broad Form (IBC 4037) only
The Named Perils Form (IBC 4036) only
opts.w: 反了：列名险表不保一般水管破裂。

bank.note: FOI 原例（BROAD FORM - LIMITED COVERAGE FOR WATER DAMAGE）：水管冻裂 $180,000 存货水损，Broad Form 赔。Broad Form 仍除外：洪水、水体漫溢、地下室墙地渗水、下水道倒灌。

bank.stem: Under the Commercial Property Broad Form, water damage from each of the following is excluded EXCEPT:

opts.t: Sewer water backing up into the stockroom
opts.w: 下水道倒灌是 Broad Form 明文除外的水损。

opts.t: A frozen water pipe that bursts overnight
Spring flood water from a nearby river
opts.w: 洪水与水体漫溢除外。

opts.t: Groundwater seeping through basement walls
opts.w: 地下室墙地渗水除外。

bank.note: Broad Form 的水损好处是水管冻裂或破裂；四类水损仍除外：洪水（flood）、水体漫溢、地下室墙地渗水（seepage）、下水道倒灌（sewer backup）。

bank.stem: An insurer applies a basic fire rate of .65 per $100 of insurance to a building insured for $400,000. What is the premium?

opts.w: 把费率当成 .60 了。
把费率当成按保额的 6.5% 了；费率是每 $100 收 $0.65。

bank.stem: An insurer sets a basic fire rate of .70/$100 for a store and adds a loading of .05/$100 to cover the additional perils of the Broad Form. What premium does the insurer charge on a $600,000 building?

opts.w: 这只是基本火险费率的保费，漏了广式加费。
加费是 .05 不是 .10。
这只是加费部分（.05 × 6,000），不是总保费。

bank.note: 先定基本火险费率（只保列名险的费率），再为 Broad Form 的其余危险加 loading：.70 ＋ .05 ＝ .75/$100。$600,000 ÷ $100 × .75 ＝ $4,500。

bank.pt: 火险费率因素 · 找不是的
bank.stem: When setting the basic fire rate for commercial property, an insurer considers each of the following factors EXCEPT:

opts.t: The occupancy of other tenants in the building
opts.w: 占用（occupancy）是五大因素之一：同楼有高火险租户，费率更高。

opts.t: The fire claims history of similar businesses
opts.w: 同类业务的理赔记录（通常五年）是五大因素之一。

opts.t: The annual sales volume of the business
The distance from fire halls and hydrants
opts.w: 公共消防保护（离消防站、消防栓的远近）是保护因素的一部分。

bank.note: 火险费率五因素：construction（建筑结构）、protection（公共与私人消防保护）、occupancy（自己与他人的用途）、location（与他楼距离、周边建筑、街区）、claims history（同类业务通常五年的火损记录）。营业额、员工人数都不是（练习卷第 52 题考员工人数）。

bank.stem: Which item is an example of private protection that may lower a commercial fire rate?

opts.t: A full-time paid municipal fire department
opts.w: 这是公共保护（来自外部的消防力量）。

opts.t: An automatic sprinkler system in the building
A sufficient year-round public water supply
opts.w: 这是公共保护的因素之一。

opts.t: The building's distance from other structures
opts.w: 这是地点（location）因素，不是保护。

bank.note: Public protection＝外部消防力量（离消防站与消防栓近、专职消防队、水源充足且全年可用）；private protection＝申请人自己做的防损（灭火器、烟感热感报警、自动喷淋）。

bank.pt: 建筑定义 · 找不算的
bank.stem: Under the commercial property definition of 'building', each of the following is included EXCEPT:

opts.t: A portable sign placed on the front lawn
A pole sign permanently fixed on the premises
opts.w: 与建筑有关、永久固定在处所上的结构（围栏、杆式招牌、院灯）属建筑。

opts.t: Wall-to-wall carpeting installed by the owner
opts.w: 永久安装、构成建筑一部分的固着物属建筑。

opts.t: A burglar alarm wired into the building
opts.w: 接入建筑电路的防盗报警属建筑。

bank.note: 建筑定义五项：① 与建筑有关、位于处所上的固定结构（金属围栏、杆式招牌、院灯）；② 与建筑相通相连的加建与延伸；③ 永久固着物（暖气管道、大型空调、满铺地毯、灯具、接入电路的防盗报警、内嵌货架）；④ 为维护、日常修理、小改动而放在处所上的材料设备用品；⑤ 业主自有建筑内的装饰用活植物。可移动的招牌不固定，归设备（FOI 自测第 17 题）。

bank.stem: The Butlers own their store building. Applying the FOI definition of building, which of these is insured within their building limit?

opts.t: Silk flowers decorating Betty's office
opts.w: 丝绸花不是活植物，不在建筑定义第 (v) 项里。

opts.t: Pyramid cedars growing in front of the store
opts.w: 建筑定义只含建筑内的装饰植物；户外树木另有扩展且不保风暴。

opts.t: Tomato plants grown inside to sell for school
opts.w: 要卖的植物不是装饰用途。

opts.t: A $15,000 live palm tree in the showroom

bank.note: 建筑定义 (v)：growing plants, trees, shrubs or flowers inside the building used for decorative purposes when the insured is the owner of the building。FOI 原题答案：丝绸花否、棕榈树是、门前雪松否、待售番茄否。

bank.pt: 建材 · 小改动 vs 大工程
bank.stem: Which item is insured within the building limit of a commercial property policy?

opts.t: Steel beams on the premises for a new warehouse wing
opts.w: 大修或新建工程用的材料不在建筑定义里，要另买（如 Builder's Risk）。

opts.t: Lumber delivered to a job site for the owner's new store
opts.w: 不在处所上，而且是新建工程。

opts.t: Leftover cedar trim stored on site for a minor alteration
Tools owned by the contractor doing a major renovation
opts.w: 承包商的工具不是被保险人为维护存放的用品，大改造也不在内。

bank.note: 建筑定义 (iv)：materials, equipment and supplies on the premises for maintenance of, and normal repairs and minor alterations to the building。FOI 原例：Butler 家多买的雪松装饰条放在后面的储物棚里，算建筑；大修或翻新用的材料设备不保，要另买（练习卷第 53 题：新仓库的建材不算）。

bank.pt: 存货 · 业务以外的货
bank.stem: A bookstore's Declarations Page describes its business as a retail book store. The owner also sells a few bicycles from the shop. A fire destroys both books and bicycles. How are the bicycles treated under the stock coverage?

opts.t: Covered, because all merchandise on the premises is stock
opts.w: 存货只含「该业务惯常的」货物，书店的自行车不是。

opts.t: Uninsured as stock, as they are unusual to the stated business
Covered as equipment, since they are used in the business
opts.w: 待售的自行车是货物，不是营业中使用的设备。

opts.t: Covered, but only up to 10% of the stock amount of insurance
opts.w: FOI 没有这种 10% 的折中规则，这是编的。

bank.note: Stock 定义 (i)：merchandise of every description usual to the insured's business，业务性质写在 Declarations Page 上。FOI 原例：书店的存货险不含同时在卖的自行车。另两项：包装与广告材料；有义务投保或依法负责的他人类似财产。

bank.pt: 他人财产 · 依法负责
bank.stem: In the Butlers' upholstery building, an employee accidentally ignites cleaning fluid and the building burns. $75,000 of customers' furniture is destroyed. Under the stock definition, why can this loss be included?

opts.t: Because the Butlers are legally liable for the property
Because customers' goods are always part of stock
opts.w: 他人财产要满足两个条件之一：有义务投保，或依法负责。

opts.t: Because the customers signed waivers of subrogation
opts.w: 放弃代位求偿与能否纳入存货无关。

opts.t: Because the loss occurred during business hours
opts.w: 营业时间与否不是判据。

bank.note: Stock (iii) 与 Equipment (ii)：similar property belonging to others which the insured is under obligation to keep insured or for which he is legally liable。雇主通常对雇员造成的他人财产损失依法负责，所以客户家具可算进存货保额——前提是保额够大。

bank.stem: The Butlers lease a photocopier, postage meter and telephone system worth $41,800. The lease requires them to insure the equipment. Under which class can this property be insured?

opts.t: Building, because the phone system is wired in
opts.w: 这些是租来的设备，不是被保险人建筑的永久固着物。

opts.t: Stock, because it is property of others
opts.w: 存货里的他人财产指与所售货物「类似」的财产，复印机是营业用设备。

opts.t: None, as only the owner may insure leased goods
opts.w: 有义务投保或依法负责时，承租人可把它纳入自己的设备保额。

opts.t: Equipment, as property of others they must insure

bank.note: Equipment (ii)：与 stock 相同，含有义务投保或依法负责的他人类似财产。租赁协议通常要求承租人投保；没有协议，法律也可能让承租人负责。

bank.pt: 租户改良 · 承接前租户
bank.stem: Nadia rents retail space in a mall. She paid the previous tenant for the use interest in the flooring and lighting that tenant had installed. How should these improvements be insured on Nadia's commercial property policy?

opts.t: As building, because they are permanently attached to it
opts.w: 租户不拥有建筑，对建筑没有可保利益，不能投保建筑。

opts.t: Under the landlord's policy, since Nadia did not install them
opts.w: 条款明写：买下前租户使用权益的，视同自己出资所做。

opts.t: As equipment, as if Nadia had made them at her own expense
As stock, because she bought them from another business
opts.w: 改良是对建筑的改动，不是待售货物，不归存货。

bank.note: Equipment (iii) 租户改良：租户自费对所占用建筑做的改良、改动与改善，租户不是建筑业主时，归设备投保。If the Insured purchased the use interest in tenant's improvements made by a predecessor tenant, this Form applies as though such tenant's improvements had been made at the expense of the Insured.（练习卷第 54 题同一考点）

bank.stem: To which losses does the co-insurance clause apply?

opts.t: Total losses only
opts.w: 全损时保额全部用完，没有「按比例」的问题。

opts.t: Partial losses only
Both total and partial losses
opts.w: 共保只对部分损失起作用（练习卷第 55 题）。

opts.t: Losses under $5,000 only
opts.w: 反了：$5,000 以下（或 2% 以下）是共保豁免。

bank.note: 考试口径：共保条款只对部分损失起作用（partial losses only）。 原因是多数损失是部分损失，故意低保的人等于赌自己只会有部分损失。

bank.stem: A building has an actual cash value of $800,000 and an 80% co-insurance requirement. It is insured for $480,000. A fire causes a $100,000 partial loss. Ignoring the deductible, how much does the insurer pay?

opts.w: 把 80% 当成直接赔付比例了。
保额不够应保额，共保罚则要起作用。

bank.pt: 共保计算 · 自担多少
bank.stem: Stock worth $250,000 (ACV) is subject to a 90% co-insurance clause and is insured for $150,000. A partial loss of $45,000 occurs. How much of the loss must the insured absorb, ignoring the deductible?

opts.w: 这是保险人赔的钱，题问被保险人自担多少。
按 80% 算了；本题共保比例是 90%。
保险人仍按比例赔一部分，被保险人不是全部自担。

bank.stem: The Butlers insure furniture stock with an ACV of $500,000 for $200,000 under an 80% co-insurance clause. A small fire destroys a display sofa worth $3,500. Ignoring the deductible, what does the insurer pay?

opts.w: 这是套了共保公式的结果，但这次损失落在共保豁免里。
按保额除以全部价值算了，而且这次根本不套共保。

opts.t: Nothing
opts.w: 低保不会让损失一分不赔，何况这次适用豁免。

bank.note: 共保条款开头一句：只在损失超过「适用保额的 2%」与「$5,000」两者较小者时才适用（Waiver of Co-Insurance）。2% × $200,000 ＝ $4,000，较小者是 $4,000；$3,500 没超过，不套共保，全额赔——即使严重低保。

bank.stem: After any commercial property loss, the insurer pays the least of several amounts. Each of the following is one of those amounts EXCEPT:

opts.t: The amount calculated with the co-insurance formula
opts.w: 共保公式算出的数是三者之一。

opts.t: The replacement cost of the property when new
The limit of insurance on the item
opts.w: 该项的保额是三者之一。

opts.t: The amount of the loss
opts.w: 损失金额本身是三者之一。

bank.note: FOI：保险人赔付 (a) 共保公式算出的数、(b) 保额、(c) 损失金额 三者中最小的那个。IBC 4036 赔偿协议还另有一层：不超过财产价值、被保险人的利益、保额三者最小。

bank.stem: If commercial property is insured on a replacement cost basis, what value is used in the co-insurance calculation?

opts.t: Replacement cost, not actual cash value
Actual cash value, as the clause states
opts.w: FOI 特别提醒：按重置成本承保时，共保用重置成本算。

opts.t: Market value at the time of the loss
opts.w: 共保的计算基础不是市场价。

opts.t: The amount shown on the last renewal
opts.w: 那是实保额（Did），不是应保额的计算基础。

bank.note: 考试口径：财产按重置成本承保的，共保计算也用重置成本，而不是实际现金价值（ACV）。 所以按重置成本承保的客户，保额要对着重置成本买。

bank.pt: 残骸清理 · 保额用完
bank.stem: A fire totally destroys the Butlers' stock and equipment, and the insurer pays the full $300,000 limits for those items. The building is only partly damaged. It costs $12,000 to remove the debris of the stock and equipment. How does the debris removal clause respond?

opts.t: It pays the $12,000 in addition to the exhausted limits
opts.w: 残骸清理不增加保额；存货与设备的保额已用完。

opts.t: It pays from the remaining building limit for that debris
opts.w: 建筑剩余的保额只能用于清理建筑的残骸，不能挪给存货设备。

opts.t: It pays 25% of the $12,000 as a fixed debris allowance
opts.w: 没有这种固定比例的补贴，这是编的。

opts.t: It pays nothing for that debris, as those limits are used up

bank.note: FOI：保额没用完时，剩余保额可用于残骸清理；保额已全部用于赔款的，就不再有这项清理保障——存货与设备全损、保额赔光，就不赔它们的残骸清理；建筑只部分受损的，建筑剩余保额可用于清理建筑的残骸。IBC 4036／4037 原件写明扩展「不增加保额」。

bank.stem: A windstorm blows a neighbour's uprooted trees and a garden shed onto the insured's commercial premises. Removal costs $4,000. Does the debris removal clause respond?

opts.t: No, because the debris is not insured property
opts.w: 条款专门写了风暴吹到处所上的非保财产残骸也赔。

opts.t: Only if the neighbour's insurer refuses to pay first
opts.w: 条款没有「邻居保险先赔」这一前提。

opts.t: Yes, it covers debris blown onto the premises by windstorm
Only if the insured's own property was also damaged
opts.w: 风暴残骸这一项不以自家财产受损为条件。

bank.note: Debris Removal 第二段：保险人也赔清理不属本保单承保、但被风暴吹到处所上的残骸或财产的费用（Removal of Windstorm Debris）。另：残骸清理费不计入共保的价值计算。

bank.stem: The Butlers insure their stock for $300,000. A fire causes a $200,000 loss, which is paid. A month later, a second fire causes a $150,000 stock loss. Under the reinstatement clause, what happens?

opts.t: The insurer pays $100,000, the limit remaining after the first loss
opts.w: 恢复条款下保额不因赔付而减少。

opts.t: The insurer pays $150,000, and the limit stays at $300,000
The insurer pays $150,000 after charging a reinstatement premium
opts.w: 恢复保额不另收保费（练习卷第 57 题）。

opts.t: The insurer cancels the policy after the first loss and reissues it
opts.w: 条款没有赔后注销重出这回事。

bank.note: Reinstatement Clause：本表单任何一项下的赔款都不会减少对应的保额。 整个保单期内，无论赔几次、赔多少，保额都不变；不另加保费。

bank.pt: 代位求偿 · 有可保利益的人
bank.stem: Ralph lent the Butlers $100,000 and is named as a payee on their policy. He also rewired their store, and his faulty wiring caused a fire. After paying the claim, can the insurer recover from Ralph?

opts.t: No, as subrogation is waived against anyone with an insured interest
Yes, since the insurer is subrogated to all rights against others
opts.w: 条款第二句：对保单涉及其利益的人放弃代位求偿。

opts.t: Yes, but only up to the $100,000 he lent the Butlers
opts.w: 借款额与能否追偿无关，这是编的上限。

opts.t: No, because subrogation never applies to commercial property
opts.w: 商业财产保单本来有代位求偿权，只是对特定的人放弃。

bank.note: Subrogation Clause：赔付后保险人取得被保险人对他人的追偿权，但all rights of subrogation are hereby waived against any ... interest with respect to which insurance is provided by this policy——收款人、合伙人、子公司等有可保利益的人不追。FOI 原例：Ralph 布线引起火灾，保险人没有向他追偿。

bank.stem: A $100,000 loss is caused by a negligent contractor. The insurer paid $80,000 and the insured bore $20,000. After costs, the insurer recovers a net $50,000 from the contractor. Under the subrogation clause of the commercial property forms, how is the recovery shared?

opts.t: $50,000 to the insurer, which paid most of the loss
opts.w: 追回不足以完全补偿时，按双方各自承担损失的比例分。

opts.t: $25,000 to each party in equal shares
opts.w: 不是平分，是按承担比例分。

opts.t: $20,000 to the insured first, the rest to the insurer
opts.w: 条款不是被保险人优先，而是按比例。

opts.t: $40,000 to the insurer and $10,000 to the insured

bank.note: Subrogation Clause：扣除追偿费用后的净额不足以完全补偿时，按保险人与被保险人各自承担损失的比例分。80:20 → 保险人 $40,000、被保险人 $10,000。

bank.pt: 防护系统 · 找不必通知的
bank.stem: Under the Property Protection Systems clause, the insured must immediately notify the insurer of each of the following EXCEPT:

opts.t: Cancelling the burglar alarm's monitoring contract
opts.w: 监控或维护合同取消或不续约，必须立即通知。

opts.t: Police suspending response to the alarm system
opts.w: 警方暂停对该系统的出警，必须立即通知。

opts.t: A scheduled sprinkler test that finds no problems
A known defect that disables the sprinkler system
opts.w: 知道的中断、缺陷，必须立即通知。

bank.note: 三项通知义务：① 知道的中断、缺陷；② 监控或维护合同取消或不续约；③ 警方暂停出警。保险人可以：减少保障（防盗报警坏了可能整个盗窃保障都没了）、加收保费、注销保单。例行检测没发现问题不在其列。

bank.pt: 防护系统 · 不知道的缺陷
bank.stem: The sprinkler system in the Butlers' store fails to operate in a fire because its pipes were clogged by debris from the municipal watermain. The Butlers had no way of knowing. How does the insurer treat the claim?

opts.t: It denies the claim for breach of the protection systems clause
opts.w: 义务只针对被保险人知道的缺陷。

opts.t: It pays the claim, as the insured cannot report an unknown defect
It reduces the claim by the value the sprinklers would have saved
opts.w: FOI 没有这种按比例扣减的规则。

opts.t: It pays only if the Butlers bought a sprinkler maintenance contract
opts.w: 维护合同不是赔付前提；问题在于是否知道缺陷。

bank.note: 条款原句：notify the insurer of any interruption, flaw or defect coming to the knowledge of the Insured。FOI 原例：喷淋因供水总管带来的杂物堵塞没启动，不会因此拒赔——被保险人不可能报告自己不知道的事。

bank.stem: Stock is stolen from the insured's fully enclosed delivery van while the driver is in a coffee shop. The doors were locked and the windows closed, but there are no visible marks of forced entry. Under the Locked Vehicle Warranty, what is the result?

opts.t: Uninsured, as there is no visible evidence of forcible entry
Covered, because the doors were locked and the windows closed
opts.w: 还差一条：必须有可见的强行进入痕迹。

opts.t: Covered, because the driver was away only briefly
opts.w: 离开多久不是判据；无人看管时被盗就要满足全部条件。

opts.t: Uninsured, because stock in a vehicle is never insured
opts.w: 加费可扩到运输途中的存货与设备，只是要守这条保证。

bank.note: Locked Vehicle Warranty：车辆有全封闭车身或车厢；从无人看管的车上被盗，只在强行进入（有可见证据）、门已锁、窗已关时才赔。公共承运人控制下的财产不适用这条。

bank.stem: The Butlers leave $4,500 of antiques at Jack Fir's woodworking shop for restoration. A fire at Jack's shop destroys them. The Butlers bought the temporary locations coverage. How is the loss treated?

opts.t: Paid only by Jack's insurer, because the shop is his premises
opts.w: FOI 原例：由 Butler 家自己保单的临时地点保障赔。

opts.t: Uninsured, as property away from the premises is never covered
opts.w: 加费可以加上处所以外地点的保障，这正是临时地点保障的用途。

opts.t: Paid only if the antiques were in transit when the fire began
opts.w: 这是放在别人店里，不是运输途中。

opts.t: Paid under their own policy's temporary locations coverage

bank.note: 商业财产保单只保 Declarations Page 上写明地点的财产。加费可扩到两类处所外：① 运输途中（加拿大或美国本土，守上锁车辆保证）；② 临时地点＝不归被保险人所有、租用或控制的地点（练习卷第 58 题）。

bank.stem: A separate glass insurance policy may contain as few as three exclusions. Which three?

opts.t: Earth movement, thieves and accidents
opts.w: 反了：这三样是普通商业财产保单排除、而玻璃险要补上的。

opts.t: Fire, flood and wear and tear
opts.w: FOI 列的三项是火、战争、核能危险。

opts.t: Fire, war and nuclear energy hazard
War, vandalism and insured's acts
opts.w: 被保险人或他人意外打碎恰恰是玻璃险要保的。

bank.note: 商业财产保单对外部玻璃保障有限，即使最好的保单也除外：被保险人或他人意外打碎、地面移动、窃贼打碎。玻璃险的承保协议极宽，很多只有三项除外：火、战争、核能危险。

bank.stem: A fire destroys an architect's drawings for a project half finished. Her commercial property policy has no special coverage for records. What will it pay for the drawings?

opts.t: The full cost of redoing the design work
opts.w: 重做的成本要买 Valuable Papers and Records 才赔。

opts.t: The blank value of the paper and materials
The fee the client would have paid for them
opts.w: 财产保单不赔预期的设计费收入，那是营业收入问题。

opts.t: Nothing, as records are excluded property
opts.w: 记录不是除外财产，只是按空白价值赔。

bank.note: 普通商业财产保单对记录只赔空白价值（IBC 4036：空白材料费，有副本时再加誊抄人工）。买了 Valuable Papers and Records 才赔重新制作的全部费用；场所关闭时文件要放在保单指定的容器里。

bank.stem: A store has Mercantile Stock Burglary coverage. During business hours, a customer slips a camera into her bag and walks out. What is the result?

opts.t: Uninsured, as no unlawful entry or visible signs of force occurred
Covered, because stock was unlawfully taken from the premises
opts.w: 三个条件只满足一个；还要非法进出与可见的强力痕迹。

opts.t: Covered, because the store was open to the public at the time
opts.w: 营业中开放不是承保条件。

opts.t: Uninsured, because cameras are excluded from burglary coverage
opts.w: 相机不是除外财产；拒赔原因是不满足强力进入条件。

bank.note: Burglary 要有强力证据。Mercantile Stock Burglary 三条都要证明：① 财产从处所内被非法拿走；② 处所被非法进入或离开；③ 进出点有可见的强力痕迹。顺手牵羊满足不了。要保这类损失得买 Theft（最宽）。

bank.stem: An employee carrying the day's bank deposit is knocked unconscious in an accident on the way to the bank, and a passer-by takes the deposit bag. Which crime coverage responds?

opts.t: Burglary, since force was involved in the taking
opts.w: 入室盗窃要求非法进出处所的强力痕迹。

opts.t: Safe burglary, because the money left the premises
opts.w: 保险柜盗窃要求强行打开保险柜或整柜搬走。

opts.t: None, because the custodian did not see the taking
opts.w: 看见拿走是抢劫的一种情形，不是唯一情形。

opts.t: Robbery, as property was taken from an unconscious custodian

bank.note: Robbery 三种情形：① 用实际或威胁的暴力从控制财产的人手里拿走；② 从被杀或失去知觉的保管人那里拿走（FOI 原例正是本题）；③ 保管人目睹无权的人拿走（顾客从收银机拿钱被经理看见）。处所内外的抢劫可用 Inside/Outside Robbery 附加险保。

bank.pt: 广式表盗窃 · 找不保的
bank.stem: Under the Commercial Property Broad Form (IBC 4037), theft of each of the following by outsiders is covered EXCEPT:

opts.t: A laptop taken from the sales counter
opts.w: 设备被外人拿走，Broad Form 保盗窃，不要求强力证据。

opts.t: Furniture stock taken from the showroom
opts.w: 存货被盗是 Broad Form 的好处之一。

opts.t: Securities taken from the office safe
A photocopier taken from the back office
opts.w: 复印机属设备，被外人偷走在 Broad Form 下承保。

bank.note: Broad Form 保存货与设备被外人非法拿走，不需要证明使用了强力。但财产保单一律不保现金与证券（IBC 4037 除外财产 (f)：money, cash cards, bullion, securities…），连 Broad Form 也不例外——要另买 Money and Securities (Broad Form)（练习卷第 51 题：收银机里的现金）。

bank.stem: The Money and Securities (Broad Form) policy insures which three causes of loss?

opts.t: Burglary, robbery and safe burglary only
opts.w: 这些都包括在「wrongful abstraction」里，但只是其中一部分。

opts.t: Destruction, disappearance and abstraction
Fire, theft and a mechanical breakdown of the safe
opts.w: 机械故障与现金证券无关。

opts.t: Forgery, counterfeit money and employee fraud
opts.w: 伪造伪钞是住宅扩展的项目，不是这张表的三项。

bank.note: Money and Securities (Broad Form)：最宽的现金证券保障，保 actual destruction（实际毁坏，如割枪开保险柜烧了钱）、disappearance（不在原处又无被盗迹象）、wrongful abstraction（一切不当拿走，含保险柜盗窃、抢劫、盗窃）。

bank.stem: Which two exposures excluded by commercial property forms does a Boiler and Machinery Policy insure?

opts.t: Explosion of owned boilers or pressure vessels, and breakdown
Earthquake damage and flood damage to the building
opts.w: 这两项靠地震、洪水附加险，不是锅炉机器险。

opts.t: Theft of machinery and vandalism to boilers by outsiders
opts.w: 盗窃与破坏由财产表或犯罪险处理。

opts.t: Loss of income and extra expense after a boiler failure
opts.w: 这是营业中断与额外费用险的事。

bank.note: 商业财产表除外：① 被保险人拥有、操作或控制的锅炉与超过每平方英寸 15 磅的压力容器爆炸对建筑造成的损失；② 电气或机械故障。Boiler and Machinery Policy 正保这两项（锅炉压力容器、空调机组、配电盘开关、电机、压缩机水泵）。保险人通常会检验；判定危险可立即中止保障，不必通知按揭权人。

bank.stem: A general contractor building a project that will take 10 months wants to buy only $50,000 of Builder's Risk coverage at the start and increase it as work proceeds. How will the insurer respond?

opts.t: It will agree and adjust the limit monthly at no extra cost
opts.w: FOI 说保险人要求一开始就按完工价值买，以免文书来回不断。

opts.t: It will agree but apply a co-insurance penalty to any loss
opts.w: FOI 没有这种安排，这是编的。

opts.t: It will require the contractor's tools to be added to the limit
opts.w: 承包商的工具恰恰是 Builder's Risk 的除外。

opts.t: It will require the completed value to be insured from the start

bank.note: Builder's Risk - Broad Form（IBC 4042）：保额要按完工价值买，避免工期里不停改保额；费率已反映价值逐步上升。保：构成完工项目的材料（被保险人或他人所有）；可选：景观、临时建筑、模板、围挡、脚手架。不保：承包商的工具设备、修补有缺陷材料工艺设计的费用（对其他已完工部分的后续损失除外）。

bank.stem: Work on a building insured under a Builder's Risk - Broad Form stops for 45 consecutive days while the owner arranges financing. The building is unoccupied. What is the status of the coverage?

opts.t: It continues until the building is completed and occupied
opts.w: 这是正常终止点，但停工超过 30 个连续日会提前自动终止。

opts.t: It continues until the policy's stated expiry date
opts.w: 建工险以工程状态终止，不只看到期日。

opts.t: It ended automatically after 30 days with no construction
It is suspended until work restarts, then resumes automatically
opts.w: 条款写的是终止（ceases），不是暂停后自动恢复。

bank.note: Builder's Risk 只在施工期间有效（所以也叫 COC policy）：工程无施工活动或原样搁置超过 30 个连续日自动终止；否则通常在建筑被占用时终止（练习卷第 62 题）。

bank.pt: 营业中断 · 危险要承保
bank.stem: A 6.5 earthquake damages a Vancouver furniture store, which closes for five weeks and loses $150,000 of income. The store's commercial property policy excludes earthquake. Its Business Interruption insurance is an endorsement to that policy. What does Business Interruption pay?

opts.t: $150,000, because the income loss is clearly documented
opts.w: 营业中断只在财产损失由财产保单承保的危险造成时才赔。

opts.t: Nothing, because the peril is uninsured under the property policy
Up to 12 months of income, regardless of the cause of the closure
opts.w: 12 个月是常见赔付期，前提仍是承保危险。

opts.t: Only the continuing expenses, but none of the lost profit
opts.w: 营业中断赔持续费用与利润损失两部分；本案是起因不在保。

bank.note: 营业中断险四个特点：① 补偿合同（赔持续费用＋利润损失）；② 与财产保单承保同样的危险——必须有承保危险造成的实际财产损失（FOI 原例：温哥华家具店地震停业五周，不赔）；③ 不受保单期限制（常见 12 个月）；④ 能减少损失的费用也赔。

bank.pt: 营业中断 · 民政当局
bank.stem: A serious fire in the building next door leads police to block customer access to Mei's shop for a week. Her own property is undamaged, and fire is an insured peril on her property policy. Does her Business Interruption insurance respond?

opts.t: Yes, because the peril restricting access is insured on her policy
No, because her own property suffered no physical damage
opts.w: FOI 写明的例外：民政当局禁止顾客进入，即使自己没受损也赔。

opts.t: Yes, but only after a 30-day waiting period has passed
opts.w: FOI 没有 30 天等待期，这是编的。

opts.t: No, because civil authority orders are always excluded
opts.w: 反了：这是 FOI 点名的例外情形。

bank.note: 例外：没有实际财产损失也可能失去收入——附近起火或暴动，警察、消防等民政当局禁止顾客进入；只要限制进入的那个危险是自己商业财产保单承保的，收入损失就赔。

bank.pt: 盈利式 vs 利润式
bank.stem: The Butlers' store burned on May 1 and reopened October 15, but a hospital customer never came back. Which statement about Business Interruption forms is correct?

opts.t: The Earnings Form pays until income returns to its expected level
opts.w: 反了：那是利润式；盈利式到财产修复为止。

opts.t: The Profits Form stops paying on October 15, when rebuilding ends
opts.w: 反了：利润式赔到收入恢复，失去的客户也算。

opts.t: Both forms stop paying on October 15, when the store reopens
opts.w: 只有盈利式在重建完成时停；利润式继续。

opts.t: The Profits Form pays until income returns to its expected level

bank.note: Earnings Form：从损失日赔到财产修复、重建或替换完成（本例 5 月 1 日至 10 月 15 日）。Profits Form：赔到收入恢复到没有损失时应有的水平——停业期间丢掉的客户（医院改向别家买）造成的收入下降也赔，所以 FOI 推荐利润式。两式通常都以 12 个月为期，可加费延长。

bank.pt: 额外费用险 · 找不赔的
bank.stem: Extra Expense Insurance (IBC 4027) pays each of the following costs incurred to continue normal operations after a loss EXCEPT:

opts.t: Rent for temporary premises while repairs are made
opts.w: 租临时场所是 FOI 列的额外费用。

opts.t: Overtime wages to get the business running again
opts.w: 加班工资是额外费用。

opts.t: Regular salaries that would have been paid anyway
Installing telephones at the temporary location
opts.w: 在临时地点装电话是 FOI 点名的额外费用。

bank.note: 额外费用险只赔比没有损失时多出来的费用：租临时场所、租临时设备、装电话、加班工资、赶工奖金。本来就要付的工资、按揭（练习卷第 65 题）不赔。适合停业几天都受不了的业务：保险经纪、旅行社、医生、报社、银行。

bank.pt: 额外费用 vs 减损费用
bank.stem: How does Extra Expense Insurance differ from the 'expenses to reduce loss' paid under Business Interruption insurance?

opts.t: Extra expense is paid only if it reduced the insurer's loss
opts.w: 反了：要证明减少了损失的是营业中断里的减损费用。

opts.t: Extra expense is paid without proof that it reduced the claim
Extra expense is limited to 12 months, while loss reduction is unlimited
opts.w: FOI 没有用期限来区分两者。

opts.t: Extra expense covers only rented equipment, never premises
opts.w: 额外费用险也赔租临时场所。

bank.note: FOI 的注：营业中断险赔「能减少损失的费用」，前提是证明确实减少了保险人本要赔的金额；额外费用险没有这个要求，为继续正常营业多花的钱就赔。

bank.stem: Under the IBC 4036 definition of 'premises', property in or on vehicles is included when the vehicles are within what distance of a described location?

opts.t: 100 metres
15 metres
opts.w: 15 是锅炉压力的每平方英寸磅数，不是距离。

opts.t: 30 metres
opts.w: 条款写的是 100 米（328 英尺）。

opts.t: 500 metres
opts.w: 条款写的是 100 米（328 英尺）。

bank.note: IBC 4036／4037 定义：premises＝每个所列地点产权线以内的全部区域、相邻人行道与车道之下的区域，以及该地点 100 米（328 英尺）以内车辆里或车上的财产。

bank.stem: A boutique insured under IBC 4037 has $6,000 of costume jewellery stock stolen by a burglar. What does the Broad Form pay before the deductible?

opts.t: $6,000, because the Broad Form insures theft of stock
opts.w: 4037 对珠宝、首饰、皮草另有除外，只保回第一个 $1,000 或列名危险造成的损失。

opts.t: $2,000, the limit for jewellery and furs
opts.w: $2,000 是家主表的数，商业广式表是第一个 $1,000。

opts.t: Nothing, as all jewellery is excluded property
opts.w: 除外有两个例外：任何损失的第一个 $1,000，以及列名危险造成的。

opts.t: $1,000, the first $1,000 of the loss

bank.note: IBC 4037 除外财产 (h)：furs, fur garments, jewels, jewellery, costume jewellery, watches, pearls, or precious and semi-precious stones，但不适用于 ① 任何承保损失的第一个 $1,000，② 列名危险（Named Perils）直接造成的损失。盗窃不是列名危险，所以赔 $1,000。

bank.stem: Under IBC 4037, each of the following losses is excluded EXCEPT:

opts.t: A shortage of stock discovered only when taking inventory
opts.w: 神秘失踪与盘点短缺明文除外。

opts.t: Stock spoiled by a power interruption with no other damage
opts.w: 电力供应中断造成的损失除外（承保危险直接造成的除外）。

opts.t: Stock destroyed by a fire that started in a neighbour's shop
Wear and tear on the display racks over several years
opts.w: 磨损、锈蚀、逐渐老化除外。

bank.note: 4037 是 all risks，但除外清单很长：盘点短缺与神秘失踪、磨损锈蚀老化、修补缺陷材料工艺设计、电力水气供应中断、温度极端、地震、洪水、下水道倒灌、机械电气故障、啮齿动物害虫、加工中的财产等。火灾当然保。

bank.stem: An IBC 4036 policy requires the insured to keep fire extinguishers serviced. One extinguisher in the back office was overdue for service when a windstorm tore off the roof. The insured proves the lapse had nothing to do with the loss. What happens?

opts.t: The claim is denied for breach of a condition of the policy
opts.w: 条款第 9 条：证明不遵守既没造成也没加重损失的，保险人不得以此拒赔。

opts.t: The claim is paid, as the breach neither caused nor worsened the loss
The claim is paid at 80%, the usual penalty for breaching a condition
opts.w: 没有这种折扣罚则，这是编的。

opts.t: The claim is paid only after the policy is endorsed to remove the condition
opts.w: 条款本身就给了这个保护，不需要批单。

bank.note: IBC 4036 第 9 条 Breach of Condition：不遵守条件，之后的损失不赔；但被保险人证明不遵守既没造成也没加重损失的，保险人不得以此拒赔；对被保险人无法控制的那部分处所不遵守，不影响保障。对照练习卷第 28 题：违反条件看因果，违反保证不看。

bank.pt: 保单条件 · 重大变更
bank.stem: Under the Commercial Property Policy Conditions, after the insurer is notified of a material change and asks for an additional premium, how long does the insured have to pay it?

opts.t: Fifteen days from receipt of the notice
Five days from the date of the notice
opts.w: 5 天是保险人亲自送达终止通知的期限。

opts.t: Thirty days from the date of the notice
opts.w: 30 天是保险人以其他理由挂号信终止的期限。

opts.t: Sixty days from the date of the notice
opts.w: 60 天是完成损失证明后的付款期限。

bank.note: 条件 4 Material Change：被保险人能控制、知道的重大变更，未及时书面通知的，变更涉及的部分合同无效；保险人收到通知后可以退还未满期保费并注销，或要求被保险人收到通知 15 天内补交保费，不交则合同不再有效。

bank.pt: 保单条件 · 终止通知
bank.stem: An insurer wants to terminate a commercial property policy by registered mail because the insured has not paid the premium. Under the Commercial Property Policy Conditions, how much notice must it give?

opts.t: Five days
opts.w: 5 天是亲自送达的通知期。

opts.t: Thirty days
opts.w: 30 天是以挂号信、因欠费以外的理由终止。

opts.t: Sixty days
opts.w: 条件 5 没有 60 天这一档。

opts.t: Fifteen days

bank.note: 条件 5 Termination：保险人终止要提前书面通知——亲自送达 5 天、挂号信因欠费 15 天、挂号信因其他理由 30 天，15 天与 30 天从挂号信到达收件邮局的次日起算；被保险人可随时要求终止（按短期费率退费）。这些条件与第 3 章的法定条件同源，BC 现行写法以《Insurance Act》s.29 为准（第 3 章讲）。

bank.stem: After a bitter argument, Mike deliberately set fire to three grain bins on his neighbour's farm. Which statement best describes Mike's position?

opts.t: Only a civil action is possible, because the loss was to private property
opts.w: 故意纵火既是对社会的错行（刑事），也造成私人损失（民事），两套法律可以同时启动。

opts.t: His liability policy will pay the neighbour, since the neighbour is a third party
opts.w: 受害人是第三方没错，但故意造成的损害责任保单不赔。

opts.t: He may face both criminal prosecution and a civil action for damages
Only criminal prosecution is possible, because the fire was set on purpose
opts.w: 刑事起诉不排除民事索赔；民法的目标是让受害人拿到赔偿，刑法基本不管这件事。

bank.note: FOI 的 Mike 烧粮仓的例子：同一行为可以同时引发刑事起诉和民事索赔，而责任保单对故意造成的损害一概不赔。

bank.pt: 刑法的特征 · 找不对的
bank.stem: All of the following statements about criminal law are true EXCEPT:

opts.t: It deals with wrongs committed against society
opts.w: 这是FOI 对刑法的第一句定义，说法正确。

opts.t: Its rules are defined by statute in the Criminal Code
opts.w: 刑法规则全部由《刑法典》成文规定，说法正确。

opts.t: All Canadian provinces are subject to the same criminal laws
opts.w: 刑法全国统一，各省适用同一套，说法正确。

opts.t: Its main purpose is to compensate victims for their losses

bank.note: 刑法定罪并处罚，FOI 口径明说它很少关心补偿受害人；让受害人得到赔偿是民法的目标。

bank.stem: In the common law provinces, the common law system is based on which of the following?

opts.t: Written rules passed by the provincial legislative assemblies
opts.w: 这是成文法（statute law）的来源，不是普通法的基础。

opts.t: The doctrine of precedence
The terms of private agreements between the parties
opts.w: 私人协议的条款是合同法处理的对象，不是普通法这套体系的基础。

opts.t: The penalties set out in the Criminal Code
opts.w: 《刑法典》属于刑法，是成文规则，与普通法的先例原则无关。

bank.note: 普通法建立在先例原则上：情形相似的案件，法院一般按以前的判决来判。成文法才是立法机关的书面规则。

bank.stem: A long-standing common law precedent treats anyone under 21 as a minor. A province then passes a statute setting the age of majority at 19. In that province, which rule applies?

opts.t: The precedent, because common law is the main legal system outside Quebec
opts.w: 普通法是主体制度不假，但成文法一经通过就优先于同一事项的先例。

opts.t: The precedent, until a court overturns it in a later case
opts.w: 不需要法院先推翻先例；成文法通过即优先。

opts.t: Whichever rule is more favourable to the minor in the particular case
opts.w: FOI 口径里没有「择有利者适用」的规则，优先顺序是确定的。

opts.t: The statute, because statute law takes priority over common law precedent

bank.note: 成文法通过后，优先于针对同一事项的任何普通法先例。FOI 用的正是成年年龄这个例子（21 岁降到 18 或 19 岁）。

bank.stem: In tort law, what is the term for a person who commits a wrong that harms an innocent party?

opts.t: Tortfeasor
Plaintiff
opts.w: plaintiff 是提起诉讼的一方，也就是受害人，不是实施错行的人。

opts.t: Bailee
opts.w: bailee 是暂时保管他人财产的人，与是否侵权无关。

opts.t: Licensee
opts.w: licensee 是经占用人同意、为自己目的进入场所的人。

bank.note: 实施侵权的人叫 tortfeasor；两人以上一起造成损害叫 joint tortfeasors。原告是 plaintiff，被告是 defendant。

bank.pt: 侵权三要素 · 找不是的
bank.stem: Certain elements must be present in every tort action. Which of the following is NOT one of them?

opts.t: A duty was owed to the person who was harmed
opts.w: 这是第一要素 duty owed。

opts.t: The defendant intended to cause the injury or damage
The duty owed to the plaintiff was breached
opts.w: 这是第二要素 duty breached。

opts.t: Damages were suffered as a proximate result of the defendant's actions
opts.w: 这是第三要素：损害是被告行为的直接后果。

bank.note: 三要素是有义务、违反义务、损害是直接后果。「故意」不是要素：非故意侵权（过失）照样成立，而且那正是责任险的主要对象。

bank.pt: 近因 · 只对直接后果负责
bank.stem: A shopper breaks her wrist when she slips on a spill a store failed to clean up. On the way to the clinic, her taxi is struck by a speeding driver and she also suffers a neck injury. For which injuries would a court hold the store liable?

opts.t: Both injuries, because neither would have happened without the spill
opts.w: 「没有前一件事就没有后一件事」不够；中间插入了超速司机这个新的主因，因果链断了。

opts.t: Neither injury, because the later collision replaces the store's negligence
opts.w: 后面的事故只切断颈部伤的因果链，手腕骨折仍是积水的直接后果。

opts.t: The broken wrist only, as it is the proximate result of the store's negligence
The neck injury only, because it was the more recent cause of loss
opts.w: 近因不是「时间上最近」的原因，而是不间断地导致结果的原因。

bank.note: 与 FOI 的「邮递员断腿、救护车又被撞」同理：被告只对自己直接造成的损害负责，别人的行为造成的不算。

bank.pt: 没有实际损害就没有侵权
bank.stem: A visitor slips on an icy walkway that the occupier carelessly failed to sand, but gets up completely unhurt and with no damage to his belongings. Could a tort action by the visitor succeed?

opts.t: No, because no actual injury or damage was suffered
Yes, because the occupier owed a duty and breached it
opts.w: 有义务、也违反了，但三要素缺第三项（实际损害），侵权不成立。

opts.t: Yes, because the result of leaving ice unsanded was foreseeable
opts.w: 可预见性是过失的条件之一，但没有损害就没有可赔的东西。

opts.t: No, because an occupier owes no duty to a visitor on a walkway
opts.w: 占用人对使用场所的人有合理安全的义务，这句话本身就错。

bank.note: 三要素缺一不可。前两项都具备，但没有实际的伤害或损失，诉讼不会成功。

bank.pt: 责任险为哪类侵权设计
bank.stem: Liability insurance policies are primarily designed to insure which of the following?

opts.t: The intentional torts of insureds
opts.w: 故意造成的伤害或损害，责任保单明确不赔。

opts.t: The criminal acts of insureds
opts.w: 保险公司不保被保险人犯罪行为的财务后果。

opts.t: The contractual promises of insureds
opts.w: 合同上自己揽下的责任原则上是除外的，不是责任险的主要对象。

opts.t: The unintentional torts of insureds

bank.note: 责任保单主要为被保险人的非故意侵权设计，其中最重要的是过失；故意侵权和犯罪行为都不保。

bank.stem: When a court decides whether a defendant was negligent, the defendant's conduct is measured against the standard of:

opts.t: A person with expert training in the activity
opts.w: 标准不是专家，而是处在相同情形下的合理人。

opts.t: A reasonable person in similar circumstances
The defendant's own usual level of care
opts.w: 标准是客观的合理人，不是被告自己平时的水平。

opts.t: The most careful person in the community
opts.w: 法律不要求做到最谨慎，只要求做到合理人会做的程度。

bank.note: 过失＝合理人会做的没做，或合理谨慎的人不会做的做了。尺子是同样情形下的合理人。

bank.stem: A golfer tees off and the ball strikes a person standing 400 yards down the fairway. Applying the foreseeability test for negligence, the golfer would most likely:

opts.t: Be negligent, because golfers are strictly liable for any ball they hit
opts.w: 打高尔夫不是严格责任活动，仍要看有没有过失。

opts.t: Be negligent, because an injury actually occurred
opts.w: 有损害不等于有过失；后果还必须是可以合理预见的。

opts.t: Not be negligent, because the injured person was a trespasser
opts.w: 题干没有说伤者是侵入者，这一条也不是FOI 口径判断的依据。

opts.t: Not be negligent, because the injury could not reasonably be foreseen

bank.note: FOI 的边界：前一组才走出 100 码就开球，伤人可预见；打到 400 码外的人不可预见，不构成过失。

bank.pt: 过失的举证 · 找不对的
bank.stem: All of the following statements about proving negligence are true EXCEPT:

opts.t: The plaintiff must show that a legal duty owed to the plaintiff was breached
opts.w: 过失必须被证明，原告要证明被告违反了对他的法律义务，说法正确。

opts.t: The defendant must first prove that he or she acted as a reasonable person
The results of the act or failure to act must have been foreseeable
opts.w: 可预见性是过失的额外条件之一，说法正确。

opts.t: Failing to do what a reasonable person would do can amount to negligence
opts.w: 过失定义的前一半就是「该做的没做」，说法正确。

bank.note: 一般规则：被控侵权的人在被证明之前是无辜的，举证责任在原告。只有严格责任才把举证倒过来。

bank.pt: 严格责任 · 活动放错了地方
bank.stem: A business lawfully stores large quantities of a highly flammable solvent in a densely populated neighbourhood. Despite careful handling, a fire damages nearby homes. On what basis is the business most likely to be held liable?

opts.t: Vicarious liability, since the business is responsible for the acts of others
opts.w: 替代责任是对他人（如雇员）行为的间接责任，本题没有他人的侵权。

opts.t: Intentional tort, because the business chose to store the solvent there
opts.w: 选择储存不等于故意造成损害，故意侵权要求明知不法而为。

opts.t: Strict liability, as a reasonable activity carried on in an unreasonable setting
No basis, because the business took every reasonable precaution
opts.w: 严格责任正是不问过错：再小心，出了事也要负责。

bank.note: FOI 列的第一种严格责任活动：合理的活动放在不合理的地点，例子就是在人口稠密区大量储存高度易燃物。

bank.stem: How do liability insurance policies generally treat injury or damage arising from activities for which the insured is held strictly liable?

opts.t: They respond to pay, unless the activity is otherwise excluded
They never respond, because strict liability is treated as intentional
opts.w: 严格责任不是故意，只是不要求证明过错。

opts.t: They respond only if the insured is also proven to be negligent
opts.w: 严格责任不问过失，保单也不另设这个条件。

opts.t: They respond only to the cost of defending the claim
opts.w: FOI 口径说的是赔付伤害或损害，不是只付抗辩费。

bank.note: FOI 原意：除非另有除外，责任保单一般会赔被保险人负严格责任的活动造成的伤害或损害。

bank.stem: Tired of break-ins at his cabin, an owner rigs a concealed device meant to injure anyone who forces the door. A burglar is badly hurt by it. Under the common law rules on trespassers:

opts.t: The owner is not liable, because no duty of any kind is owed to a trespasser
opts.w: 对侵入者的义务最低，但不是零：不得设陷阱、不得故意伤害。

opts.t: The owner is liable only if the burglar was a child
opts.w: 对侵入者不得设陷阱的义务不以年龄为条件。

opts.t: The owner is not liable, because the burglar was committing a crime
opts.w: FOI 口径的规则没有因侵入者犯罪而免除「不得设陷阱」这项义务。

opts.t: The owner may be liable, because occupiers must not set traps for trespassers

bank.note: 占用人对侵入者负最低义务，但有两件事不能做：设陷阱、故意伤害。

bank.stem: A building site left unfenced over a weekend attracts neighbourhood children, and one is injured while playing there. Under the traditional common law position on children and attractive nuisances, the occupier of such property must:

opts.t: Simply refrain from setting traps or intentionally causing harm
opts.w: 这是对侵入者的最低义务；对儿童，FOI 口径给的是最重的一档。

opts.t: Make sure the premises are free of any danger whatsoever
Simply warn of concealed dangers the occupier knows about
opts.w: 这是普通法对 licensee 的义务，不是对儿童的。

opts.t: Do nothing further, as the children entered without permission
opts.w: 普通法认为儿童缺乏避险判断、需要保护，不能因未经许可就没有义务。

bank.note: 工地这类天然吸引儿童的财产叫 attractive nuisance（allurement）。FOI 口径给占用人的义务是：场所须免于任何危险。这题容易按一般法理选成侵入者或被许可人那一档；考试按 FOI 口径的最重一档答，BC 现行法的标准其实是「在一切情形下合理」。

bank.stem: A client visiting an accountant's office slips on a loose stair tread in the shared stairway of a building with several tenants. Under common law precedent, who is responsible for the condition of the stairway?

opts.t: The landlord, who is responsible for areas common to all tenants
The accountant, because the client was visiting the accountant's office
opts.w: 楼梯是全体租户共用的区域，不在会计师租用和控制的范围内。

opts.t: All tenants jointly, in proportion to the space each one rents
opts.w: FOI 口径里没有让租户按面积分担公共区域责任的规则。

opts.t: No one, because a landlord never warrants that premises are fit for use
opts.w: 「不保证适用性」是对租户租用部分的默认规则，公共区域是明确的例外。

bank.note: 多租户建筑里，屋顶、楼梯、停车区、大堂等公共区域的状况，房东对租户和其他人都负责。

bank.stem: A dry cleaner protects customers' garments with the same locks and alarm system used by other dry cleaners in the city. Thieves defeat the system and steal a customer's coat. In tort law, is the dry cleaner liable to the customer?

opts.t: Yes, because a bailee for hire must protect property from all sources of loss
opts.w: 保管人不是对一切损失负责，只在因过失违反通常注意义务时负责。

opts.t: Yes, because a bailee for hire owes the highest duty of care
opts.w: 标准是 ordinary care（同行水平），不是最高注意。

opts.t: No, because bailees are liable only where a written contract says so
opts.w: 保管人在侵权法上本来就有通常注意义务，合同只是可能另加责任。

opts.t: No, because it exercised the ordinary care used by others in the same business

bank.note: 有偿保管人的标准是同行会尽的注意（ordinary care）。做到了同行水平，损失又不是因为它的过失，侵权法上就不负责。

bank.pt: 替代责任的边界 · 办私事
bank.stem: A furniture store's installer agrees, for $25 cash and without telling his employer, to dismantle a customer's old dining suite during his lunch hour. He damages the customer's walls. Is the store liable for the damage?

opts.t: Yes, because employers are liable for all acts of their employees
opts.w: 替代责任限于「职务过程中」，不是雇员的一切行为。

opts.t: Yes, because the damage happened at the home of a store customer
opts.w: 地点和对象不是标准，关键是他当时在替谁干活。

opts.t: No, because the employee was on a frolic of his own
No, because an employer is never liable for the torts of an employee
opts.w: 职务过程中的侵权恰恰由雇主负责，这句话方向反了。

bank.note: 雇员放下职务去办自己的事叫 on a frolic of their own，由此造成的损害雇主不负责。FOI 的 Harry 午休接私活就是这个例子。

bank.pt: 替代责任 · 找雇主要负责的
bank.stem: Under common law precedent, an employer is NOT liable in all of the following situations EXCEPT:

opts.t: An employee carelessly damages a customer's floor while making an assigned delivery
An employee hires a stranger, without the employer's consent, to finish his work
opts.w: 未经雇主同意把工作转托给非雇员，是FOI 列的第一种例外，雇主不负责。

opts.t: An employee takes time off from his duties to attend to a personal matter
opts.w: 办私事（frolic of their own）是第二种例外，雇主不负责。

opts.t: An employee uses the employer's loader, without authorization, for a private job
opts.w: 未经许可为自己的目的使用雇主财产，是第三种例外，雇主不负责。

bank.note: 三种例外都是雇员超出职责范围。只有「在指派的送货中不小心弄坏东西」是职务过程中的侵权，雇主要负责。

bank.stem: An employee who is covered by the provincial workers' compensation plan is seriously injured at work when a defective ladder supplied by the employer breaks. What is the employee's remedy?

opts.t: Sue the employer for negligence, because the employer supplied the ladder
opts.w: 受工伤保险保障的雇员被禁止就工伤起诉雇主，哪怕雇主有过失。

opts.t: Claim plan benefits only if the employer is first shown to be at fault
opts.w: 工伤给付是无过错的，不需要先证明雇主有过错。

opts.t: Claim plan benefits and also sue the employer for the same injury
opts.w: 领给付的代价就是放弃起诉雇主的权利，二者不能兼得。

opts.t: Claim benefits directly from the workers' compensation plan, regardless of fault

bank.note: 工伤保险给雇员无过错给付，作为交换，雇员放弃就工伤起诉雇主的权利。FOI 的 Harry 从六米高的梯子上摔下来就是这个结论。

bank.pt: 独立承包商 · 找不共担的
bank.stem: An occupier and an independent contractor will share liability for injury or damage in all of the following situations EXCEPT when:

opts.t: The work being contracted is inherently dangerous
opts.w: 本身危险的工作（如用炸药清树桩）是FOI 列的共担情形。

opts.t: The injury results from defective equipment supplied by the occupier
opts.w: 占用人提供的设备有缺陷造成伤害，是FOI 列的共担情形。

opts.t: The contractor was chosen with care and left to decide how to do the work
The occupier controls how the work is carried out
opts.w: 占用人控制施工方式，是FOI 列的共担情形。

bank.note: 选任尽了合理注意、工作本应进行、又让承包商自己决定怎么干——这正是占用人不负责的标准情形，承包商对自己的侵权负责。

bank.pt: 连带责任 · 各负全额
bank.stem: Two neighbours carelessly fell a tree together and destroy parked cars. A court awards the car owners $90,000. Each neighbour insists the other was mostly at fault and they cannot agree on equal shares. What does the law provide?

opts.t: Each neighbour is liable for only $45,000 until fault is finally apportioned
opts.w: 各付一半只是实践中的做法；法律规定的是各自对全额负责。

opts.t: Each neighbour is held liable for the entire $90,000 award
The car owners must wait until the neighbours settle their own dispute
opts.w: 规则的目的正是不让原告等侵权人之间吵完。

opts.t: The neighbour who last worked on the tree is liable for the full award
opts.w: FOI 口径里没有「最后动手的人负全责」的规则，这只是当事人自己的说法。

bank.note: 共同侵权人对均分有争议时，各自对全额负责，好让原告尽快拿到赔偿；两人之间怎么分另行解决。

bank.pt: 野生动物 · 严格责任
bank.stem: A couple keeps a cheetah under a special permit in a sturdy, locked cage. A visiting child reaches into the cage and is mauled. On what basis are the owners liable?

opts.t: Negligence, but only if the cage is shown to have been inadequate
opts.w: 野生动物适用严格责任，不需要证明笼子不合格或主人有过失。

opts.t: They are not liable, because the animal had never injured anyone before
opts.w: 「以前没伤过人」对野生动物不是抗辩；对家养的狗FOI 口径也说没有第一口免费。

opts.t: Strict liability, because the animal's natural ferocity is common knowledge
Vicarious liability, because owners answer for the acts of their animals
opts.w: 替代责任讲的是对他人（如雇员）行为的责任，不是对动物。

bank.note: 凶猛或野性属于常识的动物，主人对其造成的伤害负严格责任，不问有没有过失。FOI 的例子是宠物猎豹 Fluffy。

bank.pt: 父母的责任 · 找不负责的
bank.stem: Under common law precedent, parents will be financially responsible for damage caused by their child in all of the following situations EXCEPT:

opts.t: The parents gave the child an air rifle, which the child fired at a neighbour's car
opts.w: 把危险物交给孩子控制，是父母负责的四种情形之一。

opts.t: The child, told by a parent to paint the fence, sprayed paint on a neighbour's house
opts.w: 孩子按父母的指示行事造成损害，父母负责。

opts.t: The child damaged a customer's property while working in the parents' business
opts.w: 孩子受雇于父母的生意时造成损害，父母负责。

opts.t: The properly supervised child carelessly rode a bicycle into a parked car

bank.note: 父母一般不为子女的侵权付钱。监管到位、没有交给危险物、不是按父母指示、也不在父母的生意里干活——四种例外一个都不沾，就回到默认规则。

bank.pt: 承保协议的条件 · 找不是的
bank.stem: Under the main insuring agreement found in most liability policies, all of the following must be true for bodily injury or property damage to be covered EXCEPT:

opts.t: It must be caused by an occurrence as defined
opts.w: 承保协议要求损害由一次 occurrence 造成，这是条件之一。

opts.t: It must occur during the policy period
opts.w: 损害必须发生在保单期内，这是事故发生制的核心条件。

opts.t: It must take place within the coverage territory
opts.w: 损害必须发生在承保地域内，这是条件之一。

opts.t: It must be reported during the policy period

bank.note: FOI 的承保协议三个条件：由 occurrence 造成、发生在保单期内、发生在承保地域内。没有「索赔须在保单期内提出」这一条——那是 claims-made 保单的写法，FOI 讲的是事故发生制。

bank.pt: 事故发生制 · 保单过期后才被起诉
bank.stem: A customer was injured in a store in 2023 while the store's occurrence-basis liability policy was in force. The store closed and the policy was not renewed in 2024. In 2025 the customer sues. Which policy, if any, responds?

opts.t: No policy, because no liability policy was in force when the action was started
opts.w: 事故发生制不看起诉时有没有保单，只看伤害发生时保单是否有效。

opts.t: The 2023 policy, because the injury occurred during its policy period
No policy, because the claim was not reported before the policy ended
opts.w: 「保单期内报告索赔」是 claims-made 的条件，不是事故发生制的。

opts.t: Any policy the owner buys in 2025, because that is when the claim is made
opts.w: 事后买的保单不保已经发生的损害；触发点是伤害发生的时间。

bank.note: 事故发生制只问伤害或损害是否发生在保单期内，不问什么时候被索赔。所以旧保单要留着：多年后被起诉，找的是事发那年的保单。

bank.pt: 人身伤害的范围 · 找不属于的
bank.stem: As defined in liability policies, "bodily injury" includes all of the following EXCEPT:

opts.t: Physical injury suffered in a fall on defective stairs
opts.w: 从有缺陷的楼梯摔下受伤，是FOI 举的人身伤害的典型例子。

opts.t: Sickness or disease caused by the insured's product
opts.w: 人身伤害的定义包括疾病，FOI 举的是有缺陷植入物致病的例子。

opts.t: Humiliation suffered by a person who was wrongfully detained
Death that results at a later date from the injury
opts.w: 由伤害在日后导致的死亡，算同一次人身伤害的一部分。

bank.note: Bodily injury＝身体伤害＋疾病＋由此导致的死亡。被错误扣留带来的羞辱不是身体上的伤害，它属于第 10 章讲的 personal injury（人身伤害以外的伤害）。

bank.stem: A fire started by a neighbour's child destroys the Butlers' home. Besides the damage to the house, the Butlers pay to rent a temporary dwelling and to board their dog. Under the neighbour's liability policy, these extra costs are:

opts.t: Not covered, because they are not physical damage to tangible property
opts.w: 财产损害的定义不止物理损坏，还明写包括由此产生的使用损失。

opts.t: Covered as supplementary payments, in addition to the limit
opts.w: 附加给付是抗辩费、诉讼费、利息等费用，不是给第三方的损失赔偿。

opts.t: Covered as bodily injury, because the family was displaced
opts.w: 流离失所不是身体伤害、疾病或死亡，不属于人身伤害。

opts.t: Covered as property damage, because they arise from loss of use of the premises

bank.note: 财产损害包括有形财产的物理损坏以及由此导致的使用损失。租临时住处、寄养宠物的额外开支，都是失去房屋使用造成的。

bank.stem: Which of the following is included in the definition of "property damage" in a liability policy?

opts.t: Loss of use of tangible property that has not been physically injured
Punitive damages awarded for the destruction of tangible property
opts.w: 惩罚性赔偿不是财产损害，而且责任保单根本不赔。

opts.t: Damage to tangible property that is owned by the named insured
opts.w: 责任险只保第三方；被保险人自己的财产不在其中。

opts.t: A drop in the market value of property that was never affected
opts.w: 定义讲的是物理损坏和使用损失，没有「未受影响财产的市价下跌」。

bank.note: 定义的两半：有形财产的物理损坏及由此产生的使用损失；没有受到物理损坏的有形财产的使用损失。

bank.stem: Betty, who is named as an insured on a liability policy, falls on her own front steps and breaks her wrist. She asks whether the liability coverage will pay for her injury. The correct answer is:

opts.t: Yes, because the injury was accidental and happened on the insured premises
opts.w: 意外、发生在自家场所都不够；责任险赔的是被保险人欠别人的赔偿。

opts.t: Yes, but only up to the limit that applies to each occurrence
opts.w: 限额是怎么赔的问题；这里是赔不赔的问题，她不是第三方。

opts.t: No, because liability coverage applies only to injury caused to third parties
No, because bodily injury coverage requires that a lawsuit be started first
opts.w: 不赔的原因不是没有诉讼，而是受伤的是被保险人自己。

bank.note: 责任保单保的是被保险人给第三方造成的伤害或损害；第三方＝保单上没有列名的任何人。被保险人自己受伤属于第一方损失。

bank.stem: A shopper who has been feeling ill faints in a store and is hurt. Nothing about the premises contributed to the fall, but the owner feels he should pay because it happened in his store. Will the store's liability policy respond to pay damages?

opts.t: Yes, because the injury occurred on the insured's premises
opts.w: 发生在场所上不等于占用人有法律责任。

opts.t: No, because the policy responds only when the insured is legally liable
Yes, because the insured has accepted responsibility for the injury
opts.w: 被保险人自己认不认不算数；保单只认法律责任。

opts.t: No, because fainting is a sickness and sickness is not bodily injury
opts.w: 疾病恰恰包括在人身伤害的定义里；不赔的原因是没有法律责任。

bank.note: 被保险人可能觉得有道义上的责任，但保单只在他法律上有责任时才响应，过失必须成立。

bank.stem: After losing control of her riding mower and injuring two children, Betty tells her broker she is sure she is legally liable. Which statement is correct?

opts.t: Betty's own admission is what establishes her legal liability
opts.w: 被保险人通常没有足够的法律知识下这个判断，她的看法不构成法律责任。

opts.t: Her insurer decides legal liability once its adjuster has investigated
opts.w: 保险公司可以决定和解，但法律责任不由保险公司认定。

opts.t: Her broker should confirm liability so that the claim can be paid quickly
opts.w: 经纪人无权也不应认定客户的法律责任。

opts.t: Only the courts can determine legal liability, although most claims settle out of court

bank.note: 只有法院有权认定一个人对伤害或损害的法律责任；不过证据明显时，保险人多数会同意庭外和解。

bank.stem: Smoke from a neighbour's improperly vented fireplace gradually discolours the side of the Butlers' house over five months. No single date of damage can be identified. Does the neighbour's occurrence-basis liability policy apply?

opts.t: Yes, because occurrence includes continuous or repeated exposure
No, because an occurrence must be a sudden event that can be fixed in time
opts.w: 那是 accident 的定义；occurrence 还包括长期发生的损害。

opts.t: No, because gradual damage of this kind is never the result of negligence
opts.w: FOI 口径里没有这条规则；排烟不当正是可能的过失。

opts.t: Yes, but only for the damage that happened during the first month
opts.w: 保单没有「只赔第一个月」的限制；整个持续暴露算一次 occurrence。

bank.note: Occurrence 包括突发的意外事故，也包括持续或反复暴露于大体相同的有害条件。这是FOI 口径邻居壁炉熏墙的例子。

bank.stem: Which statement correctly describes the relationship between an "accident" and an "occurrence"?

opts.t: An occurrence is one kind of accident and is the narrower of the two terms
opts.w: 方向反了：accident 是 occurrence 的一种，occurrence 更宽。

opts.t: The two terms have the same meaning and are used interchangeably
opts.w: accident 限于突发、时间确定的事件；occurrence 还包括长期暴露。

opts.t: An accident happens over a long period, while an occurrence is sudden
opts.w: 两个词的特征被对调了。

opts.t: An accident is sudden and fixed in time, while an occurrence also covers long-term exposure

bank.note: Accident＝能确定时间的突发、不寻常事件；occurrence 把它包括在内，还加上长期持续或反复的暴露。

bank.pt: 每次事故限额 · 计算
bank.stem: A business has an occurrence-basis liability policy with a $1,000,000 limit per occurrence and no aggregate limit. In one policy year it is legally liable for two separate losses: $600,000 in March and $1,400,000 in August. What is the total the insurer pays in damages?

opts.w: 这是把限额当成全年总上限；没有累计限额时，限额每次事故重新可用。
第一次只损失 $600,000，按实际损失赔，不是每次都赔满限额。
这只是第二次损失的金额，而且第二次也要受 $1,000,000 的限额约束。

bank.note: 第一次 $600,000 全赔；第二次超过限额，只赔 $1,000,000，其余 $400,000 自付。合计 $1,600,000。每次事故之后限额重新可用。

bank.stem: A liability policy carries a $1,000,000 per-occurrence limit and a $2,000,000 aggregate limit. During the policy term the insured is legally liable for three separate losses, in this order: $900,000, $800,000 and $700,000. How much does the insurer pay for the third loss?

opts.w: 第三次损失在每次事故限额内，但累计限额只剩 $300,000。

opts.t: Nothing
opts.w: 累计限额还剩 $300,000，没有用完。

bank.note: 前两次共赔 $1,700,000，累计限额 $2,000,000 只剩 $300,000。累计限额是保单期内全部有效索赔的最高赔付额。

bank.pt: 分项限额 · 多人受伤
bank.stem: A liability policy is written with split limits of $100,000/$200,000/$50,000. In one occurrence three people suffer bodily injury, with damages assessed in this order: $150,000, $60,000 and $70,000. What is the total the policy pays for bodily injury?

opts.w: 这是三人损害的简单相加，既没有压每人限额，也超过了合计限额。
压了每人限额（100＋60＋70），但忘了每次事故合计限额 $200,000。
$50,000 是财产损害限额，不能加到人身伤害上。

bank.pt: 分项限额 · 一人受伤加财产损害
bank.stem: A liability policy has split limits of $100,000/$200,000/$50,000. In one occurrence the insured is legally liable for $180,000 of bodily injury to one person and $65,000 of damage to that person's vehicle. What does the policy pay?

opts.w: 这是全额相加；人身伤害受每人限额约束，财产损害受 $50,000 约束。
把人身伤害按 $180,000 全赔了；只有一个人受伤，适用的是每人限额 $100,000。
$200,000 是多人受伤时的人身伤害合计限额，不是人身加财产的总上限。

bank.note: 只有一人受伤，人身伤害按每人限额赔 $100,000；财产损害按第三个数赔 $50,000。合计 $150,000。第二个数只在多人受伤时才用得上。

bank.stem: A court orders an insured to pay $400,000 in compensatory damages and $100,000 in punitive damages. The insured's liability limit is $1,000,000. How much of the award does the insurer pay?

opts.t: $500,000, because the total award is within the limit of insurance
opts.w: 在限额内也不赔惩罚性赔偿；责任保单只赔补偿性赔偿。

opts.t: $400,000, because the policy pays compensatory damages only
$100,000, because punitive damages are paid before other damages
opts.w: 方向反了：惩罚性赔偿完全由被保险人自己承担。

opts.t: Nothing, because an award of punitive damages voids the coverage
opts.w: 惩罚性赔偿只是不赔，不会让补偿性赔偿的保障失效。

bank.note: 责任保单只赔补偿性赔偿。惩罚性或惩戒性赔偿是为了惩罚被告、威慑他人，完全由被保险人自己承担。

bank.pt: 及时报告的对象是事故
bank.stem: A restaurant patron slips on a wet floor, says she is fine and leaves. The owner does not tell his liability insurer. Twelve days later the patron's lawyer writes to say she broke her hip and will sue. Which of the owner's duties under the policy was not met?

opts.t: To promptly notify the insurer of any occurrence that could lead to a claim
To pay for the patron's medical treatment as soon as the injury was known
