opts.w: 被保险人没有这项义务；除急救外自行付款反而是禁止的。

opts.t: To obtain a signed statement from the patron saying that she was unhurt
opts.w: 保单没有要求被保险人取得对方的声明。

opts.t: To wait until a claim was actually made before contacting the insurer
opts.w: 正相反：义务的对象是可能引起索赔的事故，不能等索赔来了才报。

bank.note: 义务是事故一发生就及时报告，哪怕对方说没事。FOI 的 Mr. Good 被电线绊倒的例子就是这个结论：及时报告是保障的一项条件。

bank.pt: 被保险人的义务 · 找不是的
bank.stem: In the event of an occurrence, claim or action, a liability insurer requires the insured to do all of the following EXCEPT:

opts.t: Immediately provide copies of any legal documents received
opts.w: 收到法律文件立即转交副本，是义务之一（notice of a claim）。

opts.t: Authorize the insurer to obtain records and other information
opts.w: 授权保险人取得警察、消防等机关的记录，是义务之一。

opts.t: Negotiate directly with the claimant to keep the settlement low
Help the insurer investigate, settle or defend the claim
opts.w: 协助调查、和解或抗辩，是义务之一。

bank.note: 调查、抗辩、和解的权利专属于保险人。被保险人自己去和对方谈，不但不是义务，还侵犯了这项权利。

bank.stem: A customer cuts her arm on a broken display case. Without contacting his insurer, the store owner pays $80 for first aid supplies used at the scene and then gives the customer $500 "to forget the whole thing." Which amount, if any, can be passed on to the insurer?

opts.t: Both amounts, because they were paid in good faith to reduce the claim
opts.w: 善意不是标准；除急救外，未经保险人同意的自愿付款不予偿还。

opts.t: Only the $500, because it settled the customer's claim in full
opts.w: 自行和解侵犯了保险人专属的权利，这笔钱保险人不会偿还。

opts.t: Neither amount, because no payment may be made without consent
opts.w: 有一个例外：事故当时的急救费用可以不经同意就发生。

opts.t: Only the $80, because first aid is the one expense allowed without consent

bank.note: 未经保险人同意，被保险人不得自行付款、承担义务或产生费用，急救除外。自愿付钱还可能被法院看成承认责任；急救不会。

bank.stem: An insured is served with court documents starting an action against her. Why does the liability policy require her to send copies to the insurer immediately?

opts.t: So that the insurer can cancel the policy before any judgment is given
opts.w: 这项条件的目的不是让保险人脱身，而是让它能及时出面抗辩。

opts.t: So that the insurer can declare to the court its intention to defend the action
So that the insured is released from any further duty to co-operate
opts.w: 转交文件不解除协助调查、和解、抗辩的义务。

opts.t: So that the insurer can decide whether the insured is legally liable
opts.w: 法律责任由法院认定，不由保险人认定。

bank.note: 收到起诉通知要立即告知并转交全部法律文件，这叫 notice of a claim。它让保险人有机会向法院表明将为被保险人抗辩。

bank.stem: An insured is sued by a close friend who was hurt on his premises. Believing his friend deserves to be paid, the insured refuses to testify when the insurer decides to defend the action. The insured has failed in his duty to:

opts.t: Provide the insurer with prompt notification of the occurrence
opts.w: 题干没有说他迟报；问题出在他拒绝作证。

opts.t: Assist in the settlement or defence of the claim
Refrain from making voluntary payments to the claimant
opts.w: 他没有自行付款；这是另一项义务。

opts.t: Authorize the insurer to obtain records and other information
opts.w: 授权取得记录是另一项义务，与出庭作证无关。

bank.note: 被保险人认识原告、站在对方一边时，最容易违反协助义务。保险人决定抗辩时可能需要被保险人作证，拒绝会严重削弱抗辩。

bank.pt: 附加给付 · 找不属于的
bank.stem: The Supplementary Payments insuring agreement of a liability policy provides for all of the following EXCEPT:

opts.t: The costs of defending the action against the insured
opts.w: 抗辩费用是附加给付的第一项。

opts.t: Court costs assessed against the insured
opts.w: 判由被保险人承担的诉讼费是附加给付之一。

opts.t: Compensatory damages awarded to the injured third party
Reasonable expenses the insured incurs at the insurer's request
opts.w: 应保险人要求而发生的合理费用是附加给付之一。

bank.note: 给第三方的补偿性赔偿由保单限额支付；附加给付是限额之外的费用：抗辩费、应要求发生的合理费用、诉讼费、判决后利息。

bank.pt: 判决后利息 · 只算限额以内
bank.stem: A court gives judgment against an insured for $1,500,000. The insured's liability limit is $1,000,000. The insurer takes three months to decide not to appeal and then pays. Under the Supplementary Payments provision found in most liability policies, on what amount does the insurer pay interest from the date of judgment?

opts.t: $1,000,000, the part of the judgment within the limit of insurance
$1,500,000, because the delay in payment was caused by the insurer
opts.w: 谁造成延迟不改变规则；保险人只对限额以内的部分付利息。

opts.t: $500,000, the part of the judgment the insured must pay personally
opts.w: 超出限额的部分及其利息由被保险人自己承担，不是保险人。

opts.t: No amount, because interest is not one of the supplementary payments
opts.w: 判决日起的利息正是附加给付的第四项。

bank.note: 利息自判决作出之日起算，保险人只负担保单限额以内那部分金额的利息。FOI 的例子是判赔 $2,000,000、限额 $1,000,000。这题容易因为「延迟是保险人造成的」而选全额；条款只让保险人负担限额以内部分的利息。

bank.stem: An insured with a $1,000,000 liability limit is found legally liable for compensatory damages of $950,000. The insurer's legal costs to defend the action were $120,000. Under most liability policies, what does the insurer pay in total?

opts.t: $950,000, because defence costs are the insured's own expense
opts.w: 抗辩费用由保险人按附加给付承担，不是被保险人自付。

opts.t: $1,000,000, because the limit caps damages and defence costs together
opts.w: 多数保单的附加给付在限额之外，不占用限额。

opts.t: $1,070,000, because defence costs are paid in addition to the limit
$830,000, because defence costs are deducted from the damages payable
opts.w: 抗辩费不会从给第三方的赔款里扣。

bank.note: 限额留着付赔款；抗辩费等附加给付在限额之外另付，通常不设金额上限。$950,000＋$120,000＝$1,070,000。

bank.pt: 限额与附加给付的分工
bank.stem: In a liability policy, the limit of insurance stated for bodily injury and property damage is reserved for:

opts.t: The cost of legal counsel chosen by the insurer
opts.w: 律师费属于抗辩费用，由附加给付在限额之外负担。

opts.t: Interest that accrues after a judgment is rendered
opts.w: 判决后利息属于附加给付，不占用限额。

opts.t: Expenses the insured incurs at the insurer's request
opts.w: 这是附加给付的一项，不由限额支付。

opts.t: The payment of claims

bank.note: 限额只用来付赔款。调查、和解、抗辩中多出来的费用另有一个承保协议负担，叫 Supplementary Payments。

bank.stem: A client has personal liability coverage under her homeowners policy. She also runs a retail shop, gives paid financial advice and owns a car. Which statement best reflects how liability insurance is arranged?

opts.t: Her personal liability coverage extends to all of these activities worldwide
opts.w: 个人责任保障不保经营活动、职业服务和汽车。

opts.t: A single business policy would cover the shop, the advice and the car
opts.w: 商业责任险不保职业服务，也不保汽车的所有与使用。

opts.t: Separate policies are needed for personal, business and professional exposures, and for the car
Only the car needs separate insurance; the rest falls under the homeowners policy
opts.w: 汽车确实要单独的保单，但商业与职业风险同样需要各自的保单。

bank.note: 责任保单按活动分开：个人、商业、职业三类风险各需要一张保单；汽车和飞机的责任风险大到必须由各自专门的保单承保。

bank.pt: 四项保障里哪项要法律责任
bank.stem: Section II of the Homeowners Forms provides four liability coverages. Under which one must the insured be legally liable before the insurer pays?

opts.t: Coverage F - Voluntary Medical Payments
opts.w: F 是自愿给付，条款明写即使被保险人没有法律责任也付。

opts.t: Coverage G - Voluntary Payment for Damage to Property
opts.w: G 赔的正是被保险人不必负法律责任的非故意损害。

opts.t: Coverage E - Personal Legal Liability
Coverage H - Voluntary Compensation for Residence Employees
opts.w: H 即使被保险人没有法律责任也给住家雇员定额给付。

bank.note: 只有 Coverage E 以法律责任为前提；F、G、H 名字里都带 voluntary，是不问责任的自愿给付。

bank.pt: Section II 通常没有免赔额
bank.stem: A client who is being sued by a neighbour asks whether the deductible shown for her property coverages will be taken off any payment made under Section II - Liability Coverage. The best answer is:

opts.t: Yes, the Section I deductible applies to every claim under the policy
opts.w: 免赔额是 Section I 财产保障的事；FOI 口径说责任这几项通常不设免赔额。

opts.t: Yes, but only to payments made under Coverages F and G
opts.w: F、G 同样通常不设免赔额。

opts.t: No, because a deductible applies only when the insured is not at fault
opts.w: 免赔额与过错无关；FOI 的说法是这几项保障通常没有免赔额。

opts.t: No, the liability coverages are usually not subject to a deductible

bank.note: FOI 口径：Section II 的四项保障通常不设免赔额。同一件他人财物，改在 Section I 下索赔就要扣免赔额。

bank.pt: 车行对顾客车辆的责任
bank.stem: A repair garage carries a Commercial General Liability Policy. A mechanic negligently damages a customer's car while it is in the garage for service. Which coverage is designed for the garage's liability for this damage?

opts.t: Section E of the Standard Garage Automobile Policy (S.P.F. No. 4)
The products liability coverage of the garage's CGL policy
opts.w: 受损的是顾客交来保管的车，不是车行卖出的产品；CGL 也把汽车的所有、使用或操作除外。

opts.t: Section A of the Standard Garage Automobile Policy (S.P.F. No. 4)
opts.w: Section A 是对他人的第三者责任；顾客车辆在照管下的损坏归 Section E。

opts.t: An Errors and Omissions policy purchased by the garage
opts.w: E&O 是给提供意见和咨询的专业人士的，不保修车造成的物理损坏。

bank.note: S.P.F. No. 4 的 Section E 承保被保险人对在其照管、保管或控制下的顾客汽车的损坏所负的法律责任；Section A 是第三者责任。

bank.stem: The Smiths own their home, which is described on the Coverage Summary page, and a lakeside cottage that they never told their insurer about. Does the cottage fall within the definition of "premises" in Section II?

opts.t: Yes, because all seasonal residences owned by the insured are included
opts.w: 季节性住所可以包括，但条件是具体列明在 Coverage Summary 页上。

opts.t: No, because owned residences must be specifically described on the Coverage Summary page
Yes, because premises includes any place the insured uses temporarily
opts.w: 临时使用的场所以被保险人不是所有人为条件，自有的小屋不适用。

opts.t: No, because a seasonal residence can never be insured under Section II
opts.w: 季节性住所可以承保，只要列明。

bank.note: 基本定义：列名被保险人或其配偶设有住所的一切场所，包括季节性住所，前提是具体列明。FOI 的 Bart 夫妇三处房产的例子。

bank.stem: A retired couple leaves B.C. each winter and rents a condominium in Arizona under a five-month lease. The condominium is not described on their Coverage Summary page. A visitor is hurt because of the condition of the condominium. Is it "premises" under Section II?

opts.t: No, because they are tenants under an agreement longer than 90 consecutive days
Yes, because it is a place where the insureds are residing temporarily
opts.w: 临时居住的场所有条件：不是所有人，且租约不超过连续 90 天。

opts.t: Yes, because the personal liability coverage applies anywhere in the world
opts.w: 全球范围说的是个人行为；场所引起的责任要先落进场所的定义。

opts.t: No, because premises outside Canada are never included in the definition
opts.w: 临时居住的场所不限加拿大，酒店、营地全世界都算；问题在租期。

bank.note: 临时居住或使用的场所不必列明，但租约超过连续 90 天就不算。FOI 特别提醒：这对每年冬天外出三个月以上的人很要紧。

bank.pt: 新主要住所 · 三者取最早
bank.stem: An insured takes possession of a newly purchased home in Canada on June 1, intending to make it her principal residence. Her existing Homeowners policy expires on June 10 and is not renewed, and no other insurance is arranged. A courier is injured at the new home on June 20. Is the new home "premises" on that date?

opts.t: Yes, because new principal residences are covered for 30 consecutive days
opts.w: 30 天只是上限之一；保单 6 月 10 日到期，取最早者。

opts.t: Yes, because coverage continues until specific insurance is arranged
opts.w: 三个终点取最早的一个，不是等到另行投保为止。

opts.t: No, because a newly acquired home must first be added by endorsement
opts.w: 新主要住所是自动承保的，不需要先批改；问题在时限。

opts.t: No, because the automatic coverage ended when the policy expired

bank.note: 新主要住所自取得之日起自动承保，但不超过连续 30 天、保单到期或终止、另行安排责任保险三者中最早的一个。本题最早的是 6 月 10 日保单到期。

bank.pt: 自动包括的场所 · 找不含的
bank.stem: Without being specifically described on the Coverage Summary page, "premises" in Section II includes all of the following EXCEPT:

opts.t: A family cemetery plot
opts.w: 个人或家庭的墓地或墓穴自动包括。

opts.t: A vacant building lot the insured owns in British Columbia
opts.w: 在加拿大拥有或租用的非农空地自动包括。

opts.t: A vacant building lot the insured owns in Hawaii
Land in Canada where a two-family home is being built for the insured to live in
opts.w: 在加拿大为自住而建一至三户住宅的土地自动包括。

bank.note: 空地这一项只限加拿大境内，而且农地除外。FOI 口径明说：在得州或夏威夷买的空地要另行投保。

bank.stem: The insureds' daughter, who depends on them for support, rents an apartment in another Canadian city for the eight-month university year. The apartment is not shown on the Coverage Summary page. Under the definition of premises, the apartment is:

opts.t: Included as premises, without having to be specifically declared
Excluded, because the lease is longer than 90 consecutive days
opts.w: 90 天限制有一个例外，正是受抚养学生就读期间的住处。

opts.t: Excluded, because the named insureds do not live in the apartment
opts.w: 学生住处的例外不要求列名被保险人本人住在那里。

opts.t: Included as premises, but only for the first 30 consecutive days
opts.w: 30 天是新主要住所的时限，与学生住处无关。

bank.note: 在加拿大境内、由受列名被保险人或其配偶抚养的学生就读期间临时居住的租来的住处，算场所，不必列明，也不受 90 天限制。

bank.stem: While on holiday in Greece, an insured carelessly knocks down a pedestrian while riding a rented bicycle and is sued for the pedestrian's injuries. Does Coverage E of the insured's Homeowners policy apply?

opts.t: Yes, because Coverage E insures personal acts anywhere in the world
No, because Coverage E applies only to occurrences that take place in Canada
opts.w: Coverage E 承保被保险人在世界任何地方的个人行为。

opts.t: No, because the injury did not happen on the insured's premises
opts.w: E 有两个来源：个人行为（全世界）和场所；不必发生在场所上。

opts.t: Yes, but only if the insured bought separate travel liability coverage
opts.w: FOI 口径明说度假不需要另买责任保单。

bank.note: Coverage E 承保被保险人作为普通居民在世界任何地方的法律责任。FOI 的 Butler 家去台湾、希腊或中国度假的例子。

bank.pt: 合同责任 · 与场所有关的书面合同
bank.stem: A homeowner hires a contractor to build a fence at her home and agrees in writing to assume the contractor's liability for unintentional injury to passers-by. A passer-by is injured and a claim is made against the homeowner under that agreement. How does Coverage E respond?

opts.t: It does not respond, because liability assumed by contract is always excluded
opts.w: 这条除外有两个例外，与场所有关的书面合同是其中之一。

opts.t: It does not respond, because the contractor's work is a business pursuit
opts.w: 经营除外针对的是被保险人自己的经营活动，不是她请来的承包商。

opts.t: It responds only if the homeowner was personally negligent
opts.w: 这个例外保的正是她以合同承担的他人责任，不要求她本人有过失。

opts.t: It responds, because the liability relates to her premises and was assumed in writing

bank.note: 合同承担的责任原则除外，但保险人承保你以书面合同承担的、与你的场所有关的他人法律责任。FOI 的例子就是请承包商建围栏。

bank.pt: 合同责任 · 自愿揽下别人的责任
bank.stem: An insured lends his golf cart, which is in perfect working order, to a friend and promises to take on any liability the friend incurs while using it. The friend carelessly injures someone, and the injured person claims against the insured under that promise. Will Coverage E pay?

opts.t: Yes, because the golf cart is owned by the insured
opts.w: 拥有球车不是关键；责任来自他自愿许下的承诺，而球车没有缺陷。

opts.t: No, because the insured voluntarily assumed the liability of another person
Yes, because a promise between friends is treated as a written contract
opts.w: FOI 口径里没有这条规则；而且书面合同的例外还要求与场所有关。

opts.t: No, because golf carts are never insured under Section II
opts.w: 自有的电动高尔夫球车在球场上使用时是承保的，这句话不对。

bank.note: 被保险人不能自愿承担别人的责任再让保险人付钱。只有两种例外：没有合同他本来也有责任（如球车有缺陷），或与场所有关的书面合同。

bank.pt: 借来的割草机 · E 与 G 的分工
bank.stem: Bert borrows a neighbour's riding lawnmower and accidentally damages its transmission. Repairs will cost $600. Which statement about Bert's Homeowners policy is correct?

opts.t: Coverage E pays, because Bert is responsible for property he borrowed
opts.w: E 把被保险人照管、保管或控制下的财产（包括借来的）除外。

opts.t: Coverage E pays, but only if the neighbour starts a lawsuit against Bert
opts.w: 有没有诉讼都不赔，问题在照管、保管、控制除外。

opts.t: Coverage E excludes it as property in Bert's care, custody or control, but Coverage G may respond
Neither Coverage E nor Coverage G can respond, because the damage was accidental
opts.w: 意外正是 G 的对象：非故意的直接损害，不问法律责任。

bank.note: 借来或租来的财产落在 care, custody or control 除外里，Coverage E 不赔。Coverage G 不问法律责任，在它的小限额内可以赔非故意的直接损害。

bank.stem: While staying in a rented chalet, an insured carelessly leaves the fireplace damper closed, and smoke from the fireplace stains the walls and ceiling. The chalet owner claims for the cleaning costs. Under the wording of the IBC Homeowners Forms, does Coverage E apply?

opts.t: Yes, because smoke damage to rented premises is an exception to the exclusion
opts.w: 例外里的烟限于取暖或烹饪设备突然异常故障运行的烟，壁炉的烟被点名排除。

opts.t: No, because the smoke exception does not include smoke from fireplaces
No, because damage to premises rented by an insured is never covered
opts.w: 他人场所因火、爆炸、水、烟的非故意损害是承保的例外，不是一概不保。

opts.t: Yes, because any unintentional damage to rented premises is covered
opts.w: 例外只限火灾、爆炸、水损、烟四种原因，不是一切非故意损害。

bank.note: 照管控制除外的例外：他人场所及其内财物因火灾、爆炸、水损、烟的非故意损害。烟指取暖或烹饪设备突然、异常的故障运行，壁炉的烟不算。这题容易只记住「烟是例外」就选赔；条款把壁炉的烟点名排除了。

bank.stem: An insured carelessly leaves a tool on the stairs at home. His adult son, who lives in the household, trips on it, is injured and sues his father. How does Coverage E respond?

opts.t: It does not respond, because injury to a household resident is excluded
It responds, because the father was negligent and is legally liable
opts.w: 有过失、有法律责任也不赔：同住者的人身伤害被明确除外。

opts.t: It responds, because the injury happened on the insured premises
opts.w: 发生在场所上不够；伤者是同住的家人，落在除外里。

opts.t: It does not respond, because family members can never sue one another
opts.w: FOI 口径说有些省的法律允许同住家人互相起诉；不赔是因为保单除外。

bank.note: Coverage E 除外：你本人以及住在你家里的任何人的人身伤害，住家雇员除外。责任险是第三方保障，被保险人是第一方。

bank.pt: Coverage E 的除外 · 找赔的
bank.stem: All of the following are excluded under Coverage E - Personal Liability EXCEPT:

opts.t: Damage to a neighbour's antique table caused by the insured's work in refinishing it
opts.w: 因你施工而损坏的动产是除外 4。

opts.t: Bodily injury to a boarder who lives in the insured's household
opts.w: 同住者（含寄宿者）的人身伤害除外。

opts.t: Water damage the insured accidentally causes to a hotel room she is renting
Damage to a canoe that is owned by the insured
opts.w: 自有财产的损坏是除外 2。

bank.note: 租用的他人场所因水损造成的非故意损害，是照管控制除外的例外，Coverage E 赔。FOI 的 Betty 在酒店忘关浴缸水龙头的例子。

bank.stem: A neighbour sues an insured for an injury the insured says never happened. The insured wants the insurer to pay the lawyer she has hired herself. Under Coverage E, the insurer will:

opts.t: Refuse to defend, because it defends only claims that have merit
opts.w: 保险人对毫无根据、虚假或欺诈的索赔同样抗辩。

opts.t: Defend the claim, but pay only for the legal counsel it selects
Defend the claim and pay for any lawyer the insured chooses
opts.w: 保险人保留选择律师的权利，只付自己选定的律师的费用。

opts.t: Pay the insured's lawyer, but deduct the fees from the Coverage E limit
opts.w: 抗辩费用在保险金额之外，而且只付保险人选定的律师。

bank.note: 保险人为 Coverage E 承保的索赔抗辩，哪怕索赔毫无根据、虚假或欺诈；但它保留选择律师的权利，只付自己选定的律师。

bank.stem: A dinner guest stumbles over his own feet in the insured's dining room, strikes his head and is taken to hospital by ambulance. The insured was not negligent in any way. Which coverage of the insured's Homeowners policy is designed to respond?

opts.t: Coverage E, because the injury occurred on the insured's premises
opts.w: E 要求被保险人有法律责任；本题他没有任何过失。

opts.t: Coverage G, because the payment would be made voluntarily
opts.w: G 是财产损害的自愿给付，不是医疗费。

opts.t: No coverage, because the insured is not legally liable for the injury
opts.w: F 正是即使没有法律责任也付的保障。

opts.t: Coverage F, because it pays medical expenses whether or not the insured is liable

bank.note: Coverage F 付在被保险人场所上意外受伤的人的医疗费，不问被保险人有没有责任。FOI 口径朋友 Peter 自己绊倒的例子。

bank.stem: All of the following statements about Coverage F - Voluntary Medical Payments are true EXCEPT:

opts.t: It applies only to injuries that happen on the insured's premises
Funeral expenses are among the medical expenses it can pay
opts.w: 医疗费用的清单里包括丧葬费用，说法正确。

opts.t: The expenses must be incurred within one year of the accident
opts.w: 只付事故之日起一年内发生的费用，说法正确。

opts.t: It does not pay the medical expenses of the insured
opts.w: 不赔被保险人自己及同住者的医疗费，说法正确。

bank.note: F 有两种触发：被保险人非故意伤到别人（不限地点），或别人在被保险人的场所上意外受伤。把它说成只限场所上，就漏了第一种。

bank.stem: The insureds' 13-year-old son, angry at a neighbour, deliberately scratches the neighbour's car. Repairs cost $700. Which coverage under the parents' Homeowners policy responds?

opts.t: Coverage G, because it pays for damage intentionally caused by a child
opts.w: G 赔故意损害只限 12 岁及以下的被保险人，13 岁已经过线。

opts.t: Coverage E, because the parents are legally liable for their child's acts
opts.w: E 把任何被保险人的故意行为造成的损害除外；父母也不当然对子女负责。

opts.t: Neither Coverage E nor Coverage G, because the damage was intentional and he is over 12
Coverage F, because it is paid whether or not the insured is liable
opts.w: F 是医疗费用的给付，与财产损害无关。

bank.note: 故意损害原则上哪一项都不赔。Coverage G 只为 12 岁及以下的被保险人开了口子；13 岁的故意行为落回一般除外。

bank.pt: Coverage G · 不必负法律责任的损害
bank.stem: While helping a neighbour carry a china cabinet, an insured loses his grip when the neighbour moves too quickly, and the cabinet's glass doors break. The insured is probably not legally liable, but the neighbour expects him to pay the $75 repair. Which coverage is designed for this?

opts.t: Coverage E - Personal Liability
opts.w: E 以法律责任为前提；本题被保险人大概没有法律责任。

opts.t: Coverage G - Voluntary Payment for Damage to Property
Coverage F - Voluntary Medical Payments
opts.w: F 付的是医疗费，不是财产损害。

opts.t: Section I - Property Coverages, less the deductible
opts.w: Section I 保的是被保险人一方的财产损失风险，不是这类对邻居的小额赔付。

bank.note: Coverage G 付被保险人非故意造成的直接财产损害，即使他在法律上不必负责。FOI 口径搬瓷器柜的例子。

bank.pt: Coverage G 的除外 · 找赔的
bank.stem: Coverage G - Voluntary Payment for Damage to Property does NOT apply to any of the following EXCEPT:

opts.t: The theft of a camera which the insured had borrowed from a friend
opts.w: 因财产被盗而产生的索赔是 G 的除外。

opts.t: A neighbour's loss of use of a tractor the insured damaged
opts.w: 使用损失是 G 的除外，G 只付直接损害。

opts.t: Damage to furniture owned by the insured's tenant
opts.w: 被保险人的租客拥有或租用的财产除外。

opts.t: Accidental damage to a friend's laptop the insured dropped

bank.note: G 的三条除外：被保险人或其租客拥有或租用的财产；Section I 已承保的财产；使用损失、失踪或被盗。碰掉朋友的电脑是非故意的直接损害，赔。

bank.pt: Coverage H · 拒绝给付后起诉
bank.stem: A gardener hired by an insured for occasional work is injured on the job. The insurer offers the benefits under Coverage H, but the gardener refuses them and sues the insured for negligence. Which statement is correct?

opts.t: Coverage H did not apply, because occasional employees must be named on the policy
opts.w: 临时住家雇员自动承保；要列明的是长期雇员。

opts.t: The insurer may withdraw its offer, but the insured's liability insurance is not affected
The insurer must still pay the Coverage H benefits in addition to defending the suit
opts.w: 雇员不接受给付或起诉时，保险人可以撤回提议。

opts.t: By refusing the benefits, the gardener gave up the right to sue the insured
opts.w: 放弃起诉权的是接受给付并签弃权书的人，不是拒绝的人。

bank.note: H 的给付是自愿的：雇员不接受或起诉，保险人可以撤回提议，但不影响责任保险（Coverage E 仍在）。接受给付的人才要签弃权书。

bank.pt: 自有船艇 · 哪条自动承保
bank.stem: An insured owns four watercraft and has not added any watercraft liability coverage to her Homeowners policy. Liability arising from which one is automatically insured under Section II?

opts.t: A 14-foot fishing boat with a 25 H.P. outboard motor
opts.w: 舷外机合计上限是 12 kW（16 H.P.），25 H.P. 超标。

opts.t: A personal watercraft powered by a 60 H.P. motor
opts.w: 其他类型发动机的上限是 38 kW（50 H.P.），60 H.P. 超标。

opts.t: A 32-foot sailboat with no motor
opts.w: 无动力船艇的上限是 8 米（26 英尺），32 英尺超标。

opts.t: A 16-foot canoe with no motor

bank.note: 自有船艇的三条线：舷外机合计 12 kW（16 H.P.）、其他机型 38 kW（50 H.P.）、无动力 8 米（26 英尺）。16 英尺的独木舟在线内。

bank.pt: 非自有船艇 · 赔什么不赔什么
bank.stem: On holiday, an insured rents a boat with a 225 H.P. inboard motor and carelessly runs into a dock, damaging the dock and the boat and injuring a boy who was fishing there. What does the insured's personal liability coverage pay?

opts.t: Nothing, because the motor exceeds the 50 H.P. limit for watercraft
opts.w: 马力上限只针对自有船艇；非自有船艇不论类型和马力都承保。

opts.t: The damage to the dock and the boy's injury, but not the damage to the rented boat
The damage to the dock, the boy's injury and the damage to the rented boat
opts.w: 租来的船本身的损坏不赔，由被保险人自己承担。

opts.t: Only the boy's injury, because property damage from watercraft is excluded
opts.w: 对码头的财产损害同样承保；不赔的只是那条船本身。

bank.note: 使用或操作非自有船艇造成的他人伤害和损害都赔，不看马力；但那条船本身的损坏不赔。FOI 的 Butler 家在加勒比租船的例子。

bank.pt: 新购超标船艇的 30 天
bank.stem: An insured buys a boat with a 90 H.P. inboard motor and does nothing about insurance. Forty-five days after the purchase he injures a swimmer while operating it. Is the liability insured under Section II of his Homeowners policy?

opts.t: No, because the automatic coverage for a newly acquired watercraft lasts only 30 days
Yes, because newly acquired watercraft are covered until the policy expires
opts.w: 新购超标船艇只自动承保 30 天，不是到保单到期。

opts.t: Yes, because watercraft with inboard motors have no horsepower limit
opts.w: 其他类型发动机的上限是 38 kW（50 H.P.）。

opts.t: No, because owned watercraft can never be insured under a Homeowners policy
opts.w: 线内的自有船艇自动承保，超标的也可以加保费承保。

bank.note: 超过特别限制的新购船艇，自购买之日起自动承保 30 天，之后要批改保单才继续有保障。

bank.pt: 拖车 · 挂没挂在上牌车上
bank.stem: An insured's camper trailer comes loose while being towed behind his licensed pickup truck on the highway and strikes another vehicle. Is the resulting liability insured under Section II of his Homeowners policy?

opts.t: Yes, because Section II insures the ownership and use of any trailer
opts.w: 拖车承保有条件：当时没有挂在、载于或被拖于需登记的机动车上。

opts.t: Yes, because the trailer itself is not subject to motor vehicle registration
opts.w: 条件看的是牵引它的机动车是否需登记，以及当时是否在被拖。

opts.t: No, because the trailer was being towed by a vehicle subject to motor vehicle registration
No, because trailers are insured only while kept on the insured's premises
opts.w: 条款没有「只限在场所内」的条件；停在营地溜坡伤人也承保。

bank.note: 拖车引起的责任承保，条件是它当时没有挂在、载于或被拖于需要机动车登记的机动车上。被牵引途中脱钩不保；停在营地自己溜坡才保。

bank.pt: 经营例外 · 找不保的
bank.stem: Although business pursuits are generally excluded, Section II insures claims arising from all of the following EXCEPT:

opts.t: Renting two parking stalls in the insured's garage to neighbours
opts.w: 出租不超过 3 个车位或马厩位是承保的例外。

opts.t: Part-time babysitting by the insureds' 16-year-old daughter
opts.w: 未满 21 岁的被保险人的临时或兼职经营活动是承保的例外。

opts.t: Occasionally renting out the family home while the insureds winter in Florida
opts.w: 偶尔出租平时自住的住宅是承保的例外。

opts.t: Operating a full-time hair salon in the basement of the home

bank.note: 六项例外里没有「在家里全职经营一门生意」。这类经营要在 Coverage Summary 上列明，或改用商业综合责任险。

bank.stem: During her employer's annual golf tournament, an accountant carelessly hits a ball that injures another player, who sues her. Does her personal liability coverage respond?

opts.t: No, because the injury occurred during the course of her occupation
opts.w: 在工作期间不等于除外；要看行为与职业有没有直接关系。

opts.t: Yes, because the personal act was not directly related to her occupation
No, because any claim against a professional requires Errors and Omissions Insurance
opts.w: E&O 保的是提供专业服务的责任，打球伤人不是专业服务。

opts.t: Yes, because business pursuits of any kind are insured under Section II
opts.w: 经营活动原则除外，只有六项例外。

bank.note: 经营除外的第一项例外：在从事职业期间的、与该职业没有直接关系的个人行为。FOI 举的就是公司高尔夫球赛。

bank.pt: Section II 的一般除外 · 找赔的
bank.stem: Section II of the Homeowners Forms excludes claims arising from all of the following EXCEPT:

opts.t: The rendering of, or failure to render, a professional service
opts.w: 提供或未能提供专业服务是一般除外。

opts.t: The insured's dog biting a postal employee at the insured's home
The ownership, use or operation of any aircraft
opts.w: 飞机的所有、使用或操作是一般除外。

opts.t: The transmission of a communicable disease by an insured
opts.w: 被保险人传播传染病是一般除外。

bank.note: 自家的狗咬伤邮递员，是FOI 列的 Coverage E 典型赔案。专业服务、飞机、传播传染病、故意或犯罪行为、虐待都是一般除外。

bank.stem: An electrical contractor finishes rewiring a customer's house and leaves the site. Two weeks later a connection the contractor made improperly overheats and causes a fire. This loss is an example of which business liability exposure?

opts.t: Completed operations liability
Premises and operations liability
opts.w: 作业责任指工作正在进行时造成的伤害；本题活已经干完并交付使用。

opts.t: Tenants' legal liability
opts.w: 租客法律责任是租客对自己占用的建筑的损坏对房东负的责任。

opts.t: Personal injury liability
opts.w: personal injury 指人身伤害以外的伤害，如诽谤、非法驱逐。

bank.note: 完成的工作交付使用之后造成伤害或损害，是完工作业责任。水管、暖气、电气承包商和电器修理店都有这种风险。

bank.pt: personal injury 不是身体伤害
bank.stem: A landlord, wrongly believing that proper notice had been given, changes the locks and removes a tenant's belongings. The tenant, who was not physically hurt, sues for wrongful eviction. Under a business liability policy this claim falls within:

opts.t: Bodily injury liability
opts.w: 租客没有身体伤害、疾病或死亡，不属于 bodily injury。

opts.t: Products liability
opts.w: 没有涉及被保险人卖出的任何产品。

opts.t: Completed operations liability
opts.w: 没有涉及完成后交付使用的工作。

opts.t: Personal injury liability

bank.note: Personal injury＝人身伤害以外的伤害：书面和口头诽谤、恶意控告、非法进入或驱逐、歧视。

bank.pt: 作业责任 · 活正在干
bank.stem: While sliding a new refrigerator into place in a customer's kitchen, a store's delivery employee gouges the customer's floor. The store's liability for the floor is best described as arising from:

opts.t: Its products, because the refrigerator was sold by the store
opts.w: 损害不是冰箱这件产品的缺陷造成的，而是送货安装的动作造成的。

opts.t: Its completed operations, because delivery is part of the sale
opts.w: 损害发生在活正在干的时候，不是完工交付使用之后。

opts.t: Its business operations performed away from its own premises
The condition of its premises, because the store is the occupier
opts.w: 出事地点是顾客家，不是店铺场所的状况问题。

bank.note: 企业在自己场所或在他人场所干活时造成伤害或损害，是经营作业责任。FOI 的 Harry 送冰箱划坏地板的例子。

bank.stem: Which of the following professionals would purchase Malpractice Insurance rather than Errors and Omissions Insurance?

opts.t: An accountant
opts.w: 会计师属于提供意见和咨询的专业人士，买 E&O。

opts.t: An architect
opts.w: 建筑师属于提供意见和咨询的专业人士，买 E&O。

opts.t: A druggist
An insurance broker
opts.w: 保险经纪人属于提供意见和咨询的专业人士，买 E&O。

bank.note: 提供医疗保健的（医生、牙医、药剂师）买 Malpractice Insurance；提供意见和咨询的（会计师、律师、建筑师、保险经纪人）买 E&O。

bank.pt: 伞式保单 · 基础保单先赔
bank.stem: A business has a primary liability policy with a $2,000,000 limit and an Umbrella Liability Policy. It is found legally liable for $2,600,000 in a claim that both policies cover. How is the claim paid?

opts.t: The umbrella policy pays the entire $2,600,000, because it has the higher limit
opts.w: 伞式保单是在基础保单之上的；基础保单先赔。

opts.t: The two policies each pay $1,300,000, sharing the loss equally
opts.w: 不是平摊；基础保单先赔满自己的限额。

opts.t: The primary policy pays $2,000,000 and the business pays the remaining $600,000
opts.w: 不够的部分正是伞式保单要赔的，在其限额内。

opts.t: The primary policy pays $2,000,000 and the umbrella policy pays the remaining $600,000

bank.note: 出险时基础保单先赔；基础保单的保险不够时，伞式保单在其限额内赔超出的部分。

bank.stem: A commercial insured's primary liability policy excludes a certain claim, but its Umbrella Liability Policy contains no such exclusion. How will the umbrella policy respond?

opts.t: It will not respond, because an umbrella policy pays only after a primary policy has paid
opts.w: 伞式保单有两种赔法，基础保单不保而伞式保单没有同样除外时也赔。

opts.t: It will pay the claim, subject to a Self-Insured Retention
It will pay the claim in full from the first dollar, with no deductible of any kind
opts.w: 这种情形要先扣一个高额免赔，即自留额（SIR）。

opts.t: It will not respond, because umbrella policies follow every exclusion in the primary policy
opts.w: 只有伞式保单自己也有同样的除外才不赔。

bank.note: 基础保单不保、伞式保单又没有同样除外时，伞式保单赔，但要先扣 SIR（自留额）：商业风险 $10,000 至 $25,000 不稀奇，个人的通常 $500 至 $1,000。

bank.stem: What is the leading cause of disabilities?

opts.t: Accidents that occur on the job
opts.w: 书中说工伤事故只占事故里不到一成，更不是失能的首要原因。

opts.t: Sickness, especially as people age
Accidents that occur away from work
opts.w: 90% 以上事故与工作无关，但事故整体仍不是首要原因。

opts.t: Industrial disease contracted at work
opts.w: 职业病只是疾病里工伤计划管的一小块。

bank.note: 书中原句 Sickness is the leading cause of disabilities；年纪越大，因病失能的人数远超因事故失能。

bank.stem: Approximately what proportion of all accidents are NOT work related?

opts.t: Less than 10%
opts.w: 正好反了：不到 10% 是工作相关的。

opts.t: About one in three
opts.w: 1／3 是「65 岁前失能超 90 天」的比例，不是事故比例。

opts.t: Over 90%
About half of them
opts.w: 书中没有「一半」这个数，原文是 over 90%。

bank.note: 书中：over 90% of all accidents are not work related——这部分工伤计划不管，要靠 A&S 保单。

bank.stem: Harry, an employee, cuts his hand with a saw while building a fence for his employer and misses 12 weeks. A week after returning, he is injured in a car accident on his way home from work and misses 10 days. How does the workers' compensation plan respond?

opts.t: It pays for both injuries, since both arose from his employment
opts.w: 下班路上的车祸书中明说不算工作相关。

opts.t: It pays for neither, because both are covered by A&S policies
opts.w: 工作中锯伤由工伤计划赔，不靠 A&S。

opts.t: It pays for the car accident only, since it is an auto loss
opts.w: 正好反了：工作中受伤才由工伤计划赔。

opts.t: It pays for the saw injury only, not the car accident

bank.note: 书中 Harry Lipps 例：工作中锯伤由工伤计划赔；下班回家路上的车祸 not work related，工伤计划不赔。

bank.stem: Workers' compensation plans provide no fault benefits on the understanding that the injured employee:

opts.t: Holds the employer harmless and will not sue
Will contribute a share of the plan premiums afterward
opts.w: 保费只由雇主付，雇员不付。

opts.t: Will purchase a separate Accident and Sickness policy
opts.w: A&S 是补工伤计划不管的那块，不是交换条件。

opts.t: Must first prove that the employer was negligent
opts.w: 无过错给付恰恰不用证明雇主过失。

bank.note: 无过错给付的交换条件：雇员不追究雇主责任（holds the employer harmless）、也不提起诉讼（练习卷第 73 题考的就是这一点）。

bank.stem: Which statement about the funding of workers' compensation plans is correct?

opts.t: Premiums are shared equally by employers and employees
opts.w: 书中明写只由雇主付。

opts.t: Premiums are paid by employers only, varying by risk
Premiums are set at one flat rate for every type of industry
opts.w: 按职业风险浮动，建筑业比零售贵。

opts.t: Premiums are paid by employees through their payroll deductions
opts.w: 雇员不付工伤计划保费。

bank.note: 书中：All premiums … are payable by employers only，并按职业风险浮动（建筑业高于零售杂货服装）。

bank.stem: Most workers' compensation plans provide all of the following benefits for work-related disabilities EXCEPT:

opts.t: Necessary medical and vocational rehabilitation programs
opts.w: 这是四项给付之一（医疗与职业康复），陈述正确。

opts.t: A lost income benefit of about 90% of net earnings when temporary
opts.w: 四项给付之一（临时失能按净收入 90%）。

opts.t: Compensation for pain and suffering awarded by a court
A death benefit, including basic funeral expenses
opts.w: 这是四项给付之一（丧葬费＋一次性身故金＋月收入），陈述正确。

bank.note: 四项给付＝必要医疗费、医疗与职业康复、误工收入补偿（临时按净收入 90%）、身故给付。工伤计划不走法院，雇员放弃起诉雇主，所以没有法院判的痛苦赔偿。

bank.stem: All of the following are good candidates for individual Accident and Sickness insurance EXCEPT:

opts.t: A self-employed contractor running a small business
opts.w: 自雇人士是书中列的第一类候选，陈述正确。

opts.t: A high income employee who wants more protection
opts.w: 高收入雇员是书中列的候选之一，陈述正确。

opts.t: A worker whose employer offers no group plan at all
opts.w: 单位没有团体计划的人是书中列的候选之一，陈述正确。

opts.t: A retiree aged 68 who has stopped working entirely

bank.note: 四类候选：自雇、单位无团体计划、高收入雇员、想要更好条款者。失能收入保险补的是工作收入；而且保险人一般不承保 60 岁以上。

bank.stem: The most common type of individual Accident and Sickness insurance policy is the:

opts.t: Disability Income policy
Major Medical coverage plan
opts.w: 大额医疗是团体计划的可选附加。

opts.t: Weekly Indemnity Policy
opts.w: 周给付是团体计划的短期保障。

opts.t: Trip Cancellation Policy
opts.w: 行程取消是旅行险的附带保障，不属 A&S 个人保单。

bank.note: 考试口径：个人意外与疾病险（A&S）里最常见的是失能收入保单（Disability Income Policy）——失能期间按月给收入。

bank.stem: A dentist with an 'own occupation' disability policy injures her hand and can no longer perform dental work, but she takes a full-time job teaching at a college. What happens to her disability benefits?

opts.t: Benefits stop, since she is now working in another occupation
opts.w: 这是 any occupation 的结果。

opts.t: Benefits continue in full, though she works elsewhere
Benefits are reduced by the amount of her new teaching income
opts.w: 书中写 own occupation 下 full benefits would continue。

opts.t: Benefits continue only until the end of the elimination period
opts.w: 等待期是给付开始前的自保期，不是给付止点。

bank.note: own occupation 是最宽定义：无法履行本职业重要职责就 即使他已在从事别的职业，仍照付全额给付。

bank.stem: Which definition of disability is the MOST limiting?

opts.t: Own occupation
opts.w: own occupation 是书中说的最宽定义，正好相反。

opts.t: Regular occupation
opts.w: 书中只列名，没说它最窄。

opts.t: Any occupation
Total occupation
opts.w: 书中只有 own／regular／any 三档，没有 total occupation。

bank.note: any occupation 最窄：只要能从事与教育、培训、经验或收入相称的任何职业就不给付。

bank.stem: In a disability income policy, the elimination period is best described as the:

opts.t: Period during which benefits are payable to the insured
opts.w: 这是给付期（Benefit Period）。

opts.t: Period of grace allowed for the payment of an overdue premium
opts.w: 宽限期与等待期无关。

opts.t: Period after which statements on the application are incontestable
opts.w: 那是两年不可抗辩期。

opts.t: Period of self-insurance before benefits begin to be paid

bank.note: Elimination Period＝从失能开始到开始给付之间的自保期；越长保费越低。

bank.stem: Once the elimination period is satisfied, disability income payments continue until which event?

opts.t: The insured recovers, dies, or the benefit period ends, whichever is first
The insured reaches age 65, regardless of recovery or death in the meantime
opts.w: 到 65 岁只是给付期的一个选项，且康复或身故会提前终止。

opts.t: The insured's group plan at work begins paying benefits for the same loss
opts.w: 书中没有这条停止事由。

opts.t: The insurer decides the insured has received enough to cover the loss
opts.w: 停止事由是客观的三者先到。

bank.note: 考试口径：给付持续到被保险人康复、身故或给付期（Benefit Period）结束，以先到者为准（whichever occurs first）。

bank.stem: An applicant for disability income insurance wants the lowest possible premium. Which combination of choices would produce the LOWEST premium?

opts.t: Own occupation definition, 30-day elimination period, benefits to age 65
opts.w: 三项都是推高保费的选择。

opts.t: Any occupation definition, 120-day elimination, 2-year benefits
Own occupation definition, 120-day elimination period, benefits to age 65
opts.w: own occupation 与到 65 岁都推高保费。

opts.t: Any occupation definition, 30-day elimination period, benefits to age 65
opts.w: 等待期短、给付期长都推高保费。

bank.note: 理赔成本随所选给付变化：给付期越长、等待期越短、定义越宽（own），保费越高。最便宜＝any occupation＋长等待期＋短给付期。

bank.stem: The premium for Accident and Sickness insurance is directly affected by all of the following factors EXCEPT:

opts.t: The insurer's claims costs
opts.w: 理赔成本是三因素之一，会直接影响保费。

opts.t: The insurer's operating expenses
opts.w: 营运费用是三因素之一，会直接影响保费。

opts.t: The insured's provincial plan
The insurer's investment earnings
opts.w: 投资收益是三因素之一，回报率与保费直接相关。

bank.note: 书中定价三因素：理赔成本、营运费用、投资收益。省医保不在其中。

bank.stem: Under an individual Accident and Sickness policy that the insurer may cancel, claims experience has deteriorated for one policyholder only. What may the insurer do?

opts.t: Raise this one policyholder's renewal premium
opts.w: 书中：Individual policy holders or policies cannot be singled out。

opts.t: Add an exclusion rider to this policy mid-term
opts.w: 书中没有给保险人这个权利。

opts.t: Nothing at all, since premiums are guaranteed
opts.w: 保费保证到 65 岁的是不可注销保单。

opts.t: Charge extra for a whole class of insureds

bank.note: 可注销保单：当某一类被保险人理赔经验变差时，可对该类续保加费；不能单挑某个保单持有人。

bank.stem: Under an individual Accident and Sickness contract, a person has an insurable interest in all of the following EXCEPT:

opts.t: Their own neighbour
Their own employee
opts.w: 雇员在书中的可保利益名单里，陈述正确。

opts.t: Their own grandchild
opts.w: 书中列明（child or grandchild）。

opts.t: Their own spouse
opts.w: 配偶在书中的可保利益名单里，陈述正确。

bank.note: 可保利益：本人、子女或孙子女、配偶、雇员、有金钱利益者、自己依靠其供养或教育者。邻居不在其中——除非被保险人书面同意。

bank.stem: An individual A&S contract is about to take effect, but the applicant lacks an insurable interest at that time and the person insured has NOT given written consent. The contract is:

opts.t: Valid but benefits are reduced by half
opts.w: 书中没有「减半给付」之说，缺可保利益的后果是合同无效。

opts.t: Void
Voidable at the option of the insured
opts.w: 书中写的是 void，且选择权不在被保险人。

opts.t: Valid once two years have passed
opts.w: 两年不可抗辩管陈述，不能补可保利益。

bank.note: 考试口径：投保人没有可保利益的，合同无效（void）；被保险人书面同意可以补足。

bank.stem: Three years after an individual disability policy was issued, the insurer learns the insured understated her age by four years on the application. What is the correct result?

opts.t: The contract is void, because the statement was false
opts.w: 年龄误报不是宣告无效，而是调整。

opts.t: Nothing changes, since the two-year period has expired
opts.w: 年龄误报是两年不可抗辩的例外。

opts.t: The benefits or premium are adjusted to the true age
The insurer may cancel the policy and refund premium
opts.w: 书中没有「注销退费」这种处理，年龄误报只按真实年龄调整。

bank.note: 两年后不可抗辩，例外两个：欺诈（随时可挑战，通常宣告无效）与年龄误报（按真实年龄调整给付或保费）。

bank.stem: A claim is made under an individual A&S policy while a premium amount is still owing. The insurer may:

opts.t: Deny the claim entirely until the premium is paid
opts.w: 书中给的是扣除权，不是拒赔。

opts.t: Pay the claim and waive the unpaid premium amount
opts.w: 书中说可以扣除，不是放弃。

opts.t: Cancel the policy back to the date of the missed premium
opts.w: 书中没有给保险人追溯注销的权利，只有从赔款扣除欠费。

opts.t: Deduct the unpaid premium from the claim payment

bank.note: 第四个特征 Unpaid Premiums：保险人可以从赔款里扣除未付的保费。

bank.stem: An employee covered under her employer's group disability plan resigns to start her own business. What happens to her group disability coverage?

opts.t: It ends automatically when employment terminates
It converts automatically into an individual policy
opts.w: 书中没有自动转换之说。

opts.t: It continues until the next policy anniversary date
opts.w: 书中说离职即自动终止。

opts.t: It continues if she keeps paying the group premium
opts.w: 团体险由雇主买，离职即止。

bank.note: 考试口径：通过雇主获得的失能保障，一离职就自动终止。所以自雇人士是个人 A&S 的典型客户。

bank.stem: Under a typical group Weekly Indemnity plan, an employee who misses work because of the flu for three days would MOST likely receive:

opts.t: Benefits from the first day of absence
opts.w: 第一天起付的是事故，不是疾病。

opts.t: No benefits, as sickness pay starts later
Benefits only after a 13-week waiting period
opts.w: 13 周是给付期选项之一，不是等待期。

opts.t: Long Term Disability benefits right away
opts.w: LTD 在周给付期结束后才开始。

bank.note: 周给付：事故第 1 天起付；疾病第 4、8 或 15 天起付。理由是不打算赔感冒、流感这类几天就好的小病。

bank.stem: Eligibility for Long Term Disability benefits under a group plan typically starts:

opts.t: On the first day of a disability caused by accident
opts.w: 那是周给付对事故的起付日。

opts.t: After the employee has been employed for two years
opts.w: 书中没有「受雇满两年」这个条件，LTD 接在周给付之后。

opts.t: At the end of the Weekly Indemnity benefit period
Only after the employee reaches the age of 65 years
opts.w: 65 岁常是 LTD 的终点，不是起点。

bank.note: LTD 资格从周给付期结束时开始，只要仍失能、仍符合职业定义，可付到 65 岁。

bank.stem: All of the following are factors in rating a travel insurance policy EXCEPT:

opts.t: The area of travel
opts.w: 旅行地区是书中列明的定价因素，陈述正确。

opts.t: The age and health of the individuals
opts.w: 年龄与健康是书中列明的定价因素，陈述正确。

opts.t: The duration of the trip
opts.w: 行程长短是书中列明的定价因素，陈述正确。

opts.t: The method of transportation

bank.note: 定价因素：个人或家庭、单次或年度、行程次数、长短、地区、限额、年龄与健康。交通方式不在其中（练习卷第 86 题）。

bank.stem: A single employee takes one two-week vacation each year to visit family in a neighbouring province. Which travel policy is MOST appropriate for him?

opts.t: An individual single trip policy purchased each year
An annual family policy covering an unlimited number of trips
opts.w: 他单身且每年只去一次。

opts.t: An annual individual policy with a 180-day trip option
opts.w: 只去一次两周，不必买年度。

opts.t: No policy, since provincial plans have reciprocal agreements
opts.w: 书中说互惠协议不等于福利与限额相同，出省就该买。

bank.note: 书中 Harry 例：每年一次、两周、单身 → 每年买一张个人单次保单，保费很可能比 Butler 家的全家年度保单低。

bank.stem: An employee takes her family to Hawaii under her family travel policy. The husband was diagnosed with a heart condition two months before the trip and faints due to high blood pressure; their unemployed 27-year-old son breaks his leg. Under that family policy, which medical expenses are covered?

opts.t: Both the husband's and the son's expenses are covered
opts.w: 丈夫属既往症、儿子超龄非受供养子女，两项都不赔。

opts.t: Neither the husband's nor son's expenses are covered
Only the husband's expenses are covered, as an emergency
opts.w: 出发两个月前确诊，属既往症。

opts.t: Only the son's broken leg is covered, as an accident
opts.w: 27 岁失业不算受供养子女。

bank.note: 儿子 27 岁、失业、不在读：超过受供养子女年龄（20，在读 26），不在保单内；丈夫的病出发前已存在且未稳定够期：既往症不赔。

bank.stem: A traveller needs emergency treatment while abroad. Under a typical travel policy, which situation would MOST likely be covered?

opts.t: Childbirth within eight weeks of the expected due date
opts.w: 预产期前 8 周内分娩是除外。

opts.t: An injury suffered while skydiving on vacation
opts.w: 跳伞属「危险活动」，是常见除外，不会赔。

opts.t: Emergency treatment for sudden food poisoning
Hospitalization following a drug overdose
opts.w: 药物过量属「药物滥用」，是常见除外，不会赔。

bank.note: 练习卷第 87 题同型：食物中毒是突然、不可预见、保期内发生、需立即治疗的紧急情况；其余三项各踩一条除外。

bank.stem: On day three of a 14-day cruise, an insured breaks her leg, leaves the ship, and flies home; the tickets were non-refundable. Which coverage pays the non-refundable travel costs?

opts.t: Trip cancellation, which applies after the departure date
opts.w: 取消险管出发前，这里已经出发。

opts.t: Nothing, because non-refundable fees are always excluded
opts.w: 书中说不可退旅费在限额内赔。

opts.t: Lost tickets coverage under the optional non-medical benefits
opts.w: 票没丢，是因伤中断行程。

opts.t: Trip interruption, as an incidental coverage of the policy

bank.note: 已出发后因伤中止＝行程中断（附带保障），在限额内赔酒店、机票与不可退旅费；行程取消保护的是出发日之前。

bank.stem: Which of the following statements about travel insurance is NOT correct?

opts.t: Like IBC homeowners forms, travel policies follow one standard wording
Some policies respond only when the insured is over 500 km from home
opts.w: 书中原文，正确陈述。

opts.t: Single trip policies cover only one trip lasting no more than 180 days
opts.w: 书中原文，正确陈述。

opts.t: Travel policies are subject to whichever provincial statutory conditions apply
opts.w: 书中原文，正确陈述。

bank.note: 考试口径：旅行险不像房屋险那样有 IBC 示范条款，市面上找不到两张完全相同的旅行险保单——旅行险没有标准保单。

bank.stem: How is automobile insurance provided in Quebec?

opts.t: The province covers personal injury and private insurers cover property damage
A compulsory government plan provides every coverage, including property damage
opts.w: 那是 BC、SK、MB 的强制政府计划；魁北克只由政府管人伤。

opts.t: Private insurers provide all coverages under a standard owner's policy
opts.w: 那是 AB、ON 与大西洋省份的私营模式。

opts.t: Private insurers cover personal injury and the province covers vehicle damage
opts.w: 方向反了：魁北克政府管人伤，私营公司管财产损失。

bank.note: 魁北克是混合制（hybrid）：人身伤害归省政府，财产损失归私营保险公司。AB、ON、大西洋省份全私营；BC、SK、MB 是强制政府计划。

bank.pt: 私营公司在 BC 能卖什么 · 找不是的
bank.stem: In British Columbia, private insurers may compete with the government plan by offering all of the following EXCEPT:

opts.t: Physical damage coverage for the policyholder's own vehicle
opts.w: 自车损失（own-damage）是私营公司在 BC 可卖的第三项。

opts.t: Increased limits for third-party liability coverage
opts.w: 加高第三方责任限额是私营公司可卖的超额保障之一。

opts.t: The compulsory basic coverage required to license a vehicle
Increased protection against uninsured and underinsured motorists
opts.w: 加强无保险／保额不足驾驶人保障也在可卖清单里。

bank.note: BC 的私营保险公司只能卖超额保障（excess coverage）：加高第三方责任、加强无保险／保额不足驾驶人保障、自车损失。Basic 由 ICBC 独家提供，上牌必须买。

bank.pt: Nick 的选择 · 低免赔额只有私营有
bank.stem: Lena lives in Kamloops. She wants $2,000,000 in third-party liability and a lower physical-damage deductible than the government plan offers. Where can she obtain each?

opts.t: Extra liability only from ICBC; the lower deductible from either source
opts.w: 增补册的例子说低免赔额只有私营公司提供，责任险两边都可以。

opts.t: Extra liability from either ICBC or a private insurer; the lower deductible only from a private insurer
Both from ICBC, because private insurers may sell only the compulsory basic coverage
opts.w: 方向反了：私营公司不能卖 Basic，只能卖超额保障。

opts.t: Both only from a private insurer, because ICBC sells no liability above $200,000
opts.w: ICBC 也卖加高的第三方责任（Extended TPL），两边都能买。

bank.note: 增补册 Nick 的例子：加高第三方责任政府或私营都能买；更低的车损免赔额只有私营公司提供，所以他两样都在私营公司买了。

bank.stem: In provinces with compulsory government auto insurance, what insurance documents does a policyholder receive?

opts.t: A full standard owner's policy wording plus a separate registration card
opts.w: 强制省不另发保单条款；细节写在法规、官网和经纪手册里。

opts.t: Only a vehicle registration, because insurance is proven by the licence
opts.w: 文件是两联：一联是保险证明，一联是登记证明。

opts.t: A binder, which is replaced by a full policy within 30 days
opts.w: 这里不是临时保单流程，两联文件本身就是全部文件。

opts.t: A two-part document serving as proof of insurance and evidence of registration

bank.note: 强制政府计划的省份：投保人拿到两联文件，一联是保险证明、一联是车辆登记证明；因为保障细节写在法规与官网里，不再另发保单。

bank.stem: Which body was given responsibility in 2003 for setting ICBC's basic insurance rates?

opts.t: ICBC's own board, without outside review
opts.w: 2003 年起 Basic 费率由外部监管机构定，不是 ICBC 自定。

opts.t: The British Columbia Utilities Commission
The Insurance Council of British Columbia
opts.w: Insurance Council 管的是中介持牌与操守，不定 ICBC 费率。

opts.t: The provincial Superintendent of Motor Vehicles
opts.w: 增补册写明是 BCUC，不是机动车监理。

bank.note: 2003 年《Insurance Corporation Act》修订，指定 BC Utilities Commission（BCUC） 为 Basic 费率监管机构，并禁止 Basic 与可选业务之间交叉补贴，免得 ICBC 在可选险上对私营公司占便宜。

bank.stem: A private insurer complains that ICBC could use profits from its compulsory basic business to underprice its optional collision coverage. Which feature of the 2003 legislation addresses this concern?

opts.t: A prohibition on cross-subsidizing between basic and optional operations
Basic rates must be approved by the Insurance Council before they take effect
opts.w: 费率监管机构是 BCUC，不是 Insurance Council；而且这里问的是交叉补贴。

opts.t: Private insurers are allowed to sell the compulsory basic coverage as well
opts.w: Basic 仍是 ICBC 独家，私营公司只能卖超额保障。

opts.t: ICBC is barred from selling any optional coverage at all
opts.w: ICBC 照样卖可选险，与私营公司竞争。

bank.note: 2003 年法律禁止 Basic 与可选业务之间交叉补贴，防止 ICBC 借垄断业务在可选险上取得对私营公司的竞争优势。

bank.pt: ICBC 制度的好处 · 找不是的
bank.stem: Each of the following is described as a benefit of British Columbia's public auto insurance system EXCEPT:

opts.t: The cost of coverage is spread over a driver's lifetime
opts.w: 把成本摊到一生、让高风险的年轻与年长阶段更负担得起，是列明的好处。

opts.t: Rates do not depend on a driver's age, gender or marital status
opts.w: 不按年龄、性别、婚姻定价，增补册称之为非歧视性定价。

opts.t: Licensing, registration and insurance are handled in one integrated system
opts.w: 三项职能整合、少了重复，是列明的好处。

opts.t: Rates for every driver are identical regardless of crash history

bank.note: 好处包括：几乎人人买得到（只有极高风险者会被拒）、不按年龄性别婚姻定价、成本摊到一生、各经纪行产品相同只比服务、牌照登记保险一体化。但有事故的人照样多交——driver factor 正是按事故记录调的。

bank.stem: Failing to obey a traffic rule and thereby causing a crash is an example of:

opts.t: Strict liability imposed by contract
opts.w: 这是疏忽造成的过失侵权，与合同无关。

opts.t: An intentional tort
opts.w: 故意侵权是蓄意侵犯他人权利，例如故意打人。

opts.t: An unintentional tort
A breach of a statutory condition
opts.w: 这里讲的是侵权分类，不是保单条件。

bank.note: 侵权分故意（蓄意伤人、明知有缺陷还卖）与非故意（粗心、未尽义务，如不守交规撞车）。过失（negligence）是最常见的非故意侵权。

bank.stem: Which provinces are described as having pure no-fault systems with no right to sue?

opts.t: Quebec and British Columbia
opts.w: BC 保留了少数可诉情形，增补册点名的纯无过失只有 MB 与 QC。

opts.t: British Columbia and Saskatchewan
opts.w: BC 是限制诉讼的无过失制、仍有例外；SK 不是纯无过失。

opts.t: Ontario and Alberta
opts.w: 这两省是无过失与侵权混合的私营体系。

opts.t: Manitoba and Quebec

bank.note: 增补册：每个省都有某种程度的无过失；Manitoba 与 Quebec 是纯无过失、无诉权；其他省是无过失＋侵权的组合。

bank.stem: In a no-fault system as described for Autoplan, the victim of a vehicle crash:

opts.t: Collects benefits only if the other driver is uninsured
opts.w: 给付与对方有没有保险无关，谁有错都一样拿。

opts.t: Cannot sue for damages, including pain and suffering
Must first prove the other driver was at fault to collect any benefit
opts.w: 无过失制度就是不必先证明对方有错。

opts.t: May sue for pain and suffering but not for medical costs
opts.w: 无过失制度下连痛苦与精神损失也不能起诉。

bank.note: 无过失：受害人没有诉权（不能就损害或痛苦起诉），由保险公司付医疗康复、按预设标准补收入；肇事方与受害方同样能拿给付（有的省对刑事过失驾驶有限制）。

bank.stem: A tourist from Oregon is injured on a British Columbia highway in 2026 by a driver from Vancouver who ran a stop sign. The tourist wants to sue the Vancouver driver for her injuries. Under British Columbia's lawsuits limitation:

opts.t: She must bring her action in Oregon instead, under the law of the state where she lives
opts.w: 事故在 BC 公路上，适用 BC 的诉讼限制。

opts.t: She may sue, because the limitation protects only drivers who live in British Columbia
opts.w: 增补册明说诉讼限制对 BC 居民和非居民都适用。

opts.t: Her claim is generally barred, because the limitation covers non-residents too
She may sue for pain and suffering only, because her medical costs are paid by ICBC
opts.w: BC 限制的是绝大多数人伤诉讼本身，不是只开放精神损失。

bank.note: 2021-05-01 起 BC 对造成人伤、死亡、车损的肇事司机原则上禁止起诉，对居民与非居民都适用；非居民在 BC 受伤也可按情况从 ICBC 拿给付。例外很少，如涉及非标准车辆的非公路事故。

bank.stem: On what date did ICBC move from a tort-based system to Enhanced Care?

opts.t: April 1, 2019
opts.w: 2019 年 9 月是驾驶员挂钩定价改革，不是 Enhanced Care。

opts.t: January 1, 2020
opts.w: 这个日期不是任何一次 ICBC 改制的起点。

opts.t: April 19, 1973
opts.w: 那是《Insurance Corporation Act》通过、ICBC 成立的日子。

bank.note: 2021 年 5 月 1 日 ICBC 从侵权制转为 Enhanced Care（一种无过失制），同时限制大部分针对肇事司机的诉讼。

bank.pt: Enhanced Care 把车损也纳入 Basic
bank.stem: Under Enhanced Care, how does a driver who was free of fault get their vehicle repaired?

opts.t: By suing the at-fault driver in Small Claims Court
opts.w: Enhanced Care 正是要省掉这一步；车损已纳入 Basic。

opts.t: Only through optional Collision coverage, if purchased
opts.w: Collision 管的是自己负责的那部分；无责部分走 Basic。

opts.t: Through vehicle damage coverage that is now part of ICBC's basic coverage
Through the at-fault driver's third-party liability coverage
opts.w: BC 公路车车事故的车损已改为直接赔付，不走对方责任险。

bank.note: Enhanced Care 把投保人自车在碰撞中的损坏并入 ICBC Basic（即 Basic Vehicle Damage），无责司机不必再起诉肇事方来修车。

bank.stem: Mei moves from Alberta to Victoria to take up permanent residence and brings her car. Under the rule taught for the exam, by when must she register, license and buy compulsory insurance for it in British Columbia?

opts.t: Within 90 days
opts.w: 考试口径的期限是 30 天。

opts.t: When her Alberta policy expires
opts.w: 期限从移居起算，不看原保单何时到期。

opts.t: Before driving it on any British Columbia road
opts.w: 「立即」只适用 5,000 kg 以上商用车和商用挂车。

opts.t: Within 30 days

bank.note: 考试口径：移居 BC 定居者须在 30 天内登记、上牌、买强制保险；5,000 kg 以上商用车或商用挂车要立即。现行 MVA s.21 的触发条件按用途（非旅游用途）而不是「定居」，见课文第④节（KU-0034）。

bank.stem: A forestry contractor operates an off-road vehicle only on forest service roads, never on public roads. What is the minimum insurance requirement?

opts.t: At least $200,000 in third-party liability, from ICBC or a private insurer
Only ORV registration with sticker plates and no liability coverage
opts.w: 只登记挂 ORV 牌是公有土地上越野车的规则；林业道路另有责任险要求。

opts.t: None, because off-road vehicles never need insurance in British Columbia
opts.w: 只在林业道路上跑也有要求：至少 $200,000 第三方责任。

opts.t: Full Autoplan Basic, because forest service roads count as public highways
opts.w: 全套 Basic 是给允许上公共道路的越野车的。

bank.note: 越野车三档：只在公有土地上用——登记挂 ORV 牌，不必上牌投保；允许上公共道路——上牌并买 Basic；只在林业道路（forest service roads）用——至少 $200,000 第三方责任，可买 ICBC 的 Off-Highway TPL 或私营保险。

bank.stem: Raj buys a used pickup in Washington State and brings it to British Columbia. Before it can be registered here, it must:

opts.t: Pass only a provincial mechanical and safety inspection
opts.w: 从加拿大境外进来的车，联邦与省两道检验都要过。

opts.t: Comply with both federal and provincial vehicle inspections
Be inspected only if it is more than 10 years old
opts.w: 增补册没有车龄门槛：所有外来车辆都要检验。

opts.t: Be inspected after registration, within 30 days
opts.w: 检验在登记之前，不是之后。

bank.note: 所有从 BC 省外带进来的车都要先过机械与安全检验才能登记；从加拿大境外进来的，联邦与省两道检验都要过。经纪行有指定检验点名单。

bank.pt: 保费三个调整因子 · 找不是的
bank.stem: ICBC adjusts the base premium for an individual policy using all of the following risk factors EXCEPT:

opts.t: The age and gender of the principal driver
The driving experience and crash histories of regular operators
opts.w: 驾驶经验与事故记录是三个调整因子之一。

opts.t: The territory covered by the policy
opts.w: 地区是三个调整因子之一。

opts.t: The vehicle's rate class
opts.w: 费率类别（车辆用途）是三个调整因子之一。

bank.note: 人人从同一个 base premium 起步，再按三个风险因子调：地区、费率类别、常用驾驶人的经验与事故记录；之后才看折扣与附加费。ICBC 不按年龄、性别定价。

bank.stem: A taxi is garaged overnight in Abbotsford but is driven almost every shift in downtown Vancouver. For rating, its assigned territory is:

opts.t: Territory Z, because taxis are rated outside British Columbia
opts.w: Territory Z 是 BC 省外地区，不是给出租车用的。

opts.t: Where the owner's business is registered
opts.w: 地区归属看车在哪儿跑或停，不看公司注册地。

opts.t: Where the vehicle is usually driven
Where the vehicle is garaged overnight
opts.w: 私家车、摩托车按停放地（home location）；出租车与巴士按通常行驶地。

bank.note: BC 分 14 个地区＋省外的 Z 区。私家车、摩托车等按停放地；巴士、出租车等按通常行驶地。

bank.stem: In ICBC rating, the vehicle's rate class specifies:

opts.t: The vehicle's repair cost group
opts.w: 维修成本分组是自车损失险的 rate group，不是 rate class。

opts.t: The vehicle's intended use
The number of at-fault crashes on the vehicle
opts.w: 事故记录跟着驾驶人走，体现在 driver factor 上。

opts.t: The region where the vehicle is driven
opts.w: 那是 territory（地区）。

bank.note: Rate class＝车辆用途，有 150 多种；商用比纯休闲贵。别和 own-damage 的 rate group（按车型平均赔案、维修成本定）混淆。

bank.stem: Gordon has driven in British Columbia for 24 years. He caused one crash 12 years ago and none since. Last month he caused a crash. Under ICBC's crash forgiveness:

opts.t: No forgiveness, because he has an earlier at-fault crash on his 40-year record
opts.w: 宽免看的是最近 10 年的扫描期，12 年前那次在扫描期外。

opts.t: No forgiveness, because forgiveness requires 25 years of driving
opts.w: 门槛是至少 20 年，他有 24 年。

opts.t: Every future crash is forgiven while he remains crash-free for 10 years
opts.w: 宽免只免一次（a single at-fault crash）。

opts.t: This single at-fault crash is forgiven

bank.note: 两个条件：在 BC 驾驶至少 20 年，且最近 10 年（scan period）没有有责事故 → 宽免一次有责事故。ICBC 记录保存 40 年，但宽免判据看 10 年扫描期。有责事故 ICBC 叫 chargeable claim。现行 ICBC 写法是「驾龄满 20 年、其中至少 10 年在 BC」，考场按「在 BC 满 20 年」答。

bank.stem: A driver's driver factor starts at 1.000. Which statement describes how it changes?

opts.t: It changes only when the driver receives a traffic ticket or fine
opts.w: 违章走 DPP／DRP；driver factor 看经验与有责事故。

opts.t: It falls with crash-free experience and rises after an at-fault crash
It goes up each year of experience and down after a crash is paid
opts.w: 方向反了：越有经验越低，出事越高。

opts.t: It stays fixed at 1.000 until the driver reaches the age of 25
opts.w: ICBC 不按年龄定价；因子随经验与事故变。

bank.note: Driver factor 是电脑算的三位小数，从 1.000 起步：无事故经验越久越低（变好），出有责事故就升（变差）。ICBC 用它乘 base premium。

bank.stem: Priya is the principal driver of the family car. Also listed are her husband, who has 30 years of crash-free driving, and her son, who was licensed last year. How is the combined driver factor determined?

opts.t: 75% Priya's factor and 25% her son's factor
100% Priya's factor, because only the principal driver counts
opts.w: 列名两人以上时用合并因子，不只看主驾。

opts.t: 75% Priya's factor and 25% her husband's, because he is the best driver
opts.w: 25% 取的是风险最高的那个列名驾驶人，不是最好的。

opts.t: An equal one-third weighting of all three listed drivers
opts.w: 不是平均；是主驾 75%＋风险最高者 25%。

bank.note: 两名以上列名驾驶人：75% 看主驾（principal driver），25% 看风险最高的那个列名驾驶人（经验最少／有责事故最多）。增补册 Joseph Banks 一例里，25% 取经验最少的儿子 Jordan。

bank.pt: 加好司机降保费的限制
bank.stem: Tom, the principal driver, adds his friend Sam to his policy because Sam has a much better driver factor. Sam lives elsewhere and works for another company. Will listing Sam lower Tom's combined driver factor?

opts.t: Yes, because any listed driver with a lower factor reduces the combination
opts.w: 只有家庭成员或雇员的更好因子才会拉低合并因子。

opts.t: Yes, but only after Sam has been listed for a full policy term
opts.w: 增补册没有这种等待期；关键是身份。

opts.t: No, because named drivers can never affect the premium
opts.w: 列名驾驶人当然会影响：25% 看风险最高者。

opts.t: No, because Sam is neither a household member nor an employee

bank.note: 列名驾驶人的因子比主驾好时，只有他是投保人家庭成员或雇员才能拉低合并因子——防止投保人专门挂一个低风险的人来压保费。

bank.stem: The Chens list two teenagers who hold learner's licences on their policy. How is the learner premium applied?

opts.t: No fee is charged until a learner causes a crash
opts.w: 列了学员就加费，与有无事故无关。

opts.t: The learners' crash records raise the policy's driver factor
opts.w: 学员期间造成的事故不计入其驾驶记录。

opts.t: One additional fee covers every learner who operates the vehicle
An additional fee is charged for each learner who is listed
opts.w: 名单上学员再多也只收一次。

bank.note: 列了持学习驾照者，ICBC 加一笔费用（金额按居住地，不考），一笔费用覆盖所有学员。学员期不计入日后的 driver factor，学员期事故也不进记录。

bank.pt: 新手的降低因子什么时候取消
bank.stem: ICBC lets each new driver start with a reduced driver factor. When is that reduction removed altogether?

opts.t: When the new driver causes a first crash of any kind
opts.w: 第一次有责事故只让因子上升；第二次才整个取消优惠。

opts.t: When the new driver has held a full licence for three years
opts.w: 满三年是新居民因子回落的节奏，不是新手优惠取消的条件。

opts.t: When the new driver receives a first traffic ticket
opts.w: 违章走罚分保费，不影响这个起步优惠。

opts.t: After causing a second crash within one 10-year scan period

bank.note: 新手起步给一个降低的 driver factor；出一次有责事故因子上升；同一 10 年扫描期内出第二次，优惠整个取消。

bank.stem: Ahmed moved to British Columbia from Manitoba in 2025 with 18 years of clean driving. He caused one crash in Winnipeg in 2022. How does ICBC treat his record for his driver factor?

opts.t: He starts at the best possible factor because of his 18 clean years
opts.w: 新居民头三年反而是加高的因子；经验好只是加得少。

opts.t: He starts with a raised factor for three years; the 2022 crash is ignored
He is rated as a learner until he obtains a British Columbia licence
opts.w: 新居民不按学员处理；是头三年加高的因子。

opts.t: The 2022 Manitoba crash raises his driver factor for the next ten years
opts.w: 新居民到 BC 之前的事故不计；只算在 BC 头三年里的。

bank.note: 新居民头 3 年给加高的 driver factor，无事故每年回落；经验多、驾照记录好（ICBC 看抵达前 15 年的驾照记录）可以加得少。到 BC 前造成的事故不计，只计在 BC 头三年的；只看 2017-03-01 及以后的有责事故。

bank.pt: 未列名驾驶人出事记在谁头上
bank.stem: Olivia lends her car to her colleague Ben, who lives elsewhere and is absent from her list of drivers. Ben causes a crash. Whose driving record and driver factor are affected?

opts.t: Both, each sharing half of the at-fault crash
opts.w: 增补册没有分摊；记录跟着驾驶人。

opts.t: Neither, because Ben was driving with permission
opts.w: 有许可只说明 Ben 是被保险人；事故照样记在他头上。

opts.t: Ben's, although Olivia may face a one-time penalty
Olivia's, because she is the registered owner
opts.w: 有责事故记在开车的人头上，车主的记录与因子不受影响。

bank.note: 有责事故记录跟着驾驶人走：记 Ben，不记 Olivia。但若保单没有 Unlisted Driver Protection（或不适用），ICBC 会向车主收一次性的 Unlisted Driver Accident Premium。

bank.stem: A paramedic causes a crash while driving an ambulance to an emergency call. A week later she causes another crash while driving the ambulance back to the station with no call in progress. Which crash affects her driver factor?

opts.t: Only the second crash
Only the first crash, because ambulances are not rated
opts.w: 方向反了：豁免的是急救呼叫中的那次。

opts.t: Neither, because first responders are never rated on duty
opts.w: 豁免只限执行紧急呼叫期间，不是整个当班。

opts.t: Both, because she was at fault each time
opts.w: 执行急救呼叫途中的那次不影响因子。

bank.note: 急救人员在执行紧急呼叫时驾驶紧急车辆出事，driver factor 不受影响；不在紧急呼叫中出事，照样影响。

bank.stem: Doris, 68, insures her car for pleasure use with a senior's discount. Which use keeps her within the discount's conditions?

opts.t: Commuting to a part-time job two days every week
opts.w: 每周两天一个月约 8–9 天，超过每月 6 天的上限。

opts.t: Driving to a volunteer job every weekday
opts.w: 每个工作日就远超每月 6 天。

opts.t: Making business deliveries on up to six days each calendar month
Using the car for business as long as she is the only driver
opts.w: 条件是每月最多 6 天，与是否独自驾驶无关。

bank.note: 长者折扣：65 岁以上、只保休闲用途；适用 Basic、Extended TPL 与 own-damage。每个日历月最多 6 天可用于通勤、商务或送货。出一次有责事故折扣减少，10 年内第二次就取消。现行 ICBC 材料只写 Basic 打 25%，考场按「Basic、Extended TPL、own-damage 三项」答。

bank.stem: Kevin buys an annual policy and expects to drive about 7,500 km this year. Which low-driving-distance discount can he receive?

opts.t: The Low-Kilometre Discount on Autoplan Basic only
opts.w: 低里程折扣要求年里程少于 5,000 公里，他超了。

opts.t: Both the Low-Kilometre and Distance-Based discounts
opts.w: 7,500 公里不到 5,000 门槛，只够得上按距离折扣。

opts.t: Neither, because both discounts require under 5,000 km
opts.w: 按距离折扣的门槛是少于 10,000 公里。

opts.t: The Distance-Based Discount on certain optional coverages only

bank.note: 低里程折扣（Low-Kilometre）：Basic 减 10%，年保单、少于 5,000 km。按距离折扣（Distance-Based）：可选险（Extended TPL、Collision、Comprehensive、Specified Perils）减 10–15%，年保单、少于 10,000 km，开得越少折得越多。现行：2025-06-01 起续保的可选险门槛放宽到 15,000 km，并按相隔一年的两次读数核实际里程——考场仍按 10,000 km。

bank.stem: To qualify for a low-driving-distance discount, all of the following odometer records are acceptable if dated within seven days of the purchase or renewal EXCEPT:

opts.t: A mileage estimate signed by the policyholder
A New Vehicle Information Statement form
opts.w: 新车信息表也在认可清单里。

opts.t: A photograph showing the vehicle's odometer
opts.w: 里程表照片是认可的凭证之一。

opts.t: A garage work order showing the odometer reading
opts.w: 修车行收据或工单是认可凭证。

bank.note: 认可的里程凭证（都须在买／续保前 7 天内）：里程表照片、修车行或车行的收据工单、车况 App 读数、填实数的 ICBC Transfer/Tax Form、New Vehicle Information Statement。估计数、取整数都不行；读数不能在保期中途补报或改，折扣也不能在保期内转到另一辆车。

bank.pt: 哪些车不享低里程折扣
bank.stem: Why are motorcycles and collector vehicles ineligible for the low-driving-distance discounts?

opts.t: They cannot be insured with annual policies of any kind
opts.w: 它们也可以买年保单；问题在于本来就不是全年开。

opts.t: They are already rated lower since they are seldom driven all year
They have no odometer reading that ICBC is able to accept
opts.w: 增补册给的理由是风险本已较低、已收较低保费。

opts.t: They are excluded from every discount that ICBC offers
opts.w: 只是不能享低里程类折扣，不是所有折扣都排除。

bank.note: 摩托车、收藏车等费率类别本来就不全年开、风险较低，ICBC 已经收得比别的车少，所以不再给低里程折扣。

bank.stem: Which vehicle qualifies for ICBC's immobilizer discount on its specified-perils or comprehensive coverage?

opts.t: A sedan whose engine is disabled until a chipped key fob is recognized
A pickup with a hidden switch the driver flips to enable starting
opts.w: 手动防盗器不在折扣范围内，只认被动电子式。

opts.t: A travel trailer fitted with a wheel lock
opts.w: 挂车没有发动机，不享这个折扣。

opts.t: A motorcycle with a factory-installed passive immobilizer
opts.w: 摩托车可以不发动就被抬走，所以不享这个折扣。

bank.note: 只有被动电子防盗器（熄火即自动锁死、认芯片钥匙才能启动）享 Specified Perils 与 Comprehensive 的折扣，金额由 ICBC 系统算。手动防盗器不享；摩托车与挂车不享。

bank.stem: Marco has a disability and owns a van that his daughter drives for him; he is absent from the list of drivers. What must happen for him to receive the 25 percent disability discount on Autoplan Basic?

opts.t: Nothing; ICBC applies it automatically to every eligible vehicle owner
opts.w: 这个折扣不自动生效，要交文件。

opts.t: He must first be listed on the policy as the principal driver
opts.w: 增补册明说不是列名驾驶人也能享。

opts.t: He must show approval under the provincial disability fuel tax refund program
He must obtain a medical certificate from a doctor chosen by ICBC
opts.w: 资格看的是省政府残障燃油税退税计划的批准，不是 ICBC 医生。

bank.note: 残障折扣：Basic 减 25%，不列名驾驶人也能享；资格是获 BC 残障人士燃油税退税计划批准；不自动生效，要把政府文件交给经纪人。

bank.stem: Last year Jason was convicted of impaired driving. He has since sold his car and insures no vehicle. Which statement is correct?

opts.t: He pays an Unlisted Driver Accident Premium instead
opts.w: UDAP 是向车主收的、因未列名者出事，与酒驾定罪无关。

opts.t: ICBC can still charge him a Driver Penalty-Point Premium
Nothing is payable, because these premiums are added only to a vehicle policy
opts.w: DPP／DRP 与 Autoplan 保费分开，没车也要交。

opts.t: ICBC adds the amount to his next policy only if he buys a car
opts.w: 增补册明说即使不拥有、不投保任何车辆也照收。

bank.note: DPP：某些 MVA 违章或刑法定罪（如酒驾）。DRP：一次驾驶相关刑事定罪、适用的 MVA 定罪或超速定罪；或两次以上路边吊销／禁驾或开车用电子设备定罪。两者与 Autoplan 保费分开，没车没保单也要交。

bank.stem: A Driver Risk Premium is triggered by a single conviction of each of the following types EXCEPT:

opts.t: An applicable conviction under the Motor Vehicle Act
opts.w: 一次适用的 MVA 定罪就会触发 DRP。

opts.t: A driving-related Criminal Code conviction
opts.w: 只要一次这类定罪就会触发 DRP。

opts.t: An excessive-speeding conviction
opts.w: 一次超速定罪就会触发 DRP。

opts.t: A conviction for using an electronic device while driving

bank.note: DRP 分两档：一次即触发——驾驶相关刑事定罪、适用的 MVA 定罪、超速定罪；两次以上才触发——路边吊销／禁驾、开车使用电子设备定罪。

bank.pt: UDAP 三个条件同时成立
bank.stem: ICBC charges the registered owner an Unlisted Driver Accident Premium only when all of the following are true. Which one is NOT a required condition?

opts.t: ICBC pays out on a chargeable claim arising from that crash
opts.w: 这是三个并列条件之一；增补册自测题专门考「没付款也收」是错的。

opts.t: The registered owner was a passenger in the vehicle at the time
Unlisted Driver Protection is absent from the policy or does not apply
opts.w: 这是三个并列条件之一。

opts.t: A driver not listed on the policy is responsible for an at-fault claim in the vehicle
opts.w: 这是三个并列条件之一。

bank.note: UDAP 三个条件同时成立才收：① 没有 UDP 或 UDP 不适用；② 未列名驾驶人造成有责理赔；③ ICBC 就该事故的有责理赔实际付了款。紧急送医等情形不收。

bank.stem: Nina left her roommate off the policy, who then caused a crash in her car. Nina paid $1,000 for Basic and $500 for optional coverages. Had the roommate been listed, she would have paid $1,300 for Basic and $600 for optional coverages. What Unlisted Driver Accident Premium will ICBC charge?

opts.w: Basic 部分是 15×$300＝$4,500，低于 $5,000 上限，不是按上限算。
这只是保费差额本身；罚金是差额乘 15，再套上限。
没套可选险那部分的上限：可选差额 15 倍 $1,500 超过了 2×$600＝$1,200。

bank.note: Basic：15×($1,300－$1,000)＝$4,500（上限 $5,000，未超）。可选：15×($600－$500)＝$1,500，上限＝应付可选保费的 2 倍＝$1,200 → 取 $1,200。合计 $5,700。差额为零或负数则不收。现行附录 APG33J 把可选部分上限写成「已付保费 × 2」，字面套用会得 $5,500；考场按「应付保费 × 2」算。

bank.stem: A first-time ICBC customer with no payment history wants to pay a 12-month policy in quarterly instalments. What will the broker tell her?

opts.t: Instalments are available only for optional coverages
opts.w: 分期可以付保费、牌照费与杂费。

opts.t: She may do so, but sales tax applies to the financing charges
opts.w: 分期收融资费，但不收销售税。

opts.t: Quarterly payments are available only on 6-month policies
opts.w: 季度付款对应 12 个月保单。

opts.t: She must start with the six-month monthly-payment option

bank.note: 分期三种：6 个月保单月付、12 个月保单月付、12 个月保单季付。新客户没有付款记录，必须先用 6 个月方案，顺利付完一期后续保才能任选。收融资费，不收销售税；扣款日遇周末或法定假日顺延到下一个工作日。

bank.pt: 拒绝出单令 · 找不是的
bank.stem: A refuse-to-issue order may be placed on a motorist's file for each of the following EXCEPT:

opts.t: A failed mechanical inspection
opts.w: 未通过机械检验是列明的原因。

opts.t: Unpaid impound fees
opts.w: 扣车费用是列明的原因，防止车主弃车。

opts.t: Two not-at-fault crashes in the past year
Unpaid Family Maintenance Enforcement Program debts
opts.w: 拖欠子女抚养费是列明的原因。

bank.note: RoadSafetyBC、司法部、交通部等可令 ICBC 拒卖或拒续，直到欠款罚款付清：交通罚款与欠款、扣车费、环保不合规、机械检验不合格、公交罚款、FMEP 抚养费欠款。无责事故不在其中。

bank.pt: 谁是被保险人 · 找不是的
bank.stem: Autoplan Basic covers each of the following people EXCEPT:

opts.t: A mechanic road-testing the car with the owner's permission
The person who leases the vehicle
opts.w: 承租人（lessee）与车主同样在承保之列。

opts.t: A household member who is listed as a driver on the policy
opts.w: 列名驾驶人在承保之列。

opts.t: A friend with a valid licence who drives with the owner's permission
opts.w: 持有效驾照、经车主许可驾驶的人也在承保之列。

bank.note: Basic 承保：车主或承租人、列名驾驶人、任何持有效驾照并经车主或承租人许可的人。做买卖、修理、保养、存放、服务、停车生意的人即使有车主许可也不保，要自己买 garage policy。

bank.stem: Hannah leaves her SUV at a repair shop and agrees that the technician may test-drive it. During the test drive the technician injures a pedestrian. Whose insurance is meant to respond to claims arising from the technician's driving?

opts.t: No one, because test drives are excluded from all auto insurance
opts.w: 有保险：修理厂应当自己买 garage policy。

opts.t: Hannah's Autoplan Basic, because she gave permission
opts.w: 许可在这里不够：汽车行业的人被明确排除在车主保单之外。

opts.t: The repair shop's own garage policy
The technician's personal Autoplan policy on his own car
opts.w: 考试口径说这类业务要买 garage policy，不是靠个人保单。

bank.note: 修车、卖车、存车、泊车等业务对客户车辆的使用，车主的 Autoplan 不保，即使有车主许可；这些企业要另买 garage policy（细节不在考试范围）。

bank.stem: Autoplan Basic coverage applies in which territory?

opts.t: Canada only, because ICBC is a provincial insurer
opts.w: 美国也在承保地域内。

opts.t: Canada, the U.S., and ships sailing between their ports
Anywhere in North America, including Mexico
opts.w: 墨西哥不在承保地域内。

opts.t: British Columbia only, unless an extension is purchased
opts.w: Basic 本身就覆盖加拿大与美国。

bank.note: Basic 的承保地域：加拿大、美国、以及往返加美港口之间的船上。去墨西哥出事 ICBC 不赔，要另买当地保险。

bank.pt: Basic 五项 · 找不是的
bank.stem: Autoplan Basic provides each of the following compulsory coverages EXCEPT:

opts.t: Inverse Liability Coverage
opts.w: 反向责任险是 Basic 五项之一。

opts.t: Basic Vehicle Damage
opts.w: BVD 是 2021 年起 Basic 五项之一。

opts.t: Underinsured Motorist Protection
opts.w: UMP 是 Basic 五项之一。

opts.t: Collision

bank.note: Basic 五项：基本车损（Basic Vehicle Damage）、第三者责任（Third Party Liability）、反向责任（Inverse Liability）、强化事故给付（Enhanced Accident Benefits）、保额不足驾驶人保障（Underinsured Motorist Protection）。Collision 是可选险，管自己负责的那部分车损。

bank.pt: BC 仍然可诉的情形 · 找不是的
bank.stem: British Columbia's prohibition on crash lawsuits does NOT apply to which of the following?

opts.t: Injury to a passenger in a two-car collision on a public road in Surrey
opts.w: 公路上两车相撞的人伤属于被禁止的诉讼。

opts.t: Damage to a fence knocked down by a car
Repair costs of a car hit at a Burnaby intersection
opts.w: BC 公路上的车损走 BVD 直接赔付，不能起诉。

opts.t: Pain and suffering of a British Columbia resident injured on a British Columbia highway
opts.w: 这正是诉讼限制的核心对象：BC 公路上的人伤不能起诉。

bank.note: 诉讼限制不适用的情形：车辆以外的财产（建筑、围栏）、第三方车内物品或货物、营业中断、须清理的环境损害、在允许诉讼的省外地区出事、涉及非标准车辆的非公路事故。

bank.pt: 可诉例外 · 车里的货
bank.stem: A delivery van stopped at a red light in Burnaby is rear-ended. The van is repaired, but $8,000 of customers' furniture inside it is ruined. Can the van owner pursue the at-fault driver for the furniture?

opts.t: Yes, because damage to contents or cargo of a third party's vehicle is an exception
No, because cargo losses are paid by Basic Vehicle Damage instead
opts.w: BVD 明说不赔车内物品、货物与营业中断。

opts.t: Yes, but only if the furniture belonged to the van owner personally
opts.w: 例外条款没有这种所有权条件。

opts.t: No, because all crash-related lawsuits in British Columbia are prohibited
opts.w: 说得太满：车内物品与货物是列明的例外。

bank.note: 第三方车内的物品或货物损失是诉讼限制的例外，可以向肇事方索赔，由肇事方的第三方责任险响应。BVD 本身不赔车内物品、货物与营业中断。

bank.stem: Darren from Kelowna causes a crash in Banff, Alberta, where lawsuits for injuries are permitted. He has Autoplan Basic and no extended liability. How much third-party liability coverage does Basic provide?

opts.t: Unlimited, because Enhanced Accident Benefits has no overall limit
opts.w: 无总上限说的是 EAB，不是第三方责任。

opts.t: $1,000,000, the limit that applies outside British Columbia
opts.w: $1,000,000 是营运重型车等的 Basic 限额，不是省外限额。

opts.t: Nothing, because Autoplan applies only inside British Columbia
opts.w: Basic 在加拿大与美国都有效。

opts.t: $200,000, subject to Alberta's rules on lawsuits

bank.note: 在 BC 省外出事，Basic 提供 $200,000 第三方责任，按当地的诉讼规则走。不够的部分靠可选的 Extended Third Party Liability。

bank.pt: 营运车辆的法定较高限额
bank.stem: Under British Columbia law, which vehicle automatically receives $2 million of third-party liability under Autoplan Basic?

opts.t: A commercial trailer hauling lumber
opts.w: 商用挂车是 $1,000,000 那一档。

opts.t: A taxi carrying passengers for hire
A tanker truck carrying dangerous goods
A private passenger car used to commute
opts.w: 私家车 Basic 是 $200,000。

bank.note: 收费载货或载客的车，BC 法律要求提高第三方责任：重型商用车（总重 5,000 kg 以上）、商用挂车、巴士、出租车、豪华轿车 Basic 自动 $1 million；运载危险品的 $2 million。这两个数不在「不考」块内，是正经考点（KU-0006）。

bank.pt: TPL 不适用的情形 · 找不是的
bank.stem: ICBC's Third Party Liability coverage does NOT apply to which of the following?

opts.t: Injury to a cyclist in Oregon who sues the British Columbia driver
opts.w: 俄勒冈允许起诉，这正是 TPL 要响应的情形。

opts.t: Damage to a neighbour's garage door hit by the insured's car
opts.w: 车辆以外的他人财产，TPL 照样响应。

opts.t: Damage to a fence owned by the city
opts.w: 他人的围栏属于可诉的财产损失，TPL 响应。

opts.t: Damage to the insured's own house caused by the insured's car

bank.note: TPL 不适用：诉讼受限或不允许的地区；投保人车上载运的财产；投保人自有或租用的财产（如自己的房子）；WCA 下应付的评估费罚款；拖带须上牌而未上牌的挂车；工地上附属设备作业（如车载吊臂）；投保人因该事故被刑法定罪时判给的赔偿。

bank.stem: A crane mounted on a contractor's licensed truck swings into a neighbouring building while lifting materials at a work site. Under Autoplan, the truck's Third Party Liability coverage:

opts.t: Applies, provided the truck was parked on a public road at the time
opts.w: 考试口径的除外不看车停在哪里，看的是附属设备在工地作业。

opts.t: Does not apply, because operation of attached equipment at a work site is excluded
Responds, because the crane is permanently attached to the vehicle
opts.w: 附属设备在工地作业正是 TPL 的除外情形。

opts.t: Responds only up to the $1 million commercial limit
opts.w: 这里是赔不赔的问题，不是限额的问题。

bank.note: 工地上附属设备作业（如卡车上的吊臂）造成的损失，ICBC 第三方责任不适用；这类风险应另买商业责任险。

bank.stem: When is ICBC's Third Party Liability coverage unavailable for damages awarded in a lawsuit?

opts.t: When the crash occurs outside British Columbia
opts.w: 省外出事 Basic 照样给 $200,000 第三方责任。

opts.t: When the injured person is a passenger in the policyholder's car
opts.w: 乘客受伤不是 TPL 的除外理由。

opts.t: When the policyholder is convicted of a crime tied to the crash
When the policyholder receives a speeding ticket for the crash
opts.w: 增补册的除外是刑法定罪，不是交通罚单。

bank.note: TPL 除外清单最后一项：投保人因该事故被刑法定罪时，诉讼判给的赔偿 TPL 不付。

bank.stem: Which statement about Enhanced Accident Benefits is correct?

opts.t: It covers cyclists and pedestrians as well, regardless of fault
It is an optional coverage bought with Income Top-Up
opts.w: EAB 是 Basic；Income Top-Up 才是可选。

opts.t: It pays only the drivers and passengers of licensed vehicles
opts.w: 骑车人和行人同样在 EAB 的保障范围内。

opts.t: It applies only when the injured person was not at fault
opts.w: EAB 不问谁有错，有责方也能领。

bank.note: EAB 是 Basic 保障，对所有 BC 居民与 ICBC 客户开放，不问过错，赔医疗、收入损失等，没有总上限；司机、乘客、骑车人、行人都包括在内。

bank.pt: 非居民在 BC 受伤
bank.stem: A visitor from Ontario is injured as a passenger in a crash in Kelowna. She has accident benefits through her own Ontario auto insurer. How are her benefits handled?

opts.t: She receives nothing, because only British Columbia residents qualify
opts.w: 非居民在 BC 受伤 ICBC 也会帮付医疗康复。

opts.t: She must sue the at-fault driver, because visitors are outside Enhanced Care
opts.w: 诉讼限制对非居民同样适用，而且她有给付可拿。

opts.t: Her Ontario insurer is her main source of accident benefits
ICBC pays all her benefits in full, with no regard to fault
opts.w: 非居民的给付可能按其过错程度不同，而且另有车险时以那家为主。

bank.note: 非居民在 BC 车祸受伤，ICBC 帮付医疗与康复，但金额可能按其过错程度不同；如果她通过另一家车险公司享有意外给付，那家是主要来源。

bank.pt: 医疗费 · 和 MSP 的关系
bank.stem: How do Enhanced Accident Benefits relate to British Columbia's Medical Services Plan?

opts.t: They pay only if the injured person has no MSP coverage
opts.w: 有没有 MSP 不是条件；EAB 报 MSP 不管的部分。

opts.t: MSP pays first and then recovers its costs from the injured person
opts.w: 增补册说的是分工，不是先付后追。

opts.t: They replace MSP for all crash injuries
opts.w: MSP 照管基本医疗；EAB 是在它之上。

opts.t: MSP covers basic care; the benefits pay for extras beyond it

bank.note: MSP 管基本医疗；EAB 在此之上报销理疗、脊骨、注册按摩、心理、针灸、预批牙科、药品耗材、眼镜义齿等器具、事故现场到医院的救护车、就医交通、危重住院时亲友探视的交通住宿等——前提是其他保险或医疗计划没有覆盖。

bank.pt: 医疗报销 · 找不是的
bank.stem: Enhanced Accident Benefits may reimburse each of the following EXCEPT:

opts.t: Dental treatment the injured person started without ICBC approval
Massage therapy by a registered massage therapist
opts.w: 注册按摩治疗在列明的治疗项目里。

opts.t: Dental treatment that ICBC has pre-authorised
opts.w: 预先批准的牙科治疗在列。

opts.t: Ambulance transportation from the crash scene to a hospital
opts.w: 现场到医院的救护车在列。

bank.note: 列明项目里牙科的写法是「pre-authorised by ICBC」（须 ICBC 预先批准）。其余如注册按摩、救护车、眼镜、义齿、处方鞋、去治疗的交通都在报销范围。

bank.stem: Sofia earns a gross salary of $80,000 and a net income of $60,000. She cannot work after a crash. Under the exam calculation, her annual income replacement benefit is:

opts.w: 收入替代不是全额，是净收入的 90%。
90% 乘的是净收入，不是毛收入。
75% 不是考试口径的比例。

bank.note: 考试口径：净收入 × 90%＝$60,000×90%＝$54,000；总额受年毛收入上限约束（上限金额每年 4 月 1 日调整，不考）。现行另有「平均毛周薪 75%、周封顶」的第二算法取高者（KU-0024），见第④节。

bank.pt: 收入替代从第几天开始、谁先赔
bank.stem: When do Income Replacement Benefits begin, and how do they rank against other wage-loss benefits?

opts.t: Eight days after the crash; they come second to plans such as employer disability and EI
Immediately after the crash; they are paid before any employer plan
opts.w: 从事故后第 8 天起付，而且排在其他工资损失给付之后。

opts.t: After 30 days; they are paid in equal shares with WorkSafeBC
opts.w: 起付期与排序都不对。

opts.t: Eight days after the crash; they are paid before WorkSafeBC benefits
opts.w: 起付日对，但排序反了：ICBC 排在 WorkSafeBC 之后。

bank.note: 收入替代事故后第 8 天起付；它排在其他工资损失给付之后（雇主伤残计划、WorkSafeBC、EI）。未满 18 岁、学生、65 岁以上者事故时在职也能领（KU-0026）。

bank.stem: Walter, 71, works three days a week at a hardware store and is injured in a crash. Is he eligible for Income Replacement Benefits?

opts.t: No, because the benefit ends at age 65
opts.w: 增补册说 65 岁以上事故时在职也能领。

opts.t: Only if he purchased Income Top-Up
opts.w: Income Top-Up 只是加高上限，不是资格条件。

opts.t: Yes, since he had a job at the crash date
Only if he was not at fault for the crash
opts.w: 收入替代不问谁造成事故。

bank.note: 收入替代不问过错；未满 18 岁、学生、65 岁以上的人，只要事故时有工作都能领。

bank.stem: Before a crash, Amira stayed home without pay to care for her two children, aged 5 and 9. Her injuries now prevent her from providing that care. What is the purpose of the caregiver benefit she can receive?

opts.t: To pay her to continue caring for the children while she recovers
opts.w: 目的恰恰是她做不了时请别人来做。

opts.t: To pay for hiring someone else to be the caregiver
To reimburse the children's own medical costs
opts.w: 孩子没受伤；这项给付是给照护者的。

opts.t: To replace the salary she would have earned in an outside job
opts.w: 这不是收入替代：她是无薪照护者。

bank.note: Caregiver Benefit 给事故时无薪照护 16 岁以下孩子或无法正常工作者的人；目的是请别人来照护。分全职与兼职两档（每周金额不考）。

bank.stem: Personal Care Assistance under Enhanced Accident Benefits pays for:
