opts.t: A lump sum for a permanent loss of function
opts.w: 那是 Permanent Impairment 的一次性给付。

opts.t: Lost wages of a family member who stays home from work
opts.w: 照护给付按伤者需要的照护等级给，不是补家属工资。

opts.t: Counselling for family members of a person killed in a crash
opts.w: 那是 Grief Counselling。

opts.t: Hiring help for an injured person unable to self-care

bank.note: Personal Care Assistance＝请人照顾生活不能自理的伤者，按所需照护等级给（非灾难性／灾难性不需 24 小时／灾难性需 24 小时；月度金额不考）。

bank.stem: How is the lump-sum Permanent Impairment payment determined?

opts.t: By a court award, reduced by the injured person's share of fault
opts.w: Enhanced Care 下这是按法规附表给，不是法院判、也不按过错打折。

opts.t: By the type of injury and the extent of impairment under a regulation's schedule
By the injured person's age, using a fixed amount for each year
opts.w: 附表按伤害类型与损害程度定，不按年龄。

opts.t: By the injured person's income at the time of the crash
opts.w: 收入决定的是收入替代与死亡给付，不决定永久伤残给付。

bank.note: 永久伤残给一次性金额，按伤害类型与永久损害程度，依据 Insurance (Vehicle) Act 下 Permanent Impairment Regulation 的附表。现行金额与百分比怎么乘见第④节（KU-0025）。

bank.pt: 康复给付 · 找不是的
bank.stem: ICBC's rehabilitation benefits may include each of the following EXCEPT:

opts.t: Compensation for pain and suffering
Alterations to the person's vehicle to accommodate the injury
opts.w: 车辆改装是列明的项目。

opts.t: Training for a new career after the crash
opts.w: 重返原岗位或转行培训是列明的项目。

opts.t: Alterations to the person's home to accommodate the injury
opts.w: 住宅改造是列明的项目。

bank.note: 康复给付：重返工作或转行培训、住宅与车辆改造、其他必要的康复开支。痛苦与精神损失在无过失制度下不赔，是侵权诉讼才有的项目。

bank.stem: A widowed father of two dependent children, aged 8 and 12, is killed in a crash. Who receives the one-time death benefit?

opts.t: His estate, to be divided under his will
opts.w: 死亡给付直接给法定受益人，不进遗产按遗嘱分。

opts.t: His own parents, as next of kin
opts.w: 父母只在特定情形下才领；有受养子女时由子女领。

opts.t: Nobody, because there is no surviving spouse
opts.w: 没有配偶时由受养子女分领。

opts.t: The dependent children, who share the payment

bank.note: 死亡给付一次性付给在世配偶、同居伴侣或受养人，金额看死者事故时的年龄与收入；没有配偶或伴侣时由受养子女分领；特定情形下给成年子女或父母。

bank.stem: After a fatal crash, the victim's sister must travel 80 km each way from her home community to attend grief counselling with an Indigenous elder. What does ICBC provide?

opts.t: Nothing for travel, because counselling must be with a licensed psychologist
opts.w: 提供者可以是咨询师、精神科医生、神职人员或原住民长老。

opts.t: Grief counselling only for the spouse, not for siblings
opts.w: 每位家庭成员都可以领。

opts.t: Counselling costs, and her travel and accommodation may be pre-approved
Travel costs only if she was also injured in the crash
opts.w: 交通住宿预批看的是单程超过 50 公里，不看她是否受伤。

bank.note: 每位家庭成员都可按每位遇难者领一笔哀伤辅导费（金额不考）；提供者可以是咨询师、精神科医生、神职人员或原住民长老。单程超过 50 公里去辅导的，交通与住宿可以预先批准。

bank.stem: Tyler's car suffers $12,000 of damage in a highway crash in Nanaimo. ICBC finds him 40 percent responsible. He has optional Collision with a $500 deductible. How much does Basic Vehicle Damage pay, and what share of the deductible does Tyler pay?

opts.t: $7,200, and he pays the full deductible
opts.w: 免赔额也按责任比例分摊，他只付 40%。

opts.t: $12,000, and he pays no deductible
opts.w: BVD 要按他负责的比例扣减。

opts.t: $4,800, and he pays 60% of the deductible
opts.w: 比例用反了：BVD 赔的是他不负责的 60%。

opts.t: $7,200, and he pays 40% of the deductible

bank.note: BVD 按投保人不负责的比例赔：$12,000×60%＝$7,200。他负责的 40%（$4,800）走可选 Collision，免赔额也只付 40%（$200）。没买 Collision 就自己扛那 $4,800（KU-0003）。

bank.stem: Basic Vehicle Damage coverage has a limit of $200,000 and pays for:

opts.t: Business income lost while the vehicle is being repaired
opts.w: 营业中断明确不在 BVD 范围内。

opts.t: Repair or replacement of the vehicle, including loss of use, towing and storage
Repair of the vehicle and the cargo carried inside it
opts.w: BVD 明说不赔车内物品、货物与营业中断。

opts.t: Repair of the vehicle only when the crash happens outside British Columbia
opts.w: 方向反了：BVD 只在 BC 公路上适用，省外不适用。

bank.note: BVD 限额 $200,000：修理或更换投保车辆（含永久附属设备），以及使用损失、拖车、存放费用；不赔车内物品、货物、营业中断。超出限额靠可选 Collision。

bank.stem: Kim, insured with ICBC, is hit by another car in Spokane, Washington, and bears no fault. Which statement is correct about her vehicle damage?

opts.t: Basic Vehicle Damage pays because she was not responsible
opts.w: BVD 只在 BC 境内适用，省外出事不适用。

opts.t: Basic Vehicle Damage pays up to $200,000 anywhere in Canada or the United States
opts.w: $200,000 是 BVD 限额，但地域只在 BC。

opts.t: Washington law governs, and she needs collision coverage to be insured for repairs
Nothing can be recovered, because Autoplan does not apply in the United States
opts.w: Autoplan 在美国适用；只是 BVD 不适用，走当地法律或 Collision。

bank.note: BVD 只适用于 BC 公路上涉及特定车辆的事故。省外出事 BVD 不适用，按事故地法律处理；投保人要靠 Collision 才有修车保障（也可向对方索赔）。

bank.stem: On a private ranch road, Ellie's licensed SUV is struck by a teenager driving an unlicensed golf cart. Ellie is free of fault. Does Basic Vehicle Damage cover her SUV?

opts.t: No; off-highway it needs two licensed standard vehicles
Yes, because she was not responsible for the crash
opts.w: 非公路事故里，对方是非标准车辆时 BVD 根本不适用，与过错无关。

opts.t: Yes, but only up to 50 percent of the damage
opts.w: BVD 没有这种对半规则。

opts.t: No, because Basic Vehicle Damage never applies off a public highway
opts.w: 非公路也可能适用：两辆持牌标准车或持牌挂车相撞时。

bank.note: 非公路事故：至少两辆持牌标准车（或持牌挂车）相撞，BVD 才适用；撞的是拖拉机、高尔夫球车等非标准车辆，或撞行人、骑车人，BVD 不适用——走 Collision 或对方的第三方责任。

bank.stem: Underinsured Motorist Protection pays up to $1 million when an injured policyholder or household member meets which two conditions?

opts.t: They were not at fault, and the other driver was uninsured
opts.w: UMP 不看自己有没有过错，看的是 EAB 资格与对方保额。

opts.t: They are outside Canada, and the other driver was identified
opts.w: UMP 在加拿大与美国都有效，没有这个地域条件。

opts.t: They lack accident-benefit eligibility, and the other driver is underinsured
They bought Extended Third Party Liability, and the claim exceeds $200,000
opts.w: UMP 是 Basic 自带，不以买 Extended TPL 为前提。

bank.note: UMP 最高 $1 million／人，两个条件同时成立：① 不享有 EAB；② 肇事方第三方责任险不足以赔判定的损害。所以在 BC 不允许起诉的场合（包括绝大多数 BC 事故）UMP 不适用（KU-0004、KU-0057）。

bank.pt: UMP 场景 · 非公路行人
bank.stem: A pedestrian who lives in the policyholder's household is hit in an off-highway crash in British Columbia where she is ineligible for Enhanced Accident Benefits. She sues and is awarded $700,000, but the driver has only $200,000 of liability coverage. How much can UMP pay?

opts.t: $1,000,000, the full UMP limit
opts.w: 限额是上限，不是固定给付；只补差额。

opts.t: Nothing, because UMP applies only outside British Columbia
opts.w: 增补册的例子正是 BC 境内非公路的行人。

opts.t: $700,000, the full award
opts.w: UMP 补的是对方保额不足的部分，对方已付 $200,000。

bank.note: 这正是增补册的 BC 境内例子：不享有 EAB、可以起诉、对方只有 $200,000 → UMP 补差额 $700,000－$200,000＝$500,000（上限 $1 million／人）。UMP「只管省外」是旧派生件的错误简化（KU-0004）。

bank.stem: A policyholder is seriously injured by a driver with only $200,000 of coverage in a crash on a Vancouver street. Her losses exceed $1 million. Under Underinsured Motorist Protection:

opts.t: UMP does not apply, because the law in British Columbia does not permit this lawsuit
UMP pays up to $1 million, because the other driver's limit is too low
opts.w: 在 BC 不允许起诉的场合 UMP 不适用；她走 EAB。

opts.t: UMP pays the excess above $200,000 without any limit
opts.w: UMP 有 $1 million 上限，而且这里根本不适用。

opts.t: UMP pays only after she sues and obtains a judgment in British Columbia
opts.w: BC 公路上的人伤不能起诉，没有判决可拿。

bank.note: 增补册明说：在法律不允许车祸诉讼的场合（包括 BC），UMP 对人伤与死亡不适用。她在 BC 公路上受伤，享有 EAB，照护康复由 EAB 管。

bank.stem: When a British Columbia policyholder makes a UMP claim for a crash in Idaho, which law governs how the coverage applies?

opts.t: Federal Canadian law, because the crash was abroad
opts.w: 没有这种联邦法规则。

opts.t: The law of the place where the crash occurred
Whichever law gives the policyholder the higher payment
opts.w: 不是择优，按事故地法律。

opts.t: British Columbia law, because the policy was issued there
opts.w: 增补册说按事故地的法律。

bank.note: UMP 在加拿大与美国都有效；在 BC 以外出事，按事故发生地的法律决定 UMP 怎么适用。

bank.stem: A hit-and-run driver smashes Ravi's backyard fence on a British Columbia highway. Ravi rents his home, owns no car and has no other coverage for the fence. Which statement is correct?

opts.t: Up to $200,000 under the statutory provision, less $750
He can claim under Hit and Run coverage with no deductible
opts.w: Hit and Run 是车主的可选险，保的是车；他没车。

opts.t: He can claim under Basic Vehicle Damage for the fence
opts.w: BVD 只赔投保车辆本身。

opts.t: He has no recourse, because he does not insure a vehicle with ICBC
opts.w: 法定条款对全体 BC 居民开放，不需要有车或驾照。

bank.note: Insurance (Vehicle) Act 的法定条款：BC 居民的非车辆财产（建筑、围栏、自行车）在 BC 公路上被无保险或逃逸司机损坏，最高 $200,000；独立于 Basic，不必有车、有保单或有 BC 驾照，前提是没有其他保障；逃逸致财产损失要付 $750 免赔额。

bank.pt: 反向责任 · 触发条件
bank.stem: Inverse Liability Coverage responds to damage to the policyholder's vehicle in which situation?

opts.t: A single-vehicle crash in which nobody else was involved
opts.w: 反向责任按对方负责的比例赔，必须有对方。

opts.t: A crash on a British Columbia highway with another British Columbia driver
opts.w: BC 境内两车事故走 BVD，不是反向责任险。

opts.t: A crash in Quebec, where such claims are barred by law
A crash in Mexico, where ICBC coverage does not apply
opts.w: 反向责任只针对加拿大与美国的不允许索偿的辖区。

bank.note: Inverse Liability：事故发生在、或肇事方住在加拿大或美国某个法律不允许就此类损失索偿的辖区时，赔投保车辆的损失，按对方负责的比例赔；同时由 Basic 付对方负责比例的 Collision 免赔额。

bank.stem: In an inverse-liability situation, the other driver is 30 percent responsible for $10,000 of damage to the policyholder's car. The policyholder has Collision with a $500 deductible. Which statement is correct?

opts.t: Inverse Liability pays $7,000 and Collision pays $3,000
opts.w: 比例用反了：反向责任按对方负责的 30% 赔。

opts.t: Inverse Liability pays $3,000, and Basic pays 30% of the Collision deductible
Inverse Liability pays the full $10,000 because the other driver was at fault
opts.w: 只按对方负责的比例赔。

opts.t: Collision pays all $10,000 and the policyholder pays the full $500
opts.w: 对方负责的比例由反向责任赔，免赔额的 30% 也由 Basic 付。

bank.note: 反向责任按对方负责的比例赔：$10,000×30%＝$3,000。投保人自己负责的 70% 走 Collision；Basic 替他付对方负责那 30% 的免赔额。

bank.stem: Which own-damage coverage insures loss caused by anything other than a collision?

opts.t: Collision
opts.w: Collision 管的正是碰撞与翻车。

opts.t: Specified Perils
opts.w: Specified Perils 只保列明的几种风险，不是「碰撞以外一切」。

opts.t: Basic Vehicle Damage
opts.w: BVD 是 Basic 的碰撞车损，按不负责比例赔。

opts.t: Comprehensive

bank.note: 三种自车损失：Collision（碰撞或翻车）、Specified Perils（列明风险）、Comprehensive（碰撞以外的一切）。

bank.stem: Which vehicle is most likely rated in the declared-value category for own-damage coverage?

opts.t: A mass-produced compact sedan
opts.w: 大多数私家车、轻型商用车按 rate group 定价。

opts.t: A motorhome
A light commercial pickup
opts.w: 轻型商用车大多按 rate group 定价。

opts.t: A family minivan
opts.w: 私家车按 rate group 定价。

bank.note: 两种定价类别：rate group（按车型平均赔案、维修成本、排量、安全配置；大多数私家车与轻型商用车）与 declared value（按申报的市价含设备与税；挂车、房车、摩托车、工业车、总重 5,000 kg 以上商用车、雪地车、高尔夫球车、改装车）。

bank.pt: Collision 的范围 · 找不是的
bank.stem: Collision coverage insures damage caused by impact with each of the following EXCEPT:

opts.t: A deer that runs onto the highway
A trailer being towed by the insured vehicle
opts.w: 被拖带的挂车列在 Collision 里。

opts.t: A guardrail beside the roadway
opts.w: 路边护栏列在 Collision 里。

opts.t: A pothole in the road surface
opts.w: 坑洞明确列在 Collision 里。

bank.note: Collision：与另一车、人、物碰撞或翻车，包括被拖的车或挂车、行人、路面、坑洞裂缝、掉到路上的物体、路边的标志护栏桥墩等；还赔被肇事逃逸撞坏的车。撞动物（活的死的）归 Comprehensive。

bank.stem: Ken has only Specified Perils coverage on his older car. Which loss is covered?

opts.t: The car hits a deer on a rural road
opts.w: 撞动物不在 Specified Perils 里。

opts.t: A rock cracks the windshield on the highway
opts.w: 风挡玻璃损坏不在 Specified Perils 里，归 Comprehensive。

opts.t: Vandals scratch the paint in a parking lot
opts.w: 故意破坏与恶意毁损不在 Specified Perils 里。

opts.t: Hail dents the roof during a storm

bank.note: Specified Perils：火、盗窃（家人或雇员偷的除外）、天气（雷电、风暴、冰雹、涨水）、运输工具出事、地震、爆炸、暴乱、飞机坠落。不保故意破坏、恶意毁损、撞动物、风挡玻璃。便宜，适合怕火怕盗的旧车。

bank.stem: How does a claim paid under Comprehensive coverage affect the policyholder?

opts.t: It cancels the senior's discount
opts.w: 长者折扣看的是有责事故，不是 Comprehensive 理赔。

opts.t: It triggers an Unlisted Driver Accident Premium
opts.w: UDAP 与未列名驾驶人有责事故有关，与 Comprehensive 无关。

opts.t: It has no effect on the policyholder's driver factor
It raises the driver factor like an at-fault crash
opts.w: 增补册明说 Comprehensive 理赔不影响 driver factor。

bank.note: Comprehensive 理赔不影响 driver factor。它还包风挡玻璃、撞动物、飞来物、故意破坏等；想要最全的自车保障，一般 Collision＋Comprehensive 都买。

bank.pt: 自车损失除外 · 找不是的
bank.stem: Collision and Comprehensive coverage do NOT apply to which of the following?

opts.t: Damage from rolling the vehicle into a ditch
opts.w: 翻车是 Collision 的承保风险。

opts.t: Tires slashed by vandals in a parking lot
opts.w: 轮胎因恶意毁损受损是除外里的例外，照赔。

opts.t: Fire damage to the engine compartment
opts.w: 火灾是 Comprehensive 的承保风险。

opts.t: A laptop stolen from the back seat

bank.note: Collision 与 Comprehensive 的除外：轮胎（除非火、盗、恶意毁损或与其他承保损失相关）、正常使用造成的损坏、车内物品、家人或雇员偷车、部分工业车辆。增补册例子：车窗没关、后座的皮夹克和现金被偷、车没损坏——无保障。

bank.pt: 配对：房子烧了车也烧了
bank.stem: An insured driver with Collision and Comprehensive returns from vacation to find her house burned down and her car in the garage badly damaged by the fire. Which Autoplan coverage responds to the car?

opts.t: Third-Party Liability
opts.w: TPL 赔的是对别人的责任，不赔自己的车。

opts.t: Comprehensive
Collision
opts.w: 火灾不是碰撞，归 Comprehensive。

opts.t: Basic Vehicle Damage
opts.w: BVD 管 BC 公路上的碰撞车损，火灾不在其内。

bank.note: 车被火烧属于碰撞以外的损失 → Comprehensive。房子另由家财险处理。

bank.stem: Which ICBC optional products are issued as individual policies bought separately, rather than listed on the Autoplan policy?

opts.t: Income Top-Up and the Specialized Coverages
Collision and Comprehensive
opts.w: 这两项和 Basic 写在同一张保单上，只是单独列价。

opts.t: RoadStar and Roadside Plus
opts.w: 这两个套餐也写在同一张保单上。

opts.t: Extended Third Party Liability and Loss of Use
opts.w: 这两项也写在同一张保单上。

bank.note: ICBC 的可选险大多与 Basic 写在同一张保单上、单独列价；Income Top-Up 与专项保障（Specialized Coverages）是单独的保单。向私营公司买可选险，则由对方另出一张保单。

bank.stem: Unlisted Driver Protection lets someone absent from the policy drive the vehicle:

opts.t: For up to 30 days each year, after a separate premium
opts.w: 天数是 12 天；而且新保单自动免费带上。

opts.t: Only when the registered owner is also in the vehicle
opts.w: UDP 没有车主必须同车的条件。

opts.t: For up to 12 days each year, subject to exclusions
For any number of days, if they hold a valid licence
opts.w: 有天数上限：一年最多 12 天。

bank.note: UDP：让没列名的人一年最多开 12 天（有除外）。新的 Basic 保单自动免费附带给登记车主或承租人；出过一次未列名驾驶人事故后，续保时要付费才能继续保有。

bank.pt: UDP 除外 · 找不是的
bank.stem: Unlisted Driver Protection does NOT apply when which of the following people, absent from the policy, causes a crash?

opts.t: A coworker of the owner from another company who drove once
opts.w: 别家公司的同事不是投保人的雇员，开一次，UDP 适用。

opts.t: The principal driver's adult son who lives at home
A neighbour who borrowed the car for the second time this year
opts.w: 邻居一年借第二次远低于 12 天，又不是家人或雇员，UDP 适用。

opts.t: A visiting friend with a valid licence and the owner's permission
opts.w: 持照、有许可的访客正是 UDP 要保的人。

bank.note: UDP 不适用（车主要付 UDAP）：主驾、登记车主或承租人的家庭成员或雇员；过去 12 个月开过投保人任一辆车超过 12 天的人；无照驾驶者；过去 5 年内在投保人车上已出过事的人（自 2019-09-01 起算）。

bank.pt: UDP 除外 · 常借车的朋友
bank.stem: Over the past 12 months Liam has borrowed his friend Zoe's car on about 20 days. He is absent from her policy and causes a crash. Zoe has Unlisted Driver Protection. What is the result?

opts.t: UDP does not apply, so ICBC denies all coverage for the crash
opts.w: UDP 不适用只意味着车主付 UDAP；Liam 有许可，仍是被保险人。

opts.t: UDP applies, because Liam had Zoe's permission each time
opts.w: 许可不够：12 个月内开超过 12 天就落入除外。

opts.t: UDP applies, because Liam is not a household member
opts.w: 不是家人也会被排除：这里触发的是 12 天的除外。

opts.t: UDP is excluded, so Zoe may owe the accident premium

bank.note: 过去 12 个月开投保人车超过 12 天的人，UDP 不适用；车主要付 Unlisted Driver Accident Premium。这种人本该列名。

bank.stem: For a private passenger vehicle, ICBC's Extended Third Party Liability can increase the coverage from the basic $200,000 up to:

opts.t: $1 million
opts.w: $1 million 是重型商用车的 Basic 起点。

opts.t: $5 million
$2 million
opts.w: $2 million 是运危险品重型车的 Basic 起点，不是私家车的上限。

opts.t: $10 million
opts.w: $10 million 是重型商用车可加到的上限。

bank.note: Extended TPL：私家车或轻型商用车从 $200,000 加到最高 $5 million；重型商用车从 $1 million 加到最高 $10 million；运危险品重型车从 $2 million 加到最高 $10 million。条款条件跟随 Basic TPL。

bank.stem: Grace, who has Extended Third Party Liability with a $2 million limit, causes a crash in Washington State and is sued for $900,000. How is the claim paid?

opts.t: Basic pays $200,000 and Extended TPL pays $700,000
Basic pays nothing because the crash was in the United States
opts.w: Basic 在美国照样提供 $200,000。

opts.t: Basic pays $200,000 and Grace pays $700,000 herself
opts.w: 她买了 $2 million Extended TPL，$700,000 在限额内。

opts.t: Extended TPL pays the full $900,000, because it replaces the Basic limit
opts.w: Extended 是在 Basic 之上加，不是替代。

bank.note: Basic 先付 $200,000，超过部分由 Extended TPL 接力，到所买的总限额为止：$900,000－$200,000＝$700,000。

bank.stem: A golf course operates licensed utility carts on its fairways, off any public highway. A cart injures a golfer. Which ICBC coverage is designed for this exposure?

opts.t: Enhanced Accident Benefits for the golfer
opts.w: 非公路撞到的人常常没有 EAB 资格，所以才需要这项可选险。

opts.t: Underinsured Motorist Protection
opts.w: UMP 保的是投保人自己被撞，不保投保人撞别人。

opts.t: Autoplan Basic Third Party Liability
opts.w: Basic TPL 对持牌非标准车辆的非公路使用不适用。

opts.t: Off-Highway Third Party Liability

bank.note: Off-Highway TPL：保持牌非标准车辆（高尔夫球车、多用途车、农用拖拉机、工业车）在非公路使用时对第三方的责任；Basic 与 Extended TPL 只在它们上公路时保。限额 $200,000／$1M／$2M／$3M／$5M 可选，没有免赔额。

bank.pt: 非公路 TPL 的免赔额
bank.stem: What deductible applies to ICBC's Off-Highway Third Party Liability coverage?

opts.t: $750 per claim
opts.w: $750 是逃逸险与法定逃逸财产损失的免赔额。

opts.t: $300 per occurrence
opts.w: $300 是 RoadStar 租车 Collision 的免赔额，与此无关。

opts.t: No deductible
A share equal to the policyholder's percentage of fault
opts.w: 按过错分摊免赔额是 BVD／Collision 的做法。

bank.note: Off-Highway TPL 没有免赔额。

bank.pt: Income Top-Up 的资格与方式
bank.stem: Farah lives in Richmond, owns no car and earns well above the income-replacement cap. Can she buy Income Top-Up, and how does it work?

opts.t: Yes; it pays a fixed $100,000 lump sum after any crash
opts.w: 它是加高计算收入替代的年收入上限，不是一次性给付。

opts.t: No, because it is sold only to non-residents who license a car in BC
opts.w: 非居民在 BC 上牌投保也能买，但它首先对全体 BC 居民开放。

opts.t: No, because only Autoplan policyholders can buy it
opts.w: 增补册明说不论有没有 ICBC 保单，BC 居民都能买。

opts.t: Yes; it lifts the income cap by up to $100,000 in tiers

bank.note: Income Top-Up：全体 BC 居民可买，不论有无 ICBC 保单；在 BC 上牌投保的非居民也可。把计算收入替代用的年收入上限最多再加 $100,000，分最多 10 档、每档 $10,000。适合收入高于上限又没有雇主收入保障的人。

bank.stem: Dev has Collision coverage on his car and asks whether he also needs Hit and Run coverage. What should the broker say?

opts.t: No, because hit-and-run damage is fully covered by Basic with no deductible
opts.w: 逃逸车损要靠 Collision 或可选的 Hit and Run，后者有 $750 免赔额。

opts.t: No, because Collision already pays for damage to his car caused by hit-and-run drivers
Yes, because Collision excludes damage by drivers who leave the scene
opts.w: Collision 明说包含被肇事逃逸撞坏的车损。

opts.t: Yes, because Basic Vehicle Damage pays only half of hit-and-run damage
opts.w: 这不是 BVD 的规则；问题是 Collision 已经覆盖。

bank.note: 买了 Collision 就已包含被逃逸司机撞坏的车损，不必另买。没买 Collision、又想保 BC 公路上的逃逸车损的，可买 Hit and Run：限额 $200,000、免赔额 $750（逃逸属可选，不在 Basic 里，KU-0050）。

bank.stem: Mia has Comprehensive coverage. Thieves steal all four wheels and tires from her car overnight, and she takes taxis for a week. Under the automatic Loss of Use coverage:

opts.t: Taxi fares are reimbursed from the day of the theft, with no deductible
opts.w: 触发条件不成立：只偷了零件。

opts.t: Taxi fares are reimbursed only if she also has Collision
opts.w: 这项随 Comprehensive 或 Specified Perils 自动附带，与 Collision 无关；但这里根本不触发。

opts.t: There is no loss-of-use coverage, because only part of the vehicle was stolen
Taxi fares are reimbursed, starting 72 hours after she reports the theft
opts.w: 自动使用损失只在整车被盗时才有；只偷轮胎不算。

bank.note: 买了 Comprehensive 或 Specified Perils，整车被盗时自动有使用损失保障（日额与总额不考，无免赔额），报警后 72 小时起算；只偷了零件（轮胎、发动机）不赔使用损失。

bank.pt: 自动使用损失何时开始
bank.stem: When does the automatic Loss of Use coverage for a stolen vehicle begin?

opts.t: 72 hours after the theft is reported to police
When ICBC agrees to settle the claim
opts.w: 那是保障结束的情形之一。

opts.t: 24 hours after the policyholder notifies the broker
opts.w: 起算点是向警方报案，等待期 72 小时。

opts.t: Immediately when the vehicle is discovered missing
opts.w: 要等报警后 72 小时。

bank.note: 整车被盗的自动使用损失：向警方报案后 72 小时起算；车找回且修好、ICBC 同意结案、或用满限额，三者以先到者为止。

bank.stem: Ben bought Optional Loss of Use with his Collision coverage ($500 deductible). After a minor crash, ICBC pays $300 under Basic Vehicle Damage and he has no own-damage claim. He rented a car for two days. Will Optional Loss of Use reimburse him?

opts.t: Yes, because the coverage has no deductible
opts.w: 没有免赔额，但理赔额必须高于自车险的免赔额，而且要有自车损失理赔。

opts.t: No, because it reimburses only public transit, never rentals
opts.w: 可选使用损失包括租同类车、出租车、网约车、公交。

opts.t: No, because reimbursement requires that ICBC pay an own-damage claim
Yes, because the coverage starts right after the crash
opts.w: 起算时间对，但除整车被盗外，要 ICBC 付过自车损失理赔才报销。

bank.note: 可选 Loss of Use（配 Collision、Comprehensive 或 Specified Perils 买）：事故后立即起算；可报租同类车、出租车或网约车、公交；除整车被盗外，只有 ICBC 付了自车损失理赔才报销；无免赔额，但理赔额要高于自车险免赔额。不适用于营运豪华车、出租车、租赁车、多用途车与越野车。

bank.pt: RoadStar 四件 · 找不是的
bank.stem: The RoadStar Package combines all of the following coverages EXCEPT:

opts.t: Vehicle travel protection
opts.w: 出行被盗保障是 RoadStar 四件之一。

opts.t: Lock, key and remote-transmitter protection
opts.w: 锁具钥匙遥控器是 RoadStar 四件之一。

opts.t: Rental-vehicle coverage
opts.w: 租车保障是 RoadStar 四件之一。

opts.t: Theft deductible waiver

bank.note: RoadStar 四件：加高使用损失、租车保障、出行被盗保障（Vehicle Travel Protection）、锁具钥匙遥控器。盗窃免赔额豁免是 Roadside Plus 加的三件之一。

bank.stem: Sandeep, a British Columbia resident with RoadStar, rents a car at the Calgary airport for a 12-day trip. The rental counter offers vehicle damage coverage. What should his broker have told him?

opts.t: He need not buy it; RoadStar covers rentals up to 30 days
He need not buy it, but only if the rental lasts under 7 days
opts.w: 期限是连续 30 天，不是 7 天。

opts.t: He must buy it, because RoadStar rental coverage applies only in BC
opts.w: 增补册没有这种地域限制；连续 30 天内都保。

opts.t: He must buy it, because RoadStar covers only liability on rental cars
opts.w: RoadStar 租车保障也含 Collision 与 Comprehensive。

bank.note: RoadStar 租车保障：连续 30 天内的租车或代步车，含第三方责任、UMP、使用损失、Collision 与 Comprehensive（各有免赔额，金额不考）、租车公司的租金损失索赔。有 RoadStar 就不必买租车公司的车损险。非 BC 居民不享租车保障与出行被盗保障。

bank.stem: Which RoadStar components are unavailable to policyholders who live outside British Columbia?

opts.t: All four components, because RoadStar is for residents only
opts.w: 说得太满：只有两件对非居民不开放。

opts.t: Rental Vehicle coverage and Vehicle Travel Protection
Lock re-keying and Vehicle Travel Protection
opts.w: 锁具一项非居民也能享；另一件不开放的是租车保障。

opts.t: Increased loss-of-use and lock re-keying
opts.w: 这两件非居民也能享。

bank.note: 非 BC 居民不享 RoadStar 的租车保障与出行被盗保障（Vehicle Travel Protection）。

bank.stem: The Parks drive their sedan from Prince George to Portland for a 10-day holiday, and the car is stolen there. They have RoadStar. Which costs can Vehicle Travel Protection help with?

opts.t: Living costs, bringing the car home, and travel home
Nothing, because the theft happened outside British Columbia
opts.w: 这项保障正是为出门在外车被盗设计的。

opts.t: Lost wages for the days they cannot return to work
opts.w: 增补册列的项目里没有工资损失。

opts.t: Only the cost of renting another vehicle
opts.w: 还有额外生活费、拖车、把车运回家、回家路费等。

bank.note: Vehicle Travel Protection：出门（度假、出差）在外车被盗，行程不超过 30 天；可报额外生活费、拖车、把车运回家、另租车、回家路费，以及对方有责且不是 ICBC 承保时的 Collision 免赔额（各项金额不考）。

bank.pt: Roadside Plus 的资格与构成
bank.stem: Which statement about the Roadside Plus package is correct?

opts.t: It is a four-part package sold as a cheaper alternative to RoadStar
opts.w: 它是七件套：RoadStar 四件提额，再加三件。

opts.t: It is available to any policyholder with Collision, whatever the vehicle
opts.w: 资格看的是 Comprehensive，而且限多数轿车、轻型商用车、房车（车队车辆都可）。

opts.t: It requires ICBC Comprehensive and adds three coverages to the RoadStar four
It replaces Comprehensive coverage with a roadside service plan
opts.w: 它不取代 Comprehensive，反而以 Comprehensive 为前提。

bank.note: Roadside Plus：买了 ICBC Comprehensive 的多数轿车、轻型商用车、房车可买，车队车辆一律可买；七件套＝RoadStar 四件提高限额＋目的地协助、盗窃免赔额豁免、路边应急费用报销。

bank.stem: Lucy's car is vandalized and cannot be driven while she is on her way to a job interview. She has Roadside Plus. Under Destination Assistance:

opts.t: ICBC pays for a rental car for the rest of the week
opts.w: 目的地协助明说不含租替代车。

opts.t: Her fare to the interview, if spent within 12 hours
ICBC pays only if the damage was caused by a collision
opts.w: 触发原因包括碰撞、盗窃或故意破坏。

opts.t: ICBC pays only if she calls a tow truck first
opts.w: 增补册没有这个条件；先自付交通费再申请报销。

bank.note: 目的地协助：车因碰撞、盗窃或故意破坏不能开时，付从现场到原目的地的交通（每次有上限，金额不考）；费用要在事故或发现盗窃破坏后 12 小时内发生，自付后向 ICBC 报销；租替代车不在内。

bank.stem: Under Roadside Plus, the theft deductible waiver means that when the vehicle is stolen or damaged in an attempted theft:

opts.t: ICBC waives the Collision deductible
opts.w: 豁免的是 Comprehensive 免赔额。

opts.t: ICBC waives the deductible only if the thief is caught
opts.w: 增补册没有这个条件。

opts.t: ICBC pays double the vehicle's actual cash value
opts.w: 豁免的是免赔额，不是加倍赔。

opts.t: ICBC waives the Comprehensive deductible

bank.note: 同时有 Roadside Plus 与 Comprehensive，车被盗或企图盗窃受损时，ICBC 免收 Comprehensive 免赔额。

bank.pt: 路边应急报销 · 找不是的
bank.stem: Emergency Roadside Expense Repayment may reimburse each of the following EXCEPT:

opts.t: A battery boost
opts.w: 搭电在列明可报的费用里。

opts.t: The cost of a new battery
Delivery of gas to the roadside
opts.w: 送油服务在列；不含油本身。

opts.t: Changing a flat tire
opts.w: 换爆胎在列；不含轮胎本身。

bank.note: 路边应急报销：车因保单平常不保的原因趴窝时的服务费——送油、搭电、开锁、拖车、换或补胎、紧急绞车、打车；不含零件、耗材、汽油、机油、电瓶、轮胎。每个保期最多 2 次，每次有上限（金额不考）。

bank.stem: To qualify for ICBC's New Vehicle Protection coverages, the vehicle must:

opts.t: Already have both Collision and Comprehensive coverage
Be a motorhome or other recreational vehicle
opts.w: 房车明确不能买这类保障。

opts.t: Have a gross vehicle weight above 5,500 kg
opts.w: 条件是 5,500 kg 及以下的私家车或轻型商用车。

opts.t: Be insured under a declared-value rating only
opts.w: 增补册没有这个条件；看的是车型、年款、总重和已买的自车险。

bank.note: 新车保障三种（新车重置升级、重置成本、限折旧）都要求车已买 Collision 与 Comprehensive；车须是私家车或总重 5,500 kg 及以下的轻型商用车；房车不行。否则自车损失只赔实际现金价值（ACV）。

bank.stem: Aiden's car is in its second model year and carries New Vehicle Replacement Plus. After a crash, repairs are estimated at 55 percent of its market value. What happens?

opts.t: ICBC treats it as a total loss only if damage reaches 90 percent
opts.w: 90% 是重置成本险可能用到的门槛，新车重置升级是 50%。

opts.t: ICBC repairs it with aftermarket parts, because it is not a write-off
opts.w: 55% 已超过 50% 门槛，按全损处理。

opts.t: ICBC pays the actual cash value less depreciation
opts.w: 这项保障就是为了避开折旧按重置价赔。

opts.t: ICBC treats it as a total loss and pays full replacement value

bank.note: New Vehicle Replacement Plus（第一、二个年款）：修理估价超过市值 50% 即按全损，赔全额重置价并计入通胀，可选同款新车、换车型或拿现金；不算全损时可用原厂新件修。

bank.stem: How does Replacement-Cost coverage differ from New Vehicle Replacement Plus?

opts.t: It depreciates the vehicle but adds inflation
opts.w: 重置成本险计通胀、不计折旧。

opts.t: It applies only to the first model year, at a 50 percent threshold
opts.w: 第一年款＋50% 更像新车重置升级；这一项是到第三年款。

opts.t: It runs to the third model year with no set loss percentage
It applies only to used vehicles bought from a dealer
opts.w: 增补册讲的是年款，不是新旧来源。

bank.note: Replacement-Cost：第一到第三个年款都可；没有固定的全损百分比，可能高到市值的 90%；计通胀、不计折旧。New Vehicle Replacement Plus 只到第二年款，门槛 50%。

bank.pt: 限折旧险的第三年款限制
bank.stem: Carla's car was in its third model year on the day her Limited-Depreciation coverage took effect. Later the car is written off. For which cause of loss does this coverage apply?

opts.t: A fire in the owner's garage
opts.w: 第三年款生效的，火灾全损不保。

opts.t: A theft from a parking lot
opts.w: 第三年款生效的，盗窃全损不保。

opts.t: Vandalism on a city street
opts.w: 第三年款生效的，故意破坏全损不保。

opts.t: A collision with a truck

bank.note: Limited-Depreciation：车不超过三个年款，全损时限制折旧。若生效当天已是第三个年款，火灾、盗窃、故意破坏、恶意毁损造成的全损不保；碰撞全损照保。

bank.stem: In the current year, which British Columbia–registered private passenger vehicle would ICBC generally treat as high-value?

opts.t: A 16-year-old coupe with an MSRP of $450,000
opts.w: MSRP 超 $400,000 的要在 14 个年款以内；16 年超了。

opts.t: A 4-year-old sedan with an MSRP of $160,000
A 9-year-old SUV with an MSRP of $180,000
opts.w: MSRP 超 $150,000 的要在 7 个年款以内；9 年超了，又不到 $400,000。

opts.t: A 2-year-old motorcycle with an MSRP of $200,000
opts.w: 摩托车、商用车、挂车、休闲车不在这个口径里。

bank.note: 一般口径：BC 注册私家车 MSRP 超 $150,000 且在近 7 个年款内，或 MSRP 超 $400,000 且在近 14 个年款内，为高价值车辆（Special Risk Own Damage 计划），保费较高；商用车、摩托车、挂车、休闲车不算。要买自车险须符合 Special Risk Own Damage Policy 的条件。

bank.stem: A collector keeps an unregistered project car on blocks in his garage and never drives or parks it on a highway. Which ICBC product suits it?

opts.t: A Binder for Owner's Interim Certificate
opts.w: 那是给省外新购车开回 BC 登记用的临时保险。

opts.t: A Vintage Motor Vehicle Certificate
opts.w: 古董车证书要求挂 vintage 牌并符合车龄等条件，而且是为上路活动设计的。

opts.t: A Storage Policy
Autoplan Basic, because every vehicle in BC must carry it
opts.w: Basic 是给上公路行驶的上牌车辆的。

bank.note: Storage Policy：为不在使用中的已登记或未登记车辆提供第三方责任与自车损失选项——不在公路、私家路或私人地产上行驶，也不停在公路上。增补册例子：冬季停在自家车道的房车被树枝砸坏。

bank.stem: A Kelowna resident buys a truck in Alberta and wants to drive it home to register it. Which ICBC product applies, and for how long can it be issued?

opts.t: An interim certificate valid for 1 to 31 days
A temporary binder valid for 14 days that must be followed by a full policy
opts.w: 14 天是 S.P.F. 下新购车的自动保障，不是 ICBC 的 APV38。

opts.t: A Storage Policy until the truck is registered
opts.w: Storage 是给不使用的车，这里要上路开回来。

opts.t: Unlisted Driver Protection on his existing policy
opts.w: UDP 解决的是未列名驾驶人，不是新购车临时保险。

bank.note: ICBC 的 Binder for Owner's Interim Certificate of Insurance（APV38）：BC 居民或在 BC 注册的机构在省外（加拿大或美国本土）新买的车开回 BC 登记期间用，1 到 31 天；保费看申报价值、所选保障与天数。它不一定允许车在别的辖区公路上行驶（可能要当地许可）。ICBC 用 binder 一词与第 2 章的通用义不同（KU-0035）。

bank.pt: 未上牌农用拖拉机证书
bank.stem: A farmer's unlicensed tractor must cross a public highway to reach a field on the other side. What does ICBC offer, and what condition applies?

opts.t: Full Autoplan Basic, after the tractor is licensed
opts.w: 这类农具按 MVA 不必上牌；证书正是为它们设计的。

opts.t: Off-Highway Third Party Liability, which also covers crossing roads
opts.w: Off-Highway TPL 保的是持牌非标准车辆的非公路使用。

opts.t: Blanket third-party liability under a certificate that must be carried in the tractor
Nothing; tractors crossing a road are covered by the farm liability policy
opts.w: 公路上那一段归车险，农场责任险不管（KU-0008）。

bank.note: Unlicensed Farm Tractor Certificate：为不必按 MVA 上牌的农用机具（如拖拉机）在公路上使用提供统保式第三方责任，证书必须随车携带；哪怕只是横穿公路也要有（KU-0008）。

bank.pt: 收藏车资格 · 找不是的
bank.stem: To qualify as a collector vehicle, each of the following is required EXCEPT:

opts.t: It is well maintained or restored to original specifications
opts.w: 保养良好或复原到原厂规格是条件之一。

opts.t: It is at least 25 years old with collectible value, or at least 15 years old and limited-production
opts.w: 车龄条件（25 年有收藏价值，或 15 年限量／停产）是条件之一。

opts.t: It is used only for pleasure purposes
opts.w: 只作休闲用途是三个条件之一。

opts.t: It displays vintage plates

bank.note: 收藏车（collector）三条件：至少 25 年且 ICBC 认可有收藏价值，或至少 15 年的限量／停产车型；保养良好或复原到原厂规格；只作休闲用途。挂 vintage 牌是古董车（Vintage Motor Vehicle Certificate，至少 30 年）的条件。

bank.pt: 古董车证书的用途限制
bank.stem: Ray insures his 1965 roadster, which has vintage plates, under a Vintage Motor Vehicle Certificate. Which trip is permitted?

opts.t: Driving it to a classic car club event
Lending it to a friend for a road trip
opts.w: 公路旅行不在允许用途内。

opts.t: Driving it to work on sunny days
opts.w: 通勤不在允许用途内，其他用途一律不许。

opts.t: Using it for weekend grocery shopping
opts.w: 购物不在允许用途内。

bank.note: 古董车证书只在去或在：指定检验点、修理保养点、游行或展览、车会活动、婚礼或毕业典礼、公共仪式（如道路桥梁开通）时有效，其他用途一律不许。不符合灯光等安全规定的只能白天开。

bank.pt: 保障条件 · 找不是的
bank.stem: Each of the following is listed as a prohibited use or breach of condition that allows ICBC to deny coverage EXCEPT:

opts.t: Refusing to take a breathalyzer or other roadside test
opts.w: 拒绝酒测或路边测试是列明的违反条件。

opts.t: Lending the vehicle to an unlisted driver for one day
Participating in a race or speed test
opts.w: 参加比赛或测速是列明的违反条件。

opts.t: Using the vehicle to tow an uninsured trailer
opts.w: 拖带无保险挂车是列明的违反条件。

bank.note: 列明的违反条件：违反 MVA 或其他法律的用途、超出保单允许用途、超期在别的辖区行驶、无有效驾照、犯罪中驾驶、逃避警察、比赛测速、拖无保险挂车、故意暴力（路怒）、酒后或药后驾驶（如酒测超 0.05）、拒绝酒测。借给未列名者开一天不违反条件（走 UDP／UDAP）。完整清单在 Insurance (Vehicle) Regulation s.55。

bank.pt: 违反条件的后果（Andrew 型）
bank.stem: While making a delivery, Pat causes a crash that injures another driver. Pat's licence expired four months earlier. Under the exam view of ICBC coverage conditions, what happens?

opts.t: ICBC pays the other driver, but Pat's own vehicle damage is unpaid and Pat must repay ICBC
ICBC refuses to pay anyone, including the injured driver
opts.w: 受害第三方照样获赔；ICBC 事后向 Pat 追偿。

opts.t: ICBC pays everything, because an expired licence is only a paperwork issue
opts.w: 考试口径把无有效驾照驾驶列为违反条件。

opts.t: ICBC pays Pat's vehicle damage and the injured driver's claim, then cancels the policy
opts.w: Pat 自己的车损不赔。

bank.note: 增补册 Andrew 例：违反条件（驾照过期）后，ICBC 照赔受害第三方，但不赔违约者自己的车，并向他追回付给第三方的钱。现行法：仅违反驾照限制或条件本身不构成违反（Reg s.55(3.1)，KU-0033），见第④节。

bank.stem: Nora drinks heavily at a party, drives off and rolls her car. Police notice she has been drinking but lay no charges. ICBC denies her own-damage claim. Is the denial consistent with the coverage conditions?

opts.t: No, because police must first record a breath test above 0.08
opts.w: 考试口径给的是 0.05 的例子，而且关键是无法正常控制车辆。

opts.t: Yes, but only if she has caused a previous crash
opts.w: 与以往事故记录无关。

opts.t: Yes; she was too impaired to control the car properly
No, because ICBC may deny only after an impaired-driving conviction
opts.w: 增补册 Ida 例：没被起诉照样可以拒赔。

bank.note: 增补册 Ida 例：醉到无法正常控制车辆，即使警方没有起诉，ICBC 也可拒赔她自己的车；被定罪酒驾或拒绝酒测同样拒赔。清单举例是酒测超过 0.05（现行法的判据见 KU-0032）。

bank.stem: In Canada, the regulation of insurance intermediaries such as agents and brokers is primarily a matter of:

opts.t: Federal jurisdiction under OSFI
opts.w: OSFI 管联邦注册保险公司的偿付能力，不管中介牌照。

opts.t: Each insurer's own agency contract
opts.w: 代理协议管交保费期限等，不是监管来源。

opts.t: Provincial jurisdiction
Joint federal and municipal rules
opts.w: 书中没有市政一层，中介监管是省的事。

bank.note: 书中原句：Regulation of insurance intermediaries is a provincial matter，由各省 Insurance Act 规定。

bank.stem: In British Columbia, which body has been delegated the administration of broker licensing, complaint handling and discipline?

opts.t: The Insurance Brokers Association of BC
opts.w: IBABC 是行业协会，不是监管者。

opts.t: The federal Superintendent of Financial Institutions
opts.w: 联邦层面管不着省内中介牌照。

opts.t: The Insurance Corporation of British Columbia
opts.w: ICBC 是政府车险公司，不管经纪人牌照。

opts.t: The Insurance Council of British Columbia

bank.note: BC、AB、SK、MB 四省把牌照、投诉、纪律委托给各自的 Insurance Council（练习卷第 88 题同型）。现行口径下 Council 依 Financial Institutions Act 行使这些职能（KU-0060）。

bank.stem: Insurance Councils with delegated licensing and discipline functions exist in all of the following provinces EXCEPT:

opts.t: Ontario
Saskatchewan
opts.w: 设 Insurance Council 的四省之一，陈述正确。

opts.t: Manitoba
opts.w: 设 Insurance Council 的四省之一，陈述正确。

opts.t: Alberta
opts.w: 设 Insurance Council 的四省之一，陈述正确。

bank.note: 设 Insurance Council 的是 BC、AB、SK、MB 四省；安省 1981 年立《Registered Insurance Brokers of Ontario Act》，由 RIBO 让经纪人自己制定和执行标准。

bank.stem: A self-employed person applying for a general insurance licence must be sponsored by:

opts.t: A licensed broker in another province
opts.w: 书中没有这种保荐方式。

opts.t: An insurer the applicant represents
The provincial brokers' association
opts.w: 协会不是法定保荐人。

opts.t: Any two clients who know the applicant
opts.w: 书中没有由客户担任保荐人的做法。

bank.note: 受雇者由雇用他的经纪行或保险人保荐；自雇者由他所代表的保险人保荐。

bank.stem: Under the British Columbia step licensing system described for the exam, which licence level is qualified to own and manage a brokerage?

opts.t: Level I
opts.w: Level I 只限办公室内、随时受监督。

opts.t: Level II
opts.w: Level II 能出门卖，但不能拥有或管理经纪行。

opts.t: Level III
Any level, after five years
opts.w: 书中没有凭年资取得的规定。

bank.note: 只有 Level III 可以 own and manage a brokerage。

bank.stem: A Level I licensee in British Columbia is asked to go to a car dealership to arrange automobile insurance for a customer. Under the exam rules, this is permitted only if:

opts.t: A Level III licensee goes along to supervise
opts.w: 例外不靠陪同，靠移动车险合同。

opts.t: The Level I has held the licence for one year
opts.w: 书中没有给 Level I 设年资条件。

opts.t: The customer signs a written consent form first
opts.w: 书中没有客户同意这个条件。

opts.t: The brokerage has an ICBC Mobile Auto Contract

bank.note: Level I 销售只限经纪行办公室；唯一例外是经纪行与 ICBC 签了 Mobile Auto Contract，可去车行办车险。现行 Council Rules 6(1) 已改成「修完 Council Rules Course 可外出」（KU-0059），但考试按书中口径答。

bank.stem: Which of the following statements about the step licensing system is NOT correct?

opts.t: Higher levels are granted on years of experience alone
The knowledge required increases with each licence level
opts.w: 书中原意，陈述正确。

opts.t: A Level II may sell outside the office but may not own a brokerage
opts.w: 书中原意，陈述正确。

opts.t: There are three levels of licence in British Columbia
opts.w: BC 确为三级，陈述正确。

bank.note: 练习卷第 89 题同型：分级制下每升一级要求的知识都更多，不是凭年资自动升级。

bank.stem: Brokers generally receive an All Classes (Other Than Life) licence. This means they:

opts.t: May sell any insurance, including life, once licensed
opts.w: 正好相反：寿险除外。

opts.t: May not sell other classes unless so licensed
May only sell personal lines, not commercial insurance
opts.w: 寿险以外的一般保险全部可卖。

opts.t: Must renew a separate licence for each class every year
opts.w: 书中没有逐类分别续牌的规定。

bank.note: All Classes (Other Than Life) 牌照的经纪人不得卖其他类别（如寿险），除非另有牌照；书中例子是安省卖旅行险要另领牌照。

bank.stem: For the exam, how is the licence term in British Columbia described?

opts.t: One year, renewed by writing a new examination
opts.w: 一年期是安省的例子，且续牌不靠再考。

opts.t: Three years, followed by full requalification
opts.w: 三年是新斯科舍的例子。

opts.t: Continuous, with an annual filing requirement
Lifetime licence, with no further filing at all
opts.w: BC 有年度申报要求。

bank.note: 书中：British Columbia - continuous with annual filing requirement；安省 1 年，新斯科舍 3 年。现行年度申报绑定 CE 与 E&O 确认，逾期 60 天自动注销（KU-0061）。

bank.stem: A broker licensed only in Alberta wants to place property insurance for a client's building located in British Columbia. Under the exam rules, what is required?

opts.t: Nothing, since one provincial licence is valid across Canada
opts.w: 书中明说每个做业务的省都要持牌。

opts.t: Only the client needs to be a resident of Alberta
opts.w: 与客户住哪无关，看在哪个省做业务。

opts.t: The insurer alone needs a BC licence, not the broker
opts.w: 经纪人也必须在该省持牌。

opts.t: The broker must also be licensed in British Columbia

bank.note: 经纪人在哪个省做业务，就要在哪个省持牌；考试口径还说保险人在某省承保财产，保单须由该省持牌经纪人副署并分佣。

bank.stem: In its simplest form, rebating involves:

opts.t: Returning part of the stated premium as an inducement
An insurer reducing a premium after a favourable claims-free review
opts.w: 保险人自己定的保费调整不是经纪人回扣。

opts.t: A broker refunding unearned premium when a policy is cancelled early
opts.w: 退未满期保费是合同结算，不是诱因。

opts.t: Paying a referral fee to another licensed broker for a new client
opts.w: 书中没把转介费定义为回扣（BC 现行法另有豁免）。

bank.note: 回扣＝把保单所列保费的一部分返还给投保人，作为购买诱因；也可以是钱以外的有价物。

bank.stem: A broker offers a commercial prospect a free one-year gym membership worth $1,200 if the prospect moves all of his business insurance to her brokerage. Under the exam rules, this is:

opts.t: Acceptable, because no cash is returned
opts.w: 回扣可以是钱以外的有价物。

opts.t: A form of rebating that may cost her the licence
Acceptable, if she records it as a business expense
opts.w: 记账方式不改变诱因性质。

opts.t: Tied selling, not rebating, and so it is allowed
opts.w: 搭售是把出单绑在另一张保单上，这里是给好处换业务；而且搭售也不许。

bank.note: 回扣也可以是给客户钱以外的有价物。价值足以构成购买诱因，就是回扣，可吊照。BC 现行 FIA s.79 允许低于保费 25% 的回扣（KU-0067），但考试按「多数省禁止」答。

bank.stem: Which of the following would NOT be considered rebating?

opts.t: Returning $300 cash to a client who buys the policy
opts.w: 现金返还作诱因，典型回扣。

opts.t: Giving a client a free weekend trip for buying a policy
opts.w: 有价物作诱因，也是回扣。

opts.t: Handing out coffee mugs with the brokerage logo
Paying a client's first month of premium if she signs
opts.w: 替客户付保费等于返还保费。

bank.note: 笔、咖啡杯、帽子等赠品，价值不足以构成购买诱因时，不算回扣。

bank.stem: A broker's licence can be revoked in each of the following situations EXCEPT when the broker:

opts.t: Is found guilty of misrepresentation or dishonesty
opts.w: 这是吊照事由之一（欺诈、不诚实）。

opts.t: Fails to remit premiums within the Agency Agreement term
opts.w: 这是吊照事由之一（逾期不交保费）。

opts.t: Places coverage with an unlicensed insurer improperly
opts.w: 这是吊照事由之一（违规用无牌保险人）。

opts.t: Applies a premium discount authorized by the insurer

bank.note: 练习卷第 90 题同型：保险人授权的折扣体现在保单保费里，不是经纪人私下返还保费，不算回扣；其余三项都是吊照事由。

bank.stem: A brokerage may face licence termination for failing to remit premiums to an insurer. The deadline for remitting premiums is set by:

opts.t: The Agency Agreement between the brokerage and the insurer
A fixed 30-day rule applied the same way in every province
opts.w: 书中说期限写在代理协议里，不是全国统一天数。

opts.t: The client, when the premium is first paid to the brokerage
opts.w: 客户不决定经纪行何时交给保险人。

opts.t: The provincial brokers' association in its annual bulletin
opts.w: 行业协会不定经纪行交保费的期限。

bank.note: 经纪行与保险人签代理协议时，交保费期限会写清楚；不合理地逾期不交是吊照事由 (c)。

bank.stem: Misuse of trust funds by a broker includes all of the following EXCEPT:

opts.t: Inadequate control of the brokerage's finances
opts.w: 这是书中列的三种挪用之一。

opts.t: Remitting client premiums to insurers on time
Misappropriation of clients' premium funds
opts.w: 这是书中列的三种挪用之一。

opts.t: Deliberate misrepresentation of trust positions
opts.w: 这是书中列的三种挪用之一。

bank.note: 经纪人把客户保费 in trust 持有至交给保险人；挪用包括财务控制不力、故意虚报信托头寸、侵占资金。按时交给保险人恰恰是义务本身。

bank.stem: The CCIR 2006 paper on managing conflicts of interest set out three fundamental principles for intermediaries. Which of the following is NOT one of them?

opts.t: The priority of the client's interest
opts.w: 这是 CCIR 三原则之一。

opts.t: Disclosure of conflicts or potential conflicts of interest
opts.w: 这是 CCIR 三原则之一。

opts.t: Lowest premium available
Product suitability
opts.w: 这是 CCIR 三原则之一，陈述正确。

bank.note: CCIR 2006 三原则：客户利益优先、披露实际或潜在利益冲突、产品适合性。「最低保费」不是原则（练习卷第 23 题也说经纪人不必总选最便宜的）。

bank.stem: A broker is convicted of a criminal offence that has nothing to do with insurance work. Under the integrity standard, this conviction:

opts.t: Is irrelevant, because it is unconnected with the broker's work
opts.w: 书中明列：即使与工作无关也算。

opts.t: Matters only to the broker's professional association
opts.w: 这是 Council 行为准则的诚信标准。

opts.t: Matters only if the offence involved a client's money
opts.w: 与客户钱有关的另列一条，但不是唯一情形。

opts.t: Is conduct found not to meet the integrity standard

bank.note: 诚信不达标的例子第一条：被判刑事犯罪，即使与经纪业务无关。

bank.stem: Taking improper advantage of a client's inexperience, youth, or lack of sophistication is a breach of which standard of conduct?

opts.t: Integrity
Fee Disclosure
opts.w: 收费披露管的是保费外收费。

opts.t: Encouraging Public Respect
opts.w: 这条管公众对行业的信心。

opts.t: Confidentiality
opts.w: 保密标准管的是客户信息，不是占客户便宜。

bank.note: 利用客户缺乏经验、教育、年轻或不老练占便宜，列在诚信（Integrity）标准下。

bank.stem: A personal lines broker is asked by a long-time client to arrange complex marine cargo insurance, an area she knows little about. Under the competence standard, what should she do?

opts.t: Accept and learn the product while handling the account
opts.w: 书中说超出能力时应拒绝代理。

opts.t: Decline and advise the client to seek a competent broker
Accept, as long as the insurer's underwriter approves it
opts.w: 承保人同意不等于经纪人称职。

opts.t: Accept, but charge an extra fee to cover her research time
opts.w: 收费不能弥补能力不足。

bank.note: 超出个人能力时，经纪人应当推掉这件事，并建议客户去找在该领域有能力的其他经纪人。

bank.stem: All of the following are examples of conduct found NOT to meet the quality of service standard EXCEPT:

opts.t: Failing to return client calls promptly and in detail
opts.w: 书中列的不达标例子。

opts.t: Failing to give sufficient notice of non-renewal
opts.w: 书中列的不达标例子。

opts.t: Recommending a costlier policy that fills a gap
Failing to tell clients about changes in policy terms
opts.w: 书中列的不达标例子。

bank.note: 服务质量要求至少等于通常审慎称职的经纪人；没有提供合适保险造成不合理缺口才是不达标。推荐能补缺口的保单正是尽责。

bank.stem: A broker receives a bonus from an insurer for placing business with it. Under the advising clients standard, the broker must disclose this to clients when:

opts.t: The bonus exceeds 10% of the commission
opts.w: 书中没有按奖金比例设的门槛。

opts.t: The policy premium is more than $5,000 a year
opts.w: 书中没有按保费金额设的门槛。

opts.t: The client asks in writing about commissions
opts.w: 书中没有「客户书面询问」这个条件。

opts.t: It favours that insurer to client detriment

bank.note: 激励或奖金如果影响了经纪人推荐某家保险人、而且是以牺牲客户利益为代价，就必须向客户披露。BC 现行 FPDR s.3 要求一律告知是否收佣（KU-0068），但考试按此口径答。

bank.stem: A broker tells a client she will issue his automobile policy only if he also buys his homeowners policy through her. This practice is known as:

opts.t: Tied selling
Rebating
opts.w: 回扣是返还保费或给有价物作诱因。

opts.t: Countersigning
opts.w: 副署是本省持牌经纪人签署保单。

opts.t: Re-marketing
opts.w: 重新询价转保不是这个意思。

bank.note: 把出车险保单作为购买另一张保单的条件，就是搭售（tied selling），经纪人不得参与或协助。

bank.stem: A broker stops acting for a client after the client moves his insurance elsewhere. Regarding the confidential information the client disclosed earlier, the broker:

opts.t: Is free to share it, since the relationship has ended
opts.w: 书中明说结束后仍有义务。

opts.t: Must keep it confidential even after ceasing to act
May share it only with other brokers at the agency
opts.w: 同事之间也只能按原目的使用。

opts.t: Must hand it over to the new broker automatically
opts.w: 没有自动移交的规定。

bank.note: 保密义务在经纪人不再为该客户服务之后仍然持续；信息只能按当初提供的目的分享。

bank.stem: A broker wants to charge a client a service fee in addition to the insurer's premium on an individual policy. Which requirement applies?

opts.t: The fee may be charged if it is below the commission
opts.w: 书中没有这种比较标准。

opts.t: The fee is prohibited in every case under the standard
opts.w: 书中允许收费，但要书面解释。

opts.t: It must be explained in writing with amount and reason
The fee needs only verbal mention when the policy is sold
opts.w: 书中要求书面，不是口头。

bank.note: 保费外的费用须事先书面清楚解释，包括金额和收费理由；说不出理由的费用被视为 unconscionable。

bank.stem: A broker learns of an apparent breach of insurance regulations by another licensee that is reasonably likely to cause someone serious damage. What should the broker do?

opts.t: Tell the affected clients to sue the other licensee
opts.w: 书中要求的是向监管报告。

opts.t: Stay silent, since it is not the broker's own conduct
opts.w: 书中说经纪人有义务向监管报告。

opts.t: Warn the other licensee privately and take no other step
opts.w: 私下提醒不能代替向监管报告。

opts.t: Report the matter to the proper regulatory authority

bank.note: 维护职业操守：可能造成严重损害的明显违规，经纪人有义务向主管监管机构报告。

bank.stem: A broker complies with all licensing laws but breaches the higher code of conduct of the provincial brokers' association. The most likely consequence from the association is:

opts.t: Termination of the broker's association membership
Revocation of the broker's licence by the association
opts.w: 协会不发牌，也不能吊照。

opts.t: A criminal charge laid under the provincial Insurance Act
opts.w: 违反协会准则不是刑事问题。

opts.t: No consequence, as association codes are only advisory
opts.w: 书中说可导致终止会籍。

bank.note: 协会标准一般高于法律；不遵守可能导致终止经纪人／经纪行的会籍。

bank.stem: How do the codes of conduct of provincial brokers' associations generally compare with the standards required by law?

opts.t: They are generally lower than legal requirements
opts.w: 正好相反：协会标准一般高于法律。

opts.t: They are generally higher than legal requirements
They are identical to the Insurance Act provisions
opts.w: 书中说协会标准更高。

opts.t: They apply only to brokerages, not to individuals
opts.w: 协会准则多是个人承诺。

bank.note: 考试口径：职业团体给自己定的行为标准，通常高于法律的要求；多以个人承诺的形式出现。

bank.stem: Which of the following is NOT listed in FOI as an exclusion common to both personal and commercial property policies?

opts.t: Earthquake
opts.w: 地震是 FOI 列出的常见除外之一。

opts.t: Sewer back-up
opts.w: 下水道倒灌也在常见除外清单里，有的保险人作为附加险提供。

opts.t: Theft
War
opts.w: 战争是常见除外，理由是可能危及保险人偿付能力。

bank.note: FOI 第 5 章常见除外：earthquake、flood、农业或工业烟雾、磨损与渐变、锈蚀、war、nuclear incident、法规执行导致的增加成本、sewer back-up。盗窃是常见承保风险，不在这张除外清单里。

bank.stem: According to FOI, which statement about earthquake and flood coverage is correct?

opts.t: They are automatically covered under every all risks property form
opts.w: all risks 保单同样有除外，地震与洪水正是常见除外。

opts.t: They are commonly excluded, but coverage is readily available
They can never be insured because the losses would be catastrophic
opts.w: FOI 说可另行购买；永不可保的是战争、核事故这一类。

opts.t: They can be insured only through a government disaster program
opts.w: FOI 口径是向保险人另买，不是只能靠政府项目。

bank.note: FOI 原意：even the broadest property policies contain exclusions；However, coverage for earthquake and flood is readily available。考试按这句答。实务另记：高风险洪泛区住宅洪水险可能买不到（KU-0066）。

bank.pt: 巨灾 · 地震引起的火灾
bank.stem: An earthquake breaks a gas line and the resulting fire burns the insured's home. The homeowners policy follows the IBC model wording and has no earthquake endorsement. What is covered?

opts.t: Both the shaking damage and the fire damage
opts.w: 地震震损本身仍在除外之内，没有加买地震附加险不赔。

opts.t: Nothing, because the earthquake is excluded
opts.w: 示范条款对地震引起的火灾或爆炸给出了例外：赔后续的火灾损失。

opts.t: Only the shaking damage, after the deductible
opts.w: 正好反了：震损除外，火灾损失才赔。

opts.t: Only the loss or damage caused by the fire

bank.note: IBC 1151 示范条款：earth movement 除外；但由此引发火灾或爆炸的，只赔火灾或爆炸造成的那部分损失。考试口径同时提醒：许多保险人在改条款，把地震后续损失一并除外——实务看具体保单。

bank.pt: 巨灾 · 疏散与额外生活费
bank.stem: Civil authorities order an evacuation after an earthquake. The insured's home is undamaged, and the policy does not cover earthquake. Is additional living expense payable?

opts.t: Yes, because civil authority orders are always covered
opts.w: 民政当局命令条款有前提：引起命令的风险必须是本保单承保的风险。

opts.t: No, because the peril causing the order is not insured
Yes, but only for the first 14 days
opts.w: 这不是条款逻辑；问题不在天数，在于引起命令的风险没保。

opts.t: No, because additional living expense requires a total loss
opts.w: 额外生活费不以全损为前提，房子没损也可能因疏散令而赔。

bank.note: FOI 第 6 章：民政当局下令禁止进入时可赔 ALE 与租金损失，前提是引起命令的风险是保单承保的风险；因地震疏散，除非保了地震，否则不赔。

bank.stem: Under OSFI's climate risk management guideline, the increasing frequency and severity of extreme weather events such as hailstorms and floods is classified as:

opts.t: Chronic physical risk
opts.w: 慢性物理风险指气候的长期渐变，例如海平面上升。

opts.t: Transition risk
opts.w: 转型风险来自向低碳经济调整中的政策、技术与市场变化。

opts.t: Acute physical risk
Liability risk
opts.w: 责任风险是物理与转型风险引出的索赔与诉讼，不是事件本身。

bank.note: OSFI B-15：物理风险分急性（极端事件更频更重）与慢性（长期渐变）；另有转型风险，两者都可能引出责任风险。

bank.pt: 气候风险 · 转型风险
bank.stem: New regulations to cut greenhouse gas emissions raise the cost of rebuilding damaged homes. For an insurer, this is best described as:

opts.t: A transition risk
An acute physical risk
opts.w: 急性物理风险是极端天气事件本身，这里的成本来自政策变化。

opts.t: A moral hazard of the insured
opts.w: 道德危险因素是投保人的主观特征，与政府法规无关。

opts.t: A chronic physical risk
opts.w: 慢性物理风险是气候本身的长期渐变，不是政策。

bank.note: OSFI B-15：transition risks 来自向低碳经济调整中的 government policies, legislation and regulation、技术进步与市场情绪变化。建筑规范收紧推高重建成本，属于转型风险。

bank.pt: 巨灾 · 损失估计会上修
bank.stem: The insured loss estimate for the November 2021 floods in British Columbia was raised from $515 million to $675 million. What does this mainly illustrate?

opts.t: Insurers overstate early estimates and later reduce them
opts.w: 方向反了：这次是上修，不是下调。

opts.t: Catastrophe loss figures are estimates revised as claims develop
Residential claims made up most of the increase
opts.w: IBC 说增量主要来自商业险索赔，许多住宅在买不到洪水险的区域。

opts.t: Government disaster aid is counted in insured losses
opts.w: 保险损失只算保险赔付，不含政府救助。

bank.note: IBC 2022-06-15：CatIQ 估计从 $515M 上调到 $675M，增量主要来自商业险索赔。巨灾损失是随定损推进不断修订的估计，引用要带日期。

bank.stem: A client whose home is in a high-risk floodplain in BC asks whether overland flood coverage can be added at renewal. What is the broker's best response?

opts.t: Confirm it can be added, since flood coverage is readily available
opts.w: 这是 FOI 的概括；高风险洪泛区住宅洪水险可能买不到，不能先承诺。

opts.t: Add sewer back-up coverage, which also covers rising river water
opts.w: 下水道倒灌与地表水／河水漫入是两个不同的保障口子。

opts.t: Ask the insurer whether it will offer the coverage there, then advise
Tell the client that flood damage can never be insured in BC
opts.w: 低中风险地段一般可以加购，说「永远不能保」同样是错误信息。

bank.note: 实务口径（KU-0066）：IBC 2022 与联邦 2026 进度报告都指出高风险区住宅洪水险可能买不到。正确做法是先向保险人确认能否承保、条件与免赔额，再书面告诉客户结果。

bank.stem: According to FOI, rebating is best described as:

opts.t: Returning part of the stated premium to the applicant as an inducement
Sharing part of a commission with another licensed broker for a referral
opts.w: 持牌人之间的转介费是另一回事，BC 法条还把它列为回扣的豁免。

opts.t: An insurer lowering the premium because the insured has no claims
opts.w: 保险人按费率规则给的无赔款优待是定价，不是经纪人回扣。

opts.t: A dividend paid to policyholders of a mutual insurance company
opts.w: 保单约定的分红不是回扣，BC 法条也明列为豁免。

bank.note: 考试口径：回扣（rebating）就是把保单上的一部分保费退给投保人，作为诱使其购买保险的好处；也可以是钱以外的有价物。

bank.stem: According to FOI, each of the following could be rebating EXCEPT:

opts.t: Returning $250 of the premium in cash after the sale
opts.w: FOI 的 Butler 例子正是这种返现，属于回扣。

opts.t: Giving a valuable gift card to win the policy
opts.w: 回扣也可以是钱以外的有价物，只要起购买诱因作用。

opts.t: Handing out pens and coffee mugs to all clients
Promising to pay back part of the premium at renewal
opts.w: 承诺返还部分保费同样是以保费返还作诱因。

bank.note: FOI：笔、咖啡杯、帽子这类赠品，价值不足以构成购买诱因，不算回扣。注意 BC 现行法条按「意在充当回扣的有价物」算，实务别拿「是礼品」当挡箭牌。

bank.pt: 回扣 · FOI 口径的态度
bank.stem: According to FOI, in the majority of provinces the practice of rebating is:

opts.t: Permitted as long as it is disclosed to the client in writing
opts.w: FOI 口径没有「书面披露即可」的说法。

opts.t: Permitted only on commercial policies, not on personal lines
opts.w: FOI 没有按险种区分。

opts.t: Prohibited, and it can lead to termination of the licence
Left entirely to each insurer's own agency agreement
opts.w: FOI 把它归为违反保险法规的行为，不是由代理协议决定。

bank.note: 考试口径：多数省份禁止持牌人给回扣；Butler 例子说返现可以成为吊销经纪人牌照的理由。考试按这句答；BC 现行另见 FIA s.79（KU-0067）。

bank.stem: Under British Columbia's Financial Institutions Act and its regulation, a rebate of premium is lawful only if it is:

opts.t: Equal to or less than 25% of the premium
opts.w: 条例原文是 must be less than 25%：等于 25% 不合法。

opts.t: Less than 10% of the premium
opts.w: 比例记错了；BC 条例写的是 25%。

opts.t: Less than 25% of the premium
Any amount, if disclosed in writing
opts.w: BC 有比例上限，书面披露不能让超限回扣变合法。

bank.note: FIA s.79(1)：禁止回扣，除非低于规定金额或比例；Financial Products Disclosure Regulation s.2：a rebate of premium must be less than 25% of the premium。

bank.stem: In BC, a client's annual premium is $1,200. Which cash rebate offered by the agent complies with the rebate rule?

opts.w: $300 正好是 25%，条例要求低于 25%。
$350 约为保费的 29%，超过 25% 的上限。
$480 是保费的 40%，远超 25% 的上限。

bank.note: 25% × $1,200 = $300；回扣必须低于这个数，所以 $290 合规，$300 不合规（FPDR s.2）。

bank.stem: Which of the following is expressly excluded from BC's rebate rule in the Financial Institutions Act?

opts.t: A cash refund to the client of 30% of the premium
opts.w: 超过 25% 上限，正是这条规则要禁止的。

opts.t: A gift card for the client worth 30% of the premium
opts.w: 意在充当回扣的有价物也计入，同样超限。

opts.t: A referral fee paid by one licensed agent to another
A discount promised by the agent before binding
opts.w: 代理承诺的折扣就是回扣的典型形态，不是豁免。

bank.note: FIA s.79(2) 三项豁免：(a) 保单约定的分红、盈余返还；(b) 持牌人为自己投保并按条件收常规佣金；(c) s.178(2) 持牌代理之间的转介费。

bank.stem: In British Columbia, the rule on rebates of premium is found in the:

opts.t: Insurance Act
opts.w: FOI 笼统说违反各省 Insurance Act；BC 的条文在 FIA，不在 Insurance Act。

opts.t: Financial Institutions Act
Insurance (Vehicle) Act
opts.w: 那部法管 ICBC 强制车险，不管回扣。

opts.t: Personal Information Protection Act
opts.w: 那是 BC 私营部门隐私法。

bank.note: BC 的回扣规则在 Financial Institutions Act s.79，配 Financial Products Disclosure Regulation s.2。FOI 说的 Insurance Act 是全国概括，对 BC 是错的出处。

bank.stem: Before the end of 2004, how did BC's Financial Institutions Act treat rebates of premium?

opts.t: Rebates were allowed up to half of the premium
opts.w: 2004 年之前没有比例空间，是全面禁止。

opts.t: Rebates, gifts, promotions and inducements were all prohibited
Rebates were allowed only on commercial lines of insurance
opts.w: 旧 s.79(1) 不分险种，一律禁止。

opts.t: Rebates were not addressed by any BC statute at that time
opts.w: 旧 s.79(1) 明文禁止，不是没有规定。

bank.note: BC Laws 时点版：2004-12-31 前的 s.79(1) 禁止 a rebate of premium or other gift, promotion or inducement；之后改为低于规定比例（25%）可以。FOI「多数省禁止」对 BC 描述的是 2004 年以前的状态。

bank.pt: 利益冲突 · CCIR 三原则
bank.stem: According to FOI, the CCIR 2006 paper on conflicts of interest set out each of the following principles for intermediaries EXCEPT:

opts.t: The priority of the client's interest
opts.w: 这是 CCIR 三原则的第一条，在列。

opts.t: Disclosure of conflicts or potential conflicts of interest
opts.w: 这是 CCIR 三原则的第二条，在列。

opts.t: Product suitability
opts.w: 这是 CCIR 三原则的第三条，在列。

opts.t: Placing business with the lowest-priced insurer

bank.note: FOI 第 15 章：CCIR 2006 三原则＝The Priority of the Client's Interest；Disclosure of Conflicts or Potential Conflicts of Interest；Product Suitability。「最低价」不是原则——适合性看的是需要，不是价格。

bank.stem: According to FOI, when must a broker disclose an incentive or bonus received for placing business with an insurer?

opts.t: Only when the bonus exceeds a fixed share of the commission earned
opts.w: FOI 没有按金额或比例设门槛。

opts.t: When it is a factor in recommending that insurer to the client's detriment
Only when the client specifically asks how the broker is paid by insurers
opts.w: FOI 口径不以客户主动询问为条件。

opts.t: Never, because commission arrangements are confidential business matters
opts.w: FOI 明确要求在特定条件下披露。

bank.note: 考试口径：经纪人从保险人那里拿到任何形式的激励或奖金，如果它影响了推荐、使客户吃亏，就必须向客户披露。BC 现行更宽：每笔交易都要告知是否由保险人付佣金（FPDR s.3(1)(c)）。

bank.stem: Which of the following is an example of tied selling?

opts.t: Offering a lower rate because the client has no claims history
opts.w: 这是按风险定价，不是搭售。

opts.t: Recommending an umbrella policy after reviewing the client's needs
opts.w: 基于需要的推荐不以买另一张单为出单条件。

opts.t: Issuing an auto policy only if the client also buys a home policy
Explaining that a multi-policy discount is available if wanted
opts.w: 可选的组合折扣不是强制条件。

bank.note: 考试口径：以客户购买另一份保险作为签发车险保单的条件，属于「搭售」（tied selling）——经纪人不得参与。

bank.pt: 披露 · 每笔交易三项
bank.stem: Under BC's Financial Products Disclosure Regulation, an insurance agent must disclose each of the following to the customer when providing a product EXCEPT:

opts.t: The name of the insurer whose product is being provided
The agent's relationship with that insurer
Whether the insurer pays the agent a commission or compensation
opts.w: s.3(1)(c) 要求——不论是否影响推荐。

opts.t: The agent's total income from all insurers in the past year

bank.note: FPDR s.3(1)：(a) 保险人名称；(b) 与保险人的关系；(c) 是否由保险人付佣金或报酬。没有要求披露个人总收入（分契保单另须披露佣金金额或估计）。

bank.stem: A realtor without an insurance licence refers a home buyer to an agent, and the agent pays the realtor a referral fee. Under the Insurance Council Code of Conduct, the agent must:

opts.t: Disclose the fee to the client in writing before arranging the insurance
Disclose the fee only if the client later asks about the referral
opts.w: Code 7.3.2 要求主动、事前、书面告知，不等客户问。

opts.t: Disclose the fee to the insurer, but not necessarily to the client
opts.w: 条款要求告知的对象是客户。

opts.t: Not disclose it, since referral fees are a private business matter
opts.w: 转介报酬恰恰是必须告诉客户的利益安排。

bank.note: Code 7.3.2：客户由无牌第三方转介，安排交易之前，书面告知客户付给转介人的任何费用或报酬；FPDR s.4(b) 同样要求交易前告知。付钱本身是否合法另看 FIA s.178。

bank.stem: Under the Code of Conduct, a fee an agent charges in addition to the policy premium must be disclosed in writing before the transaction, showing separately:

opts.t: The agent's fee only, since the premium is shown on the policy
opts.w: 条款要求三个金额分别列出，不只代理费。

opts.t: The insurer's premium, the agent's fee and any premium finance fee
The agent's commission rate and the insurer's expected profit
opts.w: 要列的是客户实际要付的各项金额，不是佣金率或利润。

opts.t: The total amount payable as a single combined figure
opts.w: 合并成一个总数正是条款要避免的。

bank.note: Code 7.3.3：保费之外另收的费用，交易前书面告知，并分别列出 total insurance premium、total additional fee charged by the agent、any premium finance fees charged by the agent。

bank.pt: 利益冲突 · 不可调和
bank.stem: Under the Insurance Council's conflict of interest guidelines, what should a licensee do when a conflict is irreconcilable?

opts.t: Proceed after obtaining the client's written consent
opts.w: 不可调和的冲突，即使客户同意也不应代理。

opts.t: Proceed, but disclose the conflict after the transaction
opts.w: 披露必须在客户决定之前；而且不可调和时根本不应代理。

opts.t: Decline to act, even if the client consents
Refer the matter to the insurer to decide
opts.w: 处理冲突是持牌人自己的责任，不能推给保险人决定。

bank.note: Code 附录 A 第 3 节：When there is an irreconcilable conflict …, the licensee should decline to act, even with consent。可以调和的冲突：事前书面披露＋取得知情、自愿的明示同意。

bank.pt: 利益冲突 · 表面冲突
bank.stem: Under the Insurance Council's guidelines, an apparent (perceived) conflict of interest exists when:

opts.t: The licensee has already acted against the client's interest
opts.w: 那是实际造成了损害；表面冲突不要求真的发生。

opts.t: A reasonable person would perceive a conflict, whether or not one exists
The licensee can foresee an interest arising at some point in the future
opts.w: 那是潜在冲突（potential）。

opts.t: The licensee knows of an interest strong enough to influence the work
opts.w: 那是实际冲突（real）。

bank.note: Code 附录 A：real＝已知有足以影响履职的利益；potential＝可以预见将来会有；apparent／perceived＝一个合理的人会认为存在冲突，whether or not this is, in fact, the case。

bank.pt: 利益冲突 · 转保原因
bank.stem: A general insurance agent moves a client to a new insurer at renewal, partly because the agency no longer represents the client's original insurer. What does the Council's guidance require?

opts.t: Nothing, if the new premium is the same or lower
opts.w: 保费没变也要告知；要告知的是转保原因。

opts.t: Disclosure only if it was the main reason for the change
opts.w: 条款写明：即使不是主要原因，也要告诉客户。

opts.t: Approval from the original insurer before the move
opts.w: 条款没有要求原保险人批准。

opts.t: Telling the client this reason, even if it is not the main one

bank.note: Code 附录 A 第 5 节 III：If the reason for moving a client … is because a general insurance licensee no longer represents the original insurance company, the client needs to be advised of this, even if it is not the primary reason for the change。

bank.pt: 核保 · 第一线核保人
bank.stem: According to FOI, brokers are often called "first line underwriters" because they:

opts.t: Have authority to bind any risk without the insurer's approval
opts.w: 经纪人一般没有任意承保权；有授权承保的是 MGA 一类获授权中介。

opts.t: Are first to assess whether a risk meets the insurer's eligibility rules
Set the premium rates for all complex commercial risks they submit
opts.w: FOI：复杂商业风险的费率全部由核保员定。

opts.t: Are employed by the insurer to inspect every property before binding
opts.w: 检验由保险人的外勤人员或独立检验机构做；经纪人不是保险人雇员。

bank.note: 考试口径：经纪人是最先评估客户风险、判断它是否符合保险人承保条件的人。决定权仍在保险人的核保员。

bank.stem: According to FOI, which statement about underwriters is correct?

opts.t: They must hold a Level 1 licence because they quote premiums
opts.w: FOI 说核保员不直接向公众销售，所以不需持牌。

opts.t: They are independent contractors hired by brokerages
opts.w: 核保员是保险公司雇员。

opts.t: They are insurer employees and are not required to be licensed
They report to the Insurance Council rather than to the insurer
opts.w: 核保员是保险公司员工，向保险人负责。

bank.note: 考试口径：核保员是保险公司雇员，不直接向消费者卖保险，所以不需要持牌。

bank.stem: According to FOI, underwriters get the information they need for risk selection from each of the following EXCEPT:

opts.t: The application
opts.w: 四个来源之一，常常已足够作初步判断。

opts.t: The insurer's loss experience data for that type of risk
opts.w: 四个来源之一：看过去 3 到 5 年该类风险的赔付。

opts.t: The insurer's annual premium tax return
Inspection reports
opts.w: 四个来源之一：外勤人员或独立检验机构的报告。

bank.note: FOI 第 4 章列出的四个来源：the application、the broker、loss experience data、inspection reports。保费税申报与风险选择无关。

bank.pt: 核保 · 物质危险因素
bank.stem: Which of the following is an example of a physical hazard as described in FOI?

opts.t: The applicant is in serious financial difficulty
opts.w: 财务状况是 moral hazard 的表现。

opts.t: Waste has accumulated throughout the building
The applicant's past claims appear to have been inflated
opts.w: 品行问题是 moral hazard 的表现。

opts.t: The applicant thinks loss prevention is pointless because of insurance
opts.w: FOI 把漠不关心也归入 moral hazard。

bank.note: FOI：physical hazards are conditions relating to the premises——建筑构造、占用性质、内务管理（housekeeping，如地毯翘起、废物堆积）。财务、品行、漠不关心都属于 moral hazard。

bank.pt: 核保 · 漠不关心归哪类
bank.stem: According to FOI, an applicant who refuses to make any effort to prevent losses because "everything's insured" demonstrates:

opts.t: A high level of physical hazard
opts.w: 物质危险因素是处所的客观条件，这里是投保人的态度。

opts.t: A high level of moral hazard
A speculative risk
opts.w: 投机风险是可能获利也可能亏损的风险，与投保人态度无关。

opts.t: An uninsurable peril
opts.w: peril 是致损原因，不是投保人的特征。

bank.note: 考试口径只分两类危险因素，把 indifference to loss 归入 moral hazard：投保人觉得「反正都保了」就不肯多花力气防损，说明道德危险很高。别的书常另称 morale hazard，按 FOI 口径选 moral。

bank.stem: According to FOI, an underwriter's decision on a risk may be any of the following EXCEPT:

opts.t: Accept the risk with an increase in the deductible
opts.w: 提高免赔额承保是五种决定之一。

opts.t: Accept the risk subject to certain conditions
opts.w: 附条件承保是五种决定之一。

opts.t: Accept the risk with a reduction in the rate
Reject the risk
opts.w: 拒保是五种决定的第一种。

bank.note: FOI 五种决定：reject；accept on the basis presented；accept with an increase in rate；accept with an increase in the deductible；accept subject to certain conditions。没有「降费承保」。

bank.pt: 核保 · 不实陈述须重要
bank.stem: Under BC's Insurance Act, a misrepresentation or failure to disclose by the insured in the application makes the contract void or voidable only if it is:

opts.t: Made intentionally, whether or not it matters
opts.w: s.17 的门槛是「对合同重要」，不是故意与否。

opts.t: Material to the contract
Discovered within one year of the policy being issued
opts.w: s.17 没有发现期限的条件。

opts.t: Contained in a document signed by the broker
opts.w: 谁签字不是条件；问题在于是否重要。

bank.note: BC Insurance Act s.17：A contract is not rendered void or voidable by reason of any misrepresentation, or any failure to disclose …, unless the misrepresentation or failure to disclose is material to the contract；重要与否是事实问题。

bank.stem: Under the Insurance Council Code of Conduct, if an agent is unable to renew a client's insurance on the same terms and conditions, the client should be notified at least how long before expiry?

opts.t: 15 days
opts.w: 15 天是法定条件里补交加费的期限，与续保通知无关。

opts.t: 30 days
opts.w: 比 Code 的要求短。

opts.t: 45 days
opts.w: 45 天出现在分契保单的保险人通知规则里，不是这一条。

opts.t: 60 days

bank.note: Code 7.3.12：Clients should be notified at least 60 days prior to the expiration of their existing insurance if you are unable to renew their insurance at the same terms and conditions。

bank.stem: How many modules make up the new edition (New Edition 1.0) of CAIB 1, as published by IBABC?

opts.w: 8 个模块的是新版 CAIB 2。
12 章是旧版 CAIB 1。
没有哪一版 CAIB 是 10 个模块或 10 章。

bank.note: IBABC 模块页：新版 CAIB 1 共 15 个模块（从 Purpose of Insurance Contracts 到 Travel Medical Insurance）；旧版是 12 章；新版 CAIB 2 是 8 个模块。

bank.pt: 新版 CAIB 1 · FOI 的缺口
bank.stem: Which new edition CAIB 1 module covers a topic that is entirely absent from FOI?

opts.t: Personal Liability Insurance
opts.w: FOI 第 9、10 章讲个人责任险。

opts.t: Regulation of Insurance Brokers
opts.w: FOI 第 15 章讲经纪人监管。

opts.t: Travel Medical Insurance
opts.w: FOI 第 11 章后半讲旅行险。

opts.t: Farm Insurance

bank.note: FOI 全书没有农场保险（KU-0002）；新版 CAIB 1 第 13 模块就是 Farm Insurance。从 FOI 转考新版 CAIB 1，这是最大的内容缺口。

bank.pt: 旧版 CAIB · 最后考试日
bank.stem: According to IBABC, what is the last day to write a previous edition CAIB exam?

opts.t: September 15, 2026
opts.w: 这是 2026-01 旧版报名表的说法，已被 2026-07-29 版报名表取代。

opts.t: December 31, 2026
opts.w: 这是 Insurance Council 认旧版资格的截止日，不是考试截止日。

opts.t: December 15, 2026
January 1, 2027
opts.w: 这是 Council 起只认新版的日期。

bank.note: IBABC：All CAIB Previous Edition exams must be written by December 15, 2026。两个日期管两件事：12-15 是能不能考（IBABC），12-31 是 Council 认不认（KU-0064）。

bank.stem: 按考试口径，保险公司破产、无力支付索赔时，PACICC 对单一事故的全部索赔赔付上限是多少？

opts.w: 这是 UMP 里常见的层级数字，不是 PACICC 的事故上限。两个数字分属完全不同的制度。
考试口径给的是 $250,000，翻倍是常见的凭印象作答。（现行 PACICC 按保单类别设上限，家财为 $545,000，但这不是本题问的考试口径。）

opts.t: 无上限，全额赔付
opts.w: PACICC 是行业互助兜底，不是无限担保。它靠所有参与公司按直接承保保费比例摊派，必须封顶。

bank.note:
PACICC 两个数字一起背：单一事故索赔上限 $250,000；未满期保费最多退 70%，且每张保单上限 $700。

⚠️ 以上是 2017 年版考试口径，考场按它答。现行实务（[PACICC Coverage](https://www.pacicc.ca/what-we-do/coverage/)，核于 2026-10-30）已改为按保单设上限：汽车险 $435,000、家财 $545,000、商业财产与商业责任 $400,000；未满期保费退 70%，按最多 $2,500 计、即每张保单最多 $1,750。BC 政府保险人卖的强制车险（ICBC Basic）不在保障内。

bank.stem: 按考试口径，保险公司破产后，PACICC 对未满期保费退还的规定是？

opts.t: 全额退还未满期保费
opts.w: PACICC 只退一部分。全额退还等于把破产成本完全转嫁给其他保险公司。

opts.t: 最多退 70%，每张保单上限 $700
最多退 70%，每张保单上限 $250,000
opts.w: 比例对了，上限套错——$250,000 是单一事故索赔上限，不是保费退还上限。

opts.t: 最多退 50%，每张保单上限 $700
opts.w: 上限对了，比例错。是 70% 不是 50%。

bank.note:
两个数字必须成对记：赔款 $250,000／保费 70% 且上限 $700。考题最爱把这两组交叉换位。

⚠️ 这是 2017 年版考试口径。现行实务（[PACICC Coverage](https://www.pacicc.ca/what-we-do/coverage/)，核于 2026-10-30）：仍退 70%，但计算基数上限为 $2,500，即每张保单最多退 $1,750。

bank.stem: OSFI（联邦金融机构监理办公室）在保险监管中的职责是什么？

opts.t: 向个人签发保险从业牌照
opts.w: 个人牌照由省级机构管（BC 省是 Insurance Council）。OSFI 管的是公司不是人。

opts.t: 按财务标准发牌并持续监控公司偿付能力
审批私营保险公司销售的合同条款
opts.w: 审批合同条款是省级 Superintendent of Insurance 的职责，依本省《Insurance Act》执行。

opts.t: 在保险公司破产时代为支付有效索赔
opts.w: 那是 PACICC 的职能。OSFI 是想办法别让公司破产，PACICC 是破产之后收拾残局。

bank.note: 一条线记住：OSFI 管公司财务、省 Superintendent 管合同条款、Insurance Council 管个人牌照、PACICC 管破产兜底。四个都容易互相当干扰项。

bank.stem: 关于经纪人持有保费的规定，下列说法除哪一项外都正确？

opts.t: 代理协议通常给经纪 30–60 天把保费汇给保险公司
opts.w: 这条是对的。考试口径给的行业惯例窗口就是 30–60 天。

opts.t: 多数省份要求经纪单独设立保费信托账户
安大略省要求保费存入独立信托账户，且不得晚于收到款项后三个银行日
opts.w: 这条是对的，且「三个银行日」是安省《Registered Insurance Broker's Act》的原文口径。

opts.t: 保险公司在保单到期前并未完全赚到保费
opts.w: 这条是对的，正是保险业受托性质（fiduciary）的基础——钱到期前还不算你的。

bank.note: 反着记：多数省份不要求单设信托账户，安大略是例外。「哪个省不一样」是这一节最爱考的角度。找例外题里，正确答案是那个「说反了」的选项。

bank.stem: 考试口径对 fiduciary（受托人）的定义口径是什么？

opts.t: 替别人管钱的人
受法律授权代表他人签署合同的人
opts.w: 那接近代理人（agent）的定义。受托关系的核心是钱不是签字权。

opts.t: 对保险公司负有首要义务的中介
opts.w: 那是 agent 与 broker 的区分（agent 代表保险公司），与受托性质是两个问题。

opts.t: 在破产时代为支付索赔的行业机构
opts.w: 那是 PACICC。它是机制不是身份。

bank.note: 定义要能背原文口径。受托的含义是：钱在你手上但不是你的，所以信任不能被滥用。

bank.stem: 依《Insurance Act》，保单必须载明的内容不包括下列哪一项？

opts.t: 合同当事人（Parties to the Contract）
opts.w: 属于必载六项之一。合同当事人不写清楚，出险时连「谁能索赔」都无法确定。

opts.t: 保险标的（Subject Matter of Insurance）
opts.w: 属于必载六项之一。保险标的不明确，承保范围就无从界定，是最基础的一项。

opts.t: 被保险人的信用评分与理赔历史评级
费率与所收保费（Rate and Premium Charged）
opts.w: 属于必载六项之一。费率与保费必须落在保单上，事后不能由保险公司单方追认。

bank.note: 必载六项：当事人／保险期间／赔款支付对象／承保类型与责任限额／费率与保费／保险标的。核保用的评级资料不是保单必载内容。另记一条：保单起讫时刻是被保险人地址所在地当地时间 12:01 a.m.。

bank.stem: 某保单对指定地点的保额为 $100,000。出险时为保全财产把部分财产搬到未列明地点，指定地点已发生损失 $85,000。搬出去的财产在未列明地点还能用多少保额？

opts.t: $100,000，未列明地点另享一份完整保额
opts.w: 这是本条最大的坑。搬移条款让保险自动延伸，但不另给一份保额——不是白得一份。

opts.t: $15,000，即原保额扣除已发生损失后的剩余
$85,000，按已发生损失等额延伸
opts.w: 方向反了。已发生的损失是被用掉的部分，不是可用的部分。

opts.t: $0，搬到未列明地点即失去保障
opts.w: 过头了。搬移条款的作用正是让保险自动延伸到未列明地点，只是保额要分。

bank.note: 考点就是「剩余」两个字：保额是被分走的，不是被复制的。

bank.stem: 保险公司行使代位求偿权（subrogation）向责任方追偿时，诉讼以谁的名义提起？

opts.t: 以被保险人的名义
以保险公司自己的名义
opts.w: 代位的本质是「站进被保险人的鞋子里」，承接的是对方原有的权利，因此用的是原权利人的名义。

opts.t: 以监管机构的名义
opts.w: 监管机构不参与民事追偿，代位是保险合同与侵权法之间的私法安排。

opts.t: 以保险公司与被保险人共同名义
opts.w: 考试口径给的是单一口径：以被保险人名义。共同名义是想当然的折中答案。

bank.note: 形象说法：subrogation 就是把自己放进别人的鞋子里（into another's shoes）。既然穿的是别人的鞋，走路当然用别人的名字。

bank.stem: 保险公司要放弃（waive）保单中的某项条款或条件，必须满足什么形式要件？

opts.t: 经保险公司口头确认即可
opts.w: 口头永远不够。这一条正是为了防止事后各执一词。

opts.t: 书面作出并由保险公司授权人员签署
由经纪人书面确认并转达被保险人
opts.w: 经纪人不是合同当事人，无权替保险公司弃权。这是最像的一个干扰项。

opts.t: 被保险人按时缴纳保费即视为默示弃权
opts.w: 缴费是被保险人的义务，与保险公司放弃权利毫无关系。

bank.note: 两个要件缺一不可：书面 + 授权人员签署。只做到其中一个都不成立。

bank.stem: 考试口径区分 agent 与 broker 的第一条法律标准是什么？

opts.t: 首要义务对谁：agent 代表保险公司，broker 代表客户
谁是保险合同的当事人：broker 是当事人，agent 不是
opts.w: 两者都不是合同当事人。合同当事人只有被保险人和保险公司——这句本身就是标准判断题素材。

opts.t: 是否持牌：broker 必须持牌，agent 不需要
opts.w: 两者都要持牌。持牌与否不是这一对概念的区分标准。

opts.t: 收入形式：agent 拿佣金，broker 拿服务费
opts.w: 考试口径没有按报酬形式区分，两者通常都是佣金制。

bank.note: 记法：Agent 的 A 站保险公司（insurer）那边，Broker 的 B 站买方（buyer）那边。第二条区别是代表几家公司：agent 一家，broker 通常多家。

bank.stem: 考试口径指出，E&O（错误与遗漏）索赔的头号原因是什么？

opts.t: 保费未按时汇交保险公司
opts.w: 属于财务违规，走的是监管处分路径，不是 E&O 索赔的主因。

opts.t: 承保不足或不当，占近 50%
未按客户要求及时出具保险凭证
opts.w: 是常见投诉，但不是索赔金额与数量的头号来源。

opts.t: 对保险公司隐瞒被保险人的既往理赔记录
opts.w: 那是对保险公司的义务违反，属另一条线；E&O 主要是对客户的责任。

bank.note: 法定标准是 reasonable skill, care and diligence（合理的技能、注意与勤勉）。违反并造成客户损失即可能被索赔，被告的是经纪人本人和经纪公司。

bank.stem: 考试口径开篇论证「保险不是像杂货、汽油那样的商品」。下列哪一项是考试口径给出的理由？

opts.t: 必须提出申请，风险不达标会被拒保
保险合同一经签订即不可撤销
opts.w: 考试口径没有这条，而且它本身就是错的——法定条件第 5 条就是终止条款，保单按程序可以解除。

opts.t: 保险由监管机构统一定价，人人价格相同
opts.w: 方向正好说反。考试口径给的第二条理由恰恰是价格因人而异、随承保风险变动。

opts.t: 保险是无形产品，价值只有出险后才能体现
opts.w: 听起来有理，但考试口径没有把无形性列为理由——它给的两条都落在「买得到吗」和「多少钱」上。

bank.note: 考试口径只给两条理由，都要能一句话说清：①必须申请（An application is required，风险不达标会被拒保）②价格因人而异（Cost not the same for all persons，费率随承保风险变动）。

bank.stem: 依《Insurance Act》对保险的定义，保险人的赔付形式是什么？

opts.t: 支付金钱或其他等值物
只能以现金方式支付
opts.w: 官方练习卷第 2 题就钉这一条。定义原文是 *pay a sum of money or other thing of value*——保险公司有权选择修理或更换而不是给钱。

opts.t: 只能修复或更换财产
opts.w: 另一个极端。金钱与实物两条路都在定义里。

opts.t: 由被保险人选择形式
opts.w: 选择权在保险人一侧（呼应法定条件 13 Replacement），不是被保险人。

bank.note:
定义拆出的五个要点（编号顺序会考）：
(i) 转移财务责任 (ii) 只在特定风险／危险发生时赔 (iii) 赔付以补偿为限 (iv) 只保可能发生的损失（故意的、已发生的不保） (v) 赔付可以是钱或其他等值物

第 (v) 条最爱考，因为直觉会觉得「保险就是赔钱」。

bank.stem: 保险法语境下，risk 与 peril 分别指什么？

opts.t: risk 是亏钱的可能性；peril 是造成损失的起因
risk 是造成损失的起因；peril 是亏钱的可能性
opts.w: 两个反了。peril ＝ cause of loss（火、风、冰雹），risk ＝ chance of financial loss。

opts.t: risk 是保险标的本身；peril 是承保范围
opts.w: 日常口语里 risk 确实被用来指「那栋楼」，但保险法定义里的 risk 不是这个意思。考试口径专门提醒过这个干扰点。

opts.t: 两者可互换使用，只是习惯用语不同
opts.w: 两者是不同层次的概念：一个是可能性，一个是起因。混用会让整个承保基础的讨论失焦。

bank.note:
Risk ＝ the chance of financial loss（亏钱的可能性）
Peril ＝ the cause of loss（起因：火、风、冰雹）

⚠️ 考试口径特意提醒：口语里 risk 也用来指保险标的（一栋楼），这是典型的干扰项设计点。答题按法定口径。

bank.stem: 考试口径列了保险的五大功能。其中被明写为「主要功能」的是哪一个？

opts.t: 分散风险，由多数人分摊少数人的损失
构成信用体系的基础，使贷款得以发放
opts.w: 这是五大功能之一，但不是主要功能。这类题的失分点不在知识，在没读清题干里的「主要」二字。

opts.t: 消除忧虑，让人敢于放心创业经营
opts.w: 同上，是功能之一但非主要。

opts.t: 推动行业主动防灾与减少损失
opts.w: 同上。官方练习卷第 1 题的四个选项恰好就是五功能里的四个——全都对，只有一个是「主要」。

bank.note:
五大功能，(i) 是 the major function，考试口径明写：
(i) Spread of Risk —— 少数人的损失由多数人分摊
(ii) 信用体系的基础（basis of credit）
(iii) 消除忧虑、鼓励创业
(iv) 防损与减损（loss prevention）
(v) 就业与投资资本的来源

⚠️ 这是一道「读题题」不是「知识题」：四个选项都对，题干问的是哪个最主要。考场上遇到全对的选项，回头看题干的限定词。

bank.stem: 按 FOI 5e（2017）第 1 章的概括，Mutual Company 的所有者是谁？考试口径怎样描述盈余处理？

opts.t: 保单持有人；以红利或费率调整返还他们
股东；以投资回报形式分配给股东
opts.w: 那是 Stock Company（股份制）。两种组织形式的分水岭就是「谁拥有它」。

opts.t: 政府；盈余上缴财政统筹使用
opts.w: 政府保险人是另一类（BC、SK、MB、QC 四省的强制汽车险），不是相互制。

opts.t: 管理层与员工；以奖金形式分配
opts.w: 这不是考试口径对 Mutual Company 的定义；本题以保单持有人所有制区别于股东所有制，不能把管理人员的报酬安排当作公司类型。

bank.note:
| | Stock | Mutual |
|---|---|---|
| 谁拥有 | 股东 | 保单持有人 |
| 首要目的 | 股东获利 | 尽可能低成本地提供保险 |
| 盈余去向 | 股东回报 | 红利或后续费率调整返还保单持有人 |

以上是 FOI 2017 的组织形式概括；实务中不保证某年必派盈余，实际返还与责任须核公司章程和保单安排。

bank.stem: 关于独立经纪制（Independent Brokerage），下列说法只有一项是错的，是哪一项？

opts.t: 销售人是保险公司的雇员
可以同时代表多家保险公司
opts.w: 这是对的，也是独立经纪制最核心的特征——它让经纪能给客户比较多家报价。

opts.t: 客户档案归经纪行自己所有
opts.w: 这是对的，而且是三种制度里最关键的一条区别：档案归谁，决定了换保险公司时客户跟谁走。

opts.t: 报酬形式是保险公司支付的佣金
opts.w: 这是对的。独立经纪不拿工资，收入来自保险公司支付的佣金——这也解释了他为什么能同时代表多家。

bank.note:
官方练习卷第 3 题问的就是这个，答案正是「独立经纪是保险公司的雇员」——独立经纪不是雇员，是独立业主。

三种制度就比三个维度：
| | Direct Writing | Independent Brokerage | Agency |
|---|---|---|---|
| 身份 | 保险公司雇员 | 独立业主 | 独立小业主 |
| 代表几家 | 只本家 | 可多家 | 只一家 |
| 客户档案 | 保险公司 | 经纪行自己 | 代理人自己 |

独立经纪制是主流：全加拿大 80%+ 的财产与责任险经此售出；BC/SK/MB 的强制政府汽车险也走这个渠道。

bank.stem: Lloyd's of London 是什么？

opts.t: 由承保人组成的市场，本身不做保险业务
英国规模最大、历史最久的保险公司
opts.w: Lloyd's 不是一家保险公司——这几乎是本节唯一的考点，而且正因为名字像公司才被反复考。

opts.t: 英国负责保险业务的官方监管机构
opts.w: 它是市场，不是监管者。

opts.t: 由各国再保险人组成的国际性协会
opts.w: 承保人在这里以自己的名义承担直接风险，不是一个协会组织。

bank.note:
Lloyd's 不是保险公司，是一个市场。承保人（underwriters）在其中以自己的名义承担风险。

两个配套术语：
· Syndicate（辛迪加）：多个承保成员（names）组成，由 underwriting agent 管理
· The Slip（承保条）：一张折叠纸，承保人各认一定比例，认满 100% 后送 Policy Signing Office；所有 Lloyd's 保单必须有该办公室的钢印

bank.stem: 「自己的行为伤到别人，法律让你在财务上负责」——这属于哪一类风险？

opts.t: Liability risk 责任风险
Personal risk 人身风险
opts.w: 人身风险指的是自己的健康或生命受损带来的财务后果，不是伤到别人。

opts.t: Property risk 财产风险
opts.w: 财产风险指自有财产灭失受损。伤到别人的财产属于责任风险。

opts.t: Speculative risk 投机风险
opts.w: 那是按「可不可保」分的另一套维度（可能亏也可能赚），不是三类别之一。

bank.note:
三类别：
· Personal —— 人本身就是最大资产，健康或生命受损几乎必然带来财务损失
· Property —— 自有财产灭失或受损
· Liability —— 自己的行为伤到别人，法律让你财务上负责

判据一句话：伤到自己 / 损失自己的东西 / 伤到别人。

bank.stem: 应对风险有四个选项。考试口径明确评为「最不实用」与「最常用最实用」的分别是哪两个？

opts.t: 最不实用是回避；最常用是转移
最不实用是自留；最常用是控制
opts.w: 两个都不对。自留（走免赔额、大企业自保）在实务里非常常用；控制则被考试口径指出不是完整方案。

opts.t: 最不实用是转移；最常用是控制
opts.w: 完全反了。转移（买保险）正是考试口径说的 *the most popular and practical means*。

opts.t: 最不实用是控制；最常用是自留
opts.w: 控制虽有局限但仍属实用手段；自留也不是最常用的那一个。

bank.note:
⚠️ 这一对最好出题，别记反：
· (i) Avoidance 回避 —— *generally not a practical method*，最不实用（卖掉店、不开车）
· (iv) Transfer 转移 —— *the most popular and practical means*，最常用（买保险）

中间两个：
· (ii) Controlling —— 装警报降低频率与严重度，但不是完整方案（预防不总管用；风雹雷根本控不住）
· (iii) Retention —— 自保、走免赔额；免赔额越高，自留越多

bank.stem: 投机风险（speculative risk）为什么不可保？

opts.t: 社会利益不容许人从自己的失败中获利
投机风险的发生概率无法用统计方法测算
opts.w: 理由不是技术性的。考试口径给的是公共政策层面的理由：不能让人从失败中获利。

opts.t: 投机风险造成的损失金额通常过大
opts.w: 与金额无关。小额的赌博也是投机风险，同样不可保。

opts.t: 投机风险属于故意行为，被保单除外
opts.w: 创业不是故意造成损失。不可保的理由在可能获利这一点上，不在故意与否。

bank.note:
· Speculative risk ＝ 可能亏也可能赚（创业、赌博、破产）→ 不可保
· Pure risk ＝ 只可能亏、不可能赚 → 只有它可保

考试口径的理由是公共政策性的：社会利益不容许人从自己的失败中获利。
如果创业失败能拿保险赔款，就等于鼓励失败。

bank.stem: 一切合同成立须具备五个要素。下列只有一项不是其中之一，是哪一项？

opts.t: Agreement 合意
opts.w: 是五要素之一：要约 + 无条件承诺，且须有 meeting of the minds。

opts.t: Consideration 对价
opts.w: 是五要素之一：有价值之物的交换。

opts.t: Written form 书面形式
Legal Capacity 缔约能力
opts.w: 是五要素之一：须是法律认可的有行为能力人。

bank.note:
五要素：Agreement / Consideration / Legality of Object / Legal Capacity / Genuine Intention。

⚠️ 书面形式不是合同成立的要件——考试口径明写「口头协议与书面同样有约束力」。这是最容易想当然的一条。

保险语境下的具体化：投保人的对价 ＝ 保费或承诺日后付保费。

bank.stem: 客户要求 $100 免赔额，保险公司按 $500 免赔额签发保单。合意成立了吗？

opts.t: 不成立。承诺须无条件，条件被改即无合意
成立。保单既已签发，视为客户默示接受
opts.w: 签发不等于合意。meeting of the minds 要求双方对同一内容达成一致——免赔额被改了，双方想的不是同一件事。

opts.t: 成立，但客户可在收到后十天内主张撤销
opts.w: 没有这个撤销期。问题不在「能不能反悔」，在合同根本没成立。

opts.t: 不成立，因为保险合同必须采用书面形式
opts.w: 结论对，理由错。考试口径明写口头协议同样有约束力，书面不是成立要件。真正的原因是承诺被附加了条件。

bank.note:
Agreement ＝ 要约 + 无条件承诺 + meeting of the minds。

改动了条款的「承诺」在法律上是一个新的要约，不是承诺。

考试口径给的三个判断点：
· 还在谈价 → 无合意
· 免赔额被改 → 无合意
· 口头协议 → 有约束力（别以为没签字就没事）

bank.stem: Genuine Intention（真实意思）会被四种情形影响。下列只有一项不在其中，是哪一项？

opts.t: Fraud 欺诈
opts.w: 是四种之一。欺诈使一方基于虚假信息作出意思表示，因此不是真实意思。

opts.t: Duress 胁迫
opts.w: 是四种之一。被胁迫签的合同不反映当事人的真实意愿，可被撤销。

opts.t: Negligence 过失
Concealment 隐瞒
opts.w: 是四种之一，在保险里尤其重要——它连着最大诚信原则。

bank.note:
四种：Fraud / Duress / Concealment / Mistake（欺诈／胁迫／隐瞒／错误）。

过失属于侵权法的范畴，与合同意思表示是两个体系——这是个跨章的干扰项，看着像却不在这张清单上。

bank.stem: 两家报价：Ajax $2,810，Atilla $3,000。Atilla 的经纪答应成交后退客户 $250 现金。这构成什么？

opts.t: Rebating 返佣，在多数省份违法且构成吊照事由
正常的商业折扣，只要在保单上如实载明即可
opts.w: FOI 口径：关键在于退的是保单上载明保费的一部分。载明 $3,000 却实收 $2,750，这正是返佣的定义，不因「说清楚了」而合法。（BC 现行另论：$250 只占保费约 8.3%，低于 25%，在 BC 是合法回扣——但这道题问的是 FOI 定性。）

opts.t: 佣金让渡，属于经纪与客户之间的私人约定
opts.w: 换个名字不改变性质。给予其他有价值之物同样构成返佣。

opts.t: 价格竞争行为，由市场监管而非保险监管处理
opts.w: FOI 口径：这是保险法下明列的吊照事由，由保险监管直接管，不归一般市场监管。（BC 现行的回扣规则在 Financial Institutions Act s.79，同样是保险监管体系，不是竞争法。）

bank.note:
考场答哪个：按 FOI 答 a。

Rebating ＝ 把保单载明保费的一部分退现给投保人，或给予其他有价值之物，以促成交易。

⚠️ 有一个例外：笔、马克杯、帽子这类小赠品，价值不足以构成购买诱因时不算返佣。判据是「这东西够不够让人为它改变决定」。

吊照六事由记忆抓手：骗／违法尤其返佣／欠汇保费／乱找没牌的保险人／不胜任不可信／动信托的钱。

⚠️ BC 现行口径不同（面对真客户时用）：FIA s.79＋Financial Products Disclosure Regulation s.2——回扣低于保费 25% 合法，等于或超过 25% 违法；意在充当回扣的有价物按回扣计入限额；保单约定分红、持牌人自保佣金、持牌代理之间的转介费豁免（KU-0067）。本例 $250／$3,000≈8.3%，在 BC 现行法下合法。

bank.stem: 经纪收取的保费在汇交保险人之前，法律上是什么性质的资金？挪用包括哪些情形？

opts.t: 信托款；含财务管控不力、虚报头寸、侵占资金
经纪行的营业收入；只有故意侵占才违规
opts.w: 两处都错。它从来不是经纪行的钱；而且财务管控不力本身就构成挪用，不需要有侵占的故意。

opts.t: 预收款项；须在 30 天内汇出否则违规
opts.w: 性质定错了。信托的意思是这笔钱自始就不属于你，不是「你的钱但要按期交出去」。

opts.t: 保证金；由监管机构统一托管
opts.w: 保费由经纪行替保险人持有、按代理协议上缴，不是交给监管机构统一托管。

bank.note:
信托款（trust funds）——自始不属于经纪行。

⚠️ 最容易被低估的一点：财务管控不力也算挪用，不需要有据为己有的故意。混用账户、账目不清，本身就是吊照事由。

考试口径就答到这里。BC 实务另记一句：BC 没有「经纪行必须单设保费信托账户」的一般性规定——Council Rules Rule 7(2) 要求代收保费不设负担、不挪作他用、扣除授权扣款后如数上缴；只有经无牌保险人安排的保费，Rule 7(11.1) 才明文要求存入加拿大金融机构的信托账户（KU-0084）。

bank.stem: 哪四个省把牌照、投诉与纪律事务下放给 Insurance Council？

opts.t: BC、AB、SK、MB
BC、AB、ON、QC
opts.w: 安省走的是另一条路——RIBO Act（1981），行业自治权限最大；魁省也不在这个名单上。

opts.t: BC、SK、MB、QC
opts.w: 把 AB 换成了 QC。BC、SK、MB、QC 是政府强制汽车险那张名单，不是 Council 名单。

opts.t: 全国十省一律采用 Council 制
opts.w: 各省安排差异很大，正是这一节的考点所在。

bank.note:
BC、AB、SK、MB 四省设 Insurance Council，负责牌照、投诉与纪律；其决定可上诉至 Superintendent。

⚠️ 两张四省名单极易混：
